Distinguish between what is explicitly stated and what must be inferred from clues in the text
topics.assessmentPrompt: After {{name}} reads a chapter of a novel, can they explain how a character was feeling and why — pointing to something the character said or did as their evidence?
topics.nameZh: 推断人物的情感与动机
topics.descriptionZh: 从独立阅读的文本中进行推断，例如根据人物的行为推断其情感、思想和动机，并用文本中的证据来支持推断
evidenceZh: 根据人物的行为和对话推断其情感或动机（例如：“她猛地摔上门——她心情如何？”）
通过引用或指出文本中的具体证据来证明推断的合理性
区分文本中明确陈述的内容和必须从文本线索中推断出的内容
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在 {{name}} 读完小说的一个章节后，他们能否解释某个人物的感受及其原因——并指出人物说过的话或做过的事作为证据？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Main Ideas & Note-Taking
topics.description: Identify main ideas drawn from more than one paragraph and summarise them; retrieve and record information from non-fiction texts using notes, tables or other methods
evidence: Read a multi-paragraph non-fiction text and state the main idea of each paragraph in one sentence
Summarise a text of 3+ paragraphs in 2-3 sentences capturing the key points
Retrieve specific information from a non-fiction text and record it using a simple table or notes (e.g., 'Name: hedgehog, Habitat: woodland, Diet: insects')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a long non-fiction article or chapter, can they pull out the most important points and write them as a short summary — rather than just copying chunks of text?
topics.descriptionZh: 从多个段落中提取主旨大意并进行总结；使用笔记、表格或其他方法从非虚构类（non-fiction）文本中检索并记录信息。
evidenceZh: 阅读包含多个段落的非虚构类文本，并用一句话概括每个段落的主旨大意
用2到3句话总结包含3个或以上段落的文本，准确抓住关键要点
从非虚构类文本中提取具体信息，并使用简单的表格或笔记进行记录（例如：‘名称：刺猬，栖息地：树林，食物：昆虫’）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}阅读长篇非虚构类文章或章节时，他们能否提取出最核心的要点并将其写成简短的摘要，而不是仅仅照抄大段文字？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Story Lessons and Morals
topics.description: Determine the central message, lesson, or moral of a story, fable, or folktale, explaining what the story teaches the reader and supporting the interpretation with key details from the text
evidence: State the lesson or moral of a fable in one sentence (e.g. 'The Tortoise and the Hare teaches that slow and steady wins the race')
Explain what a story's central message is using at least two details from the text as support
Distinguish the central message from a summary of events — explain what the story means, not just what happens
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a fable like "The Tortoise and the Hare", can {{name}} tell you the lesson the story is teaching — and point to a moment in the story that shows that lesson?
topics.descriptionZh: 确定故事、寓言或民间传说的核心主旨、教训或寓意，解释故事向读者传达的道理，并用文本中的关键细节来支持自己的理解。
evidenceZh: 用一句话概括寓言的教训或寓意（例如：“《龟兔赛跑》告诉我们，稳步坚持才能赢得比赛”）
至少使用文本中的两个细节作为支撑，解释故事的核心主旨是什么
区分核心主旨与事件摘要——解释故事的含义，而不仅仅是复述发生了什么
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 读完像《龟兔赛跑》这样的寓言后，{{name}}能说出这个故事教导的道理，并指出故事中体现这个道理的具体情节吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Text Features & Presentation
topics.description: Identify how language choices, text structure and presentational features (illustrations, diagrams, bold print, layout) contribute to the overall meaning and effect of a text
evidence: Explain how an author's word choices create a particular effect (e.g., 'The author uses "crept" instead of "walked" to make it feel sneaky and tense')
Identify how a text's structure helps the reader (e.g., 'The headings help you find information quickly', 'The story builds suspense before the ending')
Explain how a presentational feature contributes to meaning (e.g., 'The bold words are important vocabulary', 'The diagram shows how the water cycle works')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a page with headings, diagrams, or bold words, can they explain how those features help — like "the diagram shows the water cycle because the words alone are hard to picture"?
topics.descriptionZh: 识别语言选择、文本结构以及呈现特征（插图、图表、粗体字、版面布局）如何对文本的整体意义和效果产生贡献。
evidenceZh: 解释作者的选词如何产生特定效果（例如：“作者使用‘蹑手蹑脚地走’（crept）而不是‘走’（walked），让气氛显得偷偷摸摸且紧张”）
识别文本结构如何帮助读者（例如：“标题（headings）帮助你快速找到信息”，“故事在结尾前制造悬念”）
解释呈现特征（presentational features）如何有助于表达含义（例如：“粗体字（bold print）是重要词汇”，“图表（diagram）展示了水循环（water cycle）的过程”）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}阅读带有标题、图表或粗体字的页面时，他们能否解释这些特征是如何提供帮助的——比如“图表展示了水循环，因为仅靠文字很难想象出来”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Themes and messages
topics.description: Identify recurring themes (good vs evil, friendship, bravery) and conventions (once upon a time, moral at the end, hero's journey) across a wide range of books including fairy stories, myths, legends and traditional tales
evidence: Identify a common theme across two different stories (e.g., 'Both "Jack and the Beanstalk" and "The Three Billy Goats Gruff" are about bravery overcoming a threat')
Name literary conventions found in fairy tales and myths (e.g., 'once upon a time', magical numbers like three, a quest or journey, good triumphing over evil)
Explain how the same theme can appear in different genres (e.g., friendship in a realistic story vs a myth)
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a few different fairy tales or myths, can {{name}} spot patterns — like "the hero always faces three challenges" or "good always wins in the end" — across the different stories?
topics.descriptionZh: 能够识别各类书籍（包括童话故事、神话、传说和传统民间故事）中反复出现的主题（如善恶对立、友谊、勇敢）和文学惯例（如“从前……”、篇末说理、英雄之旅）。
evidenceZh: 识别两个不同故事中的共同主题（例如：“《杰克与魔豆》和《三只山羊嘎拉嘎拉》都讲述了勇敢战胜威胁的故事”）
说出童话和神话中常见的文学惯例（例如：“从前……”、像“三”这样的魔法数字、探险或旅程、正义战胜邪恶）
解释同一个主题如何出现在不同的体裁中（例如：现实故事与神话中的友谊）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读了几个不同的童话或神话故事后，{{name}} 能发现不同故事中的规律吗——比如“英雄总是面临三次挑战”或“正义最终总是会获胜”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Character Traits and Motivation
topics.description: Analyse character traits, motivations, and feelings using text evidence, and distinguish one's own point of view from that of the narrator or characters
evidence: Identify two character traits from a story and cite the specific actions or dialogue that reveal each trait
Explain why a character made a particular decision by linking their motivation to events in the text
Describe where one's own opinion about a character differs from the narrator's portrayal and explain why
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a story, can they describe why a character made a particular choice — explaining their motivations — and also say whether they personally agree with what the character did?
topics.descriptionZh: 运用文本证据分析角色的性格特征、动机和情感，并区分自己的观点与叙述者或角色的观点
evidenceZh: 从故事中找出角色的两个性格特征，并引用揭示每个特征的具体行为或对话
通过将角色的动机与文本中的事件联系起来，解释角色做出某一特定决定的原因
描述自己对某一角色的看法与叙述者刻画该角色的角度有何不同，并解释原因
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}阅读故事时，他们能否描述角色为何做出特定选择——解释其动机——并说明他们自己是否认同角色的做法？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Connecting Ideas in Texts
topics.description: Describe connections between events, ideas, or concepts in informational text using time, sequence, cause-and-effect, and comparison language, and identify logical connections between sentences and paragraphs
evidence: Read a science text and identify three cause-and-effect relationships using signal words like 'because', 'as a result'
Explain the sequence of steps in a technical procedure using time-order language ('first', 'next', 'finally')
Describe how two paragraphs in a text are connected (e.g. comparison, cause/effect, or sequence)
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a non-fiction passage — like one about climate or history — can {{name}} explain what caused something to happen, what the effect was, and how the author linked those ideas together?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用表示时间、顺序、因果 (cause-and-effect) 和比较的语言，描述信息类文本 (informational text) 中事件、观点或概念之间的联系，并识别句子和段落之间的逻辑联系。
evidenceZh: 阅读科学文本，并使用“因为”、“结果是”等提示词 (signal words) 找出三个因果关系。
使用表示时间顺序的语言（如“首先”、“其次”、“最后”）解释技术操作步骤的顺序。
描述文本中两个段落是如何连接的（例如：比较、因果或顺序）。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读了一篇非虚构类文章（例如关于气候或历史的文章）后，{{name}}能否解释导致某事发生的原因、产生的结果，以及作者是如何将这些观点联系在一起的？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Morals in Fables, Folktales and Myths
topics.description: Explain how the central message, lesson, or moral of a story is conveyed through key details across diverse text types including fables, folktales, and myths
evidence: Retell a fable and identify the moral, citing three key details that convey it
Compare how two myths from different cultures convey a similar central message through different events
Explain the difference between the topic of a story and its central message or lesson
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a myth or folktale from another culture, can {{name}} explain what lesson or value it was teaching — and say which details in the story showed that?
topics.nameZh: 寓言、民间故事与神话中的寓意
topics.descriptionZh: 解释故事的中心思想、教训或寓意是如何通过关键细节在不同的文本类型（包括寓言、民间故事和神话）中传达出来的
evidenceZh: 复述一个寓言并指出其寓意，引用传达该寓意的三个关键细节
比较来自不同文化的两个神话是如何通过不同的事件传达相似的中心思想的
解释故事的主题与其中心思想或教训之间的区别
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读了来自其他文化的神话或民间故事后，{{name}}能否解释该故事所传达的教训或价值观，并指出故事中是哪些细节体现了这一点？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Structural terminology
topics.description: Use structural terminology (chapter, scene, stanza) to refer to parts of literary texts and describe how each successive part builds on earlier sections
evidence: Identify chapters, scenes, or stanzas in a given text and use the correct term for each
Explain how the second stanza of a poem builds on the mood established in the first
Describe how a specific chapter advances the plot by referring to events in earlier chapters
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} talks about a book they're reading, do they use words like "chapter", "stanza", or "scene" correctly — and can they explain how a later chapter builds on what happened earlier?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用结构术语（章、场、节）来指代文学文本的各个部分，并描述每一个后续部分如何建立在前面部分的基础之上。
evidenceZh: 在给定的文本中识别章、场或节，并为每个部分使用正确的术语
解释诗歌的第二节如何建立在第一节所奠定的情感基调之上
通过提及前面章节中的事件，描述特定章节如何推动故事情节发展
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}谈论他们正在阅读的书时，他们是否能正确使用“章”、“节”或“场”等词语——并且能否解释后面的章节是如何建立在前面发生的内容之上的？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Why the author wrote it
topics.description: Distinguish one's own point of view from that of the author of an informational text and identify the author's purpose
evidence: Read an opinion article and state the author's point of view, then state one's own and explain how they differ
Identify whether an author's purpose is to inform, persuade, or entertain, citing evidence from the text
Explain how word choices in an informational text reveal the author's attitude toward the topic
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a fact book or an article, can they tell you what the author's purpose was — like whether they were trying to inform, persuade, or entertain — and whether they agree with the author's viewpoint?
topics.descriptionZh: 区分自己在信息类文本中的观点与作者的观点，并识别作者的写作目的
evidenceZh: 阅读一篇观点类文章，陈述作者的观点，然后陈述自己的观点并解释两者的不同之处
判断作者的目的是为了提供信息 (inform)、说服 (persuade) 还是娱乐 (entertain)，并引用文本中的证据
解释信息类文本中的词语选择 (word choices) 如何揭示作者对该主题的态度
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 阅读事实类书籍或文章时，他们能告诉你作者的写作目的吗——比如是为了提供信息 (inform)、说服 (persuade) 还是娱乐 (entertain)——以及他们是否同意作者的观点？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Combining information from texts
topics.description: Integrate information from two texts on the same topic in order to write or speak about the subject knowledgeably, combining and comparing what each source contributes
evidence: Read two informational texts on the same topic and identify information that appears in both, information unique to each, and any contradictions between them
Combine key details from two sources into a coherent summary or short report that draws on both texts
Explain how reading a second text on the same topic added to, confirmed, or challenged understanding gained from the first text
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is researching a topic using two different books or articles, can they combine the information they've gathered from both to talk or write about the subject more fully than either source alone?
topics.descriptionZh: 整合关于同一主题的两篇文本信息，以便能够有见地(knowledgeably)地进行写作或口头表达，综合并比较各个来源所提供的内容。
evidenceZh: 阅读同一主题的两篇信息类文本(informational texts)，识别两篇文本中共有的信息、各自独有的信息以及它们之间的任何矛盾
将两个来源的关键细节结合起来，形成一篇连贯的摘要或简短报告，并综合两篇文本的内容
解释阅读同一主题的第二篇文本如何增加、证实或挑战从第一篇文本中获得的认知
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 正在使用两本不同的书或文章研究一个主题，他们能否将从两者中收集到的信息结合起来，从而比单独使用任何一个来源都能更全面地谈论或撰写该主题？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Cultural Allusions and Word Meaning
topics.description: Determine the meaning of words and phrases as used in literary texts, including understanding references to mythology and cultural allusions (e.g., Herculean, Achilles' heel)
evidence: Explain the meaning of an allusion drawn from mythology when encountered in a text, e.g. identify that 'Herculean task' means an extremely difficult task, referencing Hercules' legendary labours
Use context and knowledge of word parts to determine the meaning of unfamiliar words in a poem or story, explaining how the word contributes to tone or meaning
Identify when an author is using a word figuratively rather than literally and explain the intended meaning in context
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a story that mentions something like "a Herculean task" or "an Achilles heel", can they work out what it means — or look it up and explain the mythological reference behind it?
topics.descriptionZh: 确定文学作品（literary texts）中词语和短语的含义，包括理解对神话（mythology）和文化典故（cultural allusions）的引用（例如：海格力斯般的（Herculean）、阿喀琉斯之踵（Achilles' heel））。
evidenceZh: 在阅读文本时，解释其中源自神话的典故含义，例如识别出“海格力斯般的任务”（Herculean task）意味着极其困难的任务，并关联海格力斯（Hercules）传说中的艰苦劳作。
利用上下文和构词法知识（knowledge of word parts）推断诗歌或故事中陌生词汇的含义，并解释该词语如何有助于塑造语调（tone）或深化含义。
识别作者何时使用词语的比喻义（figuratively）而非字面义（literally），并解释其在具体语境中的实际含义。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 阅读到提及“海格力斯般的任务”（a Herculean task）或“阿喀琉斯之踵”（an Achilles heel）等内容的故事时，他们能否推断出其中的含义——或者通过查阅资料并解释其背后的神话典故（mythological reference）？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Explaining Events & Ideas
topics.description: Explain events, procedures, ideas, or concepts in an informational text, including what happened and why, by citing specific textual evidence about causes, effects, and steps in a process
evidence: Explain a historical event described in an informational text by identifying both what happened and the causes leading to it, using specific details from the text
Describe the steps in a procedure or process presented in an informational text, explaining why each step is necessary based on information in the text
Identify cause-and-effect relationships between ideas or events in an informational passage and explain them using evidence from the text
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a non-fiction article that explains how something works — like how volcanoes form — can {{name}} write down the main steps or causes in their own words, citing the specific evidence the author used?
topics.descriptionZh: 在信息类文本（informational text）中解释事件、程序、观点或概念，包括发生了什么以及为什么发生，并通过引用关于原因、结果和过程步骤的具体文本证据来进行说明。
evidenceZh: 通过识别信息类文本中描述的历史事件发生了什么以及导致该事件的原因，并使用文本中的具体细节来解释该历史事件
描述信息类文本中呈现的程序或过程中的步骤，并根据文本中的信息解释为什么每个步骤都是必要的
识别信息类文本段落中观点或事件之间的因果关系（cause-and-effect relationships），并使用文本中的证据进行解释
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读了一篇解释某事物运作原理（例如火山是如何形成的）的非虚构（non-fiction）文章后，{{name}} 能否用自己的话写下主要步骤或原因，并引用作者使用的具体证据？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Finding Theme and Summarising
topics.description: Determine the theme of a story, drama, or poem from details in the text, and provide an objective summary that captures the key events without personal opinions
evidence: Identify the theme of a story (e.g. courage, friendship, overcoming adversity) by examining what characters learn, how they change, and what the author emphasises across the whole text
Distinguish theme from topic: explain that a topic might be 'war' while the theme is 'the cost of conflict on families'
Summarise a story, chapter, or poem objectively, including only key events and details without inserting personal opinions or minor details
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a novel or a poem, can {{name}} explain the theme — like "it's about not giving up" — and then write a brief summary of the plot without mixing it up with their own opinions?
topics.descriptionZh: 根据文本细节确定故事、戏剧或诗歌的主题，并提供客观的总结，抓住关键事件而不掺杂个人意见
evidenceZh: 通过考察人物学到了什么、如何改变以及作者在整个文本中强调的内容，来识别故事的主题（如勇气、友谊、克服逆境）
区分主题与题材：解释题材可能是“战争”，而主题是“冲突对家庭造成的代价”
客观地总结故事、章节或诗歌，仅包含关键事件和细节，不插入个人意见或次要细节
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读小说或诗歌后，{{name}} 能否解释主题——比如“这是关于永不放弃的”——然后写一个简短的情节总结，而不将其与自己的观点混淆？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Firsthand and Secondhand Accounts
topics.description: Compare and contrast a firsthand account (autobiography, diary, letter) with a secondhand account (biography, textbook, news report) of the same event or topic, identifying differences in focus and information provided
evidence: Explain the difference between a firsthand account (written by someone who experienced the event) and a secondhand account (written by someone who researched it), using specific examples
Compare a diary entry and a textbook passage about the same historical event, identifying what each account includes, omits, and emphasises
Analyse how the perspective of the writer (participant vs observer/researcher) affects the information provided, the language used, and the overall tone
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} reads both a diary entry by someone who was at a historical event and a textbook account of the same event, can they explain what's different about the two — like what details each one includes and why?
topics.descriptionZh: 比较和对比同一事件或主题的第一手资料（自传、日记、信件）与第二手资料（传记、教科书、新闻报道），找出两者在关注点和所提供信息方面的差异
evidenceZh: 解释第一手资料（由事件亲历者撰写）与第二手资料（由进行研究的人撰写）之间的区别，并使用具体例子
比较关于同一历史事件的日记条目和教科书段落，找出每种资料包含、省略和强调了什么内容
分析作者的角度（参与者与观察者/研究者）如何影响所提供的信息、使用的语言以及整体基调
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 同时阅读了一篇历史事件亲历者写的日记和该事件的教科书记述，他们能否解释两者的不同之处——比如每篇记述包含了哪些细节以及原因？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: How authors support their points
topics.description: Explain how an author of an informational text uses reasons and evidence to support particular points, evaluating whether the reasoning is sound and the evidence is relevant and sufficient
evidence: Identify the key points an author makes in an informational text and list the specific reasons and evidence provided to support each point
Evaluate whether the evidence an author uses (facts, statistics, examples, expert opinions) is relevant to the point being made and sufficient to be convincing
Distinguish between well-supported claims backed by evidence and unsupported opinions or assertions in an informational text
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a persuasive article — like one arguing for or against something — can {{name}} identify the reasons the author gives and say whether each one is convincing and well-supported?
topics.descriptionZh: 解释信息类文本（informational text）的作者如何使用理由和证据（evidence）来支撑特定观点，并评估其推理是否合理、证据是否相关且充分
evidenceZh: 识别作者在信息类文本中提出的关键观点，并列出支撑每个观点的具体理由和证据
评估作者使用的证据（事实、统计数据、示例、专家意见）是否与所提出的观点相关，以及是否足够具有说服力
在信息类文本中，区分有证据充分支撑的主张（claims）与缺乏证据支撑的观点或断言
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读了一篇说理性文章——例如支持或反对某事物的文章——之后，{{name}}能否识别出作者给出的理由，并说明每一个理由是否具有说服力且得到了充分的支撑？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: In-Depth Character and Setting Analysis
topics.description: Describe in depth a character, setting, or event in a story or drama, drawing on specific details from the text such as a character's thoughts, words, actions, and interactions
evidence: Write a detailed character description drawing on evidence from multiple points in the text, including what the character says, does, thinks, and how others respond to them
Describe a setting in depth by citing specific sensory details, figurative language, and mood clues the author provides
Explain how a key event affects the characters and plot development, citing specific textual details about actions, reactions, and consequences
topics.assessmentPrompt: After {{name}} reads a chapter where an important event happens, can they write or talk about it in detail — describing what the character thought, said, and did, using specific words and moments from the text?
topics.descriptionZh: 深入描述故事或戏剧中的人物、环境或事件，运用文本中的具体细节，如人物的思想、言语、行为和互动。
evidenceZh: 撰写详细的人物描述，引用文本中多处的证据，包括人物的言语、行为、思想以及他人的反应。
通过引用作者提供的具体感官细节、修辞手法 (figurative language) 和氛围线索，深入描述环境。
解释关键事件如何影响人物和情节 (plot) 发展，引用有关行为、反应和后果的具体文本细节。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在 {{name}} 阅读完发生重要事件的章节后，他们能否详细地写下或口头描述该事件——运用文本中的具体词句和场景，描述人物的所思、所言和所为？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Interpreting visual information in texts
topics.description: Interpret information presented visually, orally, or quantitatively in informational texts (e.g., charts, graphs, diagrams, timelines, animations) and explain how it contributes to understanding the text
evidence: Read and interpret data from a chart, graph, or table included in an informational text and explain how it supports or extends the written information
Explain how a diagram, map, or timeline in an informational text helps the reader understand the topic in ways that words alone might not
Synthesise information from both the written text and a visual element (graph, illustration, infographic) to draw a conclusion that neither source provides independently
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a non-fiction article that includes a chart or timeline, can they explain what extra information those visuals add — beyond what the written text says?
topics.nameZh: 解读文本中的视觉信息
topics.descriptionZh: 解读信息类文本（informational texts）中以视觉、口头或定量方式呈现的信息（如信息图表、数据图、图解、时间线、动画），并解释这些信息如何有助于理解文本。
evidenceZh: 阅读并解读信息类文本中包含的图表、数据图或表格中的数据，并解释其如何支持或扩展书面信息
解释信息类文本中的图解、地图或时间线如何以纯文字可能无法做到的方式，帮助读者更好地理解主题
综合书面文本和视觉元素（数据图、插图、信息图表）中的信息，得出任何一个单一来源都无法独立提供的结论
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 阅读一篇包含图表或时间线的非虚构文章（non-fiction article）时，他们能否解释这些视觉信息在书面文本内容之外还增加了哪些额外信息？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Narrator's Point of View
topics.description: Compare and contrast the point of view from which different stories are narrated, including distinguishing between first-person and third-person narration and explaining how the narrator's perspective shapes the reader's understanding
evidence: Identify whether a story is told in first person (I/we) or third person (he/she/they) and explain how this affects what the reader knows about characters' thoughts and feelings
Compare two versions of a story or event told from different points of view and explain how each narrator's perspective changes what is emphasised, omitted, or revealed
Explain why an author might choose first-person narration (immediacy, personal voice) versus third-person narration (broader view, objectivity) for a particular story
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a story written in first person, can {{name}} explain how the story might feel different if it were told by a different character or by a narrator watching from the outside?
topics.nameZh: 叙述者视角 (Narrator's Point of View)
topics.descriptionZh: 比较和对比不同故事的叙述视角，包括区分第一人称 (first-person) 和第三人称 (third-person) 叙述，并解释叙述者的视角如何塑造读者的理解。
evidenceZh: 识别故事是以第一人称（“我”/“我们”）还是第三人称（“他”/“她”/“他们”）讲述的，并解释这如何影响读者对角色思想和感情的了解。
比较从不同视角讲述的同一个故事或事件的两个版本，并解释每个叙述者的视角如何改变被强调、省略或揭示的内容。
解释为什么作者在特定故事中可能会选择第一人称叙述（即时感、个人化声音）而不是第三人称叙述（更广阔的视角、客观性）。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读了一篇以第一人称写的故事后，{{name}} 能否解释如果由另一个角色或从外部观察的叙述者来讲述，这个故事给人的感觉会有什么不同？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Poems, Drama & Prose
topics.description: Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, identifying structural elements unique to each form: verse, rhythm, and meter in poetry; cast of characters, dialogue, and stage directions in drama; chapters and paragraphs in prose
evidence: Compare a poem, a play script, and a prose passage on a similar theme, identifying the structural features unique to each form (e.g. stanzas vs scenes vs chapters)
Identify and explain the function of structural elements in drama: cast list, stage directions (in italics or brackets), dialogue format, and scene divisions
Describe how structural elements of poetry such as verse, rhythm, meter, and line breaks affect how a poem is read aloud and how meaning is conveyed
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} look at a poem, a play, and a chapter from a novel and explain how each is laid out differently — for example, that a play has stage directions and a poem has verses?
topics.descriptionZh: 解释诗歌、戏剧和散文之间的主要区别，识别每种文体独有的结构元素：诗歌中的诗节（verse）、节奏（rhythm）和格律（meter）；戏剧中的人物表（cast of characters）、对白（dialogue）和舞台提示（stage directions）；散文中的章节（chapters）和段落（paragraphs）
evidenceZh: 比较相同主题的诗歌、剧本和散文段落，识别每种文体独有的结构特征（例如：诗节（stanzas）与场次（scenes）与章节（chapters）的对比）
识别并解释戏剧中结构元素的功能：人物表、舞台提示（以斜体或括号表示）、对白格式以及场次划分
描述诗歌的结构元素（如诗节、节奏、格律和分行）如何影响诗歌的朗读效果以及意义的传达
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否观察一首诗歌、一部戏剧和小说中的一个章节，并解释它们在排版布局上有什么不同——例如，戏剧有舞台提示，而诗歌有诗节？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Recommending Books
topics.description: Recommend books to peers, giving reasons for choices based on knowledge of a wide range of genres, authors, and themes, and making comparisons within and across books
evidence: Recommend a book to a peer by explaining its genre, theme, and what makes it engaging, comparing it to other books the peer has enjoyed
Justify a book recommendation by referring to specific features such as the author's style, the plot structure, or how a theme is developed
Maintain a reading log or book review collection that captures key responses to books read and serves as a reference for future recommendations
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} recommends a book to a friend, can they explain clearly why they think that person would enjoy it — mentioning the genre, characters, and themes rather than just saying "it's good"?
topics.descriptionZh: 向同伴推荐书籍，基于对广泛的体裁（genres）、作者和主题（themes）的了解给出推荐理由，并在书籍内部及不同书籍之间进行比较
evidenceZh: 向同伴推荐一本书，解释其体裁（genre）、主题（theme）以及吸引人的地方，并将其与同伴喜欢的其他书籍进行比较
通过提及具体特征（如作者的写作风格、情节结构或主题的展开方式）来证明书籍推荐的合理性
维护阅读日志或书评集，记录对所读书籍的关键反馈，并作为未来推荐的参考
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 向朋友推荐一本书时，他们能否清楚地解释为什么认为对方会喜欢这本书——提及体裁（genre）、人物（characters）和主题（themes），而不是仅仅说“它很好看”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Structure of information texts
topics.description: Describe the overall structure of an informational text (chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution) and explain how the author's chosen structure helps convey information and ideas
evidence: Identify which organisational structure an informational text uses (chronological order, compare/contrast, cause/effect, or problem/solution) and cite textual features that signal it
Explain how signal words (first, then, finally for chronology; however, similarly for comparison; because, as a result for cause/effect; the solution was for problem/solution) reveal text structure
Compare two informational texts on the same topic that use different structures and explain how each structure affects the way information is presented to the reader
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a non-fiction text, can they identify how it's organised — for example, "this one is structured as a problem and solution" or "this one goes through events in time order" — and explain why that structure works?
topics.descriptionZh: 描述信息类文本的整体结构（时间顺序 (chronology)、比较 (comparison)、因果 (cause/effect)、问题与解决方案 (problem/solution)），并解释作者所选的结构如何有助于传达信息和思想。
evidenceZh: 识别信息类文本所使用的组织结构（时间顺序 (chronological order)、比较/对比 (compare/contrast)、因果 (cause/effect) 或问题与解决方案 (problem/solution)），并引用提示该结构的文本特征。
解释提示词（时间顺序：首先、然后、最后；比较：然而、同样地；因果：因为、因此；问题与解决方案：解决方案是）如何揭示文本结构。
比较两篇关于同一主题但采用不同结构的信息类文本，并解释每种结构如何影响向读者呈现信息的方式。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 阅读非虚构类文本（non-fiction text）时，他们能否识别其组织方式——例如，“这篇文章采用了问题与解决方案的结构”或“这篇文章按时间顺序叙述事件”——并解释为什么这种结构有效？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Text & Media Connections
topics.description: Make connections between the text of a story or drama and a visual or oral presentation of the text, identifying where each version reflects specific descriptions and directions from the text
evidence: Compare a passage from a book with a film or audio adaptation, identifying specific moments where the visual or oral version matches or departs from the written text
Explain how a film, illustration, or dramatic performance interprets a scene from a story, citing specific textual descriptions the adaptation reflects
Identify details in the written text (descriptions of setting, character appearance, dialogue) that a visual or oral presentation brings to life, and note any differences
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} has read a book and then seen a film version, can they compare the two — pointing out moments where the film showed something differently from how the book described it?
topics.descriptionZh: 建立故事或戏剧文本与文本的视觉或口头呈现之间的联系，找出每个版本如何反映文本中的具体描述和指示。
evidenceZh: 比较书中的段落与电影或音频改编作品，找出视觉或口头版本与书面文本相符或存在差异的具体时刻。
解释电影、插图或戏剧表演如何诠释故事中的场景，并引用改编作品所反映的具体文本描述。
找出书面文本中（如场景描述、角色外貌、对话）被视觉或口头呈现生动展现的细节，并注意其中的差异。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果{{name}}读过一本书并观看了其电影版本，他们能否比较这两者——指出电影展现的内容与书中描述不同的时刻？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Themes Across Cultures and Traditions
topics.description: Compare and contrast the treatment of similar themes, topics, and story patterns (e.g., good vs evil, quest narratives, trickster tales) in stories, myths, and traditional literature from different cultures
evidence: Compare how two myths or folk tales from different cultures treat a similar theme (e.g., creation, heroism, the importance of honesty) and explain both similarities and differences
Identify recurring story patterns across cultures such as the trickster figure, the quest, or the transformation, providing specific examples from texts read
Explain how cultural context shapes the way a universal theme is expressed differently in stories from various traditions
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} has read two quest stories from different cultures — like a Greek myth and a West African folktale — can they compare how each treats the hero's journey and what values each story prizes?
topics.descriptionZh: 比较和对比不同文化的故事、神话及传统文学中对相似主题、话题和故事模式（如善恶对立 (good vs evil)、探索叙事 (quest narratives)、捣蛋鬼传说 (trickster tales)）的处理方式。
evidenceZh: 比较两个不同文化的神话或民间故事如何表达相似的主题（如创世 (creation)、英雄主义 (heroism)、诚实的重要性），并解释其异同。
识别跨文化中反复出现的故事模式，如捣蛋鬼形象 (trickster figure)、探索旅程 (the quest) 或变形 (transformation)，并结合阅读过的文本提供具体例子。
解释文化背景如何影响不同传统故事中普遍主题的表达方式。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 读过两个不同文化的探索故事（如希腊神话和西非民间故事），他们能比较每个故事如何处理英雄之旅 (hero's journey) 以及每个故事所珍视的价值观吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Comparing Books
topics.description: Make comparisons within and across books, identifying similarities and differences in themes, characters, settings, and authorial choices across multiple texts
evidence: Compare how two authors develop similar themes using different narrative techniques
Identify similarities and differences between characters across books by the same author
Analyse how settings function differently in two texts from the same genre
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a few books by the same author or in the same genre, can {{name}} compare them — discussing what themes, styles, or character types the author tends to use?
topics.descriptionZh: 在单本书内部及多本书之间进行比较，识别多个文本在主题、人物、背景设定以及作者创作选择方面的异同。
evidenceZh: 比较两位作者如何运用不同的叙事技巧（narrative techniques）来展现相似的主题
识别同一作者的不同书籍中人物角色的异同
分析背景设定（settings）在同一类型的两篇文本中发挥的不同作用
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读了同一作者或同一类型的几本书之后，{{name}} 能否对这些书进行比较——讨论该作者倾向于使用的主题、风格或人物类型？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Comparing Characters, Settings and Events
topics.description: Compare and contrast two or more characters, settings, or events in a story or drama, drawing on specific details about how characters interact, settings influence action, or events connect
evidence: Create a Venn diagram comparing two characters' traits using textual evidence
Explain how a change in setting affects the mood and characters' actions in a story
Analyse how two events in a narrative are connected through cause and effect
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a novel with several main characters, can {{name}} compare two of them in detail — explaining how their personalities, experiences, and relationships are both similar and different?
topics.descriptionZh: 比较和对比故事或戏剧中的两个或多个人物、场景或事件，利用具体细节说明人物如何互动、场景如何影响行动或事件如何相互联系。
evidenceZh: 使用文本证据创建维恩图（Venn diagram）来比较两个人物的特征
解释场景的变化如何影响故事中的氛围和人物的行动
分析叙事中的两个事件如何通过因果关系（cause and effect）相互联系
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读了一本有几个主要人物的小说后，{{name}}能否详细比较其中的两个人物——解释他们的性格、经历和人际关系有何异同？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Comparing Structure in Information Texts
topics.description: Compare and contrast the overall structure of events, ideas, concepts, or information in two or more informational texts, identifying patterns such as chronology, comparison, cause/effect, or problem/solution
evidence: Identify the organisational structure of two texts on the same topic
Explain how one text uses cause/effect while another uses problem/solution to present information
Analyse why an author chose a particular structure for their informational text
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} reads two non-fiction texts about the same topic that are organised differently — one in time order and one comparing two sides — can they describe those structural differences and explain how each one shapes the reader's experience?
topics.nameZh: 比较信息类文本的结构
topics.descriptionZh: 比较和对比两篇或多篇信息类文本（informational texts）中事件、观点、概念或信息的整体结构，识别诸如时间顺序（chronology）、比较（comparison）、因果（cause/effect）或问题与解决（problem/solution）等模式。
evidenceZh: 识别同一主题下两篇文本的组织结构（organisational structure）
解释一篇文本如何使用因果（cause/effect）结构，而另一篇如何使用问题与解决（problem/solution）结构来呈现信息
分析作者为何为其信息类文本选择特定的结构
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 阅读了两篇关于同一主题但组织方式不同的非虚构文本（non-fiction texts）——一篇按时间顺序，另一篇对比正反两面——他们能否描述这些结构差异，并解释每种结构如何塑造读者的阅读体验？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Different viewpoints in texts
topics.description: Describe how a narrator's or speaker's point of view influences how events are described, recognising the difference between limited and omniscient narration and how perspective shapes storytelling
evidence: Identify whether a story uses first-person or third-person narration and explain the effect
Explain how events would be described differently if told from another character's perspective
Analyse how the narrator's knowledge or bias affects what information the reader receives
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain how a story told by an all-knowing narrator feels different from one told by a single character who only knows their own side — and give an example of how that changes what the reader knows?
topics.descriptionZh: 描述叙述者或说话者的视角如何影响事件的描述方式，认识有限视角（limited narration）与全知视角（omniscient narration）的区别，以及视角如何塑造故事讲述
evidenceZh: 识别故事使用的是第一人称还是第三人称叙述，并解释其效果
解释如果从另一个角色的视角来讲述，事件的描述会有何不同
分析叙述者的认知或偏见如何影响读者接收到的信息
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否解释由全知叙述者讲述的故事，与只了解自己情况的单一角色讲述的故事在读起来有何不同——并举例说明这会如何改变读者了解到的信息？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Explaining Relationships in Texts
topics.description: Explain the relationships or interactions between two or more individuals, events, ideas, or concepts in historical, scientific, or technical texts based on specific information
evidence: Explain the cause-and-effect relationship between events in a historical text
Describe how a scientific process involves sequential steps that depend on each other
Identify how key individuals in a text influenced events or other people
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a history or science text about how two events or discoveries were connected, can {{name}} explain that relationship clearly — describing how one thing led to or influenced the other?
topics.descriptionZh: 根据具体信息，解释历史、科学或技术文本中两个或多个人物、事件、观点或概念之间的关系或相互作用。
evidenceZh: 解释历史文本中事件之间的因果关系 (cause-and-effect relationship)
描述科学过程 (scientific process) 如何包含相互依赖的连续步骤 (sequential steps)
识别文本中的关键人物如何影响事件或其他人
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读了一篇关于两个事件或发现如何相互关联的历史或科学文本后，{{name}}能否清晰地解释这种关系——描述一件事是如何导致或影响另一件事的？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Fact vs opinion
topics.description: Distinguish between statements of fact and statements of opinion in texts, recognising how authors blend factual information with subjective viewpoints
evidence: Identify and label statements as fact or opinion in a newspaper article
Explain why a statement is a fact by citing verifiable evidence or why it is an opinion
Recognise persuasive techniques that present opinions as if they were facts
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a newspaper article or non-fiction text, can they point out which parts are facts and which parts are the author's opinions — and explain how they can tell the difference?
topics.descriptionZh: 区分文本中的事实陈述与观点陈述，认识作者如何将事实信息与主观看法相融合。
evidenceZh: 在新闻报道中识别并标记出哪些陈述是事实，哪些是观点
通过引用可核实的证据来解释为什么某个陈述是事实，或者解释为什么它是观点
识别那些将观点伪装成事实的说服性技巧
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 阅读新闻报道或非虚构类文本时，他们能指出哪些部分是事实，哪些部分是作者的观点——并解释他们是如何区分这两者的吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: How Authors Treat Similar Themes
topics.description: Compare and contrast stories in the same genre on their approaches to similar themes and topics, identifying how different authors treat common ideas
evidence: Compare how two mystery stories create suspense using different techniques
Identify common themes in adventure stories and explain how each author develops them differently
Analyse how two authors from the same genre approach the theme of friendship or courage
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading two adventure stories in the same genre, can {{name}} compare how each author handled similar elements — like the hero's challenge or the resolution — and say which approach they preferred and why?
topics.nameZh: 作者对相似主题的处理方式
topics.descriptionZh: 比较和对比同一体裁的故事在处理相似主题和话题时的不同方法，识别不同作者如何处理共同的观念
evidenceZh: 比较两个悬疑故事如何使用不同的技巧来制造悬念
找出冒险故事中的共同主题，并解释每位作者是如何以不同方式展开这些主题的
分析同一体裁的两位作者是如何处理友谊或勇气这一主题的
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读了两部同一体裁的冒险故事后，{{name}} 能否比较每位作者是如何处理相似元素的——比如主人公面临的挑战或故事的结局——并说出他们更喜欢哪种处理方式以及原因？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: How Language Choices Affect the Reader
topics.description: Evaluate how authors use language including figurative language, considering the impact of word choices, imagery, and literary devices on the reader
evidence: Explain how a specific metaphor or simile affects the reader's understanding or emotions
Evaluate an author's choice of descriptive language and its impact on atmosphere
Compare how different authors use figurative language to achieve similar effects
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a descriptive passage with figurative language — like "the sun was a burning eye" — can they explain what image or feeling the author was creating and whether it was effective?
topics.nameZh: 语言选择对读者的影响
topics.descriptionZh: 评估作者如何使用语言（包括修辞语言 figurative language），并考量用词选择、意象（imagery）和文学手法（literary devices）对读者产生的影响。
evidenceZh: 解释特定的隐喻（metaphor）或明喻（simile）如何影响读者的理解或情感
评估作者对描述性语言的选择及其对氛围（atmosphere）的影响
比较不同作者如何使用修辞语言（figurative language）来达到相似的效果
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 阅读包含修辞手法的描述性段落时——例如“太阳是一只燃烧的眼睛”——他们能否解释作者试图营造怎样的意象（imagery）或情感，以及这种表达是否有效？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: How Parts Build a Whole Text
topics.description: Explain how a series of chapters, scenes, or stanzas fits together to provide the overall structure of a story, drama, or poem, analysing how each part contributes to the whole
evidence: Map the structure of a novel showing how each chapter advances plot or character development
Explain how individual stanzas in a poem build toward a central theme or message
Analyse how scenes in a play work together to develop conflict and resolution
topics.assessmentPrompt: After finishing a novel, can {{name}} explain how each chapter contributed to the whole — like how an early chapter introduced a tension that wasn't resolved until much later?
topics.nameZh: 部分如何构建整体文本
topics.descriptionZh: 解释一系列章节（chapters）、场景（scenes）或诗节（stanzas）如何组合在一起，为故事、戏剧或诗歌提供整体结构，并分析每个部分如何对整体做出贡献。
evidenceZh: 绘制小说结构图，展示每一章如何推动情节（plot）或角色发展（character development）
解释诗歌中各个独立的诗节如何逐步构建出核心主题或传达的信息
分析戏剧中的各个场景如何协同作用，以发展冲突（conflict）和解决（resolution）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 读完一本小说后，{{name}} 能否解释每一章是如何为整体做出贡献的——比如，早期的章节是如何引入一种紧张局势（tension），直到很后面才得到解决的？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Justifying Views About Texts
topics.description: Provide reasoned justifications for views about texts, supporting interpretations and opinions with evidence and logical arguments
evidence: State an opinion about a character's motivations and support it with three pieces of textual evidence
Construct a reasoned argument about an author's message using quotes from the text
Respond to an alternative interpretation by providing counter-evidence from the text
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} shares an opinion about a book — like "I think the villain had a point" — can they back it up with specific quotes or events from the text, rather than just saying how they feel?
topics.descriptionZh: 为文本观点提供有理有据的论证，运用证据和逻辑论据支持对文本的解读与见解。
evidenceZh: 表达对人物动机的看法，并用三条文本证据加以支持
运用文本引文，构建关于作者主旨的有理有据的论证
通过提供文本中的反驳证据，回应其他不同的解读
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}分享对一本书的看法时——比如“我觉得反派也有道理”——他们能否用文本中具体的引语或情节来支持自己的观点，而不是仅仅表达自己的感受？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Multimedia elements in texts
topics.description: Analyse how visual and multimedia elements contribute to the meaning, tone, or beauty of a text such as graphic novels, multimedia presentations, or illustrated editions of fiction and poetry
evidence: Explain how illustrations in a graphic novel convey emotion or advance the story
Analyse how visual elements such as colour and layout affect the tone of a multimedia text
Compare how the same scene is portrayed in text versus in visual or audio format
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a graphic novel or illustrated book, can they explain how the pictures and layout — not just the words — help tell the story or create a particular mood?
topics.descriptionZh: 分析视觉和多媒体元素如何为文本（如图像小说、多媒体演示文稿或小说与诗歌的插图版）的意义、基调（tone）或美感做出贡献。
evidenceZh: 解释图像小说（graphic novel）中的插图如何传达情感或推动故事情节
分析色彩和布局等视觉元素如何影响多媒体文本的基调（tone）
比较同一场景在文字与视觉或音频格式中的不同呈现方式
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 阅读图像小说或插图读物时，他们能否解释图片和布局——而不仅仅是文字——是如何帮助讲述故事或营造特定氛围（mood）的？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Multiple Accounts of Events
topics.description: Analyse multiple accounts of the same event or topic, noting important similarities and differences in the point of view they represent
evidence: Compare two news articles about the same event and identify differences in perspective
Explain how the author's background or purpose affects their account of an event
Identify which facts are consistent across accounts and which details differ based on viewpoint
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} reads two different accounts of the same event — like two news articles covering the same story — can they explain what each account emphasises, what each leaves out, and why the perspectives differ?
topics.descriptionZh: 分析同一事件或主题的多方报道，注意识别它们在观点（point of view）上的重要相似之处与差异。
evidenceZh: 比较两篇关于同一事件的新闻报道，找出它们在视角（perspective）上的差异
解释作者的背景或写作目的如何影响他们对事件的叙述
识别哪些事实在不同报道中保持一致，哪些细节因观点（viewpoint）不同而有所差异
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 阅读了两篇关于同一事件的不同报道——比如两篇报道同一个故事的新闻文章——他们能否解释每篇报道强调了什么内容、省略了哪些细节，以及为什么各方的观点（perspectives）会有所不同？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Quoting Accurately from Texts
topics.description: Quote accurately from literary and informational texts when explaining what the text says explicitly and when drawing inferences, using quotation marks and citations correctly
evidence: Select and copy exact words from a text to support an inference about character motivation
Use quotation marks correctly when incorporating textual evidence into written responses
Introduce quotes with signal phrases such as 'The author states' or 'According to the text'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes about a book or article for school, do they quote from the text directly — putting the exact words in speech marks — to support their points?
topics.descriptionZh: 在解释文本明确表述的内容和进行推理（inference）时，准确引用文学和信息类文本，并正确使用引号和引用标注。
evidenceZh: 从文本中选择并抄录确切的词语，以支持对人物动机的推理（inference）
在将文本证据（textual evidence）融入书面回答时，正确使用引号
使用引导语（signal phrases）引出引语，例如“作者指出”或“根据文本”
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}在学校写关于一本书或一篇文章的作业时，他们是否会直接引用文本——将原话放在引号内——来支持自己的观点？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Summarising Non-Fiction Main Ideas
topics.description: Determine two or more main ideas of an informational text and explain how they are supported by key details, then summarise the text without personal opinions
evidence: Identify the main ideas in each section of an informational article
List key details that support each main idea in a multi-paragraph text
Write an objective summary capturing the main ideas without adding personal opinions
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a long non-fiction article, can {{name}} identify two or three main ideas it covers and write a brief summary that captures all of them — without adding their own opinions?
topics.nameZh: 概括非虚构文本的主要思想
topics.descriptionZh: 确定说明性文本 (informational text) 中的两个或多个主要思想，并解释关键细节如何支持这些思想，然后在不掺杂个人观点的情况下对文本进行概括。
evidenceZh: 识别说明性文章每个部分的主要思想
列出多段落文本中支持每个主要思想的关键细节
撰写客观的摘要以涵盖主要思想，不添加个人观点
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读了一篇长篇非虚构文章 (non-fiction article) 后，{{name}}能否识别出文章涵盖的两到三个主要思想，并写一段简短的摘要来概括所有主要内容——而不添加他们自己的观点？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Supporting ideas with evidence
topics.description: Explain how an author uses reasons and evidence to support particular points in a text, identifying which reasons and evidence support which specific points
evidence: Match each of an author's main points with the evidence used to support it
Evaluate whether the evidence provided adequately supports the author's argument
Identify points in a text that lack sufficient evidence or reasoning
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a persuasive text, can {{name}} map out which reasons the author uses to support which specific points — showing that they understand the structure of the argument, not just the conclusion?
topics.descriptionZh: 解释作者如何运用理由和证据来支撑文本中的特定观点，并指出哪些理由和证据具体支持了哪些观点
evidenceZh: 将作者的每个主要观点与用来支持该观点的证据进行匹配
评估所提供的证据是否充分支持了作者的论点
找出文本中缺乏充分证据或推理的观点
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读一篇议论文后，{{name}} 能否梳理出作者使用了哪些理由来支持哪些具体观点——从而表明他们理解了论证的结构，而不仅仅是结论？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Synthesising across multiple texts
topics.description: Integrate information from several texts on the same topic in order to write or speak about the subject knowledgeably, combining information without plagiarising
evidence: Combine information from three sources into a coherent paragraph using own words
Create a fact sheet that synthesises key information from multiple texts on one topic
Present information orally that draws on multiple sources while crediting the sources
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a school report using several sources, do they bring together information from all of them into their own words — rather than just quoting or copying from one source at a time?
topics.descriptionZh: 整合关于同一主题的多篇文本信息，以便能够有见地地进行书面或口头表达，在综合信息时避免抄袭。
evidenceZh: 用自己的话将三个来源的信息结合成一段连贯的段落
制作一份事实清单（fact sheet），综合多篇关于同一主题的文本中的关键信息
口头展示信息，引用多个来源的信息并注明出处（crediting the sources）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 使用多个来源撰写学校报告时，他们是否能将所有来源的信息融会贯通，用自己的语言表达出来，而不是简单地逐段引用或照搬单一来源的内容？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Using Multiple Sources
topics.description: Draw on information from multiple print or digital sources, demonstrating the ability to locate an answer to a question quickly or solve a problem efficiently
evidence: Use search features, indexes, and headings to locate specific information across sources
Synthesise information from two or more sources to answer a research question
Evaluate which source provides the most relevant information for a given question
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} needs to answer a research question for school, can they search across several books or websites to find the relevant information quickly — rather than reading every source from start to finish?
topics.descriptionZh: 从多种纸质或数字资源中提取信息，展现出快速查找问题答案或高效解决问题的能力。
evidenceZh: 使用搜索功能、索引和标题在不同资料中查找特定信息
综合两个或多个来源的信息来解答探究性问题
评估哪个来源能为特定问题提供最相关的信息
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}需要解答学校的探究性问题时，他们能否在几本书籍或网站中快速搜索以找到相关信息，而不是从头到尾阅读每一份资料？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Analysing Text Structure
topics.description: Analyse how a text's structure — including its overall organisation, use of chapters, stanzas, scenes, paragraphs, or sections — contributes to its meaning, style, and development of ideas
evidence: Explain how a non-chronological structure (e.g., flashback, frame narrative) creates suspense or surprise
Analyse the role of a specific paragraph in developing and refining a key concept in a non-fiction text
Compare how two texts use different structures (e.g., epistolary vs. linear narrative) and the effect of each
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} analyses a poem or novel, can they explain how the author's structural choices — like starting in the middle of the action, or ending with a repeated image — shape the overall meaning of the text?
topics.descriptionZh: 分析文本的结构——包括其整体组织方式，以及章节（chapters）、诗节（stanzas）、场景（scenes）、段落（paragraphs）或部分（sections）的使用——如何有助于文本的意义构建、风格展现和思想发展
evidenceZh: 解释非按时间顺序的结构（如倒叙（flashback）、框架叙事（frame narrative））如何制造悬念或惊喜
分析特定段落在非虚构文本中发展和完善关键概念的作用
比较两篇文本如何使用不同的结构（如书信体（epistolary）与线性叙事（linear narrative））以及各自产生的效果
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}分析诗歌或小说时，他们能否解释作者的结构选择——例如从故事中间开始，或以重复的意象结尾——是如何塑造文本整体意义的？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Critical comparison across texts
topics.description: Make critical comparisons across texts — comparing themes, characters, settings, styles, or arguments in two or more works, including texts from different periods, genres, or cultures
evidence: Compare how two novels treat a shared theme (e.g., growing up) using specific evidence from both
Analyse how a modern retelling draws on and transforms elements from a traditional story or myth
Compare conflicting accounts of the same event in two non-fiction texts and evaluate which is more convincing
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading texts from very different times or cultures, can {{name}} compare them thoughtfully — noting not just surface similarities but deeper differences in values, style, and what the author assumed about their reader?
topics.descriptionZh: 对多个文本进行批判性比较——比较两部或多部作品中的主题（themes）、人物（characters）、背景（settings）、风格（styles）或论点（arguments），包括来自不同时期、体裁（genres）或文化的文本。
evidenceZh: 使用两部小说中的具体证据，比较它们如何处理一个共同的主题（如：成长）
分析现代重述故事如何借鉴并转化传统故事或神话（myth）中的元素
比较两篇非虚构文本（non-fiction texts）中对同一事件相互矛盾的描述，并评估哪一个更具说服力
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读了来自截然不同时代或文化的文本后，{{name}} 能否进行深思熟虑的比较——不仅注意到表面的相似之处，还能指出价值观、风格以及作者对读者的预设方面更深层次的差异？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Evaluating Arguments in Non-Fiction
topics.description: Evaluate arguments and claims in non-fiction texts — assess whether reasoning is sound, evidence is relevant and sufficient, distinguish between fact and opinion, and recognise bias, propaganda, and rhetorical techniques
evidence: Identify the main claim in an argument text and evaluate whether the evidence presented is sufficient
Spot logical fallacies or irrelevant evidence introduced to distract from weak reasoning
Compare two opposing arguments on the same issue and evaluate which is more convincing, with reasons
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a persuasive piece — like an editorial or a speech — can they identify the rhetorical techniques being used, evaluate whether the argument is logically sound, and explain what might be biased or misleading?
topics.nameZh: 评估非虚构文本中的论证 (Evaluating Arguments in Non-Fiction)
topics.descriptionZh: 评估非虚构文本中的论点和主张——判断推理是否合理、证据是否相关且充分，区分事实与观点，并识别偏见、宣传（propaganda）及修辞手法（rhetorical techniques）
evidenceZh: 找出议论文中的主要主张（main claim），并评估所提供的证据是否充分
识别逻辑谬误（logical fallacies）或为掩盖薄弱推理而引入的无关证据
比较针对同一议题的两个对立论点，并说明理由以评估哪一个更具说服力
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 阅读一篇说服性文章（如社论或演讲）时，他们能否识别所使用的修辞手法（rhetorical techniques），评估论证在逻辑上是否合理，并解释其中可能存在偏见或误导的内容？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Figurative Language and Literary Devices
topics.description: Determine the meaning of figurative and connotative language in context, analyse the impact of specific word choices on meaning and tone, and identify literary devices such as metaphor, simile, personification, allusion, and irony
evidence: Identify a metaphor or simile in a passage and explain its effect on the reader
Explain how an author's word choice creates a particular tone (e.g., menacing, humorous, melancholic)
Recognise an allusion to a myth, the Bible, or another text and explain what it adds to the meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a passage containing a metaphor, irony, or allusion, can they explain what the author really meant — going beyond the literal words to describe the effect that device creates for the reader?
topics.nameZh: 修辞手法与文学技巧 (Figurative Language and Literary Devices)
topics.descriptionZh: 结合语境理解比喻性语言和词语的隐含意义（connotative language），分析具体用词对文章含义和基调（tone）的影响，并识别隐喻（metaphor）、明喻（simile）、拟人（personification）、典故（allusion）和反讽（irony）等文学修辞手法。
evidenceZh: 识别段落中的隐喻（metaphor）或明喻（simile），并解释其对读者的影响
解释作者的用词如何营造特定的基调（tone）（例如：充满威胁的、幽默的、忧郁的）
识别对神话、《圣经》或其他文本的典故（allusion），并解释其丰富了怎样的含义
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 阅读包含隐喻（metaphor）、反讽（irony）或典故（allusion）的段落时，他们能否解释作者真正的意图——超越字面意思，描述这些修辞手法为读者带来的阅读效果？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Narrative Perspective and Unreliable Narrators
topics.description: Analyse point of view and narrative perspective — including first person, third person limited and omniscient, and unreliable narrator — and how the author's or narrator's perspective shapes the reader's understanding and creates effects such as suspense, irony, or humour
evidence: Identify the narrative perspective of a text and explain how it limits or expands the reader's knowledge
Explain how dramatic irony arises when the reader knows something a character does not
Compare how the same event might be told differently from two characters' perspectives
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a story with an unreliable narrator — where the person telling the story isn't fully trustworthy — can they spot the clues that suggest the narrator isn't giving the full picture?
topics.nameZh: 叙事视角 (Narrative Perspective) 与不可靠叙述者 (Unreliable Narrators)
topics.descriptionZh: 分析视角与叙事角度——包括第一人称、第三人称有限视角和全知视角，以及不可靠叙述者——并探讨作者或叙述者的视角如何影响读者的理解，以及如何营造悬念、反讽 (irony) 或幽默等效果。
evidenceZh: 识别文本的叙事视角，并解释其如何限制或拓展读者的认知
解释当读者知道角色所不知道的事情时，戏剧性反讽 (dramatic irony) 是如何产生的
比较同一事件从两个不同角色的视角出发，可能会产生怎样不同的讲述方式
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}阅读一个带有不可靠叙述者的故事时——即讲故事的人并不完全值得信任——他们能否发现那些暗示叙述者没有讲述全部真相的线索？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Plot Structure and Character Development
topics.description: Analyse how plot structure unfolds through episodes or key events, and how characters develop, respond to challenges, and change over the course of a narrative — including the relationship between character, setting, and plot
evidence: Trace how a character's attitude changes across a story and identify the turning points
Explain how a specific incident in a drama propels the action or provokes a decision
Analyse how the setting influences a character's behaviour or the mood of a scene
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a novel, can {{name}} explain how the main character changed from the beginning to the end — pointing to specific events that caused that change and how the setting shaped who they became?
topics.nameZh: 情节结构 (Plot Structure) 与人物发展 (Character Development)
topics.descriptionZh: 分析情节结构如何通过章节或关键事件展开，以及人物如何在叙事过程中发展、应对挑战并发生改变——包括人物、环境 (Setting) 和情节 (Plot) 之间的关系。
evidenceZh: 追踪人物在故事中的态度变化，并识别转折点 (Turning points)
解释戏剧或故事中的特定事件如何推动情节发展或促使人物做出决定
分析环境 (Setting) 如何影响人物的行为或场景的氛围
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 读完一本小说后，{{name}} 能否解释主角从故事开始到结束发生了怎样的变化——指出导致这种变化的具体事件，以及环境 (Setting) 是如何塑造了他们最终的模样？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Poetic forms and conventions
topics.description: Recognise and understand poetic conventions — including form (sonnet, ballad, free verse), metre, rhyme scheme, stanza structure, imagery, and sound devices (alliteration, assonance, onomatopoeia) — and analyse how poets use them for effect
evidence: Identify the form of a poem (e.g., sonnet, haiku, ballad) and explain its key structural features
Analyse how a poet uses rhythm or sound devices to reinforce meaning or mood
Explain how enjambment or a caesura affects the pace and emphasis of a line
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a poem, can they identify its form — like a sonnet or a ballad — and explain how the poet's use of rhyme, rhythm, and imagery contributes to the poem's meaning or emotional impact?
topics.descriptionZh: 识别并理解诗歌的常规手法——包括体裁（如十四行诗 (sonnet)、叙事诗 (ballad)、自由诗 (free verse)）、格律 (metre)、韵脚格式 (rhyme scheme)、诗节结构 (stanza structure)、意象 (imagery) 和声音修辞手法 (sound devices，如头韵 (alliteration)、元音叠韵 (assonance)、拟声 (onomatopoeia))——并分析诗人如何运用这些手法来增强表达效果。
evidenceZh: 识别诗歌的体裁（如十四行诗 (sonnet)、俳句 (haiku)、叙事诗 (ballad)），并解释其关键的结构特征。
分析诗人如何运用节奏或声音修辞手法来强化诗歌的含义或烘托氛围。
解释跨行连续 (enjambment) 或句中停顿 (caesura) 如何影响诗句的节奏和强调重点。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 阅读一首诗时，他们能否识别出它的体裁（例如十四行诗或叙事诗），并解释诗人对押韵、节奏和意象的运用是如何影响诗歌的含义或情感冲击力的？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Purpose, audience, and context
topics.description: Identify the purpose, audience, and context of a text and use this knowledge to support comprehension — recognising how writing aimed at different audiences (academic, popular, persuasive) uses different conventions, register, and tone
evidence: Identify the intended audience and purpose of a text and explain how the language choices reflect this
Compare a newspaper article and a scientific report on the same topic, noting differences in register and structure
Explain how knowing the historical or social context of a text deepens understanding
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads something written for a very different audience — like a scientific journal article versus a children's book on the same topic — can they explain how the purpose and audience shaped the language, tone, and structure?
topics.descriptionZh: 识别文本的目的、受众和语境，并利用这些知识辅助理解——认识到针对不同受众（学术、大众、说服性）的写作如何使用不同的惯例、语域（register）和语调（tone）。
evidenceZh: 识别文本的预期受众和目的，并解释语言选择如何反映这一点
比较同一主题的新闻报道和科学报告，注意语域（register）和结构上的差异
解释了解文本的历史或社会语境如何加深理解
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 阅读为截然不同的受众撰写的内容时——例如同一主题的科学期刊文章与儿童读物——他们能否解释目的和受众是如何塑造语言、语调和结构的？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Tracing Theme Across a Text
topics.description: Determine and analyse the theme or central idea of a text, trace how it develops across the text through key details and events, and provide an objective summary distinct from personal opinion
evidence: Identify a theme in a novel and explain how specific events develop it across the plot
Distinguish between the topic of a text (what it is about) and the theme (what it is saying)
Write a concise, objective summary of a chapter or article without inserting personal opinion
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a novel or long poem, can {{name}} explain what it was really about at its deepest level — the central idea or theme — and trace how that idea developed through key moments in the text?
topics.descriptionZh: 确定并分析文本的主题或中心思想，通过关键细节和事件追踪其在文本中的发展过程，并提供独立于个人观点的客观总结
evidenceZh: 识别小说中的主题，并解释特定事件如何在情节发展中推动该主题
区分文本的话题（文本关于什么）和主题（文本表达了什么）
在不掺杂个人观点的情况下，写出章节或文章的简明、客观的摘要
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在阅读小说或长诗后，{{name}}能否解释其最深层的真正内涵——中心思想或主题——并追踪该思想是如何通过文本中的关键情节发展起来的？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Understanding drama and performance
topics.description: Understand how dramatists communicate meaning through performance — including staging, direction, set design, lighting, and actors' choices — and how different productions can interpret the same script differently
evidence: Explain how a director's staging choices (e.g., set, lighting, blocking) affect the audience's understanding
Compare two productions or adaptations of the same play and evaluate different interpretive choices
Analyse how a filmed or live production stays faithful to or departs from the original script
topics.assessmentPrompt: After watching a stage or film production of a play they've read, can {{name}} discuss how specific choices — like the lighting, the actor's tone, or the set design — interpreted the script, and whether they agreed with those choices?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解剧作家如何通过表演传达意义——包括舞台调度（staging）、导演指导（direction）、布景设计（set design）、灯光（lighting）以及演员的选择——以及不同的制作如何对同一剧本进行不同的诠释。
evidenceZh: 解释导演的舞台调度选择（如布景、灯光、走位/blocking）如何影响观众的理解
比较同一部戏剧的两个不同制作版本或改编版本，并评估其不同的诠释选择
分析电影版或现场演出是如何忠实于原剧本或偏离原剧本的
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在观看了他们阅读过的戏剧的舞台或电影制作后，{{name}} 能否讨论具体的选择（如灯光、演员的语调或布景设计）是如何诠释剧本的，以及他们是否同意这些选择？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Using and Evaluating Textual Evidence
topics.description: Cite specific textual evidence to support analysis of what a text says explicitly and what can be inferred, distinguishing between strong and weak evidence and explaining how the evidence supports a point
evidence: Identify a relevant quotation to support an inference about a character's feelings
Explain why one piece of evidence is stronger than another for supporting a claim
Use embedded quotations in a written response to back up an analytical point
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} makes a point about a text in class or in writing, do they back it up with a specific quote or reference — and can they explain whether that evidence strongly supports their point or only weakly?
topics.nameZh: 使用和评估文本证据 (Textual Evidence)
topics.descriptionZh: 引用具体的文本证据来支持对文本字面意思和推断意思的分析，区分强弱证据，并解释证据如何支持某一观点。
evidenceZh: 找出相关的引语来支持对角色感受的推断
解释为什么在支持某一主张时，一条证据比另一条证据更有说服力
在书面回答中使用嵌入引语 (embedded quotations) 来支撑分析观点
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}在课堂上或书面表达对文本的观点时，他们是否会用具体的引语或参考内容来支持自己的观点——并且他们能否解释该证据是有力地支持了其观点，还是支持力度较弱？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Wide Independent Reading Across Genres
topics.description: Read widely and independently across fiction and non-fiction — including whole novels, short stories, plays, poetry, and non-fiction from different genres, periods, and cultures — building stamina, breadth, and personal taste as a reader
evidence: Choose books independently that offer appropriate challenge and genuine interest
Read at least two Shakespeare plays and a range of pre-1914 and contemporary literature during KS3
Maintain a personal reading record and articulate preferences with reasons
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} read for pleasure across a wide range of books — fiction, non-fiction, poetry, plays — and can they talk enthusiastically about authors, genres, or themes they've discovered on their own?
topics.nameZh: 跨体裁的广泛独立阅读
topics.descriptionZh: 广泛且独立地阅读虚构与非虚构作品——包括不同体裁、时期和文化的完整小说、短篇故事、戏剧、诗歌和非虚构作品——以培养阅读耐力、拓宽阅读广度并形成个人阅读品味。
evidenceZh: 独立选择难度适中且真正感兴趣的书籍
在第三关键阶段（KS3）期间，至少阅读两部莎士比亚戏剧以及一系列1914年前和当代文学作品
保持个人阅读记录，并能说明偏好及其原因
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 是否为了乐趣而广泛阅读各类书籍——小说、非虚构作品、诗歌、戏剧——并且能否热情地谈论他们自己发现的作者、体裁或主题？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Asking Questions
topics.description: Ask relevant questions to extend understanding; ask and answer questions to seek help, get information, or clarify something not understood
evidence: Ask a question when something is unclear or more information is needed
Answer questions with relevant and specific information
Request clarification politely (e.g. 'Can you explain that again?')
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} doesn't understand something — like instructions for a game or an explanation from a teacher — do they ask a question to find out more rather than just guessing?
topics.descriptionZh: 提出相关问题以加深理解；通过提问和回答问题来寻求帮助、获取信息或澄清不理解的内容
evidenceZh: 当内容不清楚或需要更多信息时提出问题
用相关且具体的信息回答问题
礼貌地请求澄清（例如：‘你能再解释一遍吗？’）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 不理解某些内容——比如游戏规则或老师的解释——他们会主动提问以获取更多信息，而不是凭空猜测吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Describing Aloud
topics.description: Describe familiar people, places, things, and events with detail; speak audibly and express thoughts, feelings, and ideas clearly; give well-structured descriptions and explanations
evidence: Describe a familiar person or place using several details
Speak clearly and loudly enough for the whole group to hear
Organise ideas logically when sharing information or telling about an event
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} tell you about something that happened — like a trip or a film — in enough detail that you could really picture it, speaking clearly so you can follow along?
topics.descriptionZh: 能够详细描述熟悉的人、地点、事物和事件；说话声音洪亮，清晰表达思想、情感和想法；提供条理清晰的描述和解释。
evidenceZh: 使用多个细节描述熟悉的人或地点
说话清晰且声音足够大，确保整个小组都能听见
在分享信息或讲述事件时，有逻辑地组织思路
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否给您讲讲发生过的一件事——比如一次旅行或一部电影——讲得足够详细让您能在脑海中勾勒出画面，并且说话清晰让您能轻松跟上思路？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Exploring Ideas Through Talk
topics.description: Use spoken language to develop understanding through speculating, hypothesising, imagining, and exploring ideas; use strategies to build vocabulary through talk
evidence: Wonder aloud about possibilities (e.g. 'What if...' or 'I think it might be because...')
Try out new vocabulary in conversation after hearing it in a story or lesson
Explore ideas through talk before committing them to writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is trying to figure something out — like why something happened in a story or how something works — do they talk through their ideas out loud and explore possibilities before settling on an answer?
topics.descriptionZh: 运用口语通过推测、假设、想象和探索想法来加深理解；运用通过交谈积累词汇的策略
evidenceZh: 大声说出对可能性的猜想（例如："如果……会怎样"或"我觉得可能是因为……"）
在故事或课堂上听到新词汇后，尝试在对话中使用它们
在将想法付诸笔头之前，先通过交谈进行探讨
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}试图弄明白某件事时——比如故事中某件事发生的原因或某物是如何运作的——他们是否会大声说出自己的想法，在得出最终答案前探索各种可能性？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Expressing & Justifying Opinions
topics.description: Articulate and justify answers, arguments, and opinions; participate in discussions, presentations, performances, role play, and debates
evidence: State an opinion and give a reason (e.g. 'I think ... because ...')
Participate in a class presentation or performance with confidence
Explain thinking when answering a question rather than just giving a one-word answer
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} disagrees with something or has an opinion, can they say why they think that and back it up with a reason rather than just saying "because I just do"?
topics.descriptionZh: 清晰表达并论证答案、论点和观点；参与讨论、展示、表演、角色扮演和辩论
evidenceZh: 陈述观点并给出理由（例如：‘我认为……因为……’）
充满自信地参与课堂展示或表演
在回答问题时解释自己的思考过程，而不是仅仅给出一个词的答案
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}不同意某事或有自己的观点时，他们能否说明原因并用理由来支持自己的想法，而不是仅仅说‘因为我想这样’？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Group discussions
topics.description: Participate actively in collaborative conversations staying on topic; continue a conversation through multiple exchanges; maintain attention in discussions
evidence: Stay on topic during a conversation for multiple turns
Build on what another speaker has said (e.g. 'I agree because...')
Maintain focus and contribute meaningfully in group discussions
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is chatting with a friend or taking part in a group activity, can they keep a conversation going back and forth — listening, responding, and building on what the other person said?
topics.descriptionZh: 积极参与合作性对话并紧扣主题；通过多次交流延续对话；在讨论中保持注意力
evidenceZh: 在对话的多个回合中紧扣主题
在他人发言的基础上进行补充或延伸（例如：'我同意，因为……'）
在小组讨论中保持专注并做出有意义的贡献
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}与朋友聊天或参与小组活动时，他们能否保持对话的来回互动——倾听、回应，并在对方所说的基础上进行延伸？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Listening and responding
topics.description: Listen and respond appropriately to adults and peers; follow agreed-upon rules for discussion such as listening to others and taking turns speaking
evidence: Demonstrate attentive listening by making eye contact and responding relevantly
Follow classroom discussion rules (e.g. raise hand, wait for turn)
Show understanding of what was said by paraphrasing or responding appropriately
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is in a group conversation at school or at the dinner table, do they listen while others are talking and wait for their turn before speaking?
topics.descriptionZh: 能够恰当地倾听并回应成人和同伴；遵守商定的讨论规则，如倾听他人和轮流发言
evidenceZh: 通过眼神交流和切题的回应展现专注的倾听
遵守课堂讨论规则（如举手、等待轮流发言）
通过复述或恰当的回应来展现对所听内容的理解
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}在学校或餐桌上参与小组交谈时，他们是否会在别人说话时认真倾听，并等待轮到自己时再发言？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Reciting Poetry
topics.description: Learn poems by heart and recite with appropriate intonation, adding visual displays to descriptions when appropriate, and producing complete sentences in spoken presentations
evidence: Recite a poem from memory with expression and clear enunciation
Add a drawing or visual display to support an oral description or presentation
Present information to the class using complete sentences and audible voice
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} memorise a short poem and recite it with expression — changing their voice to match the mood of the words?
topics.descriptionZh: 熟记诗歌并带有适当的语调进行朗诵，在适当时为描述添加视觉展示（如图片、道具），并在口头展示中使用完整的句子。
evidenceZh: 能够富有感情、吐字清晰地脱稿朗诵诗歌
能够添加绘画或视觉展示（如图片、道具）来辅助口头描述或展示
能够使用完整的句子和清晰响亮的声音向全班展示信息
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否背诵一首短诗并富有感情地朗诵——根据诗歌的情感改变自己的语调？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Engaging Listeners and Valuing Viewpoints
topics.description: Gain, maintain and monitor the interest of listeners when speaking; consider and evaluate different viewpoints, attending to and building on others' contributions; begin to select appropriate language for different situations
evidence: Use strategies to engage listeners during a presentation (e.g., make eye contact, vary tone and pace, ask the audience a question)
Listen to a peer's viewpoint and respond by agreeing, disagreeing, or extending their idea with a reason (e.g., 'I agree with Priya because… but I also think…')
Choose more formal language for a class presentation and more informal language for a group discussion, explaining the difference
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is talking in a group, do they notice if people are losing interest and adjust how they're speaking — or pick up on what others have said and add to it thoughtfully?
topics.nameZh: 吸引听众与尊重他人观点
topics.descriptionZh: 在表达时能够吸引、维持并关注听众的兴趣；思考并评估不同观点，倾听他人发言并在此基础上进行拓展；开始学会根据不同的场合选择恰当的语言
evidenceZh: 在演示时使用策略来吸引听众（例如：进行眼神交流、改变语调和语速、向听众提问）
倾听同伴的观点，并通过表示赞同、反对或给出理由来拓展他们的想法进行回应（例如：‘我同意普里亚的观点，因为……但我也认为……’）
在全班展示时选择更正式的语言，在小组讨论时选择更非正式的语言，并能解释两者的区别
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}在小组中发言时，他们是否会注意到别人失去兴趣并调整自己的说话方式，或者是否能留意他人的发言并经过思考后做出有深度的补充？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Preparing for and Explaining in Discussions
topics.description: Come to discussions prepared, draw on preparation and known information, and explain ideas in light of the discussion
evidence: Read assigned material and prepare three discussion points or questions before a group conversation
During discussion, refer explicitly to the text or preparation notes to support a point
After a group exchange, explain how one's own thinking changed or was confirmed by others' contributions
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} knows they're going to discuss a topic in class, do they think about it beforehand and come ready with ideas or facts to share?
topics.nameZh: 讨论前的准备与观点阐述
topics.descriptionZh: 做好讨论准备，利用准备内容和已知信息，并结合讨论情况解释自己的想法
evidenceZh: 在小组对话前阅读指定材料，并准备三个讨论要点或问题
在讨论过程中，明确引用文本或准备笔记来支持自己的观点
在小组交流后，解释自己的想法是如何改变的，或是如何被他人的发言所印证的
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果{{name}}知道他们要在课堂上讨论某个主题，他们会提前思考并准备好要分享的想法或事实吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Reporting & Recounting
topics.description: Report on a topic or recount an experience with organised facts and descriptive details, speaking clearly at an understandable pace
evidence: Deliver a one-minute oral report on a chosen topic, including at least three organised facts
Recount a personal experience using descriptive details and a clear beginning, middle, and end
Self-assess a recorded presentation for pace, clarity, and inclusion of relevant details
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} give a short talk about a topic they've researched — presenting the key facts in a logical order and speaking clearly enough for others to follow?
topics.descriptionZh: 就某一主题进行报告或记叙某段经历，需包含有条理的事实和描述性细节，并以清晰、适中的语速进行表达。
evidenceZh: 就选定的主题进行一分钟的口头报告，至少包含三个有条理的事实要点
运用描述性细节，按照清晰的开头、中间和结尾结构记叙一段个人经历
对录制的展示进行自我评估，检查语速、清晰度以及相关细节的包含情况
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否就其研究过的主题进行一次简短的演讲——按逻辑顺序展示关键事实，并表达清晰、语速适中，使他人能够轻松听懂？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Identifying Reasons Behind a Speaker's Points
topics.description: Identify the reasons and evidence a speaker provides to support particular points, evaluating whether the reasoning is logical and the evidence is relevant
evidence: Listen to a speaker's argument or presentation and list the specific reasons and evidence provided to support each main point
Evaluate whether the reasons a speaker gives are logical and whether the evidence cited is relevant to the claim being made
Ask follow-up questions that probe the strength of a speaker's reasoning, e.g. 'What evidence supports that claim?' or 'Are there other explanations?'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} listens to someone making an argument or giving reasons for something, can they tell you whether the reasons given actually support what the person is claiming?
topics.nameZh: 识别发言者观点背后的原因
topics.descriptionZh: 识别发言者为支持特定观点所提供的理由和证据，评估其推理是否符合逻辑以及证据是否相关
evidenceZh: 倾听发言者的论点或陈述，列出支持每个主要观点的具体理由和证据
评估发言者给出的理由是否符合逻辑，以及所引用的证据是否与其主张相关
提出后续问题以探究发言者推理的严密性，例如：'有什么证据支持这一主张？'或'还有其他解释吗？'
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}听到某人提出论点或为某事给出理由时，他们能判断所给出的理由是否真正支持了该人的主张吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Paraphrasing What You Hear
topics.description: Paraphrase portions of a text read aloud or information presented in diverse media and formats, capturing the key ideas accurately in one's own words
evidence: Listen to a passage read aloud and restate the main idea and key details in own words without looking at the original text
Paraphrase information from a short video, podcast, or presentation, identifying the central message and supporting details
Distinguish between paraphrasing (restating in own words) and copying, demonstrating the ability to capture meaning without repeating exact wording
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} listens to a short talk or watches a video clip about a topic, can they explain the main points back to you in their own words?
topics.descriptionZh: 对朗读的文本片段或通过多种媒体和格式呈现的信息进行复述（paraphrasing），用自己的语言准确概括核心要点。
evidenceZh: 听一段朗读的文本，在不看原文的情况下，用自己的话复述主要观点和关键细节
复述来自短视频、播客或演示的信息，识别核心主旨和支撑细节
区分复述（用自己的话重述）和照抄，展示出在不重复确切措辞的情况下把握含义的能力
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果{{name}}听了一段关于某个主题的简短谈话或观看了一个视频片段，他们能用自己的话把要点解释给你听吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Adapting Speech to Context
topics.description: Adapt speech to a variety of contexts and tasks, using formal English when appropriate to task and situation while adjusting tone, vocabulary, and style for different audiences
evidence: Present the same information formally to a panel and informally to peers
Adjust vocabulary and sentence structure when speaking to different audiences
Identify contexts that require formal English and those where informal speech is appropriate
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} naturally speak differently depending on who they're talking to — for example, more formally with a teacher than with a friend at the playground?
topics.nameZh: 根据语境调整语言表达
topics.descriptionZh: 能够根据不同的语境和任务调整语言表达，在适合任务和情境时使用正式英语（formal English），同时为不同的受众调整语气、词汇和风格。
evidenceZh: 向评委或小组正式陈述同一信息，向同伴进行非正式交流
与不同受众交谈时，调整词汇和句子结构
识别需要正式英语（formal English）的语境以及适合非正式口语（informal speech）的语境
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 是否会根据交谈对象的不同而自然地改变说话方式——例如，对老师说话比对在操场上和朋友说话更正式？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Building on Others in Discussions
topics.description: Pose and respond to specific questions in discussions, making comments that contribute to the discussion and elaborate on the remarks of others
evidence: Ask follow-up questions that build on another speaker's comment
Respond to a classmate's idea by adding supporting evidence or a related example
Redirect a discussion by posing a question that connects to the main topic
topics.assessmentPrompt: In a class discussion, does {{name}} ask questions that move the conversation forward and add comments that build on what others have said rather than just repeating the same ideas?
topics.nameZh: 在讨论中拓展他人观点
topics.descriptionZh: 在讨论中提出并回应具体问题，发表有助于推动讨论的评论，并对他人的发言进行补充和详细阐述
evidenceZh: 提出后续问题，在他人发言的基础上进行深入探讨
通过补充支持性证据或相关实例来回应同学的想法
通过提出与核心主题相关的问题来引导讨论方向
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在课堂讨论中，{{name}} 是否能提出推动对话发展的问题，并在他人观点的基础上补充评论，而不是仅仅重复已有的想法？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Drawing Conclusions from Discussion
topics.description: Review the key ideas expressed in discussions and draw conclusions in light of information and knowledge gained from the discussion
evidence: Summarise the main points made by different speakers in a group discussion
Draw a conclusion that synthesises multiple viewpoints expressed in the discussion
Explain how the discussion changed or confirmed initial understanding of a topic
topics.assessmentPrompt: After a group discussion, can {{name}} pull together the main points that were made and explain what conclusion the group reached?
topics.descriptionZh: 回顾讨论中表达的关键观点，并结合从讨论中获得的信息和知识得出结论。
evidenceZh: 总结小组讨论中不同发言者提出的主要观点
得出一个综合讨论中表达的多个观点的结论
解释讨论如何改变或确认了对某一主题的初步理解
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在小组讨论之后，{{name}}能否汇总提出的主要观点，并解释小组得出了什么结论？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Evaluating a Speaker's Argument
topics.description: Summarise the points a speaker makes and explain how each claim is supported by reasons and evidence, evaluating the logic and relevance of the support
evidence: Identify the main claim in a spoken presentation and the evidence used to support it
Evaluate whether a speaker's reasons logically support their main argument
Explain which pieces of evidence most effectively support a speaker's points
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} listens to a speaker making a case for something, can they explain back to you both what the speaker claimed and the reasons and evidence they gave to back it up?
topics.descriptionZh: 总结说话者提出的观点，并解释每个主张（claim）是如何由理由和证据支持的，同时评估这些支持的逻辑性和相关性。
evidenceZh: 识别口头陈述中的主要主张（main claim）以及用于支持该主张的证据
评估说话者的理由是否在逻辑上支持其主要论点（main argument）
解释哪些证据最有效地支持了说话者的观点
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}听说话者为某事进行论证时，他们能否向您说明说话者提出了什么主张，以及他们用来支持该主张的理由和证据？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Multimedia Presentations
topics.description: Include multimedia components and visual displays in presentations when appropriate to enhance the development of main ideas or themes
evidence: Select graphics, images, or sound that support and clarify main ideas in a presentation
Create slides or visual aids that enhance rather than distract from the spoken content
Integrate multimedia elements smoothly into an oral presentation
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} gives a presentation at school, do they think about including things like diagrams, slides, or pictures to help make their points clearer for the audience?
topics.descriptionZh: 在演示中适时加入多媒体组件和视觉展示，以促进主要观点或主题的表达与发展
evidenceZh: 选择能够支持并阐明演示中主要观点的图形、图像或声音
制作能够增强而非分散口头表达注意力的幻灯片或视觉辅助工具
将多媒体元素流畅地融入口头演示中
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}在学校做演示时，他们是否会考虑加入图表、幻灯片或图片等元素，以帮助观众更清楚地理解他们的观点？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Summarising Spoken and Media Presentations
topics.description: Summarise a written text read aloud or information presented in diverse media and formats including visually, quantitatively, and orally
evidence: Summarise the main points of a video or audio presentation in own words
Identify key information from a graph, chart, or infographic and explain it orally
Listen to a passage read aloud and provide an accurate summary of the content
topics.assessmentPrompt: After listening to a talk or watching an informational video, can {{name}} give you a spoken summary of what the main message was in their own words?
topics.nameZh: 总结口头表达与媒体展示内容
topics.descriptionZh: 总结大声朗读的书面文本，或通过多种媒介和格式（包括视觉、定量和口头方式）呈现的信息。
evidenceZh: 用自己的话总结视频或音频演示的主要内容
从图形(graph)、图表(chart)或信息图(infographic)中识别关键信息并进行口头解释
听一段朗读的文本，并提供准确的内容总结
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在听完一场演讲或观看一部信息类视频后，{{name}} 能否用自己的话口头总结其主要信息？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Performing Scripts & Poetry
