topics.description: Improvise, rehearse, and perform play scripts and poetry — using role, intonation, tone, volume, mood, silence, stillness, and action to generate language, explore meaning, and add impact to performance
evidence: Perform a scene from a play using appropriate intonation, volume, and pauses to convey character and mood
Use improvisation to explore how a character might respond in a new situation
Rehearse and perform a poem aloud, using pace and emphasis to bring out the meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} performs in a play or reads aloud from a script, do they use their voice — volume, pace, and expression — to bring the character or poem to life?
topics.descriptionZh: 即兴创作、排练并表演剧本和诗歌——运用角色、语调、语气、音量、情绪、静默、静止和动作来生成语言、探索意义并增强表演的感染力
evidenceZh: 运用恰当的语调、音量和停顿表演剧本片段，以传达角色特征和情绪
运用即兴表演探索角色在全新情境下的可能反应
排练并大声朗诵诗歌，运用语速和重音来凸显诗歌的内涵
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}参与戏剧表演或朗读剧本时，他们是否会运用声音——如音量、语速和情感表达——来让角色或诗歌生动鲜活？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Speaking Formally and Giving Presentations
topics.description: Use Standard English confidently in formal and informal spoken contexts — give short speeches and presentations expressing own ideas clearly, keeping to the point, and adapting register and vocabulary to the audience
evidence: Deliver a 2-3 minute presentation on a topic with a clear opening, organised points, and a conclusion
Adapt language between formal and informal registers depending on the context and audience
Maintain eye contact, appropriate pace, and clear articulation when speaking to a group
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} give a short prepared speech or presentation in Standard English — staying on point and adjusting their vocabulary to suit the audience?
topics.descriptionZh: 在正式和非正式口语语境中自信地使用标准英语——进行简短的演讲和展示，清晰表达自己的观点，紧扣主题，并根据听众调整语体（register）和词汇。
evidenceZh: 就某一主题进行2-3分钟的演讲或展示，包含清晰的开场白、有条理的要点和总结
根据语境和听众，在正式和非正式语体（register）之间灵活转换语言
在群体面前发言时，保持眼神交流、语速适中、吐字清晰
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否用标准英语发表简短的预备演讲或展示——做到紧扣主题并根据听众调整词汇？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Formal Debates
topics.description: Participate in formal debates and structured discussions — presenting a position with supporting evidence, responding to others’ points, summarising and building on what has been said, and following rules of discussion
evidence: Present an argument in a debate with a clear claim supported by evidence
Respond to an opposing point by summarising it fairly before offering a counterargument
Build on a previous speaker’s idea by extending, questioning, or challenging it constructively
topics.assessmentPrompt: Has {{name}} taken part in a school debate where they had to argue a position with evidence, respond to the other side's points, and keep to the rules of formal discussion?
topics.descriptionZh: 参与正式辩论和结构化讨论——提出立场并附带支持性证据，回应他人的观点，总结并在此基础上进一步发展已有内容，以及遵守讨论规则。
evidenceZh: 在辩论中提出论点，包含清晰的、有证据支持的主张
在提出反驳之前，先客观地总结反对观点，以此作为回应
通过建设性地延伸、质疑或挑战前一位发言者的想法，在此基础上进行拓展
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 是否参加过学校辩论，在其中他们需要以证据论证某一立场、回应对方观点，并遵守正式讨论的规则？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Phonics Vocabulary
topics.description: Know and use the vocabulary of phonics and word structure — phoneme, grapheme, GPC (grapheme-phoneme correspondence), blend, segment, digraph, CVC, vowel, consonant, syllable, root word, suffix, prefix, and homophone — and understand that these words describe the building blocks that phonics instruction is built on
evidence: Say the sounds for common graphemes (e.g. 'sh', 'ch', 'th', 'ee', 'igh') and use 'phoneme' and 'grapheme' correctly when explaining
Blend sounds together to read an unfamiliar word and explain what they are doing using the word 'blend'
Segment a word into its individual sounds for spelling and use the term 'segment' to describe the process
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}}'s teacher asks them to 'segment a word into phonemes' or spot a 'digraph', do they understand what those words mean and can they do the task without looking confused?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解并使用自然拼读和单词结构的词汇——音素（phoneme）、字素（grapheme）、GPC（字素-音素对应关系，grapheme-phoneme correspondence）、拼读（blend）、分音（segment）、二合字母（digraph）、辅-元-辅（CVC）、元音（vowel）、辅音（consonant）、音节（syllable）、词根（root word）、后缀（suffix）、前缀（prefix）和同音词（homophone）——并理解这些词汇描述了自然拼读教学所依赖的基础构建块。
evidenceZh: 能读出常见字素（如 'sh'、'ch'、'th'、'ee'、'igh'）的发音，并在解释时正确使用“音素（phoneme）”和“字素（grapheme）”这两个词
能将声音拼读（blend）在一起来读出陌生的单词，并用“拼读（blend）”一词来解释他们的做法
为了拼写将单词分音（segment）成单独的声音，并使用“分音（segment）”一词来描述该过程
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 的老师要求他们“将单词分音（segment）成音素（phonemes）”或找出一个“二合字母（digraph）”时，他们能理解这些词的意思并顺利完成该任务而不显困惑吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Segmenting words into sounds
topics.description: Segment spoken words into phonemes and spell CVC and simple phonetically regular words by writing a letter or letters for each sound
evidence: Write CVC words from dictation (e.g. 'cat', 'bed', 'hot')
Segment words into individual sounds before choosing letters to write
Spell simple words phonetically drawing on sound-letter knowledge
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} listen to a simple word like "cat" or "ship" and write down the letters for each sound they hear?
topics.descriptionZh: 将口语单词切分为音素（phonemes），并通过为每个音素书写对应的字母来拼写CVC（辅音-元音-辅音）单词和符合拼读规则的简单单词
evidenceZh: 听写CVC（辅音-元音-辅音）单词（例如：'cat'、'bed'、'hot'）
在选择书写字母之前，将单词切分为单个音素
运用音形对应知识，按发音拼写简单单词
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否听一个简单的单词，如'cat'或'ship'，并写下他们听到的每个音对应的字母？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Spelling from Dictation
topics.description: Write simple sentences from memory when dictated by the teacher, applying taught GPCs, spelling rules, and common exception words
evidence: Write a dictated sentence using phonically plausible spellings
Include correct spelling of taught exception words in dictation
Apply sentence punctuation in dictated writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you read a sentence out loud to {{name}} and ask them to write it down, can they spell the words correctly and put the letters in the right order?
topics.descriptionZh: 能够根据老师的听写，凭记忆写出简单的句子，并运用已学的字素-音素对应关系（GPCs）、拼写规则以及常见例外词。
evidenceZh: 运用符合拼读规律的拼写方式写出听写的句子
在听写中正确拼写出已学的常见例外词
在听写书写中正确应用句子标点符号
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果您大声朗读一个句子让{{name}}听写下来，他们能否正确拼写单词并将字母按正确的顺序排列？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Spelling Verb Endings
topics.description: Spell words with common suffixes (-s/-es for plurals and third person verbs, -ing, -ed, -er, -est) where no change to the root word is needed
evidence: Add -s or -es correctly to make plurals (e.g. 'cats', 'boxes')
Spell words with -ing and -ed endings (e.g. 'jumping', 'helped')
Add -er and -est to adjectives (e.g. 'quicker', 'quickest')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes about more than one dog or talks about something that is happening now, do they add the right ending — like "dogs" or "jumping" — without making spelling mistakes?
topics.descriptionZh: 拼写带有常见后缀的单词（如用于复数和第三人称动词的 -s/-es，以及 -ing、-ed、-er、-est），且词根无需发生任何变化。
evidenceZh: 正确添加 -s 或 -es 构成复数（例如“cats”、“boxes”）
拼写带有 -ing 和 -ed 词尾的单词（例如“jumping”、“helped”）
为形容词添加 -er 和 -est 构成比较级和最高级（例如“quicker”、“quickest”）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 写到多只狗或谈论正在发生的事情时，他们能否正确添加词尾（如“dogs”或“jumping”）而不犯拼写错误？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: The Prefix un-
topics.description: Spell words using the prefix un- to change meaning; understand that un- creates opposites or reverses actions
evidence: Spell words with un- prefix correctly (e.g. 'unhappy', 'unfair', 'undo')
Explain how un- changes the meaning of a word
Create new words by adding un- to known words
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} know that adding "un-" to the front of a word like "happy" or "lock" flips its meaning, and can they spell those words correctly?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用 (un-) 前缀拼写单词以改变词义；理解 (un-) 可以构成反义词或表示动作的撤销
evidenceZh: 正确拼写带有 (un-) 前缀的单词（如 'unhappy'、'unfair'、'undo'）
解释 (un-) 是如何改变单词含义的
通过在已知单词前添加 (un-) 来创造新词
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 是否知道在“happy”或“lock”等单词前面加上“(un-)”会反转其含义，并且能够正确拼写这些单词吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Tricky words
topics.description: Spell common exception words from memory that do not follow regular phonic patterns, including the days of the week
evidence: Correctly spell high-frequency irregular words (e.g. 'said', 'the', 'was')
Write all seven days of the week correctly
Recall and write exception words in dictated sentences
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} spell tricky everyday words like "said," "were," "come," and the days of the week from memory without needing to sound them out?
topics.descriptionZh: 凭记忆拼写不符合常规自然拼读（phonic patterns）规律的常见例外词（common exception words），包括一周七天的名称（days of the week）。
evidenceZh: 正确拼写高频不规则词（high-frequency irregular words，例如 'said'、'the'、'was'）
正确书写一周七天的名称（days of the week）
在听写句子中回忆并写出例外词（exception words）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否在不依赖自然拼读（sounding out）的情况下，凭记忆正确拼写像 'said'、'were'、'come' 这样的日常易错词（tricky everyday words）以及一周七天的名称？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Alternative Spellings for Sounds
topics.description: Spell words using alternative grapheme choices for known phonemes, learning new spellings for sounds already encountered (e.g., /ɔ:/ as 'a' before ll, /ʌ/ as 'o', words ending -tion), including distinguishing common homophones
evidence: Spell 'ball', 'call', 'walk' using alternative grapheme /ɔ:/ as 'a' before ll
Distinguish homophones in writing: 'there/their/they’re', 'here/hear', 'quite/quiet'
Spell words ending in -tion correctly: 'station', 'fiction', 'motion'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes and comes across a word where the same sound can be spelled different ways — like "see" and "sea" — do they know which spelling to use?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用已学音素（phonemes）的替代字素（graphemes）拼写单词，学习已知发音的新拼写方式（例如，/ɔ:/ 在 ll 前拼作 'a'，/ʌ/ 拼作 'o'，以及以 -tion 结尾的单词），并包括区分常见的同音词（homophones）。
evidenceZh: 在 ll 前使用替代字素 'a' 来拼写发 /ɔ:/ 音的单词，如 'ball'、'call'、'walk'
在书写中区分同音词（homophones）：'there/their/they’re'、'here/hear'、'quite/quiet'
正确拼写以 -tion 结尾的单词：'station'、'fiction'、'motion'
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 写作时遇到同一个发音可以有不同拼写方式的单词——比如“see”和“sea”——他们知道该使用哪种拼写吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Apostrophes for possession
topics.description: Use the possessive apostrophe with singular nouns to show ownership (e.g., the girl's book, the dog's bone)
evidence: Write 'the cat's tail' to show the tail belongs to the cat
Distinguish plural -s ('the cats ran') from possessive 's ('the cat's bed') in writing
Add a possessive apostrophe to a singular noun in a dictated sentence
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes something belonging to one person or thing — like "the dog's lead" or "the girl's bag" — do they put the apostrophe in the right place?
topics.descriptionZh: 在单数名词后使用所有格撇号 (possessive apostrophe) 来表示所属关系（例如：the girl's book, the dog's bone）
evidenceZh: 写出 'the cat's tail' 以表示尾巴属于这只猫
在书写中区分复数词尾 -s ('the cats ran') 与所有格 's ('the cat's bed')
在听写句子中为单数名词添加所有格撇号
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 写属于某个人或事物的东西时——比如 'the dog's lead' 或 'the girl's bag'——他们是否把撇号放在了正确的位置？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Spelling Contracted Forms
topics.description: Spell contracted forms correctly by placing the apostrophe where letters are omitted (can't, didn't, I'll, it's, etc.)
evidence: Write 'can't' for 'cannot', 'didn't' for 'did not' with apostrophe correctly placed
Distinguish 'it's' (it is) from 'its' (possessive) in a sentence
Expand a contraction back to its full form and explain which letters are missing
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a short form like "can't" or "didn't," do they put the apostrophe in the right place to show where letters are missing?
topics.descriptionZh: 通过在被省略字母的位置正确放置撇号（apostrophe）来正确拼写缩略形式（如 can't, didn't, I'll, it's 等）。
evidenceZh: 正确放置撇号，将 'cannot' 写成 'can't'，将 'did not' 写成 'didn't'
在句子中区分 'it's'（it is 的缩写）和 'its'（所有格）
将缩略形式还原为完整形式，并解释省略了哪些字母
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 写下像 'can't' 或 'didn't' 这样的缩略形式时，他们是否把撇号放在了正确的位置，以标明省略字母的位置？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Suffixes
topics.description: Apply suffix spelling rules that require changes to the root word: dropping final -e before vowel suffixes, changing -y to -i, doubling final consonants in short-vowel words; use suffixes -ment, -ness, -ful, -less, -ly
evidence: Spell 'hoping' (drop e), 'cried' (y to i), 'running' (double consonant) applying the correct rule
Add -ful, -less, -ness, -ly correctly: 'careful', 'hopeless', 'sadness', 'slowly'
Identify which suffix rule to apply to a given root word and explain why
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} adds an ending like "-ing" or "-ed" to a word, do they know when to drop a silent "e," double the last letter, or change a "y" to an "i" — for example, "running," "baked," or "happily"?
topics.descriptionZh: 应用涉及改变词根(root word)的后缀拼写规则：在以元音开头的后缀前去掉词尾的-e，将-y改为-i，在短元音单词中双写词尾辅音字母；使用后缀-ment、-ness、-ful、-less、-ly
evidenceZh: 运用正确的拼写规则拼写“hoping”（去掉e）、“cried”（y变i）和“running”（双写辅音字母）
正确添加后缀-ful、-less、-ness、-ly，如：“careful”、“hopeless”、“sadness”、“slowly”
识别给定的词根(root word)需要应用哪条后缀规则，并解释原因
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}在单词后加上“-ing”或“-ed”等词尾时，他们是否知道何时去掉不发音的“e”、双写最后一个字母，或将“y”改为“i”——例如“running”、“baked”或“happily”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Apostrophes for possession (age 7+)
topics.description: Use the possessive apostrophe accurately with both regular and irregular plural nouns (e.g., the girls' bags, the children's toys), distinguishing singular from plural possession
evidence: Place the apostrophe correctly in plural possessives: 'the dogs' kennel' vs 'the dog's kennel'
Write possessive forms of irregular plurals correctly (e.g. 'children's', 'women's', 'mice's')
Distinguish singular possession (the boy's hat) from plural possession (the boys' hats) in dictated sentences
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes about something belonging to a group — like "the children's coats" or "the teachers' cars" — do they put the apostrophe in the right place?
topics.descriptionZh: 准确使用所有格撇号（apostrophe）来表达规则和不规则复数名词的所有格（例如，the girls' bags, the children's toys），并能区分单数所有格和复数所有格。
evidenceZh: 在复数所有格中正确放置撇号：“the dogs' kennel”与“the dog's kennel”的区别
正确书写不规则复数名词的所有格形式（例如，“children's”、“women's”、“mice's”）
在听写句子中区分单数所有格（the boy's hat）和复数所有格（the boys' hats）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 描写属于一个群体的物品时——例如“the children's coats”或“the teachers' cars”——他们是否把撇号（apostrophe）放在了正确的位置？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Homophones
topics.description: Distinguish and correctly spell common homophones and near-homophones encountered at Y3-4 level (e.g., accept/except, affect/effect, brake/break, grate/great), including using the /eɪ/ sound spelt ei, eigh, or ey
evidence: Spell pairs of homophones correctly in context (e.g., 'there/their/they're', 'brake/break', 'grate/great')
Choose the correct homophone to complete a sentence (e.g., 'The dog wagged its/it's tail')
Spell words with the /eɪ/ sound as ei, eigh, or ey (e.g., vein, eight, they, neighbour)
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes, do they use the right spelling for words that sound the same but mean different things — like "brake" (on a bike) and "break" (snap something)?
topics.descriptionZh: 区分并正确拼写3-4年级（Y3-4 level）常见的同音词和近音词（例如 accept/except, affect/effect, brake/break, grate/great），包括将 /eɪ/ 发音拼写为 ei、eigh 或 ey。
evidenceZh: 在语境中正确拼写同音词对（例如：'there/their/they're', 'brake/break', 'grate/great'）
选择正确的同音词完成句子（例如：'The dog wagged its/it's tail'）
将发 /eɪ/ 音的单词拼写为 ei、eigh 或 ey（例如：vein, eight, they, neighbour）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 写作时，他们是否能为发音相同但含义不同的词使用正确的拼写——比如“brake”（自行车的刹车）和“break”（打碎某物）？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Prefixes (age 7+)
topics.description: Spell words with a range of prefixes (dis-, mis-, un-, re-, pre-, anti-, auto-, super-) understanding how each prefix modifies the root word's meaning without changing its spelling
evidence: Spell words with prefixes dis-, mis-, re- correctly without altering the root (e.g., disappoint, misspell, return)
Add prefixes un-, pre-, anti-, auto-, super- to root words and use the new word in a sentence (e.g., unhappy, preview, autograph)
Explain how a prefix changes the meaning of a root word (e.g., 'dis-' means 'not' or 'opposite of')
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a word starting with "dis-," "mis-," or "pre-," can they work out what the word means and spell it correctly by thinking about the prefix?
topics.descriptionZh: 拼写包含多种前缀（Prefixes）（如 dis-, mis-, un-, re-, pre-, anti-, auto-, super-）的单词，并理解每个前缀如何在不改变词根（Root word）拼写的情况下改变词根的含义。
evidenceZh: 正确拼写带有 dis-、mis-、re- 前缀的单词，且不改变词根（Root word）（例如：disappoint, misspell, return）
为词根（Root word）添加 un-、pre-、anti-、auto-、super- 等前缀，并在句子中使用新词（例如：unhappy, preview, autograph）
解释前缀（Prefix）如何改变词根（Root word）的含义（例如：'dis-' 表示“不”或“相反”）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到一个以“dis-”、“mis-”或“pre-”开头的单词，他们能否通过思考前缀（Prefix）的含义来推断出该词的意思并正确拼写？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Spelling Word Lists (age 7+)
topics.description: Spell words from the statutory word list for Years 3 and 4, including commonly misspelt words that do not follow regular patterns
evidence: Spell at least 20 words from the Y3-4 statutory list correctly (e.g., accident, believe, different, favourite, imagine)
Identify tricky parts of statutory words and use a strategy to remember them (e.g., 'separate' has 'a rat' in the middle)
Use statutory list words accurately in own writing across subjects
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} spell the tricky words on their school's Year 3 and 4 word list — like "enough," "believe," or "separate" — from memory when writing?
topics.descriptionZh: 拼写3至4年级法定单词表中的单词，包括不符合常规拼写规律的常见易错词。
evidenceZh: 正确拼写3至4年级法定词表中的至少20个单词（如：accident, believe, different, favourite, imagine）
识别法定单词中的难拼部分并使用记忆策略（例如，'separate'中间包含'a rat'）
在各学科的自主写作中准确使用法定词表中的单词
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}在写作时能否凭记忆拼写出学校3至4年级单词表中的易错词（如“enough”、“believe”或“separate”）？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Suffixes (age 7+)
topics.description: Spell words using productive suffixes (-ation, -ly, -ous) and less common sound-spelling correspondences (/ɪ/ as y, /ʌ/ as ou, endings sounding like /ʒə/, /tʃə/, /ʒən/, /ʃən/) introduced in the Year 3-4 programme
evidence: Spell words with suffixes -ation (e.g., information, sensation), -ly (e.g., sadly, gently, happily), and -ous (e.g., famous, enormous, various)
Spell words with less common vowel patterns: /ɪ/ as y (e.g., myth, gym), /ʌ/ as ou (e.g., young, touch, double)
Spell words with endings /ʒə/ as -sure (e.g., measure, treasure), /tʃə/ as -ture (e.g., creature, furniture), /ʒən/ as -sion (e.g., division, television)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} spell words with endings like "-tion," "-ous," or "-ly" correctly — for example, "nation," "famous," or "quietly" — without needing to look them up?
topics.descriptionZh: 运用能产后缀（如 -ation、-ly、-ous）以及三至四年级课程中引入的较少见的音形对应规则（如 /ɪ/ 对应 y，/ʌ/ 对应 ou，以及发音为 /ʒə/、/tʃə/、/ʒən/、/ʃən/ 的词尾）进行单词拼写。
evidenceZh: 拼写带有后缀 -ation（如 information、sensation）、-ly（如 sadly、gently、happily）和 -ous（如 famous、enormous、various）的单词
拼写包含较少见元音拼写模式的单词：/ɪ/ 对应 y（如 myth、gym），/ʌ/ 对应 ou（如 young、touch、double）
拼写包含特定词尾发音的单词：/ʒə/ 对应 -sure（如 measure、treasure），/tʃə/ 对应 -ture（如 creature、furniture），/ʒən/ 对应 -sion（如 division、television）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否在不查字典的情况下，正确拼写带有“-tion”、“-ous”或“-ly”等词尾的单词（例如“nation”、“famous”或“quietly”）？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Using a Dictionary to Check Spellings
topics.description: Use the first two or three letters of a word to check its spelling in a dictionary; consult reference materials including beginning dictionaries to verify and correct spellings
evidence: Locate a word in a dictionary using its first two or three letters (e.g., find 'beautiful' by looking up 'be-')
Check and correct a misspelling by comparing with the dictionary entry (e.g., look up 'freind' → 'friend')
Use a glossary or beginning dictionary to confirm spelling of a word used in own writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} isn't sure how to spell a word, can they look it up in a dictionary by using the first two or three letters to find it quickly?
topics.descriptionZh: 利用单词的前两到三个字母在字典中检查其拼写；查阅参考资料（包括初级字典）以核实和纠正拼写。
evidenceZh: 利用单词的前两到三个字母在字典中查找该词（例如，通过查找“be-”来找到“beautiful”）
通过与字典词条对比来检查和纠正拼写错误（例如，查找“freind”并纠正为“friend”）
使用词汇表（glossary）或初级字典来确认自己写作中所用单词的拼写
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果{{name}}不确定某个单词的拼写，他们能否利用前两到三个字母在字典中快速查找该词？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Spellings from Greek, French and Latin
topics.description: Spell words with etymological letter patterns from Greek (ch = /k/), French (ch = /ʃ/, -gue, -que), and Latin (sc = /s/) origins
evidence: Spell words with Greek ch such as 'scheme', 'chorus', 'chemist', 'echo' and explain the /k/ sound pattern
Spell words with French ch such as 'chef', 'chalet', 'machine' and -gue/-que endings like 'league', 'unique'
Spell words with Latin sc such as 'science', 'scene', 'discipline' and identify the silent letter pattern
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} know that some words have letter patterns from other languages — like "ch" making a "k" sound in "school" or "chorus" — and can they spell those words correctly?
topics.nameZh: 源自希腊语、法语和拉丁语的拼写
topics.descriptionZh: 拼写具有词源字母模式的单词，这些模式源自希腊语（ch = /k/）、法语（ch = /ʃ/、-gue、-que）和拉丁语（sc = /s/）
evidenceZh: 拼写包含希腊语“ch”的单词，如“scheme”（计划）、“chorus”（合唱团）、“chemist”（化学家）、“echo”（回声），并解释/k/的发音模式
拼写包含法语“ch”的单词，如“chef”（主厨）、“chalet”（小木屋）、“machine”（机器），以及以“-gue”/“-que”结尾的单词，如“league”（联盟）、“unique”（独特的）
拼写包含拉丁语“sc”的单词，如“science”（科学）、“scene”（场景）、“discipline”（纪律），并识别不发音字母的模式
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}是否知道有些单词包含来自其他语言的字母模式——例如“school”或“chorus”中的“ch”发“k”音——并且能正确拼写这些单词吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Advanced Spelling Conventions
topics.description: Spell words using assorted Y5-6 conventions: doubling after -fer when the stress remains (referring but reference), using hyphens to join prefixes to root words (co-ordinate, re-enter), the /iː/ sound spelt ei after c (receive, ceiling), and the letter string ough representing different sounds (though, through, thought, thorough, plough)
evidence: Apply the -fer doubling rule: double the r when the syllable is stressed (referring, preferred, transferred) but not when stress shifts (reference, preference)
Use hyphens correctly when a prefix ends with the same letter the root begins with (re-enter, co-own) or to avoid ambiguity (re-cover vs recover)
Read and spell words containing ough by recognising its multiple pronunciations: /oʊ/ (though), /uː/ (through), /ɔː/ (thought), /ʌf/ (rough), /aʊ/ (plough)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} correctly spell tricky words like "receive," "though," or "co-ordinate," including knowing when to use a hyphen or the "-ei" pattern after "c"?
topics.descriptionZh: 运用五至六年级的各种拼写规范拼写单词：在 -fer 结尾且重音保留时双写字母（如 referring 但 reference），使用连字符连接前缀与词根（如 co-ordinate, re-enter），在字母 c 后用 ei 拼写 /iː/ 音（如 receive, ceiling），以及字母组合 ough 代表不同发音（如 though, through, thought, thorough, plough）
evidenceZh: 应用 -fer 双写规则：当音节重音保留时双写字母 r（如 referring, preferred, transferred），但当重音转移时则不双写（如 reference, preference）
正确使用连字符：当前缀的结尾字母与词根的开头字母相同时（如 re-enter, co-own），或为了避免歧义时（如 re-cover 与 recover）
通过识别 ough 的多种发音来阅读和拼写包含该字母组合的单词：/oʊ/（如 though）、/uː/（如 through）、/ɔː/（如 thought）、/ʌf/（如 rough）、/aʊ/（如 plough）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否正确拼写 receive、though 或 co-ordinate 等易错词，并知道何时使用连字符或在 c 后使用 -ei 拼写模式？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Homophones (age 9+)
topics.description: Distinguish and correctly spell homophones and commonly confused words at Y5-6 level (e.g., affect/effect, practice/practise, advice/advise, complement/compliment, aisle/isle, led/lead), including confused words such as to/too/two and there/their/they're
evidence: Select the correct spelling from a pair of homophones by analysing meaning in context, e.g. 'The doctor's advice (noun) was to practise (verb) daily'
Spell commonly confused words accurately by applying word-class clues: advise/advice, practise/practice, licence/license (verb ends in -ise, noun ends in -ice)
Identify and correct homophone errors in extended writing, including to/too/two, there/their/they're, whose/who's, and its/it's
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes, do they use the right spelling for commonly mixed-up words — like "affect" vs "effect," "practice" vs "practise," or "there," "their," and "they're"?
topics.descriptionZh: 区分并正确拼写Y5-6年级水平的同音异义词及常见易混淆单词（例如：affect/effect、practice/practise、advice/advise、complement/compliment、aisle/isle、led/lead），包括 to/too/two 和 there/their/they're 等易混淆词汇。
evidenceZh: 通过分析上下文语境中的含义，从一对同音异义词中选择正确的拼写，例如：‘医生的建议（名词，advice）是每天练习（动词，practise）’。
运用词性线索准确拼写常见易混淆单词：advise/advice、practise/practice、licence/license（动词以 -ise 结尾，名词以 -ice 结尾）。
识别并纠正较长篇幅写作中的同音异义词拼写错误，包括 to/too/two、there/their/they're、whose/who's 以及 its/it's。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 写作时，他们是否能正确拼写常见的易混淆词——例如 "affect" 与 "effect"、"practice" 与 "practise"，或者 "there"、"their" 和 "they're"？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Silent Letters in Words
topics.description: Spell words containing silent letters that are remnants of earlier pronunciation or etymology, recognising common silent-letter patterns and using word origins to remember them
evidence: Identify and spell words with silent initial consonants: knight, know, write, wrap, gnaw, psalm, applying knowledge that these letters were once pronounced
Spell words with silent internal letters: doubt (b), island (s), muscle (c), solemn (n), using etymological connections to aid memory (e.g. doubt from Latin dubitare)
Use word families and etymology to remember silent letters, e.g. sign is related to signal where the g is pronounced
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes words that have silent letters — like "knight," "wrap," or "lamb" — do they remember to include the silent letter even though you can't hear it?
topics.nameZh: 单词中的不发音字母 (Silent Letters)
topics.descriptionZh: 拼写包含不发音字母的单词，这些字母是早期发音或词源的遗留，识别常见的不发音字母模式，并利用词源来记忆它们。
evidenceZh: 识别并拼写首辅音不发音的单词：如 knight（骑士）、know（知道）、write（写）、wrap（包裹）、gnaw（啃咬）、psalm（赞美诗），运用这些字母曾经发音的知识进行拼写。
拼写内部字母不发音的单词：如 doubt 中的 (b)、island 中的 (s)、muscle 中的 (c)、solemn 中的 (n)，利用词源联系辅助记忆（例如 doubt 源自拉丁语 dubitare）。
利用词族和词源记忆不发音的字母，例如 sign（sign 中的 g 不发音）与 signal（signal 中的 g 发音）是相关词族。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 拼写包含不发音字母的单词时——比如“knight”、“wrap”或“lamb”——他们是否会记得写上这些听不到的不发音字母？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Spelling -able & -ible
topics.description: Spell words ending in -able/-ible and the corresponding adverb forms -ably/-ibly, applying patterns to determine which suffix to use based on the root word
evidence: Apply the guideline that -able is typically used with complete root words (enjoyable, comfortable) while -ible is used with incomplete roots (visible, possible), noting key exceptions
Convert -able/-ible adjectives into adverbs by changing the ending to -ably/-ibly, e.g. comfortable → comfortably, possible → possibly, terrible → terribly
Determine whether to drop or retain the final -e of the root when adding -able, e.g. adorable (drop e) vs changeable (keep e before soft g)
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} needs to spell a word ending in "-able" or "-ible" — like "comfortable" or "visible" — can they choose the right ending and spell it correctly?
topics.descriptionZh: 拼写以“-able”或“-ible”结尾的单词及其对应的副词形式“-ably”或“-ibly”，并根据词根运用拼写规律来判断应使用哪个后缀。
evidenceZh: 运用以下规律：完整的词根通常加“-able”（如 enjoyable, comfortable），而不完整的词根通常加“-ible”（如 visible, possible），并注意关键例外情况。
将“-able”或“-ible”形容词转换为副词，将词尾改为“-ably”或“-ibly”，例如：comfortable → comfortably，possible → possibly，terrible → terribly。
判断在添加“-able”时是否应去掉或保留词根末尾的字母“-e”，例如：adorable（去掉e）与 changeable（在软音g前保留e）。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 需要拼写以“-able”或“-ible”结尾的单词（例如“comfortable”或“visible”）时，他们能选对词尾并正确拼写吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Spelling Word Lists (age 9+)
topics.description: Spell words from the statutory word list for Years 5 and 6, including words with irregular or uncommon spelling patterns that must be learned individually
evidence: Spell high-frequency words from the Y5-6 list accurately in dictated sentences, e.g. accommodate, committee, correspond, exaggerate, immediately, necessary
Use look-cover-write-check and mnemonic strategies to learn words with tricky patterns such as 'separate' (a rat in separate), 'rhythm' (rhythm helps your two hips move)
Identify and self-correct misspellings of statutory list words when proof-reading extended writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} spell the challenging words on their school's Year 5 and 6 word list — like "accommodate," "conscience," or "prejudice" — from memory when writing?
topics.descriptionZh: 准确拼写5至6年级法定词汇表（statutory word list）中的单词，包括必须单独记忆的不规则或罕见拼写模式的词汇。
evidenceZh: 在听写句子中准确拼写5至6年级词表中的高频词，如 accommodate, committee, correspond, exaggerate, immediately, necessary
运用“看-遮-写-查”（look-cover-write-check）和助记法（mnemonic strategies）学习拼写复杂的单词，如 separate（记忆提示：a rat in separate）和 rhythm（记忆提示：rhythm helps your two hips move）
在校对长篇写作时，能够识别并自行纠正法定词汇表中单词的拼写错误
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 在写作时，能否凭记忆准确拼写出其学校5至6年级词汇表中的高难度单词——例如 "accommodate"、"conscience" 或 "prejudice"？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Suffixes (age 9+)
topics.description: Spell words with Latin and French suffix patterns: endings sounding like /ʃəs/ spelt -cious or -tious (e.g., precious, cautious), /ʃəl/ spelt -cial or -tial (e.g., official, essential), and words ending in -ant/-ance/-ancy vs -ent/-ence/-ency (e.g., observant/observance, confident/confidence)
evidence: Apply the pattern that -cious follows a vowel (spacious, gracious) while -tious follows a consonant (cautious, ambitious), noting common exceptions like anxious
Choose between -cial (usually after a vowel: special, official) and -tial (usually after a consonant: essential, partial) when spelling words with the /ʃəl/ ending
Select -ant/-ance or -ent/-ence by checking whether the root ends in a hard c or g sound (-ant: significant) or a soft c or g sound (-ent: innocent), and by applying word-family strategies
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} spell words with tricky endings like "-cious," "-tious," or "-cial" — for example, "precious," "cautious," or "official" — without making mistakes?
topics.descriptionZh: 拼写带有拉丁语和法语后缀模式的单词：发音为 /ʃəs/ 的词尾拼写为 -cious 或 -tious（例如：precious, cautious），发音为 /ʃəl/ 的词尾拼写为 -cial 或 -tial（例如：official, essential），以及以 -ant/-ance/-ancy 或 -ent/-ence/-ency 结尾的单词（例如：observant/observance, confident/confidence）。
evidenceZh: 运用 -cious 跟在元音字母后（如 spacious, gracious），而 -tious 跟在辅音字母后（如 cautious, ambitious）的拼写规律，并注意 anxious 等常见例外情况。
在拼写发音为 /ʃəl/ 的单词时，正确选择 -cial（通常在元音字母后：special, official）或 -tial（通常在辅音字母后：essential, partial）。
通过检查词根是否以发硬 c 或 g 音结尾（-ant：significant）或发软 c 或 g 音结尾（-ent：innocent），并结合词族策略来选择 -ant/-ance 或 -ent/-ence。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否准确无误地拼写带有“-cious”、“-tious”或“-cial”等易错词尾的单词（例如“precious”、“cautious”或“official”）？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Applying Spelling Rules to Complex Words
topics.description: Spell correctly and consistently, applying the spelling patterns and rules from KS1-2 to increasingly complex vocabulary encountered in KS3 reading and subject-specific study
evidence: Spell subject-specific vocabulary correctly when encountered in new domains (e.g., 'parliament', 'photosynthesis', 'algorithm')
Apply known spelling rules and etymological patterns to unfamiliar words
Use proofreading strategies to identify and correct spelling errors in own extended writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes longer, more complex words in secondary school — like subject-specific vocabulary in science or history — do they spell them correctly without needing to check each time?
topics.nameZh: 运用拼写规则拼写复杂词汇
topics.descriptionZh: 正确且一致地拼写，将第一至第二学段（KS1-2）的拼写模式和规则应用到第三学段（KS3）阅读和特定学科学习中遇到的日益复杂的词汇中
evidenceZh: 在新领域遇到特定学科词汇时能够正确拼写（例如：'parliament'[议会]、'photosynthesis'[光合作用]、'algorithm'[算法]）
将已知的拼写规则和词源模式应用于生词
运用校对策略识别并纠正自己长篇写作中的拼写错误
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 在中学阶段书写更长、更复杂的词汇时——比如科学或历史中的特定学科词汇——他们能否正确拼写而无需反复检查？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Discussing and Questioning New Words
topics.description: Ask and answer questions about unknown words in texts; discuss word meanings and link new vocabulary to words already known
evidence: Ask 'What does ___ mean?' when meeting unfamiliar words during reading
Use context and pictures to work out what a new word might mean
Explain a new word by connecting it to a known word (e.g. 'enormous means really really big')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} comes across a word they don't know in a book, do they try to figure out what it means from the other words around it and connect it to words they already know?
topics.descriptionZh: 针对文本中的生词进行提问和解答；讨论词义，并将新词汇与已掌握的词汇建立联系
evidenceZh: 阅读时遇到不认识的词会问‘___是什么意思？’
利用上下文和图片来推测新词的可能含义
通过将新词与已知词汇联系起来进行解释（例如，‘enormous的意思是“非常非常大”’）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}在书中遇到不认识的词时，他们是否会尝试通过周围的词语来推测其含义，并将其与已掌握的词汇联系起来？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Shades of Meaning
topics.description: Distinguish shades of meaning among verbs describing similar actions and among adjectives differing in intensity; make real-life connections between words and their use
evidence: Compare similar verbs by acting them out (e.g. 'walk', 'march', 'strut', 'prance')
Order adjectives by intensity (e.g. big, huge, gigantic)
Connect vocabulary to personal experiences (e.g. note things at school that are 'colourful')
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} notice the difference between similar words — for example, knowing that "scorching" is stronger than "warm," or that "trotted" is different from "sprinted"?
topics.descriptionZh: 区分描述相似动作的动词之间的词义细微差别，以及强度不同的形容词之间的词义差别；将词汇与其实际生活应用场景建立联系
evidenceZh: 通过动作演示来比较相似的动词（例如：walk（走）、march（齐步走）、strut（昂首阔步）、prance（神气地走））
按强度对形容词进行排序（例如：big（大）、huge（巨大）、gigantic（庞大））
将词汇与个人生活经验相联系（例如：留意学校里 colourful（色彩斑斓）的事物）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否察觉到近义词之间的细微差别——例如，知道 scorching（灼热的）比 warm（温暖的）程度更强烈，或者 trotted（小跑）与 sprinted（飞奔）的动作不同？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Sorting & Categorising Words
topics.description: Sort common objects and words into categories to understand how concepts relate; demonstrate understanding of opposites (antonyms) for common verbs and adjectives
evidence: Group words or objects by category (e.g. animals, foods, colours)
Identify and produce opposite pairs (e.g. 'big/small', 'hot/cold', 'go/stop')
Explain why items belong together in a category
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} sort a group of words into categories — for example, separating fruits from vegetables — and tell you the opposite of common words like "hot" or "fast"?
topics.descriptionZh: 将常见物品和词语进行分类，以理解概念之间的联系；能够理解并运用常见动词和形容词的反义词（antonyms）。
evidenceZh: 按类别对词语或物品进行分组（如：动物、食物、颜色）
识别并说出反义词对（如：‘大/小’、‘热/冷’、‘走/停’）
解释为什么某些物品或词语属于同一类别
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否将一组词语进行分类——例如把水果和蔬菜分开——并说出“热”或“快”等常见词语的反义词？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Using New Vocabulary
topics.description: Use words and phrases acquired through conversations, being read to, and responding to texts in own speech and writing
evidence: Incorporate new vocabulary from read-alouds into conversations
Attempt to use interesting or topic-specific words in own writing
Use newly learned words appropriately in different contexts
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} learns a new word from a book or conversation, do they try to use it themselves — in their writing or when they're talking?
topics.descriptionZh: 在口语和写作中使用通过对话、听读（read-alouds）和文本互动所获得的词汇与短语
evidenceZh: 将听读（read-alouds）中获取的新词汇融入对话
尝试在自己的写作中使用生动有趣或特定主题的词汇
在不同的语境中恰当地使用新学到的词汇
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}从书本或对话中学到一个新词时，他们会尝试自己使用它吗——无论是在写作中还是在交谈时？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Word Parts as Clues
topics.description: Use knowledge of common inflections and affixes (-ed, -s, un-, -er) as clues to the meaning of unknown words; understand how the prefix un- changes meaning
evidence: Recognise that -ed signals past tense (e.g. 'jumped' = already happened)
Explain how un- makes a word mean the opposite (e.g. 'unhappy' = not happy)
Use word parts to figure out the meaning of an unfamiliar word
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees an unfamiliar word like "unhelpful" or "jumped," can they use the beginning or ending of the word to work out what it means?
topics.nameZh: 单词组成部分作为线索
topics.descriptionZh: 利用常见的屈折变化（inflections）和词缀（affixes）（如 -ed、-s、un-、-er）知识作为线索来理解生词的含义；理解前缀（prefix）un- 如何改变词义
evidenceZh: 认识到 -ed 标志过去时态（例如，'jumped' = 已经发生）
解释 un- 如何使单词意思相反（例如，'unhappy' = 不开心）
利用单词组成部分推断生词的含义
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到一个像 'unhelpful' 或 'jumped' 这样的生词，他们能否利用单词的开头或结尾部分来推断出它的意思？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Defining Words
topics.description: Define words by category and by one or more key attributes (e.g., 'a duck is a bird that swims'), making real-life connections between words and their use
evidence: Define 'tiger' as 'a large cat with stripes' — naming category and key attribute
Connect the word 'cozy' to real-life examples: places at home that feel cozy
Sort words into categories and explain why each word belongs
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain what a word means by saying what type of thing it is and what makes it special — for example, "a penguin is a bird that can't fly but is great at swimming"?
topics.descriptionZh: 通过类别和一个或多个关键属性来定义词语（例如，“鸭子是一种会游泳的鸟类”），并建立词语与其实际生活应用之间的联系
evidenceZh: 将“老虎”定义为“一种有条纹的大型猫科动物”——指出类别和关键属性
将“温馨”一词与现实生活中的例子联系起来：家里让人感觉温馨的地方
将词语进行分类，并解释每个词语属于该类别的原因
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否通过说明事物的类别及其独特之处来解释一个词语的意思——例如，“企鹅是一种不会飞但非常擅长游泳的鸟类”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Root Words & Inflections
topics.description: Identify frequently occurring root words and their inflectional forms (e.g., look/looks/looked/looking), using affixes as clues to word meaning and understanding how suffixes create nouns and adjectives
evidence: Identify 'play' as the root in 'played', 'playing', 'player'
Explain that '-ful' in 'careful' means 'full of care'
Use '-ness' and '-er' to form nouns from root words: 'sad → sadness', 'teach → teacher'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} sees words like "play," "plays," "played," and "playing," do they understand they all come from the same root word and can they use each form correctly?
topics.nameZh: 词根与词形变化 (Root Words & Inflections)
topics.descriptionZh: 识别常见的词根 (root words) 及其词形变化 (inflectional forms)（例如：look/looks/looked/looking），利用词缀 (affixes) 作为理解词义的线索，并了解后缀 (suffixes) 如何构成名词和形容词。
evidenceZh: 识别“play”是“played”、“playing”和“player”中的词根 (root)
解释“careful”中的后缀“-ful”表示“充满关怀的” (full of care)
使用“-ness”和“-er”从词根构成名词：“sad → sadness”、“teach → teacher”
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 看到像“play”、“plays”、“played”和“playing”这样的单词时，他们是否理解这些词都来自同一个词根 (root word)，并且能够正确使用每一种形式？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Formal and Informal English
topics.description: Recognise and compare formal and informal uses of English, understanding that language choices vary based on audience, purpose and context
evidence: Identify whether a spoken or written example uses formal or informal language (e.g., 'Dear Sir' vs 'Hey mate')
Rewrite an informal sentence in a more formal way (e.g., change 'Can I have some?' to 'May I please have some?')
Explain why formal language might be used in one situation and informal in another (e.g., a letter to the headteacher vs a note to a friend)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} understand the difference between how they'd write a text to a friend versus a formal letter — and can they explain why the language would be different?
topics.descriptionZh: 识别并比较英语的正式与非正式用法，理解语言的选择会因受众、目的和语境的不同而有所变化
evidenceZh: 识别口语或书面示例使用的是正式还是非正式语言（例如，对比“Dear Sir/尊敬的先生”与“Hey mate/嘿，哥们”）
将非正式句子改写为更正式的表达（例如，将“Can I have some?/我能要点吗？”改为“May I please have some?/请问我可以要点吗？”）
解释为何在某种情境下使用正式语言，而在另一种情境下使用非正式语言（例如，给校长的信与给朋友的留言条）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 是否理解给朋友发信息与写正式信件在表达方式上的区别，并能解释为什么使用的语言会有所不同？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Word Families and Root Words
topics.description: Explore word families based on common root words, understanding how words are related in form and meaning through shared roots, prefixes and suffixes (e.g., solve → solution, solver, dissolve, insoluble)
evidence: Generate at least 4 words in a word family from a given root (e.g., from 'play': player, playful, replay, playground)
Explain how members of a word family are connected in meaning (e.g., 'solve, solution, dissolve all relate to finding answers or breaking apart')
Use knowledge of a word family to predict the meaning of an unfamiliar member (e.g., knowing 'act' helps understand 'actor', 'action', 'react')
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} knows the word "cycle," can they work out what related words like "recycle," "bicycle," or "cyclist" mean by thinking about the shared root?
topics.descriptionZh: 探索基于共同词根（Root Words）的词族（Word Families），理解词语如何通过共享的词根、前缀（Prefixes）和后缀（Suffixes）在形式和意义上产生联系（例如：solve → solution, solver, dissolve, insoluble）
evidenceZh: 根据给定的词根，至少生成同一个词族中的4个单词（例如，从“play”生成：player, playful, replay, playground）
解释词族成员在意义上的联系（例如，“solve, solution, dissolve 都与寻找答案或分解有关”）
利用词族知识预测不熟悉成员的含义（例如，了解“act”有助于理解“actor”、“action”、“react”）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 知道“cycle”这个词，他们能否通过思考共同的词根来推断出“recycle”、“bicycle”或“cyclist”等相关单词的意思？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Literal vs Figurative Language
topics.description: Distinguish literal from nonliteral (figurative) language in context and interpret common idioms and phrases
evidence: Identify whether 'It's raining cats and dogs' is literal or nonliteral and explain what it means
Read a passage and circle three phrases used nonliterally, restating each in literal terms
Explain the difference between 'She was on fire' (figurative — performing well) and 'The log was on fire' (literal)
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a phrase like "it's raining cats and dogs" or "she had butterflies in her stomach," do they know it doesn't mean what the words literally say?
topics.descriptionZh: 在语境中区分字面语言与非字面（修辞）语言，并解释常见的习语和短语
evidenceZh: 判断‘It's raining cats and dogs’是字面意思还是非字面意思，并解释其含义
阅读一段短文，圈出三个非字面使用的短语，并将每个短语用字面意思重新表述
解释‘She was on fire’（修辞——表现极佳）和‘The log was on fire’（字面）之间的区别
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 读到诸如“it's raining cats and dogs”或“she had butterflies in her stomach”这样的短语时，他们是否知道这些短语的意思并非字面上的意思？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Antonyms & Synonyms
topics.description: Demonstrate understanding of words by relating them to their antonyms (opposites) and synonyms (words with similar meanings), using synonym and antonym relationships to refine vocabulary and improve precision in writing
evidence: Generate synonyms and antonyms for given words and explain subtle differences between synonyms, e.g. happy/joyful/ecstatic differ in intensity
Use a thesaurus to find synonyms and select the most precise word for a given context, e.g. choosing 'sprinted' rather than 'ran' to convey speed
Replace overused words in writing with more precise synonyms and explain how the substitution changes the tone or emphasis
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is writing, can they swap out a basic word for a more precise one — for example, replacing "happy" with "elated" or "said" with "whispered" — to make their meaning clearer?
topics.descriptionZh: 通过联系反义词（antonyms）和同义词（synonyms）来展示对词汇的理解，利用同义和反义关系来丰富词汇量并提高写作的精准度。
evidenceZh: 为给定词汇生成同义词和反义词，并解释同义词之间的微妙差异，例如 happy/joyful/ecstatic 在情感强度上的不同
使用同义词词典（thesaurus）查找同义词，并为特定语境选择最精准的词汇，例如选择 'sprinted' 而不是 'ran' 来传达速度感
在写作中用更精准的同义词替换过度使用的词汇，并解释这种替换如何改变语气或强调重点
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 写作时，他们能否用一个更精准的词替换基础词汇——例如，将‘happy’替换为‘elated’，或将‘said’替换为‘whispered’——以使表达的意思更清晰？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Domain Vocabulary Across Subject Areas
topics.description: Acquire and use accurately academic and domain-specific vocabulary relevant to grade-level topics, including words that signal precise meaning in informational texts across subject areas
evidence: Identify and define academic vocabulary (e.g., compare, contrast, summarise, evidence, interpret) used across multiple subject areas and use these words accurately in discussion and writing
Determine the meaning of domain-specific words encountered in science, social studies, or maths texts (e.g., ecosystem, democracy, numerator) using context, glossaries, and prior knowledge
Use newly acquired academic and domain-specific vocabulary in sentences that demonstrate understanding of precise meaning and appropriate context
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is studying a topic in science or history, do they pick up and correctly use the specific vocabulary for that subject — like "erosion," "parliament," or "habitat"?
topics.descriptionZh: 准确获取和使用与年级主题相关的学术和特定领域词汇，包括在各学科说明文中标示精确含义的词汇。
evidenceZh: 识别并定义在多个学科领域中使用的学术词汇（例如 compare (比较), contrast (对比), summarise (总结), evidence (证据), interpret (解释)），并在讨论和写作中准确使用这些词汇。
利用上下文、词汇表和先验知识，确定在科学、社会科学或数学文本中遇到的特定领域词汇的含义（例如 ecosystem (生态系统), democracy (民主), numerator (分子)）。
在句子中使用新习得的学术和特定领域词汇，以展示对精确含义和恰当语境的理解。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 学习科学或历史主题时，他们是否能掌握并正确使用该学科的特定词汇——例如 erosion (侵蚀)、parliament (议会) 或 habitat (栖息地)？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Greek and Latin Roots for Word Meaning
topics.description: Use knowledge of Greek and Latin affixes (prefixes and suffixes) and roots as clues to determine the meaning of unfamiliar words, building a bank of common roots and their meanings
evidence: Identify common Greek and Latin roots in unfamiliar words and use root meaning to infer word meaning, e.g. 'aqua' (water) in aquarium/aquatic, 'dict' (say) in predict/dictionary
Break a multi-morpheme word into prefix + root + suffix to determine meaning, e.g. un- (not) + believe + -able = not able to be believed
Use knowledge of Greek-origin prefixes (auto-, tele-, micro-) and Latin-origin prefixes (inter-, trans-, sub-) to decode and define unfamiliar vocabulary in context
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} comes across an unfamiliar word containing a Greek or Latin root they recognise — like "port" in "transport" or "bio" in "biology" — can they use that to work out the meaning?
topics.nameZh: 希腊语和拉丁语词根与词义
topics.descriptionZh: 运用希腊语和拉丁语词缀（前缀和后缀）及词根的知识作为线索，推断生词的含义，并积累常见词根及其含义的词库
evidenceZh: 识别生词中常见的希腊语和拉丁语词根，并利用词根含义推断单词意思，例如 aquarium/aquatic 中的 'aqua'（水），predict/dictionary 中的 'dict'（说）
将多语素单词拆分为前缀+词根+后缀来确定含义，例如 un-（不）+ believe + -able = 无法被相信
利用希腊语源前缀（auto-、tele-、micro-）和拉丁语源前缀（inter-、trans-、sub-）的知识，在语境中解码和推断生词含义
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 遇到一个包含其已认识的希腊语或拉丁语词根的生词——例如 'transport' 中的 'port' 或 'biology' 中的 'bio'——他们能利用这一点来推断出该词的含义吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Idioms & Proverbs
topics.description: Recognise and interpret common idioms (break the ice, hit the nail on the head), adages (actions speak louder than words), and proverbs (a stitch in time saves nine), understanding their figurative meanings and when to use them
evidence: Explain the figurative meaning of common idioms encountered in texts, e.g. 'let the cat out of the bag' means to reveal a secret, not literally releasing a cat
Interpret the meaning and intended lesson of adages and proverbs, e.g. explain that 'the early bird catches the worm' advises that acting promptly gives an advantage
Use context clues to determine the meaning of an unfamiliar idiom or proverb encountered during reading and verify using a reference source
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} hears a saying like "don't judge a book by its cover" or "the early bird catches the worm," do they know what it really means and when you'd use it?
topics.descriptionZh: 识别并理解常用习语（如“break the ice/打破僵局”、“hit the nail on the head/一针见血”）、格言（如“actions speak louder than words/事实胜于雄辩”）和谚语（如“a stitch in time saves nine/小洞不补，大洞吃苦”），理解其比喻义（figurative meanings）及使用场景。
evidenceZh: 解释在阅读文本中遇到的常见习语的比喻义，例如“let the cat out of the bag”意为泄露秘密，而不是字面意义上的把猫从袋子里放出来
解释格言和谚语的含义及其中蕴含的道理，例如说明“the early bird catches the worm/早起的鸟儿有虫吃”告诫人们尽早行动能获得优势
利用上下文线索（context clues）推断阅读中遇到的陌生习语或谚语的含义，并通过查阅参考资料进行验证
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 听到像“don't judge a book by its cover/不要以貌取人”或“the early bird catches the worm/早起的鸟儿有虫吃”这样的俗语，他们知道其真正的含义以及在什么场合使用吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Similes & Metaphors
topics.description: Understand and identify similes (comparisons using like or as) and metaphors (direct comparisons stating something is something else) in texts, explaining how each creates imagery and conveys meaning
evidence: Identify similes in a text by locating comparisons using 'like' or 'as' and explain what two things are being compared and what quality is highlighted, e.g. 'The snow was like a white blanket'
Identify metaphors in a text and explain the implied comparison, e.g. in 'Time is a thief', explain that time is compared to a thief because it takes things away
Explain how a simile or metaphor in a poem or story creates a particular image or feeling for the reader that a literal description would not achieve
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a description like "the moon was a silver coin" or "her smile was like sunshine," can they explain what image the author was trying to create?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解并识别文本中的明喻（Similes，使用“像”或“如”进行的比较）和暗喻（Metaphors，直接说明某物是另一物的比较），并解释它们各自如何创造意象和传达意义。
evidenceZh: 通过在文本中寻找使用“像”或“如”的比较来识别明喻，并解释正在比较的两件事物以及突出了什么特质，例如“雪像白色的毯子”。
识别文本中的暗喻并解释隐含的比较，例如在“时间是小偷”中，解释时间被比作小偷是因为它会带走事物。
解释诗歌或故事中的明喻或暗喻如何为读者创造出字面描述无法达到的特定意象或感觉。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}读到诸如“月亮是一枚银币”或“她的笑容像阳光”这样的描述时，他们能解释出作者试图创造什么样的意象吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Choosing Formal Vocabulary
topics.description: Distinguish between formal and informal vocabulary, selecting words appropriate for formal speech and writing such as 'discover' instead of 'find out' and 'request' instead of 'ask for'
evidence: Replace informal words with formal equivalents in a given text
Identify formal vocabulary choices in official letters and reports
Write the same message twice using formal vocabulary for a letter and informal vocabulary for a text message
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is writing something formal — like a letter or a report — do they choose more sophisticated words, like "enquire" instead of "ask" or "sufficient" instead of "enough"?
topics.descriptionZh: 区分正式与非正式词汇，选择适合正式口语和书面语的词语，例如使用“discover”而不是“find out”，使用“request”而不是“ask for”。
evidenceZh: 在给定文本中，将非正式词汇替换为正式词汇
识别正式信函和报告中所使用的正式词汇
将同一条信息写两遍，一次在信件中使用正式词汇，另一次在短信中使用非正式词汇
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 撰写正式内容（如信件或报告）时，他们是否会选择更高级的词汇，例如用“enquire”代替“ask”，或用“sufficient”代替“enough”？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Dialects & Registers
topics.description: Compare and contrast the varieties of English used in stories, dramas, or poems, including dialects and registers, understanding how language varies by region, context, and purpose
evidence: Identify dialect features in character dialogue and explain their effect
Compare formal and informal registers in different types of texts
Explain how an author uses language variety to develop character or setting
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a story with characters who speak in dialect or old-fashioned language, can they understand it and explain how it differs from the way we speak today?
topics.descriptionZh: 比较和对比故事、戏剧或诗歌中使用的英语变体，包括方言和语域（Registers），理解语言如何因地域、语境和目的而变化。
evidenceZh: 识别角色对话中的方言特征并解释其表达效果
比较不同文本类型中的正式语域（Registers）与非正式语域
解释作者如何运用语言变体来塑造人物形象或构建故事背景
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}阅读包含使用方言或旧式语言说话的人物的故事时，他们能理解这些内容并解释它与我们今天的说话方式有何不同吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Using a Thesaurus to Choose Words
topics.description: Use a thesaurus to find synonyms and extend vocabulary choices, selecting the most appropriate word based on context, connotation, and register
evidence: Use a thesaurus to find three alternatives for overused words in own writing
Select the most appropriate synonym from thesaurus options based on context and tone
Explain why one synonym is more suitable than another for a specific sentence
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is writing and wants a better word than the one they first thought of, can they use a thesaurus and pick the right synonym for the context — not just any word that means something similar?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用同义词词典（Thesaurus）寻找同义词并扩展词汇选择，根据语境、词义色彩（connotation）和语域（register）选择最恰当的词语。
evidenceZh: 在写作中使用同义词词典为自己过度使用的词语找到三个替代词
根据语境和语气（tone），从同义词词典的选项中选出最恰当的同义词
解释为什么在特定句子中，一个同义词比另一个同义词更合适
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 写作时，如果想找一个比最初想到的更好的词，他们能否使用同义词词典并为语境挑选出正确的同义词——而不仅仅是随便挑一个意思相近的词？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Academic Vocabulary
topics.description: Acquire and use accurately a broad range of general academic vocabulary and domain-specific words — drawing new vocabulary from reading and listening and deploying it consciously in writing and speech to achieve particular effects
evidence: Use academic vocabulary (e.g., analyse, evaluate, justify, convey, imply) accurately and appropriately in essay writing
Incorporate domain-specific terms from a subject studied (e.g., 'photosynthesis', 'legislature') into explanatory writing
Draw a new word or phrase from a text read and use it consciously in own writing or speech
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} pick up new words from books and lessons and actually use them in their own writing and conversation — not just understand them when someone else uses them?
topics.descriptionZh: 准确掌握并广泛使用通用学术词汇和学科专业词汇——从阅读和听力中汲取新词汇，并在写作和口语中有意识地运用，以达到特定的表达效果。
evidenceZh: 在论述文写作中准确、恰当地使用学术词汇（如：分析（analyse）、评估（evaluate）、论证（justify）、传达（convey）、暗示（imply））
在说明文写作中融入所学学科的专业术语（如：光合作用（photosynthesis）、立法机构（legislature））
从阅读文本中提取新词汇或短语，并在自己的写作或口语中有意识地加以运用。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 是否能从书本和课堂中吸收新词汇，并实际应用到自己的写作和日常交谈中——而不仅仅是在别人使用时才听得懂？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Advanced Figurative Language
topics.description: Understand and interpret figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meaning — including allusion, irony, pun, oxymoron, and extended metaphor — and distinguish between connotation and denotation when analysing or choosing words
evidence: Explain the connotative difference between words with similar denotations (e.g., thrifty vs. stingy vs. economical)
Identify irony or an allusion in a text and explain what it adds to the meaning
Analyse an extended metaphor across a paragraph or poem and explain how it develops an idea
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a poem or novel and the author uses irony, a pun, or an unexpected comparison, can they explain what effect it creates and why the author chose those words?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解并解释修辞语言、词语关系以及词义的细微差别——包括典故（allusion）、反讽（irony）、双关语（pun）、矛盾修辞法（oxymoron）和扩展隐喻（extended metaphor）——并在分析或选择词语时区分内涵（connotation）与字面义（denotation）。
evidenceZh: 解释具有相似字面义（denotation）的词语之间的内涵（connotation）差异（例如：节俭 vs. 吝啬 vs. 节约）
识别文本中的反讽或典故，并解释其为文本意义增添的作用
分析贯穿段落或诗歌的扩展隐喻，并解释其如何深化或发展某一思想
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 阅读诗歌或小说时，如果作者使用了反讽、双关语或出人意料的比较，他们能否解释这产生了什么效果，以及作者为何选择这些词语？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Vocabulary Strategies
topics.description: Determine the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases using a flexible range of strategies — including context clues, Greek and Latin affixes and roots, reference materials, and verification of inferred meaning
evidence: Use context clues (the overall meaning of a sentence, a word’s position or function) to infer the meaning of an unfamiliar word
Break down a word using known Greek or Latin roots and affixes to deduce its meaning (e.g., 'malevolent' = mal- (bad) + volent (wishing))
Look up a word in a dictionary to verify or refine an inferred meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} encounters an unfamiliar word in a book or article, can they work out its meaning using context clues, word roots, or a dictionary — and then check whether their guess was right?
topics.descriptionZh: 运用灵活多样的策略确定生词和多义词及短语的含义——包括利用上下文线索（context clues）、希腊语和拉丁语词缀与词根（affixes and roots）、参考资料，以及验证推断出的词义。
evidenceZh: 利用上下文线索（context clues）（句子的整体含义、单词的位置或功能）推断生词的含义
利用已知的希腊语或拉丁语词根（roots）和词缀（affixes）拆解单词以推断其含义（例如，'malevolent'（恶意的）= mal-（坏的）+ volent（希望））
在字典中查阅单词以验证或完善推断出的词义
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 在书籍或文章中遇到生词时，他们能否利用上下文线索、词根或字典来推断其含义——然后验证自己的猜测是否正确？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Responding to Writing Feedback
topics.description: With teacher guidance, re-read own writing aloud to check it sounds right; listen and respond to questions and suggestions from teacher or peers to add detail, clarify meaning, and strengthen writing — this is the scaffolded beginning of writing self-evaluation, not an independent skill
evidence: Reread own writing and spot a missing word or unclear sentence
Add a detail in response to a question (e.g. 'Can you tell me more about...?')
Make at least one improvement to a piece based on feedback
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}}'s teacher asks them to read their own writing aloud and then asks "does that bit make sense?", can {{name}} listen to the feedback and make a simple change to improve it?
topics.descriptionZh: 在教师的指导下，大声朗读自己的作品以检查语感是否通顺；倾听并回应教师或同伴的问题与建议，以补充细节、阐明意思并提升写作质量——这是写作自我评价的支架式（scaffolded）开端，而非一项独立技能
evidenceZh: 重读自己的作品，发现漏字或不通顺的句子
根据问题补充细节（例如：‘你能多讲讲关于……的内容吗？’）
根据反馈对作品进行至少一处改进
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}的老师要求其大声朗读自己的作品，并询问‘那部分听起来通顺吗？’时，{{name}}能否听取反馈并做出简单的修改来完善作品？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Saying Sentences Before Writing Them
topics.description: Say out loud what is going to be written; compose sentences orally before writing them down as preparation for independent writing
evidence: Say a complete sentence aloud before attempting to write it
Rehearse a sentence orally more than once to hold it in memory
Practise sentences with a partner before writing independently
topics.assessmentPrompt: Before {{name}} starts writing a sentence, do they say it out loud first — testing how it sounds — before putting pen to paper?
topics.descriptionZh: 大声说出即将写下的内容；在独立写作前，先口头造句并大声说出来，作为写作的准备
evidenceZh: 在尝试写句子之前，先大声说出一个完整的句子
口头重复练习句子一次以上，以便将其牢记在心
在独立写作前，与同伴一起练习说句子
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在 {{name}} 开始写句子之前，他们是否会先大声说出来——测试一下听起来怎么样——然后再落笔？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Shared Research Projects
topics.description: Participate in shared research and writing projects; recall information from experiences or gather information from sources to answer a question
evidence: Contribute ideas and information to a class writing project
Draw or write facts learned from personal experience about a topic
Help gather information from books or adults for a group research task
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is given a writing project that involves finding out about something — like an animal or a place — can they look up information and use what they find to write about the topic?
topics.descriptionZh: 参与合作研究与写作项目；回忆经验中的信息或从资料中收集信息以回答问题
evidenceZh: 为班级写作项目提供想法和信息
画出或写下从个人经验中了解到的关于某一主题的事实
协助从书籍或成年人那里收集信息，以完成小组研究任务
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当给{{name}}布置一个探究某事物（如动物或地点）的写作项目时，他们能否查阅资料并利用所获取的信息来就该主题进行写作？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Sharing and Publishing Your Writing
topics.description: Read own writing aloud clearly enough to be heard by peers and the teacher; use digital tools to produce and publish writing
evidence: Read own sentences aloud with clear voice and appropriate expression
Share a piece of writing by reading it to the class
Type simple words or sentences using a computer or tablet
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read their own writing aloud to the class clearly enough for everyone to hear and follow along — and have they ever typed or published a piece of writing using a computer or tablet?
topics.descriptionZh: 大声朗读自己的作品，确保声音清晰，能让同伴和老师听到；使用数字工具（digital tools）创作并发表作品
evidenceZh: 用清晰的声音和恰当的语气大声朗读自己的句子
通过在班级朗读来分享一篇作品
使用电脑或平板电脑输入简单的词语或句子
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否在班级里大声朗读自己的作品，声音足够清晰让每个人都能听到并跟上内容——并且他们是否曾经使用电脑或平板电脑输入或发表过一篇作品？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Simple Stories with Beginning and Ending
topics.description: Write simple narratives by sequencing sentences to describe events in order; narrate a single event or linked events with a beginning, middle, and ending or reaction
evidence: Write a short story with at least three sequenced sentences
Use time words like 'first', 'then', 'next' to order events
Include a reaction or ending to a narrative (e.g. 'I felt happy')
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write a short story about something that happened — with a clear beginning, middle, and end — so that someone who wasn't there could follow what happened and in what order?
topics.nameZh: 带有开头和结尾的简单故事
topics.descriptionZh: 通过按顺序排列句子来编写简单的叙述文，以按顺序描述事件；叙述单一事件或相互关联的事件，包含开头、中间和结尾或反应
evidenceZh: 编写一个至少包含三个按顺序排列的句子的短故事
使用“首先”、“然后”、“接下来”等时间词来排列事件顺序
在叙述中包含反应或结尾（例如：“我感到很高兴”）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否写一个关于某件发生过的事的短故事——具有清晰的开头、中间和结尾——让不在场的人也能理解发生了什么事以及事情发生的顺序？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Writing opinions
topics.description: Compose opinion pieces using drawing, dictating, or writing that name a topic or book and state a preference or opinion about it
evidence: State an opinion clearly (e.g. 'My favourite animal is a dog because...')
Give at least one reason for an opinion
Draw, dictate, or write to express a preference about a book or topic
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write a sentence or two giving their opinion about something — like their favourite book or food — and explain why they feel that way?
topics.descriptionZh: 通过绘画、口述或写作来创作观点文章，点明一个主题或书籍，并陈述对其的偏好或观点
evidenceZh: 清晰地表达观点（例如：'我最喜欢的动物是狗，因为……'）
为观点提供至少一个理由
通过绘画、口述或写作来表达对一本书或一个主题的偏好
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否写一两个句子来表达对某事物的观点——比如他们最喜欢的书或食物——并解释为什么会有这样的感受？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Writing Process Vocabulary
topics.description: Know and use the vocabulary of the writing process — compose, plan, draft, revise, edit, proofread, genre, audience, purpose, narrative, recount, instruction, paragraph, sequence, and detail — and understand that these words describe distinct steps and decisions that all writers make, not just tasks to tick off
evidence: Use 'compose', 'revise', and 'edit' correctly when describing the stages of writing
Explain who the 'audience' is for a piece of writing and how that changes what they write
Describe the purpose of a piece of writing (to persuade, inform, entertain, or instruct) and match their language to it
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you asked {{name}} to explain what they're doing when they write a story at school, could they walk you through each step using words like 'plan', 'draft', and 'revise' — showing they understand it's a process, not just one sitting?
topics.descriptionZh: 掌握并运用写作流程的专业词汇——构思(compose)、计划(plan)、起草(draft)、修订(revise)、编辑(edit)、校对(proofread)、体裁(genre)、受众(audience)、目的(purpose)、记叙文(narrative)、叙述(recount)、说明文(instruction)、段落(paragraph)、顺序(sequence)和细节(detail)——并理解这些词汇描述的是每位写作者都会经历的明确步骤与决策，而不仅仅是待办清单上的勾选项。
evidenceZh: 在描述写作阶段时，能正确使用“构思(compose)”、“修订(revise)”和“编辑(edit)”
能解释一篇文章的“受众(audience)”是谁，以及受众如何影响他们的写作内容
能描述一篇文章的写作目的（说服、告知、娱乐或指导），并使自己的语言风格与目的相匹配
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你让{{name}}解释他们在学校写故事时都在做些什么，他们能否使用“计划(plan)”、“起草(draft)”和“修订(revise)”等词汇，向你清晰地描述每一个步骤——从而证明他们明白写作是一个循序渐进的过程，而不是坐在那里一次就能写完的？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Writing to inform
topics.description: Compose informative or explanatory texts using drawing, dictating, or writing that name a topic and supply some information about it
evidence: Write or dictate two or three facts about a familiar topic
Label diagrams or drawings with informative details
Name a topic and provide relevant details about it
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write a few sentences explaining something they know about — like how butterflies grow or how to make a sandwich — naming the topic and sharing some facts?
topics.descriptionZh: 通过绘画、口述或书写的方式，创作传递信息或解释说明的文本，点明主题并提供一些相关信息。
evidenceZh: 写出或口述关于熟悉主题的两到三个事实
为图表或绘画添加说明性细节标签
点明主题并提供相关细节
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否写几句话解释他们了解的事物——比如蝴蝶是如何成长的，或者如何制作三明治——在点明主题的同时分享一些事实？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Basic Informational Writing
topics.description: Compose informative or explanatory texts that introduce a topic, use facts and definitions to develop points, and provide a concluding statement or section
evidence: Write an informative text that introduces a topic clearly and groups related information together
Use facts, definitions, and concrete details to develop and explain points about the topic
Provide a concluding statement or section that wraps up the information presented
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write an explanatory or informative piece — like "How Volcanoes Work" — that introduces the topic clearly, develops it with facts and definitions, and ends with a conclusion?
topics.descriptionZh: 撰写说明性或解释性文本（informative or explanatory texts），引入主题，使用事实和定义来展开要点，并提供总结性陈述或段落
evidenceZh: 撰写一篇说明文（informative text），清晰地引入主题并将相关信息归类
使用事实、定义和具体细节来展开和解释有关主题的要点
提供总结性陈述或段落，对所提供的信息进行收尾
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否写一篇说明性或解释性文章（explanatory or informative piece）——比如“火山是如何运作的”——清晰地引入主题，用事实和定义展开论述，并以结论收尾？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Building Writing Stamina
topics.description: Write about real events and for different purposes, developing stamina for sustained writing across genres beyond narrative (e.g., recounts, letters, instructions)
evidence: Write a recount of a school trip using temporal connectives (first, then, after that)
Write a simple set of instructions with numbered steps
Sustain writing for an extended period across a full page without stopping
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write in different styles for different purposes — for example, writing a recount of a school trip, a letter to a friend, or a set of instructions for a game?
topics.descriptionZh: 描写真实事件并出于不同目的进行写作，培养在叙事文体之外进行持续写作的耐力，涉猎不同体裁（如记叙文 (recount)、书信、操作指南 (instructions)）。
evidenceZh: 使用时间连接词（首先、然后、之后）写一篇关于学校旅行的记叙文 (recount)
编写带有编号步骤的简单操作指南 (instructions)
在较长时间内持续写作，写满整整一页纸且中途不停顿
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否针对不同目的采用不同文体进行写作——例如，写一篇学校旅行的记叙文 (recount)、给朋友的一封信，或一个游戏的操作指南 (instructions)？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Planning Ideas Before Writing
topics.description: Plan before writing by saying aloud or noting down what will be written, writing down ideas and key words, and encapsulating ideas sentence by sentence before composing
evidence: Verbally rehearse sentences before writing them down
Jot key words or ideas in a planning format (e.g., story map) before drafting
Write a simple plan with beginning, middle, and end for a story
topics.assessmentPrompt: Before {{name}} starts a piece of writing, do they spend a few minutes planning — jotting down ideas, key words, or a rough structure — rather than jumping straight into writing the first sentence?
topics.descriptionZh: 在动笔前通过大声说出或记录将要写的内容来进行规划，写下想法和关键词，并在正式成文前逐句梳理和概括思路。
evidenceZh: 在落笔前先口头演练句子
在起草前以规划格式（如故事地图）写下关键词或想法
为故事制定包含开头、中间和结尾的简单提纲
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在{{name}}开始写作之前，他们是否会花几分钟时间进行规划——写下想法、关键词或粗略的结构——而不是直接动笔写第一句话？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Revising and editing
topics.description: Proof-read own writing to check for errors in spelling, grammar, and punctuation; evaluate and revise writing with teacher/peer support, re-reading to ensure meaning is clear and tense is consistent
evidence: Re-read own writing and spot a missing full stop or capital letter
Identify and correct a tense inconsistency in a piece of writing
Discuss improvements with a partner and make at least one revision to strengthen the writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} finishes a piece of writing, do they proofread it for spelling mistakes, missing punctuation, and errors in grammar — and make corrections before handing it in?
topics.descriptionZh: 校对自己的写作，检查拼写、语法和标点错误；在老师或同伴的支持下评估和修改文章，重新阅读以确保语义清晰且时态一致
evidenceZh: 重新阅读自己的写作，发现遗漏的句号或大写字母
识别并纠正文章中的时态不一致问题
与同伴讨论改进方法，并进行至少一次修改以提升写作质量
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}完成一篇写作后，他们是否会校对拼写错误、遗漏的标点和语法错误，并在交作业前进行更正？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Structured Opinion Writing
topics.description: Compose opinion pieces that introduce a topic, state a clear point of view, provide organised reasons linked with connecting words, and include a concluding statement or section
evidence: Write an opinion piece that introduces the topic, states a clear opinion, and provides at least two reasons
Use linking words (because, and, also, for example) to connect the opinion to supporting reasons
End an opinion piece with a concluding statement that restates or reinforces the opinion
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write a persuasive piece — like arguing for a longer lunch break or why dogs are better pets than cats — with a clear viewpoint, organised reasons, and a conclusion?
topics.nameZh: 结构化观点写作 (Structured Opinion Writing)
topics.descriptionZh: 撰写观点类文章 (opinion pieces)，要求引入主题，明确表达观点，使用连接词 (connecting words) 提供有条理的理由，并包含总结性的陈述或段落。
evidenceZh: 撰写一篇观点文章 (opinion piece)，引入主题，明确表达观点，并提供至少两个理由。
使用连接词 (linking words: because, and, also, for example) 将观点与支持性理由连接起来。
在观点文章结尾使用总结性陈述来重申或强化观点。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否写一篇有说服力的文章 (persuasive piece)——比如争取更长的午休时间，或者论证为什么狗比猫更适合做宠物——并且具备清晰的观点、有条理的理由以及结论？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Writing Poetry
topics.description: Write poetry, exploring patterns of language, rhyme and rhythm, and learning poems by heart for recitation with appropriate intonation
evidence: Write a simple poem using rhyming couplets or a repeated pattern
Recite a poem from memory with expression and appropriate intonation
Identify rhyme and rhythm patterns in poems read aloud
topics.assessmentPrompt: Has {{name}} tried writing a poem — playing with rhyme, rhythm, or repeating patterns — and can they recite one they've learned or written with expression?
topics.descriptionZh: 创作诗歌，探索语言规律、押韵（rhyme）与节奏（rhythm），并背诵诗歌以便在朗诵时运用恰当的语调。
evidenceZh: 使用押韵对句（rhyming couplets）或重复模式创作一首简单的诗歌
富有感情并运用恰当语调背诵一首诗歌
识别大声朗读的诗歌中的押韵与节奏规律
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}是否尝试过创作诗歌——运用押韵、节奏或重复规律——并且能否富有感情地朗诵他们学过或自己创作的诗歌？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Narrative Writing
topics.description: Write narratives with developed settings, characters and plot, using dialogue and description to develop experiences and show character responses to situations
evidence: Write a narrative that includes a described setting, at least one developed character, and a clear plot with a problem and resolution
Use dialogue to show what characters say and reveal their personality or feelings
Use descriptive details and temporal words to organise events into a clear sequence with a satisfying ending
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a story, do they bring it to life with descriptions of the setting, details about the characters, and some dialogue — rather than just listing what happened?
topics.descriptionZh: 撰写具有丰富背景、人物和情节的记叙文（narrative），运用对话（dialogue）和描写来展开经历，并展现人物对情境的反应。
evidenceZh: 撰写一篇记叙文，包含对背景环境的描写、至少一个丰满的人物形象，以及包含问题与解决过程的清晰情节
运用对话来展示人物的语言，并揭示他们的个性或情感
运用描写细节和时间顺序词（temporal words）将事件组织成清晰的顺序，并有一个圆满的结局
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}写故事时，他们是否通过环境描写、人物细节和一些对话让故事生动起来——而不是仅仅罗列发生的事情？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Organising Writing into Paragraphs
topics.description: Organise writing into paragraphs, grouping related material around a theme, and use simple organisational devices such as headings and sub-headings in non-narrative writing
evidence: Divide a piece of writing into paragraphs, each focused on one main idea or aspect of the topic
Use headings and sub-headings to organise a non-fiction text (e.g., a report about animals with sections 'Habitat', 'Diet', 'Appearance')
Identify where a new paragraph should begin in a given text and explain why (e.g., 'A new paragraph starts here because the topic changes from appearance to diet')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a longer piece — like a report or a story — do they organise it into paragraphs, with related ideas grouped together and, where appropriate, headings to help the reader navigate?
topics.nameZh: 将写作内容组织成段落
topics.descriptionZh: 将写作内容组织成段落，围绕主题对相关素材进行归类，并在非叙事类写作（non-narrative writing）中使用简单的组织工具，如标题（headings）和副标题（sub-headings）。
evidenceZh: 将一篇写作内容划分为多个段落，每个段落聚焦于一个主要观点或主题的某一方面
使用标题和副标题来组织非虚构类文本（non-fiction text）（例如，一篇关于动物的报告，包含“栖息地（Habitat）”、“饮食（Diet）”、“外貌（Appearance）”等部分）
识别给定文本中新段落开始的位置并解释原因（例如，“这里开始一个新段落，因为主题从外貌转变为饮食”）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}撰写较长的文章——如报告或故事——时，他们是否将其组织成段落，将相关想法归类在一起，并在适当的地方使用标题以帮助读者阅读？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Rehearsing and Varying Sentences
topics.description: Compose and rehearse sentences orally before writing, progressively building varied and rich vocabulary and an increasing range of sentence structures including dialogue
evidence: Rehearse a sentence containing dialogue aloud before writing it (e.g. 'Let's go!' shouted Tom)
Orally compose sentences with varied openers (e.g. time adverbials, subordinate clauses) before writing
Try out two or three different ways to express the same idea orally and choose the most effective version to write
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} try out a sentence aloud before writing it — experimenting with different words and structures to find the version that sounds best?
topics.nameZh: 句子的口头演练与句式变换
topics.descriptionZh: 在书写前口头构思并演练句子，逐步积累丰富多样的词汇，并不断扩大句式结构的范围，包括对话（dialogue）。
evidenceZh: 在书写前大声演练包含对话（dialogue）的句子（例如：‘我们走吧！’汤姆大喊道）
在书写前口头构思具有不同开头（如时间状语（time adverbials）、从句（subordinate clauses））的句子
口头尝试两三种表达同一观点的不同方式，并选择最有效的版本进行书写
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}在书写前是否会大声尝试造句——尝试使用不同的词语和句式结构，以找到听起来最理想的版本？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Revising and editing (age 7+)
topics.description: Evaluate and edit writing by assessing effectiveness, proposing changes to grammar and vocabulary for consistency, and proof-reading for spelling, grammar and punctuation errors at Y3-4 level
evidence: Read own or a peer's writing aloud and suggest specific improvements to vocabulary or sentence structure
Propose changes to grammar and word choice to improve clarity and consistency across a piece of writing
Proof-read writing at Y3-4 level for spelling, punctuation, and grammatical errors and correct them independently
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} revisits a draft piece of writing, can they improve it — changing word choices to be more precise, fixing inconsistent tenses, and correcting spelling and punctuation errors?
topics.descriptionZh: 通过评估写作效果、提出语法和词汇的修改建议以保持一致性，以及在Y3-4（3-4年级）水平校对拼写、语法和标点错误来评估和编辑文章。
evidenceZh: 大声朗读自己或同伴的文章，并对词汇或句子结构提出具体的改进建议
提出修改语法和用词的建议，以提高整篇文章的清晰度和一致性
校对Y3-4（3-4年级）水平的拼写、标点和语法错误，并独立进行纠正
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 重新审视一篇草稿时，他们能否对其进行改进——将用词改得更准确，修正不一致的时态，并纠正拼写和标点错误？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Revising and editing (age 8+)
topics.description: Read back your own writing critically and independently — notice where meaning is unclear, where a word could be stronger, or where the reader might be confused; make revisions without needing teacher prompts, using your own judgment about what is and isn't working
evidence: Reread a paragraph silently and independently identify at least one place where meaning could be clearer or a word choice improved
Make a revision that goes beyond spelling/punctuation — changing a sentence for clarity or effect
Explain in their own words why they changed something ('I thought the reader wouldn't understand what I meant')
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read back something they've written — a story, a report, a letter — and spot a part that isn't quite right or could be better, all by themselves without you or a teacher pointing it out?
topics.descriptionZh: 批判性且独立地重读自己的写作作品——留意语意不清、用词不够精准或可能让读者困惑之处；无需教师提示即可自主修改，凭借自身判断力优化内容表达。
evidenceZh: 默读段落，并独立找出至少一处语意可更清晰或用词可改进的地方
进行超越拼写和标点符号的修改——为提升清晰度或表达效果而调整句子
用自己的话解释修改原因（如：‘我觉得读者可能无法理解我的意思’）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否重读自己写的文章（如故事、报告或信件），并在没有您或老师指出的情况下，完全独立地发现其中不够完善或可以改进的地方？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Short Research Projects
topics.description: Conduct short research projects that build knowledge about a topic, gather information from print and digital sources, and take brief organised notes
evidence: Generate three research questions about an assigned topic and identify two sources for each
Take brief notes from a print source, sorting key facts into provided categories
Write a short summary paragraph synthesising information gathered from two different sources
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is given a research project at school, can they look up information from books or websites, take organised notes, and then write it up in their own words?
topics.descriptionZh: 开展简短的研究项目以构建关于某一主题的知识，从印刷和数字资源中收集信息，并做简短且有条理的笔记
evidenceZh: 针对指定主题提出三个研究问题，并为每个问题确定两个信息来源
从印刷资料中做简短笔记，将关键事实分类整理到提供的类别中
撰写一段简短的总结段落，综合从两个不同来源收集的信息
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 在学校接到研究项目时，他们能从书籍或网站上查找信息，做有条理的笔记，然后用自己的话写出来吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Vivid Word Choices
topics.description: Choose precise and vivid words and phrases to create specific effects in writing
evidence: Replace vague words in 'The nice man went to the big house' with more precise alternatives and explain the effect
Write two versions of the same scene — one with plain language and one with carefully chosen words for suspense or humour
Select from a word bank the most effective verb and adjective for a given sentence, justifying each choice
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes descriptive or creative pieces, do they choose interesting and precise words — like "sprinted" instead of "ran", or "crimson" instead of "red" — to create a specific effect?
topics.descriptionZh: 在写作中选择准确且生动的词语和短语，以产生特定的表达效果
evidenceZh: 将“那个好心的男人去了那座大房子”中模糊的词语替换为更精准的词汇，并解释其效果
写出同一场景的两个版本——一个使用平实的语言，另一个使用精心挑选的词汇来营造悬念或幽默感
从词库中为给定的句子选择最有效的动词和形容词，并说明每次选择的理由
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 撰写描写性或创意性文章时，他们是否会选择有趣且精准的词汇——例如用“飞奔”（sprinted）代替“跑”（ran），或用“绯红”（crimson）代替“红”（red）——来营造特定的表达效果？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Writing Craft Vocabulary
topics.description: Know and use the vocabulary of writing craft and effect — form, structure, register, tone, voice, coherence, cohesion, argument, evidence, perspective, rhetoric, technique, formal, informal, and style — and understand that these words describe choices writers make intentionally to achieve a particular effect on the reader
evidence: Explain the difference between 'formal register' and 'informal register' and give an example of when each is appropriate
Use terms like 'coherence', 'cohesion', and 'paragraph structure' accurately when discussing or improving their own writing
Identify the 'purpose', 'audience', and 'form' of a piece of writing and explain how these shape the language choices
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is writing a persuasive letter compared to a story, can they explain the difference in 'tone' and 'register' — and why they'd make different word choices for each one?
topics.nameZh: 写作技巧词汇 (Writing Craft Vocabulary)
topics.descriptionZh: 了解并运用写作技巧与效果的词汇——体裁 (form)、结构 (structure)、语域 (register)、语气 (tone)、文风 (voice)、连贯性 (coherence)、衔接 (cohesion)、论证 (argument)、论据 (evidence)、视角 (perspective)、修辞 (rhetoric)、技法 (technique)、正式 (formal)、非正式 (informal) 以及风格 (style)——并理解这些词汇描述了作者为对读者产生特定影响而有意做出的选择。
evidenceZh: 解释“正式语域 (formal register)”和“非正式语域 (informal register)”之间的区别，并举例说明各自适用的场合。
在讨论或修改自己的写作时，准确使用“连贯性 (coherence)”、“衔接 (cohesion)”和“段落结构 (paragraph structure)”等术语。
识别一篇写作的“目的 (purpose)”、“受众 (audience)”和“体裁 (form)”，并解释这些因素如何影响语言选择。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 正在写一封说服性信件，而不是一个故事，他们能否解释两者在“语气 (tone)”和“语域 (register)”上的区别——以及为什么他们会为每篇文章做出不同的词汇选择？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Choosing Form and Tone for Your Audience
topics.description: Identify the audience for and purpose of writing before beginning, selecting the appropriate form, tone, and register to match the intended reader and communicative goal
evidence: Determine the audience (e.g., peers, teacher, younger children, a public audience) and purpose (to persuade, inform, entertain, or explain) before drafting and explain how these choices affect language and structure
Select an appropriate form for the writing task (letter, report, story, instructions, review) based on audience and purpose
