Adjust vocabulary, sentence length, and level of formality to suit the identified audience, e.g. using simpler language for younger readers and more formal language for an official letter
topics.assessmentPrompt: Before {{name}} starts a piece of writing, do they think about who will read it and why — adjusting their tone, vocabulary, and format accordingly, like writing more formally for a teacher than for a friend?
topics.nameZh: 根据受众选择写作形式与语气
topics.descriptionZh: 在开始写作前确定读者对象（audience）和写作目的（purpose），选择合适的文体（form）、语气（tone）和语域（register），以契合目标读者和交际目的。
evidenceZh: 在起草前确定读者对象（如同伴、老师、年幼的孩子或公众）和写作目的（如劝说、告知、娱乐或解释），并说明这些选择如何影响语言和结构。
根据读者对象和写作目的，为写作任务选择合适的文体（如信件、报告、故事、说明书或评论）。
调整词汇、句子长度和正式程度（formality）以适应确定的读者对象，例如对年幼读者使用更简单的语言，对正式信件使用更正式的语言。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在 {{name}} 开始写作之前，他们是否会思考谁会阅读这篇文章以及为什么阅读——并据此调整自己的语气、词汇和格式，比如给老师写作时比给朋友写作时使用更正式的语言？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Evidence-Based Writing
topics.description: Draw evidence from informational texts to support analysis, reflection, and research in writing, applying grade-level reading standards to non-fiction
evidence: Write a research-based paragraph or short report that cites specific facts, details, and evidence from informational texts to support key points
Synthesise information from two informational sources into a written summary that accurately represents both, noting areas of agreement and difference
Paraphrase information from informational texts accurately and cite sources appropriately, avoiding plagiarism
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a non-fiction piece — like a report on climate change — do they draw on specific facts and evidence from things they've read, weaving that information into their own writing?
topics.descriptionZh: 从信息类文本 (informational texts) 中提取证据以支持写作中的分析、反思和研究，并将相应年级的阅读标准应用于非虚构类文本 (non-fiction)。
evidenceZh: 撰写基于研究的段落或短篇报告，引用信息类文本 (informational texts) 中的具体事实、细节和证据来支持核心观点
综合两个信息类来源的信息写成摘要，准确反映两者内容，并注明一致与分歧之处
准确转述信息类文本 (informational texts) 中的内容并恰当标注来源，避免抄袭
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}写非虚构类文本 (non-fiction) 文章——例如气候变化报告——时，他们是否会引用阅读材料中的具体事实和证据，并将这些信息融入自己的写作中？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Literary Evidence in Writing
topics.description: Draw evidence from literary texts to support analysis, reflection, and research in writing, applying grade-level reading standards to literature
evidence: Write a response to a literary text that includes direct quotations and specific details from the text as evidence to support a claim or observation
Explain how a character's actions or dialogue reveal their traits or motivations, citing specific passages from the story as evidence
Compare how two literary texts treat a similar theme, using textual evidence from both to support the comparison
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes about a book they've read — like an essay about a character or a theme — do they support their ideas with specific quotes or details drawn directly from the text?
topics.nameZh: 写作中的文学证据 (Literary Evidence)
topics.descriptionZh: 从文学文本中提取证据 (Literary Evidence) 以支持写作中的分析、反思和研究，应用相应年级的文学阅读标准
evidenceZh: 撰写对文学文本的回应，其中包含来自文本的直接引语 (direct quotations) 和具体细节作为证据，以支持某一主张或观察
解释人物的行为或对话如何揭示其性格特征或动机，并引用故事中的具体段落作为证据
比较两部文学文本如何处理相似的主题，并使用两者的文本证据 (textual evidence) 来支持这一比较
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 撰写关于所读书籍的文章时——例如关于某个人物或主题的短文——他们是否会使用直接从文本中提取的具体引语或细节来支持自己的观点？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Writing for an audience
topics.description: Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development and organisation are appropriate to the task, purpose, and audience, maintaining a consistent style and structure throughout
evidence: Identify the task, purpose, and audience before writing and make deliberate choices about structure, tone, and vocabulary to suit them
Organise ideas logically so that the writing flows from introduction through development to conclusion, with each section serving a clear purpose
Review a draft to check that the organisation, style, and level of formality are consistent and appropriate for the intended reader
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes for school, does the piece feel well-organised and appropriate for its purpose — whether it's a formal essay, a creative story, or a persuasive argument — with a consistent tone throughout?
topics.descriptionZh: 撰写清晰连贯的文章，其内容展开和结构组织需与任务、目的和读者相适应，并在全文保持统一的风格和结构。
evidenceZh: 在写作前明确任务、目的和读者，并据此在文章结构、语气和词汇上做出合适的选择。
有逻辑地组织思路，使文章从引言到正文展开再到结论自然流畅，且每个部分都发挥明确的作用。
审查草稿，检查文章的组织结构、风格和正式程度是否保持一致，并适合目标读者。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 为学校写作时，文章是否条理清晰且符合其写作目的——无论是规范的文章、充满创意的故事，还是具有说服力的论述——并且全文语气保持一致？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Layout and Formatting in Informational Writing
topics.description: Use layout devices including headings, sub-headings, columns, bullets, and tables to structure text and guide the reader through informational and explanatory writing
evidence: Organise an informational text using headings and sub-headings to separate sections
Present comparative information using a table with clear row and column headers
Use columns and bullet points to display information in a scannable format
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a non-fiction piece — like a guide or an explanation — do they use layout features like headings, bullet points, and columns to help the reader navigate the information easily?
topics.nameZh: 信息类文本的布局与格式
topics.descriptionZh: 使用标题、副标题、分栏、项目符号和表格等排版工具来构建文本结构，并引导读者阅读信息类和解释类文本。
evidenceZh: 使用标题和副标题划分章节，组织信息类文本
使用带有清晰行列表头的表格展示对比信息
使用分栏和项目符号，以易于快速浏览的格式展示信息
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}撰写非虚构类文章（如指南或说明文）时，他们是否会使用标题、项目符号和分栏等排版特征，以帮助读者轻松阅读和获取信息？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Planning Narratives
topics.description: Plan narrative writing by considering how authors have developed characters and settings, drawing on techniques observed in texts read, heard, or performed
evidence: Identify specific authorial techniques for character development from a mentor text
Plan a character using techniques such as showing through action borrowed from a studied author
Analyse how an author builds setting and apply similar techniques in planning own narrative
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is about to write a story, do they think ahead about what their main character is like and where the story will take place before they start writing?
topics.descriptionZh: 通过考虑作者如何塑造人物和构建背景，并借鉴在阅读、聆听或表演的文本中观察到的技巧，来规划叙事写作。
evidenceZh: 从范文（mentor text）中识别作者用于人物塑造的具体技巧
借鉴所学作者的“通过动作展示”（showing through action）等技巧来规划人物
分析作者如何构建场景（setting），并在规划自己的叙事时运用类似技巧
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 准备写故事时，他们在开始写作前会提前构思主要人物的特点以及故事发生的地点吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Research & Note-Taking
topics.description: Gather relevant information from print and digital sources, summarise or paraphrase information in notes and finished work, and provide a basic bibliography or list of sources
evidence: Take organised notes from multiple sources using own words rather than copying
Create a bibliography listing sources used in a research project
Paraphrase key information from a source without changing the meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is researching a topic for a school project, can they find information from books or websites, put it in their own words, and keep track of where they got it from?
topics.descriptionZh: 从纸质和数字资源中收集相关信息，在笔记和最终作业中对信息进行总结或改写，并提供基本的参考文献或来源列表。
evidenceZh: 使用自己的语言从多个来源做有条理的笔记，而不是直接抄写
创建参考文献列表，列出研究项目中使用的资料来源
在不改变原意的情况下，用自己的话复述来源中的关键信息
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 正在为学校项目研究一个主题，他们能否从书籍或网站中查找信息，用自己的话进行表述，并记录信息的来源？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Writing a Précis
topics.description: Precis longer passages by summarising the main ideas and key information concisely while maintaining the essential meaning and removing non-essential detail
evidence: Reduce a three-paragraph text to a single paragraph capturing all main points
Identify and remove redundant information while preserving essential meaning
Write a precis that is no more than one-third the length of the original text
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} reads a long article about a topic they're studying, can they write a short summary in their own words that captures the key points without copying sentences?
topics.descriptionZh: 通过简洁地概括主要思想和关键信息来撰写较长文章的摘要（Précis），同时保留核心含义并剔除不必要的细节。
evidenceZh: 将三段文字缩减为一段，并涵盖所有主要观点
识别并删除冗余信息，同时保留核心含义
撰写长度不超过原文三分之一的摘要（Précis）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 阅读了一篇关于其正在学习主题的长篇文章，他们能否用自己的话写一段简短的摘要，抓住核心要点而不直接照抄原文句子？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Cohesion and Transitions Across Writing
topics.description: Use varied transitions, cohesive devices, and paragraph-linking strategies to create coherence across a whole piece of writing — including temporal transitions, causal connectives, and techniques for signalling shifts in argument, time, or setting
evidence: Use a range of causal and logical connectives (consequently, nevertheless, as a result) appropriately across a discursive essay
Signal a shift in time or setting within a narrative using a transitional phrase or paragraph break
Link paragraphs using a cohesive device such as a topic sentence that refers back to the previous paragraph
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes several paragraphs, do they use linking phrases like "however," "as a result," or "on the other hand" to connect ideas smoothly between sections?
topics.descriptionZh: 运用多种过渡词、衔接手段（cohesive devices）和段落连接策略，使整篇文章连贯流畅——包括时间过渡、因果连接词，以及标示论点、时间或场景转换的技巧。
evidenceZh: 在议论性文章中恰当地使用一系列因果和逻辑连接词（如“因此”、“然而”、“结果”）
在叙事文中使用过渡短语或段落换行来标示时间或场景的转换
使用衔接手段（如回指上一段的主题句）来连接各个段落
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 写多个段落时，他们是否使用了诸如“然而”、“因此”或“另一方面”等连接短语，使各部分之间的内容平滑过渡？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Developed Informational and Explanatory Writing
topics.description: Write informative and explanatory texts that examine a topic and convey ideas clearly — organising information logically with headings and formatting, developing the topic with relevant facts, definitions, details, and quotations, and using precise vocabulary
evidence: Organise an explanatory essay with a clear introduction, logical body paragraphs, and a conclusion
Develop a topic using well-chosen facts, definitions, concrete details, and quotations from sources
Use domain-specific vocabulary and formatting (headings, graphics) to aid the reader's comprehension
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write a clear explanation of how something works — like how a volcano erupts or how bread is made — so that someone who's never learned about it would understand?
topics.nameZh: 撰写信息与说明类文章
topics.descriptionZh: 撰写信息性和说明性文本，探讨主题并清晰地传达思想——使用标题和格式逻辑地组织信息，通过相关事实、定义、细节和引语来展开主题，并使用精准的词汇
evidenceZh: 组织一篇说明文，包含清晰的引言、逻辑严密的主体段落和结论
使用精选的事实、定义、具体细节和来源引语来展开主题
使用特定领域的词汇和格式（如标题、图表）以帮助读者理解
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否清楚地解释某件事物是如何运作的——例如火山是如何喷发的，或者面包是如何制作的——让从未了解过它的人也能看懂？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Persuasive Writing
topics.description: Write arguments to support claims with clear reasons and relevant evidence — including introducing claims, acknowledging counterclaims, organising reasons logically, maintaining a formal style, and providing a concluding statement
evidence: Write an argument essay with a clear claim supported by at least three pieces of evidence
Acknowledge and respond to a counterclaim rather than ignoring opposing views
Use linking words and phrases (however, furthermore, consequently) to connect claims, reasons, and evidence
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} wants to convince you to let them stay up later, can they write down clear reasons and examples to support their case rather than just saying "because I want to"?
topics.descriptionZh: 撰写文章以提出论点 (claims)，并使用清晰的理由和相关证据 (evidence) 来支持观点——包括引入论点、承认反驳观点 (counterclaims)、有逻辑地组织理由、保持正式的文风，以及提供总结性陈述。
evidenceZh: 撰写一篇议论文，提出明确的论点 (claim)，并至少用三条证据 (evidence) 来支持该论点
承认并回应反驳观点 (counterclaim)，而不是忽略反对意见
使用连接词和短语（如 however, furthermore, consequently）来连接论点 (claims)、理由 (reasons) 和证据 (evidence)
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 想说服你允许他们晚点睡觉，他们能写下清晰的理由和例子来支持自己的观点，而不是仅仅说“因为我想”吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Planning, Revising and Editing Writing
topics.description: Plan, revise, and edit writing to improve coherence and effectiveness — considering how the writing reflects its intended audience and purpose, amending vocabulary, grammar, and structure, and proofreading for accurate spelling, punctuation, and grammar
evidence: Revise a draft to improve paragraph structure, adding or removing material for coherence
Edit sentence-level issues including word choice, grammar, and punctuation before finalising
Reflect on whether the writing achieves its intended effect on the target audience and adjust accordingly
topics.assessmentPrompt: After {{name}} finishes a first draft, do they go back and make real improvements — not just fixing spelling, but changing sentences or reorganising ideas to make it better?
topics.nameZh: 写作的规划、修改与编辑
topics.descriptionZh: 规划、修改和编辑写作以提高连贯性和有效性——考虑写作如何反映其目标受众和目的，调整词汇、语法和结构，并进行校对以确保拼写、标点和语法的准确性
evidenceZh: 修改草稿以改善段落结构，增加或删除内容以提高连贯性
在最终定稿前编辑句子层面的问题，包括用词、语法和标点
反思写作是否对目标受众达到了预期效果，并据此进行调整
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在{{name}}完成初稿后，他们是否会回头进行实质性的改进——而不仅仅是修改拼写错误，还会修改句子或重新组织思路以使其更好？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Research & Source Evaluation
topics.description: Summarise and organise material from reading and research — gathering relevant information from multiple sources, assessing credibility, integrating evidence without plagiarising, and supporting ideas with factual detail
evidence: Take notes from multiple sources on a topic and organise them under logical headings
Paraphrase information from a source accurately without copying word-for-word
Assess whether a source is credible and relevant before including it in research writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is preparing for a school project, can they gather notes from several sources and organise them into a logical order before they start writing?
topics.descriptionZh: 总结并整理阅读和研究中的材料——从多个来源收集相关信息，评估其可信度，在不抄袭的情况下整合证据，并用事实细节来支持观点。
evidenceZh: 针对某一主题从多个来源做笔记，并将其整理在符合逻辑的小标题下
准确转述来源中的信息，避免逐字逐句地照抄
在将资料纳入研究报告之前，评估其是否可信且与主题相关
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 正在准备一个学校项目，他们能在开始写作前从多个来源收集笔记并将其整理成有逻辑的顺序吗？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Writing Across Genres
topics.description: Write for a range of purposes and audiences beyond narrative — including scripts, poetry, personal and formal letters, notes for talks, and other forms — selecting the appropriate form, register, and conventions for each
evidence: Write a formal letter using appropriate layout, salutation, register, and sign-off conventions
Compose a script with stage directions, character names, and realistic dialogue
Adapt writing style (vocabulary, sentence structure, tone) to suit different audiences and purposes
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write in different styles depending on the task — for example, a persuasive letter, a set of instructions, or a diary entry — and make each one sound appropriate?
topics.descriptionZh: 为叙事之外的多种目的和受众进行写作——包括剧本、诗歌、私人信件、正式信函、演讲提纲及其他形式——为每种文体选择恰当的表达形式、语域（register）和行文规范（conventions）。
evidenceZh: 使用恰当的排版、称呼、语域（register）和落款规范撰写一封正式信函
创作包含舞台提示（stage directions）、角色名称和逼真对话的剧本
调整写作风格（词汇、句式结构、语气）以适应不同的受众和目的
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否根据任务要求使用不同的风格进行写作——例如，写一封劝导信、一套操作说明或一篇日记——并使每一篇都恰当得体？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Writing Character & Dialogue
topics.description: Write narratives that develop real or imagined experiences using effective technique — including establishing context and point of view, developing characters through dialogue, pacing, and description, using varied transitions, and providing a reflective conclusion
evidence: Open a narrative by establishing setting, point of view, and a hook that engages the reader
Use dialogue, pacing, and descriptive detail to develop characters and advance the plot
Craft a conclusion that reflects on the narrated events rather than simply ending the action
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a story, do they use techniques like describing feelings, building suspense, or showing dialogue to make it interesting to read?
topics.descriptionZh: 运用有效技巧撰写叙事文，以发展真实或虚构的经历——包括建立背景和视角，通过对话、节奏和描写来塑造人物，使用多样的过渡方式，并提供具有反思性的结尾
evidenceZh: 通过建立背景、视角以及吸引读者的引子来开篇叙事
运用对话、节奏和描写细节来塑造人物并推动情节发展
构思一个对叙述事件进行反思的结尾，而不是仅仅结束情节动作
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 写故事时，他们是否会使用描写情感、制造悬念或展示对话等技巧，让故事读起来更有趣？

topics.subject: English
topics.name: Writing Techniques for Effect
topics.description: Apply growing knowledge of vocabulary, grammar, and text structure to writing — drawing on literary and rhetorical devices from reading (e.g., rhetorical questions, tricolon, anaphora, contrast) to enhance impact
evidence: Use a rhetorical question or tricolon deliberately in a persuasive piece and explain the intended effect
Employ varied sentence openings and structures to maintain reader interest across a whole piece
Draw on a literary device encountered in reading and apply it consciously in own writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} edits a piece of their writing, do they make choices about word order, sentence structure, or vocabulary to make the writing more powerful or clearer?
topics.nameZh: 提升表达效果的写作技巧
topics.descriptionZh: 将不断积累的词汇、语法和文本结构知识应用于写作——借鉴阅读中遇到的文学和修辞手法（如设问 (rhetorical questions)、三段式排比 (tricolon)、首语重复 (anaphora)、对比 (contrast)）来增强表达效果
evidenceZh: 在说服性文章中有意使用设问 (rhetorical question) 或三段式排比 (tricolon)，并解释其预期效果
运用多样的句首和句子结构，以保持读者对整篇文章的阅读兴趣
借鉴在阅读中遇到的文学手法 (literary device)，并有意识地将其运用到自己的写作中
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 修改自己的文章时，他们是否会通过调整语序、句子结构或词汇选择，来让文章更具感染力或表达更清晰？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Discovering Tutankhamun's Tomb
topics.description: Understand that we know about ancient Egypt because archaeologists have dug up and studied objects buried in the sand for thousands of years — and that one of the most exciting discoveries ever was when Howard Carter found the hidden tomb of Tutankhamun in 1922, filled with golden treasures
evidence: Explain that archaeologists find and study old objects to learn about people who lived long ago
Retell the story of Howard Carter discovering Tutankhamun's tomb
Understand that discoveries like this help us learn about how ancient Egyptians lived and what they believed
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} watches a documentary about Howard Carter opening a tomb full of gold, can they explain who Carter was and why his discovery was so important?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解我们之所以知道古埃及（Ancient Egypt）的故事，是因为考古学家（archaeologists）挖掘并研究了在黄沙下掩埋了数千年的文物。有史以来最令人激动的发现之一，就是1922年霍华德·卡特（Howard Carter）发现了隐藏的图坦卡蒙（Tutankhamun）陵墓，里面满是闪闪发光的黄金宝藏。
evidenceZh: 解释考古学家（archaeologists）如何通过寻找和研究古老的物品，来了解很久以前人们的生活
复述霍华德·卡特（Howard Carter）发现图坦卡蒙（Tutankhamun）陵墓的故事
理解像这样的发现如何帮助我们了解古埃及人（Ancient Egyptians）的生活方式以及他们的信仰
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 观看了一部关于霍华德·卡特（Howard Carter）打开一座满是黄金的陵墓的纪录片，他们能解释卡特是谁，以及为什么他的发现如此重要吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Egyptian Gods and the Afterlife
topics.description: Understand that the ancient Egyptians believed in many gods and goddesses and believed that life continued after death in a wonderful afterlife — which is why they took great care to prepare bodies and fill tombs with food, jewellery, and precious objects for the dead person to use
evidence: Explain that ancient Egyptians worshipped many different gods and goddesses
Describe the basic belief that Egyptians thought life continued after death
Give a reason why tombs were filled with treasures and everyday objects
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} learns that Egyptian tombs were filled with food, games, and gold, can they explain why the Egyptians put those things there?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解古埃及人信仰众多神明，并相信死后会在美好的来世中继续生活——这就是为什么他们会精心处理遗体，并在墓穴中装满食物、珠宝和珍贵物品，供死者使用。
evidenceZh: 解释古埃及人崇拜许多不同的神明
描述埃及人认为死后生命会继续的基本信仰
说明墓穴中装满珍宝和日常用品的原因
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 了解到埃及墓穴里装满了食物、游戏和黄金，他们能解释为什么埃及人要把这些东西放在那里吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Egypt, the Nile, and the Desert
topics.description: Locate Egypt on a map of Africa and understand that it is a country in a very hot, dry desert, but the River Nile — the longest river in the world — flows through it, bringing water and rich soil that allowed people to grow food and build one of the earliest great civilisations
evidence: Point to Egypt on a map and identify the River Nile running through it
Explain why the Nile was so important to the ancient Egyptians (water, food, transport)
Describe how the desert and the river created two very different environments side by side
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a picture of pyramids in a desert, can they tell you which country they're in and why a river made it possible for people to live there?
topics.descriptionZh: 在非洲地图上找到埃及的位置，并了解它是一个位于非常炎热、干燥的沙漠中的国家。但是，世界上最长的河流——尼罗河（River Nile）流经这里，带来了水源和肥沃的土壤，使人们能够种植粮食，并建立了最早的伟大文明（civilisation）之一。
evidenceZh: 在地图上指出埃及的位置，并辨认出流经该国的尼罗河
解释为什么尼罗河对古埃及人（ancient Egyptians）如此重要（水、食物、交通）
描述沙漠和河流是如何在相邻的地方创造出两种截然不同的环境的
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张沙漠中金字塔的图片，他们能告诉你这是哪个国家吗？能说出为什么河流让人们有可能在那里居住吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Everyday Life in Ancient Egypt
topics.description: Describe what everyday life was like for ordinary people in ancient Egypt: farmers grew wheat and barley near the Nile, families lived in mud-brick houses, children played games and had pets, and people ate bread, fish, fruit, and vegetables
evidence: Describe at least two things ordinary Egyptian families did in their daily lives
Name foods that ancient Egyptians ate or crops they grew
Identify at least one similarity and one difference between life in ancient Egypt and life today
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you asked {{name}} what a child their age might have done on a normal day in ancient Egypt, could they describe some activities — like playing games, helping with farming, or eating bread and fish?
topics.descriptionZh: 描述古埃及普通人的日常生活：农民在尼罗河附近种植小麦和大麦，家庭居住在泥砖砌成的房子里，孩子们玩游戏、养宠物，人们吃面包、鱼、水果和蔬菜。
evidenceZh: 描述古埃及普通家庭在日常生活中做的至少两件事情。
说出古埃及人吃的食物或他们种植的农作物。
找出古埃及生活与现代生活之间的至少一个相同点和一个不同点。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你问{{name}}，古埃及一个同龄孩子在普通的一天可能会做些什么，他们能描述一些活动吗——比如玩游戏、帮忙干农活，或者吃面包和鱼？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Hieroglyphs and Papyrus
topics.description: Know that the ancient Egyptians used a special writing system called hieroglyphs — pictures and symbols that stood for sounds and words — and that they wrote on a paper-like material called papyrus, which was made from a plant that grew along the Nile
evidence: Describe hieroglyphs as a writing system that uses pictures and symbols
Explain that papyrus was a material like paper made from a river plant
Understand that only specially trained people called scribes could read and write hieroglyphs
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees hieroglyphs on a museum artefact, can they tell you what they are and explain that the Egyptians wrote on a special paper called papyrus?
topics.nameZh: 象形文字 (Hieroglyphs) 与纸莎草纸 (Papyrus)
topics.descriptionZh: 了解古埃及人使用一种叫做象形文字 (Hieroglyphs) 的特殊书写系统——用图画和符号来表示声音和词语——并且他们把字写在一种类似纸的材料上，叫做纸莎草纸 (Papyrus)，它是用生长在尼罗河边的一种植物制成的。
evidenceZh: 描述象形文字 (Hieroglyphs) 是一种使用图画和符号的书写系统
解释纸莎草纸 (Papyrus) 是一种由河畔植物制成的类似纸的材料
理解只有经过专门训练的、被称为抄写员 (Scribes) 的人才能读写象形文字
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 在博物馆的文物上看到象形文字 (Hieroglyphs)，他们能告诉你这是什么，并解释埃及人是在一种叫做纸莎草纸 (Papyrus) 的特殊纸上写字的吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Pharaohs and Tutankhamun
topics.description: Know that ancient Egypt was ruled by powerful kings and queens called pharaohs, who lived in grand palaces and made the laws — and that one of the most famous pharaohs is Tutankhamun, a boy who became pharaoh as a child and whose golden tomb was discovered thousands of years later
evidence: Explain that a pharaoh was the ruler of ancient Egypt, like a king or queen
Name Tutankhamun as a famous pharaoh and describe at least one fact about him
Understand that pharaohs were very powerful and made important decisions for everyone in Egypt
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a picture of a golden Egyptian mask, can they tell you it belonged to a pharaoh called Tutankhamun and explain what a pharaoh was?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解古埃及由被称为法老（Pharaoh）的强大国王和王后统治，他们居住在宏伟的宫殿中并制定法律——并且知道最著名的法老之一是图坦卡蒙（Tutankhamun），他是一位在幼年时便登基的男孩法老，其金色的陵墓在数千年后才被发现。
evidenceZh: 解释法老是古埃及的统治者，就像国王或王后一样
说出图坦卡蒙是一位著名的法老，并描述关于他的至少一件史实
理解法老拥有极大的权力，并为埃及的全体臣民做出重要决定
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张金色埃及面具的图片，他们能告诉你它属于一位名叫图坦卡蒙的法老，并解释什么是法老吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Pyramids and the Great Sphinx
topics.description: Know that the ancient Egyptians built enormous stone pyramids as tombs for the pharaohs, that the Great Pyramid at Giza was one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World and is still standing today, and that the Great Sphinx — a statue with a lion's body and a human head — guards the pyramids
evidence: Explain that pyramids were built as tombs to protect the pharaoh's body for the afterlife
Describe the Great Pyramid as very large, very old, and still standing at Giza
Describe the Sphinx as a stone statue with a lion's body and a human head
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a photo of the pyramids, can they tell you why they were built and describe the Sphinx that sits near them?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解古埃及人建造了巨大的石头金字塔作为法老（pharaohs）的陵墓；吉萨大金字塔是古代世界七大奇迹之一，至今依然屹立不倒；大狮身人面像（Great Sphinx）是一尊拥有狮子身体和人类头颅的雕像，它守护着这些金字塔。
evidenceZh: 解释金字塔是作为陵墓建造的，目的是保护法老的遗体，以便他们在来世（afterlife）使用。
描述吉萨大金字塔非常巨大、非常古老，并且至今依然矗立在吉萨。
描述狮身人面像是一尊拥有狮子身体和人类头颅的石头雕像。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张金字塔的照片，他们能告诉你金字塔是为什么建造的吗？并且能描述一下位于它们附近的狮身人面像吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Vocabulary: ancient egypt
topics.description: Know and use the key vocabulary of ancient Egypt — pharaoh, pyramid, tomb, mummy/mummification, hieroglyphs, papyrus, sarcophagus, canopic jar, natron, archaeologist, artefact, Nile, delta, irrigation, shaduf, scribe, vizier, obelisk, sphinx, cartouche — and apply these terms accurately when describing Egyptian society, religion, and material culture
evidence: Use 'pharaoh', 'pyramid', and 'hieroglyphs' correctly and naturally in a spoken or written account of ancient Egypt
Explain what mummification is and why the Egyptians did it, using 'sarcophagus', 'canopic jar', and 'natron'
Use 'archaeologist' and 'artefact' correctly when discussing how we know about ancient Egypt
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} visited an ancient Egypt exhibition at a museum, could they read the labels and explain to you what a pharaoh was, why there were pyramids, and what hieroglyphs are?
topics.descriptionZh: 掌握并使用古埃及的关键词汇——法老（pharaoh）、金字塔（pyramid）、陵墓（tomb）、木乃伊/木乃伊化（mummy/mummification）、象形文字（hieroglyphs）、纸莎草纸（papyrus）、石棺（sarcophagus）、卡诺匹克罐（canopic jar）、泡碱（natron）、考古学家（archaeologist）、文物（artefact）、尼罗河（Nile）、三角洲（delta）、灌溉（irrigation）、桔槔（shaduf）、书记官（scribe）、维齐尔（vizier）、方尖碑（obelisk）、狮身人面像（sphinx）、王名圈（cartouche）——并在描述埃及社会、宗教和物质文化时准确应用这些术语。
evidenceZh: 在口头或书面描述古埃及时，正确且自然地使用“法老（pharaoh）”、“金字塔（pyramid）”和“象形文字（hieroglyphs）”
解释什么是木乃伊化以及古埃及人为什么要这么做，并使用“石棺（sarcophagus）”、“卡诺匹克罐（canopic jar）”和“泡碱（natron）”
在讨论我们如何了解古埃及时，正确使用“考古学家（archaeologist）”和“文物（artefact）”
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 参观博物馆的古埃及展览，他们能阅读展板标签并向你解释什么是法老、为什么会有金字塔以及象形文字是什么吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Ancient Egypt on the Timeline
topics.description: Place ancient Egypt on a timeline spanning over 3,000 years — from around 3100 BCE (unification under the first pharaoh) to 30 BCE (Roman conquest) — understanding that this civilisation lasted longer than the time between the Romans and today, and was divided into major periods: the Old Kingdom (pyramid age), Middle Kingdom, and New Kingdom (empire age)
evidence: Place ancient Egypt on a timeline showing it lasted over 3,000 years
Name the three main periods (Old, Middle, New Kingdom) and associate one fact with each
Compare the length of ancient Egyptian civilisation with another time period the child knows
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you asked {{name}} when the ancient Egyptians lived and for how long, could they explain that it was thousands of years ago and lasted longer than most other civilisations?
topics.descriptionZh: 将古埃及置于跨越3000多年的时间轴上——从大约公元前3100年（第一位法老统一埃及）到公元前30年（罗马征服）——理解这个文明延续的时间比从罗马时代至今的时间还要长，并划分为几个主要时期：古王国（金字塔时代）、中王国和新王国（帝国时代）。
evidenceZh: 将古埃及置于时间轴上，展示其延续了3000多年
说出三个主要时期（古王国、中王国、新王国）并分别关联一个相关事实
将古埃及文明的时长与孩子了解的其他历史时期进行比较
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你问{{name}}古埃及人生活在什么时代以及延续了多久，他们能否解释那是几千年前，并且古埃及文明存在的时间比大多数其他文明都要长？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Building the Pyramids
topics.description: Understand how the pyramids were built: thousands of workers moved enormous stone blocks using ramps, rollers, and sledges, the work was organised by the pharaoh's officials, and the design evolved from flat-topped mastabas to step pyramids (like Djoser's) to the smooth-sided Great Pyramid — and know that later pharaohs were buried in hidden rock-cut tombs in the Valley of the Kings
evidence: Describe at least two methods used to move and raise heavy stone blocks
Explain that pyramid design changed over time from simple tombs to the Great Pyramid
Explain why later pharaohs chose hidden tombs in the Valley of the Kings instead of pyramids
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} wonders how the Egyptians built the pyramids without modern machines, can they describe some of the methods used and explain how tomb design changed over time?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解金字塔是如何建造的：成千上万的工人使用坡道、滚木和滑橇(sledges)移动巨大的石块，工作由法老的官员组织，设计从平顶的马斯塔巴(mastabas)演变为阶梯金字塔(step pyramids，如左塞尔的金字塔)再到表面光滑的大金字塔(Great Pyramid)——并了解后来的法老被埋葬在帝王谷(Valley of the Kings)隐藏的岩凿墓(rock-cut tombs)中。
evidenceZh: 描述至少两种用于移动和抬起沉重石块的方法
解释金字塔的设计随时间从简单的陵墓演变为大金字塔
解释为什么后来的法老选择在帝王谷建造隐藏的陵墓而不是金字塔
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 好奇古埃及人如何在没有现代机器的情况下建造金字塔，他们能否描述一些使用的方法并解释陵墓设计是如何随时间变化的？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Egyptian Gods and Goddesses
topics.description: Name and describe key Egyptian gods and goddesses: Ra the sun god who sailed across the sky each day, Osiris the ruler of the afterlife, Isis the goddess of magic and motherhood, Anubis the jackal-headed god of mummification, Horus the falcon-headed sky god, Thoth the ibis-headed god of writing, and Bastet the cat goddess of protection
evidence: Name at least four Egyptian gods/goddesses and describe their roles
Explain why many gods were shown with animal heads and what the animals represented
Understand that Egyptians built temples as homes for the gods and performed daily rituals there
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees an Egyptian statue with a jackal head, can they tell you it represents Anubis and explain what he was the god of?
topics.descriptionZh: 说出并描述主要的埃及神祇：每天乘船遨游天空的太阳神拉（Ra）、冥界统治者奥西里斯（Osiris）、魔法与母性女神伊西斯（Isis）、胡狼头木乃伊制作之神阿努比斯（Anubis）、隼头天空之神荷鲁斯（Horus）、朱鹭头文字之神托特（Thoth），以及作为保护神的猫女神巴斯特（Bastet）。
evidenceZh: 至少说出四位埃及神祇的名字并描述他们的职责
解释为什么许多神祇被描绘成拥有动物头部，以及这些动物代表了什么
了解埃及人建造神庙作为神祇的居所，并在那里进行日常祭祀仪式
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到一座长着胡狼头的埃及雕像，他们能认出这代表阿努比斯（Anubis）并解释他是掌管什么的神祇吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Egyptian Social Hierarchy
topics.description: Describe the social structure of ancient Egypt as a pyramid-shaped hierarchy: the pharaoh at the top, then priests and nobles, followed by scribes and soldiers, then craftworkers and merchants, and farmers and labourers at the base — understanding that a person's position was usually inherited and determined their whole way of life
evidence: Draw or describe the social pyramid with at least four levels correctly ordered
Explain that most people were farmers and had very different lives from the pharaoh
Give an example of how social position affected someone's daily life (e.g., only scribes could read)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is asked who was more important in ancient Egypt — a scribe or a farmer — can they explain the social pyramid and where each person fitted?
topics.descriptionZh: 描述古埃及的社会结构，它呈金字塔形的等级制度（social hierarchy）：法老（pharaoh）位于顶端，其次是祭司和贵族，接着是书吏（scribes）和士兵，然后是工匠和商人，最底层是农民和劳工——需要理解一个人的社会地位通常是世袭的，并决定了他们整个的生活方式。
evidenceZh: 绘制或描述社会金字塔（social pyramid），正确排列至少四个阶层
解释大多数人都是农民，他们的生活与法老截然不同
举例说明社会地位如何影响某人的日常生活（例如，只有书吏才能读写）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果有人问 {{name}} 在古埃及谁更重要——是书吏还是农民——他们能解释社会金字塔并说明每个人所处的阶层位置吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Egyptian Tomb Paintings and Artefacts
topics.description: Use tomb paintings, artefacts, and objects from ancient Egypt as evidence to find out about daily life: Nebamun's tomb paintings show hunting and feasting, jewellery and furniture reveal craftsmanship, and everyday objects like pots and tools tell us what ordinary people used — understanding that these sources are how we piece together information about a civilisation that ended thousands of years ago
evidence: Describe what can be learned about Egyptian life by studying a tomb painting or artefact
Explain that objects found in tombs and ruins are evidence that helps archaeologists understand the past
Give an example of something specific a painting or object reveals (e.g., what food they ate, what games they played)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} looks at an ancient Egyptian painting showing people fishing and feasting, can they explain what it tells us about how Egyptians lived?
topics.descriptionZh: 利用古埃及的墓葬壁画、文物和日常物品作为证据，来了解当时的日常生活：内巴蒙（Nebamun）的墓葬壁画展示了狩猎和宴饮场景，珠宝和家具展现了当时的工艺水平，而陶罐和工具等日常用品则告诉我们普通人使用了什么——理解这些史料正是我们拼凑出数千年前消亡的文明信息的方式。
evidenceZh: 描述通过研究一幅墓葬壁画或一件文物，能了解到古埃及人生活的哪些方面
解释在墓葬和遗址中发现的物品是帮助考古学家了解过去的证据
举出一个具体的例子，说明壁画或物品揭示了什么具体信息（例如他们吃什么食物，玩什么游戏）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 观看一幅描绘古埃及人捕鱼和宴饮的壁画，他们能解释这幅画告诉了我们古埃及人怎样的生活情况吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Mummification Step by Step
topics.description: Describe the step-by-step process of mummification: the body was washed, internal organs were removed and placed in canopic jars, the body was dried with natron salt for 40 days, then wrapped in linen bandages with amulets tucked between the layers, and finally placed in a decorated coffin (sarcophagus)
evidence: List the main steps of mummification in the correct order
Explain the purpose of canopic jars and what was stored in them
Describe why mummification was performed (to preserve the body for the afterlife)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is asked how the ancient Egyptians made a mummy, can they describe the main steps — like removing organs, drying the body, and wrapping it in bandages?
topics.descriptionZh: 描述木乃伊制作的详细步骤：首先清洗遗体，取出内脏并放入卡诺匹斯罐（canopic jars）中；接着用泡碱（natron salt）将遗体干燥40天；然后用亚麻绷带包裹遗体，并在层与层之间放置护身符（amulets）；最后将遗体放入装饰华丽的棺材（石棺/sarcophagus）中。
evidenceZh: 按正确顺序列出木乃伊制作的主要步骤
解释卡诺匹斯罐（canopic jars）的用途以及里面存放了什么
描述为什么要制作木乃伊（为了在来世保存遗体）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果有人问 {{name}} 古埃及人是如何制作木乃伊的，他们能描述出主要步骤吗——比如取出器官、干燥遗体以及用绷带包裹遗体？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Scribes and the Rosetta Stone
topics.description: Know that scribes were specially trained people who could read and write hieroglyphs, that the Rosetta Stone — a slab with the same text in three scripts — was the key to cracking the hieroglyphic code, and that Jean-François Champollion used it to decipher hieroglyphs in 1822 after centuries of mystery
evidence: Explain the importance of scribes as the only people who could read and write
Describe the Rosetta Stone as having the same message in three different scripts
Name Champollion as the person who decoded hieroglyphs using the Rosetta Stone
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees the Rosetta Stone in a museum (or a picture of it), can they explain why it was so important and how it helped us read hieroglyphs?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解书吏（scribes）是受过专门训练、能够读写象形文字（hieroglyphs）的人；了解罗塞塔石碑（Rosetta Stone）——一块刻有三种不同文字但内容相同的石碑——是破解象形文字密码的关键；了解让-弗朗索瓦·商博良（Jean-François Champollion）在经历了数个世纪的谜团后，于1822年利用它破译了象形文字。
evidenceZh: 解释书吏作为唯一能够读写的人的重要性
描述罗塞塔石碑上刻有三种不同文字但表达相同信息的内容
说出商博良是利用罗塞塔石碑破译象形文字的人
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 在博物馆（或图片上）看到罗塞塔石碑，他们能解释它为什么如此重要，以及它是如何帮助我们阅读象形文字的吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Upper and Lower Egypt
topics.description: Understand that ancient Egypt was divided into Upper Egypt (the narrow river valley in the south) and Lower Egypt (the wide delta in the north), that the two lands were united under one pharaoh, and that Egyptians managed the Nile's water through irrigation canals and shadufs to grow crops year-round
evidence: Identify Upper and Lower Egypt on a map and explain why they had different landscapes
Describe how irrigation tools like shadufs and canals helped farmers water their fields
Explain that uniting the two lands was an important achievement of the early pharaohs
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a map showing the Nile splitting into branches near the sea, can they explain the difference between Upper and Lower Egypt and how farmers used the river's water?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解古埃及分为上埃及（南部的狭长河谷地带）和下埃及（北部的宽阔三角洲地带），这两片土地曾在一位法老（pharaoh）的统治下实现统一。同时，了解埃及人如何通过灌溉运河和桔槔（shaduf）来管理尼罗河水，从而实现农作物的全年种植。
evidenceZh: 在地图上指出上埃及和下埃及的位置，并解释它们为什么会有不同的地貌
描述桔槔（shaduf）和运河等灌溉工具如何帮助农民灌溉农田
解释统一这两片土地是早期法老（pharaoh）的重要成就
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张显示尼罗河在入海口附近分成多条支流的地图，他们能解释上埃及和下埃及的区别，以及农民是如何利用河水的吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Ancient Egypt's Lasting Legacy
topics.description: Evaluate ancient Egypt's lasting legacy: the Egyptians developed early forms of medicine, mathematics (used to build pyramids and survey land after floods), astronomy (calendar based on star observations), and engineering that influenced later civilisations including Greece and Rome — and compare ancient Egypt with other early civilisations (Mesopotamia, Indus Valley, Shang Dynasty) to identify shared features like writing, agriculture, cities, and organised religion
evidence: Name at least two Egyptian achievements that influenced later civilisations
Identify at least two features that ancient Egypt shared with other early civilisations
Explain why studying ancient Egypt helps us understand how human civilisation developed
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is asked what the ancient Egyptians gave to the world, can they name some lasting achievements and explain how Egypt compared to other ancient civilisations?
topics.descriptionZh: 评估古埃及的深远遗产：埃及人发展了早期的医学、数学（用于建造金字塔和洪水退去后的土地测量）、天文学（基于星象观测的历法）和工程学，这些成就影响了包括希腊和罗马在内的后世文明——并将古埃及与其他早期文明（美索不达米亚、印度河流域、商朝）进行比较，以识别出文字、农业、城市和制度化的宗教等共同特征。
evidenceZh: 至少说出两项影响后世文明的埃及成就
至少找出两项古埃及与其他早期文明共有的特征
解释为什么学习古埃及有助于我们理解人类文明的发展
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果问{{name}}古埃及为世界留下了什么，他们能否列举一些影响深远的成就，并解释古埃及与其他古代文明相比具有哪些特点？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Cleopatra and the End of Egypt
topics.description: Know that ancient Egypt eventually came to an end: the last pharaoh was Cleopatra VII, who allied with Rome but was defeated by Octavian (later Augustus) in 31 BCE, after which Egypt became a province of the Roman Empire — ending over 3,000 years of pharaonic rule and beginning a new chapter in Egypt's history
evidence: Name Cleopatra VII as the last pharaoh of ancient Egypt
Explain that Egypt was conquered by Rome and became part of the Roman Empire
Understand that the end of pharaonic rule did not mean the end of Egyptian culture
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is asked what happened to ancient Egypt in the end, can they tell you about Cleopatra and how Egypt became part of the Roman Empire?
topics.nameZh: 克利奥帕特拉与古埃及的终结
topics.descriptionZh: 了解古埃及最终走向终结的历史：最后一位法老是克利奥帕特拉七世（Cleopatra VII），她与罗马结盟，但在公元前31年被屋大维（Octavian，后来的奥古斯都 Augustus）击败。此后，埃及成为罗马帝国的一个行省，结束了长达3000多年的法老统治，开启了埃及历史的新篇章。
evidenceZh: 能说出克利奥帕特拉七世（Cleopatra VII）是古埃及的最后一位法老
能解释埃及被罗马征服并成为罗马帝国的一部分
能理解法老统治的结束并不意味着埃及文化的终结
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果问 {{name}} 古埃及最终的结局是什么，他们能告诉你关于克利奥帕特拉的故事以及埃及是如何成为罗马帝国一部分的吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Egyptian Art and Architecture
topics.description: Analyse Egyptian art and architecture: understand that Egyptian paintings followed strict conventions (people shown from the side with eyes from the front, size indicating importance), that tomb and temple design evolved from mastabas to step pyramids to smooth pyramids to rock-cut temples like Abu Simbel, and that obelisks, colossal statues, and temples like Karnak demonstrated the pharaoh's power and devotion to the gods
evidence: Identify at least two conventions used in Egyptian painting and explain their purpose
Describe how monument design changed over the course of Egyptian history
Explain why pharaohs built such enormous structures (power, religion, afterlife)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} notices that Egyptian paintings always show people in a strange sideways pose, can they explain that this was a deliberate artistic rule and describe why the Egyptians drew this way?
topics.descriptionZh: 分析埃及艺术与建筑：理解埃及绘画遵循严格的惯例（人物侧面展示但眼睛正面呈现，尺寸大小代表地位高低），了解陵墓和神庙设计从马斯塔巴（mastaba）到阶梯金字塔，再到平滑金字塔，最后到阿布辛贝神庙（Abu Simbel）等岩窟神庙的演变过程，并认识到方尖碑（obelisk）、巨型雕像以及卡纳克神庙（Karnak）等建筑展现了法老的权力及其对神灵的虔诚。
evidenceZh: 识别埃及绘画中使用的至少两种惯例并解释其目的
描述在埃及历史进程中纪念性建筑设计是如何演变的
解释为什么法老要建造如此巨大的建筑（权力、宗教、来世）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 注意到埃及绘画中的人物总是以奇特的侧面姿势呈现，他们能否解释这是一种刻意的艺术规则，并描述埃及人为什么这样作画？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Egyptian Timelines and Maps
topics.description: Read and construct historical timelines — place Ancient Egyptian periods, pharaohs, and key events on a timeline relative to each other and to the present day; interpret maps showing the Nile delta, trade routes, and the location of key sites
evidence: Place the Old, Middle, and New Kingdoms on a timeline and calculate the number of years between them
Read a map of ancient Egypt and identify the Nile, Memphis, Thebes, and the Valley of the Kings
Compare the age of Ancient Egypt on a timeline against other civilisations studied (e.g. Ancient Greece, Roman Britain)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is shown a timeline of ancient history, can they place the Ancient Egyptian kingdoms in the right order and say roughly how long ago they happened — and read a map to find where key places like Thebes were?
topics.descriptionZh: 阅读并绘制历史时间线（historical timelines）——将古埃及各个时期、法老（pharaohs）和关键事件按相互之间以及与当今时代的相对顺序排列在时间线上；解读展示尼罗河三角洲（Nile delta）、贸易路线和重要遗址位置的地图
evidenceZh: 在时间线上标出古王国（Old Kingdom）、中王国（Middle Kingdom）和新王国（New Kingdom）时期，并计算它们之间相隔的年数
阅读古埃及地图，并识别尼罗河（Nile）、孟菲斯（Memphis）、底比斯（Thebes）和帝王谷（Valley of the Kings）
在时间线上将古埃及的历史时期与其他学习过的文明（如古希腊、罗马不列颠）进行年代对比
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果向 {{name}} 展示一份古代历史时间线，他们能否按正确顺序排列古埃及的各个王国，并说出它们大约发生在多久以前——同时能否阅读地图找出底比斯（Thebes）等关键地点的位置？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Egyptian Trade and Economy
topics.description: Understand that ancient Egypt had a thriving economy based on farming surplus, trade, and specialised labour: the Nile's fertile soil produced enough food to support craftworkers, priests, and officials, and Egypt traded along the Nile and across the Mediterranean — exchanging gold, papyrus, and grain for cedarwood from Lebanon, lapis lazuli from Afghanistan, and incense from Punt
evidence: Explain how agricultural surplus along the Nile allowed people to specialise in non-farming jobs
Name at least two goods Egypt exported and two it imported, and where they came from
Describe how the barter system worked and why trade routes were important to Egypt's wealth
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} reads that the Egyptians traded gold for cedarwood from Lebanon, can they explain why Egypt needed to trade with other countries and how having surplus food made this possible?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解古埃及拥有基于农业盈余（farming surplus）、贸易和专业化劳动（specialised labour）的繁荣经济：尼罗河肥沃的土壤生产了足够的食物来养活工匠、祭司和官员，埃及人沿着尼罗河并跨越地中海进行贸易——用黄金、纸莎草和谷物换取来自黎巴嫩的雪松木、来自阿富汗的青金石以及来自蓬特（Punt）的香料。
evidenceZh: 解释尼罗河沿岸的农业盈余如何使人们能够专门从事非农业工作
说出至少两种埃及出口的商品和两种进口的商品，并说明它们的来源地
描述以物易物制度（barter system）是如何运作的，以及为什么贸易路线对埃及的财富至关重要
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 读到埃及人用黄金换取来自黎巴嫩的雪松木，他们能解释为什么埃及需要与其他国家进行贸易，以及拥有食物盈余是如何使这成为可能的吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Judgement of the Dead
topics.description: Describe the Egyptian belief in the judgement of the dead: after death, the heart was weighed against the feather of Ma'at in the Hall of Judgement, with Anubis overseeing the scales and Thoth recording the result — a pure heart meant entry to the Field of Reeds (paradise), while a heavy heart was devoured by the monster Ammit, and know that the Book of the Dead contained spells to help the deceased pass this test
evidence: Describe the weighing of the heart ceremony and name the gods involved
Explain the role of the Book of the Dead as a guide through the underworld
Connect the concept of the ka (life force) and ba (personality) to why Egyptians preserved the body
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a painting of a heart being weighed on scales, can they explain what the Egyptians believed happened after death and why they thought it was so important to live a good life?
topics.descriptionZh: 描述古埃及人对死后审判的信仰：死后，在审判大厅中，心脏会与玛阿特（Ma'at）的羽毛进行称量，阿努比斯（Anubis）监督天平，托特（Thoth）记录结果——纯洁的心意味着进入芦苇之野（Field of Reeds，即天堂），而沉重的心则会被怪物阿米特（Ammit）吞噬。此外，还需了解《死者之书》（Book of the Dead）中包含了帮助死者通过这项考验的咒语。
evidenceZh: 描述心脏称量仪式，并说出所涉及的神明名字
解释《死者之书》作为冥界指南的作用
将卡（ka，生命力）和巴（ba，人格）的概念与古埃及人保存尸体的原因联系起来
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到一幅在天平上称量心脏的画作，他们能解释古埃及人相信死后会发生什么，以及为什么他们认为生前过善良的生活如此重要吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: The Pharaoh as Living God
topics.description: Understand that the pharaoh was not just a ruler but was believed to be a living god — the intermediary between the gods and the people — and that the concept of Ma'at (truth, justice, and cosmic order) guided Egyptian law and government, with viziers and officials administering the kingdom on the pharaoh's behalf
evidence: Explain the pharaoh's dual role as both political ruler and divine figure
Describe Ma'at as the principle of truth, justice, and order that governed Egyptian society
Identify the role of viziers and officials in running the government day to day
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is asked why the pharaoh was so powerful, can they explain that Egyptians believed the pharaoh was a god on Earth and that a concept called Ma'at kept everything in balance?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解法老不仅仅是一位统治者，更被人们认为是活着的神——是神与人之间的桥梁。同时，玛阿特（Ma'at，代表真理、正义和宇宙秩序）的理念指导着埃及的法律与政府运作，而维齐尔（viziers，即宰相）和各级官员则代表法老日常管理国家。
evidenceZh: 解释法老作为政治统治者和神明化身的双重角色
描述玛阿特（Ma'at）作为治理埃及社会的真理、正义与秩序原则
识别维齐尔（viziers，宰相）和官员在日常政府运作中的作用
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果有人问 {{name}} 为什么法老拥有如此巨大的权力，他们能否解释这是因为埃及人相信法老是人间的神，并且一个叫做玛阿特（Ma'at）的理念让一切保持着平衡？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Modern Archaeology and Egyptian Ethics
topics.description: Understand that modern Egyptologists use advanced technologies — CT scanning of mummies, satellite imagery to find buried structures, DNA analysis — alongside traditional excavation, and think critically about the ethics of archaeology: whether mummies should be displayed in museums, who owns ancient artefacts, and how colonial-era collecting affects how we study and present ancient Egypt today
evidence: Name at least two modern technologies used in Egyptology and explain what they reveal
Discuss at least one ethical question about how ancient Egyptian artefacts are treated today
Understand that how we study ancient Egypt reflects our own values and biases, not just facts about the past
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} visits a museum with Egyptian mummies on display, can they think about whether that's the right thing to do and explain different viewpoints on the question?
topics.nameZh: 现代考古学与埃及伦理
topics.descriptionZh: 了解现代埃及学家如何使用先进技术——如木乃伊CT扫描（CT scanning）、寻找地下建筑的卫星图像（satellite imagery）、DNA分析（DNA analysis）——并结合传统发掘方法，同时批判性地思考考古学伦理问题：木乃伊是否应该在博物馆展出、古代文物（artefacts）的所有权归属，以及殖民时代的收藏行为如何影响我们今天对古埃及的研究和展示方式。
evidenceZh: 说出至少两种埃及学中使用的现代技术，并解释它们能揭示什么信息
讨论至少一个关于当今如何对待古埃及文物的伦理问题
理解我们研究古埃及的方式反映了我们自身的价值观和偏见，而不仅仅是关于过去的事实
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 参观一个展出埃及木乃伊的博物馆，他们能思考这样做是否合适，并解释关于这个问题的不同观点吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Egyptian Maths and Engineering
topics.description: Describe the Egyptian achievement in mathematics and engineering: the Rhind Mathematical Papyrus shows calculations of area, volume, and fractions; the precision of pyramid alignment (within 0.05° of true north) required sophisticated surveying; and Egyptian medical papyri describe detailed anatomical knowledge and pharmacological remedies — placing Egypt as a major contributor to the early history of science and technology
evidence: Describes the Rhind Mathematical Papyrus as containing worked examples of arithmetic, geometry, and unit fractions
Explains one specific engineering achievement: pyramid alignment, ramp logistics, or the accuracy of the Great Pyramid's dimensions
Names at least one medical papyrus (e.g. Ebers Papyrus) and describes the type of medical knowledge it contains
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} was told that the ancient Egyptians were solving problems involving fractions and calculating areas of fields over 3,500 years ago, could they describe what the Rhind Papyrus is and explain what it tells us about Egyptian mathematics?
topics.descriptionZh: 描述埃及在数学和工程方面的成就：莱因德数学纸草书（Rhind Mathematical Papyrus）展示了面积、体积和分数的计算；金字塔对齐的精确度（与正北方向偏差在0.05°以内）需要复杂的测量技术；埃及医学纸草书描述了详细的解剖学知识和药物疗法——使埃及成为早期科学技术史的主要贡献者。
evidenceZh: 描述莱因德数学纸草书（Rhind Mathematical Papyrus）包含算术、几何和单位分数的计算实例
解释一项具体的工程成就：金字塔对齐、坡道物流或大金字塔尺寸的精确度
至少命名一部医学纸草书（如埃伯斯纸草书 Ebers Papyrus），并描述其中包含的医学知识类型
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果告诉 {{name}} 古埃及人在3500多年前就已经在解决涉及分数的问题并计算田地的面积，他们能否描述什么是莱因德纸草书（Rhind Papyrus），并解释它告诉我们关于古埃及数学的哪些信息？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Historical Sources on Ancient Egypt
topics.description: Explain how knowledge of ancient Egypt is built from multiple source types — inscriptions, papyri, artefacts, and physical remains — and critically evaluate each: what biases, gaps, and distortions exist? Explore how Champollion’s decipherment of hieroglyphs transformed the field, and why the same artefact can be interpreted differently by different scholars
evidence: Identifies at least four types of historical source (inscriptions, papyri, tomb art, physical artefacts) and explains what each type can and cannot tell us
Explains that hieroglyphic sources were created by the literate elite and therefore tend to record official versions of events, not ordinary people's experiences
Describes at least one example where the same artefact or text has been interpreted in significantly different ways by scholars, and explains why this happens
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} was shown two history books with contradictory claims about ancient Egypt, could they explain why historians sometimes disagree, and describe what kinds of evidence they use to try to work out what really happened?
topics.descriptionZh: 解释关于古埃及的知识是如何通过多种史料来源（铭文、纸草、文物和实物遗迹）构建起来的，并对每种来源进行批判性评估：存在哪些偏见、空白和失真？探讨商博良（Champollion）对象形文字的破译如何改变了这一领域，以及为什么同一件文物会被不同的学者进行不同的解读。
evidenceZh: 至少识别出四种历史史料（铭文、纸草、墓室艺术、实物文物），并解释每种史料能告诉我们什么以及不能告诉我们什么
解释象形文字史料是由识字的精英阶层创造的，因此往往记录的是事件的官方版本，而非普通人的经历
描述至少一个例子，说明同一件文物或文本被学者们以截然不同的方式进行解读，并解释发生这种情况的原因
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果向 {{name}} 展示两本关于古埃及且论断相互矛盾的历史书，他们能否解释历史学家有时为何会产生分歧，并描述他们会使用哪些类型的证据来试图查明历史的真相？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Egypt and Its Neighbours
topics.description: Examine Egypt's relationships with neighbouring civilisations: trade networks reaching Nubia, the Levant, and Punt; the Hyksos invasion and the introduction of the chariot; and the New Kingdom empire and its conflict with the Hittites, culminating in the Battle of Kadesh and the world's earliest surviving peace treaty — understanding Egypt not as isolated but as part of a connected ancient world
evidence: Describes the trade relationship with Nubia and Punt, naming at least two goods exchanged in each direction
Explains how the Hyksos invasion introduced new military technologies to Egypt, including the horse-drawn war chariot
Describes the Battle of Kadesh (Ramesses II vs. the Hittites) and the resulting Egypto-Hittite peace treaty as a landmark in diplomatic history
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} was asked whether ancient Egyptians ever went to war with other civilisations or traded with distant countries, could they describe at least one example of each and explain how these interactions changed Egypt?
topics.descriptionZh: 考察埃及与周边文明的关系：通往努比亚（Nubia）、黎凡特（the Levant）和蓬特（Punt）的贸易网络；喜克索斯人（Hyksos）入侵及战车（chariot）的引入；新王国时期（New Kingdom）帝国与赫梯人（Hittites）的冲突，直至卡迭石战役（Battle of Kadesh）及世界上现存最早的和平条约——理解埃及并非孤立存在，而是古代互联世界的一部分。
evidenceZh: 描述与努比亚和蓬特的贸易关系，并列举至少两种双向交换的物品
解释喜克索斯人入侵如何为埃及引入新的军事技术，包括马拉战车
描述卡迭石战役（拉美西斯二世对阵赫梯人）及由此缔结的埃及与赫梯的和平条约，并将其视为外交史上的里程碑
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果询问 {{name}} 古埃及人是否曾与其他文明交战或与遥远国家进行贸易，他们能否各举至少一个例子，并解释这些互动是如何改变埃及的？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Who Really Built the Pyramids
topics.description: Analyse who built the pyramids and why, evaluating the evidence against the alien-builder myth and the slave-labour myth: archaeological evidence from worker villages at Giza shows a paid, skilled, well-fed workforce; discuss the social functions of monument building as a form of state organisation, religious duty, and employment; and assess the current controversy over newly discovered construction ramps and logistics
evidence: Cites at least three pieces of archaeological evidence from Giza that point to an organised, skilled, fed workforce rather than slaves or aliens (e.g. worker villages, bakery remains, graffiti tags, medical care)
Explains why the alien hypothesis fails to meet the standards of historical evidence and what the burden of proof in history requires
Evaluates at least two proposed explanations for ramp logistics and describes which is currently supported by the most evidence
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw a documentary claiming aliens built the pyramids, could they explain why archaeologists reject this idea and describe the actual evidence for who built them — and what their working conditions were like?
topics.nameZh: 究竟是谁建造了金字塔
topics.descriptionZh: 探究究竟是谁建造了金字塔以及为什么要建造它们，通过评估证据来破除“外星人建造”和“奴隶苦力”的迷思：吉萨（Giza）工人村的考古（archaeological）证据表明，建造者是一支有报酬、技术熟练且饮食良好的专业劳动力队伍；探讨建造宏伟建筑（monuments）作为国家组织（state organisation）、宗教义务和提供就业的社会功能；并评估目前关于新发现的建造坡道（construction ramps）和后勤物流（logistics）的争议。
evidenceZh: 引用至少三项来自吉萨的考古（archaeological）证据，这些证据指向一支有组织、有技能、饮食充足的劳动力队伍，而不是奴隶或外星人（例如：工人村落、面包房遗迹、涂鸦标记、医疗护理）
解释为什么“外星人假说”不符合历史证据的标准，以及历史研究中的举证责任（burden of proof）需要什么
评估至少两种关于坡道后勤（ramp logistics）的假设解释，并描述哪一种目前得到最多证据的支持
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看了一部声称外星人建造了金字塔的纪录片，他们能解释为什么考古学家（archaeologists）拒绝这个观点，并描述证明真正建造者的实际证据，以及他们的工作条件是怎样的吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Fall of Ancient Egyptian Civilisation
topics.description: Trace the end of ancient Egyptian civilisation through its successive conquests — Assyrian, Persian, Macedonian (Alexander the Great), and finally Roman — and explain how each conqueror was simultaneously shaped by Egyptian culture; examine Cleopatra VII as the last pharaoh and as a multilingual political strategist; and consider what survives of ancient Egypt in modern culture, religion, and language
evidence: Names the main conquerors of Egypt in chronological order (Assyrians, Persians, Macedonians under Alexander, Romans) and gives approximate dates
Describes Cleopatra VII accurately: not as a romantic icon but as a politically sophisticated ruler who spoke multiple languages and tried to preserve Egyptian independence

Identifies at least two enduring legacies of ancient Egypt in the modern world (e.g. the Coptic language as a descendant of ancient Egyptian, obelisks in Rome and Paris, Egyptian motifs in Western art and architecture)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} was asked when ancient Egypt ended and why, could they describe the final centuries — including who conquered Egypt, who Cleopatra really was, and name something from ancient Egypt that is still part of the world today?
topics.descriptionZh: 追溯古埃及文明的终结，了解其历经的连续征服——亚述 (Assyrian)、波斯 (Persian)、马其顿 (Macedonian，亚历山大大帝) 以及最终的罗马 (Roman) 征服，并解释每位征服者如何同时受到埃及文化的影响；探讨克利奥帕特拉七世 (Cleopatra VII) 作为末代法老 (pharaoh) 和多语种政治战略家的真实面貌；并思考古埃及文明在现代文化、宗教和语言中留下了哪些传承。
evidenceZh: 按时间顺序说出埃及的主要征服者（亚述人 Assyrians、波斯人 Persians、亚历山大领导下的马其顿人 Macedonians、罗马人 Romans）并给出大致年份
准确描述克利奥帕特拉七世：她不仅是一个浪漫偶像，更是一位精通政治、会说多种语言并努力维护埃及独立的统治者
指出古埃及在现代世界留下的至少两项不朽遗产（例如：作为古埃及语后裔的科普特语 (Coptic language)、罗马和巴黎的方尖碑 (obelisks)、西方艺术与建筑中的埃及图案元素）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果有人问{{name}}古埃及是何时以及为何终结的，他们能否描述其最后的几个世纪——包括谁征服了埃及、克利奥帕特拉究竟是谁，并说出一个至今仍存在于当今世界的古埃及事物？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Ancient Greece and Rome on the Map
topics.description: Locate Greece and Italy on a map and know they are countries around the Mediterranean Sea where two great ancient civilisations — Ancient Greece and Ancient Rome — grew up thousands of years ago, long after the ancient Egyptians but long before our time
evidence: Point to Greece and Italy on a world map or globe
Say that Ancient Greece and Ancient Rome were around the Mediterranean Sea
Place Greece and Rome on a simple timeline after Ancient Egypt and before today
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you showed {{name}} a map, could they point to where Ancient Greece and Ancient Rome were and tell you those places are near the Mediterranean Sea?
topics.nameZh: 地图上的古希腊和古罗马
topics.descriptionZh: 在地图上找到希腊和意大利的位置，并了解它们是地中海（Mediterranean Sea）沿岸的国家，数千年前这里孕育了两个伟大的古代文明——古希腊和古罗马，它们在古埃及文明之后很久出现，但远远早于我们现在的时代
evidenceZh: 在世界地图或地球仪上指出希腊和意大利的位置
说出古希腊和古罗马位于地中海（Mediterranean Sea）沿岸
在一条简单的时间轴上，将希腊和罗马放在古埃及之后、今天之前的位置
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你给{{name}}看一张地图，他们能指出古希腊和古罗马的位置，并告诉你那些地方靠近地中海（Mediterranean Sea）吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Ancient life vs today
topics.description: Compare how children in ancient Greece or Rome lived with how children live today — including differences in school (writing on wax tablets, learning to fight in Sparta), food (olives, bread, grapes), games, and clothing (tunics and sandals) — and understand these civilisations existed thousands of years ago
evidence: Name two ways a child's life in ancient Greece or Rome was different from today
Describe what ancient Greek or Roman children might have eaten or worn
Say that these civilisations existed thousands of years ago — long before grandparents were born
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you what it might have been like to be a child in ancient Greece or Rome — what they wore, ate, or did at school — and how it was different from today?
topics.descriptionZh: 比较古希腊或古罗马的儿童与今天儿童的生活差异——包括学校生活（在蜡板上写字、在斯巴达学习格斗）、食物（橄榄、面包、葡萄）、游戏和服装（束腰外衣和凉鞋）方面的不同——并理解这些文明存在于数千年前。
evidenceZh: 说出古希腊或古罗马儿童的生活与今天相比有两个不同的地方
描述古希腊或古罗马儿童可能吃什么或穿什么
说出这些文明存在于数千年前——在祖父母出生很久以前
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能告诉你做古希腊或古罗马的儿童可能是什么样的体验吗——他们穿什么、吃什么、在学校做什么——以及这与今天有什么不同？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Greek gods & Mount Olympus
topics.description: Know that the ancient Greeks believed in many gods and goddesses who lived on Mount Olympus — including Zeus (king of the gods, thunder), Athena (wisdom), Poseidon (the sea), Hermes (messages), and Aphrodite (love) — and that each god had special powers and a role in the world
evidence: Name at least three Greek gods and say what each one was god of
Say that the Greek gods were believed to live on Mount Olympus
Explain that the ancient Greeks prayed to different gods for different things
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw a picture of Zeus with a thunderbolt or Poseidon with a trident, could they tell you who they are and what they were the god of?
topics.nameZh: 希腊众神与奥林匹斯山
topics.descriptionZh: 了解古希腊人信仰许多居住在奥林匹斯山（Mount Olympus）上的男女神祇——包括宙斯（Zeus，众神之王，雷电）、雅典娜（Athena，智慧）、波塞冬（Poseidon，海洋）、赫尔墨斯（Hermes，神使）和阿佛洛狄忒（Aphrodite，爱情）——并且每位神祇都有特殊的能力，在世界中扮演着特定的角色。
evidenceZh: 至少说出三位希腊神祇的名字，并说明他们各自掌管什么
说出古希腊人相信众神居住在奥林匹斯山上
解释古希腊人会为了不同的事情向不同的神祇祈祷
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张宙斯手持闪电或波塞冬手持三叉戟的图片，他们能告诉你图片上是谁，以及他们分别是掌管什么的神吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Greek Myths and Heroes
topics.description: Retell at least one Greek myth involving a hero and a monster — such as Theseus and the Minotaur in the labyrinth, Heracles (Hercules) and the lion, or Perseus and Medusa — and understand that these were stories ancient Greeks told to explain the world and teach lessons
evidence: Retell a Greek myth naming the hero, the monster, and what happened
Explain that myths were stories the ancient Greeks told to make sense of the world
Describe what made a Greek hero brave or clever in the story
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you the story of a Greek hero like Theseus fighting the Minotaur or Heracles fighting the lion, and explain why the Greeks told these stories?
topics.descriptionZh: 复述至少一个涉及英雄与怪物的希腊神话——例如忒修斯（Theseus）与迷宫中的牛头怪（Minotaur），赫拉克勒斯（Heracles/Hercules）与狮子，或者珀耳修斯（Perseus）与美杜莎（Medusa）——并理解这些是古希腊人用来解释世界和传授道理的故事。
evidenceZh: 复述一个希腊神话，说出英雄、怪物的名字以及发生的事情
解释神话是古希腊人为了理解世界而讲述的故事
描述故事中是什么让希腊英雄表现得勇敢或机智
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能给你讲一个像忒修斯（Theseus）大战牛头怪（Minotaur）或赫拉克勒斯（Heracles）勇斗狮子这样的希腊英雄故事，并解释希腊人为什么要讲述这些故事吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Roman soldiers & builders
topics.description: Know that Roman soldiers marched across a huge empire building straight roads and strong walls, and that some Roman roads, walls, and buildings can still be seen today — showing that the Romans were powerful builders whose work has lasted thousands of years
evidence: Describe Roman soldiers as part of a powerful army that marched across an empire
Name something the Romans built that we can still see today such as roads or walls
Explain that Roman buildings and roads lasted because the Romans were skilled builders
topics.assessmentPrompt: If your family drove along a very straight old road or visited Roman ruins, could {{name}} tell you that the Romans built things so well they've lasted thousands of years?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解罗马士兵曾行军穿越庞大的帝国，沿途修建笔直的道路和坚固的城墙；知道今天依然能看到一些罗马的道路、城墙和建筑，这证明了罗马人是出色的建造者，他们的工程历经数千年依然屹立不倒。
evidenceZh: 描述罗马士兵是一支强大军队的一部分，曾行军穿越帝国
列举今天仍能看到的一些罗马建筑，如道路或城墙
解释罗马建筑和道路能留存至今，是因为罗马人是技艺精湛的建造者
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你的家人开车行驶在一条非常笔直的古老道路上，或者参观了罗马遗迹，{{name}}能告诉你罗马人建造的东西非常精良，历经数千年依然保存完好吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Romulus & Remus
topics.description: Know the Roman founding myth of Romulus and Remus — twin brothers abandoned as babies, raised by a she-wolf, who grew up to found the city of Rome — and understand that this is a legend the Romans told about how their city began
evidence: Retell the story of Romulus and Remus being raised by a wolf
Say that Romulus founded the city of Rome
Explain that this is a legend — a story people told, not necessarily true
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw a statue of a wolf feeding two babies, could they tell you it's the story of Romulus and Remus and how the Romans believed their city began?
topics.nameZh: 罗慕路斯与雷穆斯 (Romulus & Remus)
topics.descriptionZh: 了解罗慕路斯与雷穆斯（Romulus and Remus）的罗马建城神话——这对双胞胎兄弟在婴儿时期被遗弃，由一头母狼抚养长大，长大后建立了罗马城——并明白这是古罗马人讲述的关于他们城市起源的传说。
evidenceZh: 能复述罗慕路斯与雷穆斯被母狼抚养长大的故事
能说出是罗慕路斯建立了罗马城
能解释这是一个传说，即人们口口相传的故事，不一定完全真实
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到一尊母狼哺育两个婴儿的雕像，他们能告诉你这是罗慕路斯与雷穆斯的故事，并说出罗马人相信这就是他们城市起源的传说吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: The first Olympics
topics.description: Know that the Olympic Games began in ancient Greece at a place called Olympia as athletic competitions held in honour of Zeus, and that the modern Olympic Games we watch today were inspired by those ancient games
evidence: Say that the Olympic Games started in ancient Greece at Olympia
Name at least one sport or event from the ancient Olympics such as running or wrestling
Explain that today's Olympic Games got the idea from the ancient Greek ones
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} watches the Olympics on TV, can they tell you that the Games originally started thousands of years ago in ancient Greece?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解奥运会起源于古希腊一个叫奥林匹亚（Olympia）的地方，最初是作为向宙斯（Zeus）致敬而举办的体育竞技活动，并且我们今天观看的现代奥运会正是受到了这些古代奥运会的启发。
evidenceZh: 能够说出奥运会起源于古希腊的奥林匹亚
能说出至少一项古代奥运会的运动或项目，例如跑步或摔跤
能解释今天的奥运会是受古希腊奥运会启发而来的
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}在电视上看奥运会时，他们能告诉你奥运会最初是几千年前在古希腊开始的吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Athenian Democracy
topics.description: Understand that Athens invented democracy — a system where free male citizens gathered in an Assembly to debate and vote on important decisions for the city — but that women, enslaved people, and foreigners were not allowed to vote
evidence: Explain what democracy meant in Athens: citizens voted on decisions together
Identify who could vote in Athenian democracy (free men born in Athens) and who could not
Say that the idea of people voting on decisions started in Athens and still influences us today
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain that democracy — people voting on decisions — was invented in ancient Athens, but that not everyone was allowed to take part?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解雅典发明了民主制度——这是一种由自由男性公民在公民大会（Assembly）上集会，对城市重要事务进行辩论和投票的制度——但妇女、奴隶和外国人没有投票权。
evidenceZh: 解释民主在雅典的含义：公民们共同投票决定事务
指出在雅典民主中谁有投票权（在雅典出生的自由男性），谁没有投票权
说明人们投票决定事务的理念起源于雅典，并且至今仍在影响着我们
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否解释民主——也就是人们通过投票来决定事务——起源于古希腊雅典，但并非所有人都被允许参与其中？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Athens Versus Sparta
topics.description: Compare Athens and Sparta as two very different Greek city-states: Athens focused on learning, arts, debate, and democracy, while Sparta focused on military training, discipline, and obedience — and understand that a city-state was a city that ruled itself like a small country
evidence: Name at least two differences between life in Athens and life in Sparta
Explain what a city-state was and why Greek city-states were independent from each other
Describe what was valued most in Athens (learning, arts) versus Sparta (military strength)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you asked {{name}} about Athens and Sparta, could they tell you that Athens was famous for thinking and democracy while Sparta was famous for its fierce warriors?
topics.descriptionZh: 比较雅典和斯巴达这两个截然不同的希腊城邦（city-state）：雅典注重学习、艺术、辩论和民主（democracy），而斯巴达则注重军事训练、纪律和服从——并理解城邦就是一个像小国家一样自治的城市。
evidenceZh: 说出雅典和斯巴达生活方式的至少两个不同之处
解释什么是城邦（city-state），以及为什么希腊的各个城邦是相互独立的
描述雅典（学习、艺术）和斯巴达（军事实力）最看重的东西分别是什么
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你问{{name}}关于雅典和斯巴达的事，他们能告诉你雅典以思想和民主（democracy）闻名，而斯巴达以勇猛的战士闻名吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Boudicca's Revolt Against Rome
topics.description: Tell the story of Boudicca, queen of the Iceni tribe, who led a fierce revolt against Roman rule in Britain — burning Colchester, London, and St Albans — before her army was defeated, and understand her significance as a symbol of resistance against a powerful empire
evidence: Retell the story of Boudicca: who she was, why she revolted, what happened
Name at least one town Boudicca's army destroyed during the revolt
Explain why Boudicca is remembered as a symbol of resistance against the Romans
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you who Boudicca was and what happened when she led a revolt against the Romans in Britain?
topics.nameZh: 布狄卡反抗罗马起义 (Boudicca's Revolt Against Rome)
topics.descriptionZh: 讲述爱西尼部落 (Iceni tribe) 女王布狄卡 (Boudicca) 的故事，她曾领导了一场反抗罗马帝国 (Roman Empire) 在不列颠统治的激烈起义——烧毁了科尔切斯特 (Colchester)、伦敦 (London) 和圣奥尔本斯 (St Albans)——直到她的军队被击败，并理解她作为反抗强大帝国象征的重要意义。
evidenceZh: 复述布狄卡的故事：她是谁，为什么起义，以及发生了什么
说出至少一个布狄卡的军队在起义期间摧毁的城镇
解释为什么布狄卡被铭记为反抗罗马人的象征
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能告诉你布狄卡是谁，以及她在不列颠领导反抗罗马人起义时发生了什么吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Daily Life in a Roman Town
topics.description: Describe daily life in a Roman town — the forum (marketplace and meeting place), public baths, amphitheatre, and villas — and explain that the Romans were brilliant engineers who built straight roads, aqueducts to carry water, underfloor heating (hypocaust), and Hadrian's Wall to mark the empire's northern frontier in Britain
evidence: Describe at least three features of a Roman town such as forum, baths, or amphitheatre
Explain what an aqueduct was and why the Romans built them
Describe Hadrian's Wall and say why it was built
topics.assessmentPrompt: If your family visited Roman ruins like a bathhouse or Hadrian's Wall, could {{name}} explain what they were used for and how the Romans built them?
topics.descriptionZh: 描述罗马城镇的日常生活——包括广场（集市和集会场所）、公共浴场、圆形竞技场和别墅——并解释罗马人是杰出的工程师，他们修建了笔直的道路、用于引水的高架渠（aqueducts）、地暖系统（hypocaust），以及用于标记帝国在北部不列颠边界的哈德良长城（Hadrian's Wall）。
evidenceZh: 描述罗马城镇的至少三个特征，如广场、浴场或圆形竞技场
解释什么是高架渠（aqueducts）以及罗马人为什么要建造它们
描述哈德良长城（Hadrian's Wall）并说明建造它的原因
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你的家人去参观浴场或哈德良长城等罗马遗迹，{{name}} 能否解释它们的用途以及罗马人是如何建造它们的？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Gladiators & Pompeii
topics.description: Know that Romans watched gladiators fight in huge arenas like the Colosseum in Rome, that gladiators were usually enslaved people or prisoners trained to fight, and that the city of Pompeii was buried by the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in AD 79, preserving an extraordinary snapshot of Roman daily life
evidence: Describe what gladiators were and where they fought
Explain that the Colosseum in Rome was a giant arena for public entertainment
Retell what happened to Pompeii and why it is important for understanding Roman life
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you what gladiators were, describe the Colosseum, and explain what happened to the city of Pompeii?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解罗马人曾在罗马斗兽场（Colosseum）等巨大竞技场观看角斗士（gladiator）角斗，知道角斗士通常是被训练格斗的奴隶或囚犯，并了解庞贝（Pompeii）在公元79年被维苏威火山（Mount Vesuvius）爆发所掩埋，从而为罗马人的日常生活保留了极其珍贵的历史瞬间。
evidenceZh: 描述角斗士的身份以及他们角斗的场所
解释罗马斗兽场是一个用于公共娱乐的巨大竞技场
复述庞贝古城发生了什么，以及它为什么对了解罗马人的生活至关重要
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能告诉你角斗士是什么、描述斗兽场，并解释庞贝古城发生了什么吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Gods & the Parthenon
topics.description: Name the major Greek gods and their roles — Zeus (king, thunder), Hera (queen, marriage), Athena (wisdom, warfare), Poseidon (sea), Apollo (sun, music), Artemis (hunting, moon), Ares (war), Aphrodite (love), Hermes (messengers), Hephaestus (fire, crafts), Hades (underworld) — and know that the Parthenon in Athens was a grand temple built to honour Athena
evidence: Name at least five Greek gods and say what each was responsible for
Describe the Parthenon as a temple to Athena built on the acropolis in Athens
Explain that Greeks built temples to honour their gods and held festivals and sacrifices
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw a picture of the Parthenon, could they tell you it was a temple to Athena in Athens and name several other Greek gods and what they were god of?
topics.descriptionZh: 说出主要的希腊诸神及其职责——宙斯（众神之王，雷霆）、赫拉（天后，婚姻）、雅典娜（智慧，战争）、波塞冬（海洋）、阿波罗（太阳，音乐）、阿尔忒弥斯（狩猎，月亮）、阿瑞斯（战争）、阿佛洛狄忒（爱情）、赫尔墨斯（信使）、赫菲斯托斯（火，工艺）、哈迪斯（冥界）——并了解雅典的帕特农神庙是一座为纪念雅典娜而建的宏伟神庙
evidenceZh: 说出至少五位希腊诸神，并说明他们各自掌管什么
描述帕特农神庙是建在雅典卫城上的一座供奉雅典娜的神庙
解释希腊人建造神庙来敬奉他们的神明，并举行节日庆典和祭祀活动
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到一张帕特农神庙的图片，他们能告诉你这是雅典供奉雅典娜的神庙，并说出其他几位希腊诸神以及他们分别掌管什么吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Greek Gods with Roman Names
topics.description: Understand that the Romans adopted the Greek gods but gave them new names — Zeus became Jupiter, Hera became Juno, Ares became Mars, Athena became Minerva, Poseidon became Neptune, Aphrodite became Venus — and that this shows how deeply Rome was influenced by Greek culture
evidence: Match at least four Greek gods to their Roman names
Explain that the Romans took Greek gods and gave them Latin names
Say that this borrowing shows Rome was strongly influenced by Greek culture
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you that the Romans had the same gods as the Greeks but with different names — like Zeus becoming Jupiter and Athena becoming Minerva?
topics.nameZh: 拥有罗马名字的希腊诸神
topics.descriptionZh: 了解罗马人吸收了希腊诸神，但给他们换了新名字——宙斯（Zeus）变成了朱庇特（Jupiter），赫拉（Hera）变成了朱诺（Juno），阿瑞斯（Ares）变成了玛尔斯（Mars），雅典娜（Athena）变成了弥涅耳瓦（Minerva），波塞冬（Poseidon）变成了尼普顿（Neptune），阿佛洛狄忒（Aphrodite）变成了维纳斯（Venus）——这说明罗马深受希腊文化的影响。
evidenceZh: 将至少四位希腊诸神与他们的罗马名字进行匹配
解释罗马人引入了希腊诸神并赋予了他们拉丁语名字
说明这种借鉴表明罗马深受希腊文化的影响
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能告诉你罗马人有着和希腊人相同的神明，只是名字不同——比如宙斯变成了朱庇特，雅典娜变成了弥涅耳瓦吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Greek theatre
topics.description: Know that the ancient Greeks invented theatre, performing tragedies and comedies in large open-air amphitheatres with actors wearing masks — and that plays were performed as part of religious festivals honouring the god Dionysus, with audiences of thousands
evidence: Explain that the Greeks invented theatre with two types of plays: tragedies and comedies
Describe how Greek actors wore masks and performed in open-air amphitheatres
Say that plays were part of festivals honouring the god Dionysus
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} visited an ancient amphitheatre or saw a picture of Greek masks, could they tell you that the Greeks invented theatre and explain why actors wore masks?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解古希腊人发明了戏剧，在大型露天圆形剧场（amphitheatres）中表演悲剧（tragedies）和喜剧（comedies），演员佩戴面具——并且戏剧是祭祀酒神狄俄尼索斯（Dionysus）的宗教节日的一部分，观众可达数千人。
evidenceZh: 解释古希腊人发明了戏剧，包含两种演出类型：悲剧（tragedies）和喜剧（comedies）
描述古希腊演员如何佩戴面具并在露天圆形剧场（amphitheatres）中表演
说明戏剧表演是祭祀酒神狄俄尼索斯（Dionysus）的宗教节日的一部分
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 参观了一座古代的露天圆形剧场或看到了希腊面具的图片，他们能告诉你古希腊人发明了戏剧，并解释为什么演员要佩戴面具吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Marathon and Thermopylae
topics.description: Describe the battles of Marathon and Thermopylae as moments when Greek city-states united against the invading Persian Empire — the runner Pheidippides bringing news of victory at Marathon (origin of the marathon race), and the heroic stand of 300 Spartans at Thermopylae — and understand these wars were fought to defend Greek independence
evidence: Retell the story of the Battle of Marathon and the runner Pheidippides
Describe the Spartan stand at Thermopylae against a much larger Persian army
Explain that the Persian Wars were about Greek city-states defending their freedom
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you about the famous battles of Marathon and Thermopylae, and explain that the Greeks were fighting to defend their freedom against the Persian Empire?
topics.descriptionZh: 描述马拉松战役（Battle of Marathon）和温泉关战役（Battle of Thermopylae）作为希腊城邦（Greek city-states）联合起来抵抗入侵的波斯帝国（Persian Empire）的历史时刻——跑者菲迪皮德斯（Pheidippides）在马拉松带来胜利的消息（马拉松长跑的起源），以及300名斯巴达人在温泉关的英勇抵抗——并理解这些战争是为了捍卫希腊独立而进行的。
evidenceZh: 复述马拉松战役和跑者菲迪皮德斯（Pheidippides）的故事
描述斯巴达人在温泉关抵抗庞大波斯军队的英勇事迹
解释希波战争（Persian Wars）是希腊城邦为了捍卫自身自由而进行的战争
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能给你讲讲著名的马拉松和温泉关战役，并解释希腊人是为了抵抗波斯帝国、捍卫自由而战的吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Roman Army and Conquest of Britain
topics.description: Describe how the Roman army was organised into legions of highly trained soldiers, how Julius Caesar first raided Britain in 55 BC and Emperor Claudius later conquered it in AD 43, and explain why the Romans wanted to expand their empire — for land, resources, taxes, and glory
evidence: Describe a Roman legion as a large unit of highly trained, disciplined soldiers
Explain that Julius Caesar raided Britain first and Claudius conquered it later
Give at least one reason why the Romans invaded Britain
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you how the Roman army was organised and explain why the Romans invaded Britain — who came first and who finally conquered it?
topics.nameZh: 罗马军队与征服不列颠
topics.descriptionZh: 描述罗马军队是如何组织成由训练有素的士兵组成的军团（legion）的，儒略·恺撒（Julius Caesar）是如何在公元前55年首次突袭不列颠，以及克劳狄乌斯皇帝（Emperor Claudius）后来在公元43年征服它的，并解释罗马人为什么想要扩张他们的帝国——为了土地、资源、税收和荣耀。
evidenceZh: 将罗马军团（Roman legion）描述为一个由训练有素、纪律严明的士兵组成的大型部队
解释儒略·恺撒首先突袭了不列颠，而克劳狄乌斯后来征服了它
给出至少一个罗马人入侵不列颠的原因
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能告诉你罗马军队是如何组织的，并解释罗马人为什么入侵不列颠吗——谁先来，谁最终征服了它？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Alexander the Great's Empire
topics.description: Describe how Alexander the Great of Macedon conquered a vast empire stretching from Greece to Egypt to India, spreading Greek language, culture, and ideas across the ancient world — creating a period known as the Hellenistic Age where Greek and Eastern cultures blended
evidence: Describe the extent of Alexander's empire on a map (Greece to Egypt to India)
Explain that Alexander spread Greek culture and language across the lands he conquered
Say what the Hellenistic Age was — a blending of Greek and Eastern cultures
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you who Alexander the Great was, how far his empire stretched, and what happened to Greek culture because of his conquests?
topics.descriptionZh: 描述马其顿的亚历山大大帝如何征服了一个从希腊延伸至埃及再到印度的庞大帝国，将希腊语言、文化和思想传播到古代世界各地——开创了一个被称为希腊化时代（Hellenistic Age）的时期，在这个时期希腊文化与东方文化相互交融。
evidenceZh: 在地图上描述亚历山大帝国的疆域范围（从希腊到埃及再到印度）
解释亚历山大如何在他征服的广袤土地上推行和传播希腊文化与语言
说明什么是希腊化时代（Hellenistic Age）——即希腊文化与东方文化相互交融的时期
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能告诉你亚历山大大帝是谁、他的帝国疆域有多广阔，以及因为他的征服希腊文化发生了什么变化吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Evidence for Greek and Roman Life
topics.description: Understand that historians and archaeologists piece together ancient Greek and Roman life from evidence — pottery paintings, coins, inscriptions, ruins like Pompeii, and written texts by authors such as Homer and Pliny — and that the same evidence can be interpreted in different ways by different historians
evidence: Name at least three types of evidence historians use to learn about ancient Greece and Rome
Explain why Pompeii is especially valuable as a source of evidence about Roman life
Give an example of how the same piece of evidence could be interpreted in more than one way
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw an ancient Greek pot or a Roman coin in a museum, could they explain what historians can learn from objects like these and why different experts might interpret them differently?
topics.nameZh: 古希腊与古罗马生活的证据
topics.descriptionZh: 了解历史学家和考古学家是如何通过证据来拼凑出古希腊和古罗马的生活面貌的——这些证据包括陶器彩绘、硬币、铭文、庞贝等遗址，以及荷马和老普林尼等作家的文字记录——并认识到同一证据可能会被不同的历史学家以不同的方式进行解读。
evidenceZh: 说出至少三种历史学家用来了解古希腊和古罗马的证据类型。
解释为什么庞贝古城作为了解古罗马生活的证据来源特别有价值。
举例说明同一件证据如何能够被以多种不同的方式进行解读。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 在博物馆里看到一个古希腊陶罐或一枚古罗马硬币，他们能解释出历史学家能从这些物品中了解到什么，以及为什么不同的专家可能会对它们有不同的解读吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Fall of the Western Roman Empire
topics.description: Describe how the Western Roman Empire gradually declined due to a combination of factors — military pressure from invading peoples, political instability, economic problems, and an overstretched empire — and finally fell in AD 476, while the Eastern Roman (Byzantine) Empire continued for nearly a thousand more years
evidence: Name at least two reasons why the Western Roman Empire declined and fell
State the date AD 476 as when the last Western Roman emperor was removed
Explain that the Eastern (Byzantine) Empire survived for nearly 1,000 years after the West fell
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain why the Roman Empire fell apart and tell you that while the western half collapsed, the eastern half kept going for centuries?
topics.descriptionZh: 描述西罗马帝国如何由于多种因素的结合——包括入侵民族的军事压力、政治动荡、经济问题以及帝国疆域过度扩张——而逐渐衰落，并最终于公元476年灭亡，而东罗马（拜占庭）帝国又延续了近一千年。
evidenceZh: 说出至少两个西罗马帝国衰落和灭亡的原因
指出公元476年是最后一位西罗马皇帝被废黜的时间
解释在西部帝国灭亡后，东部（拜占庭）帝国又延续了将近1000年
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否解释罗马帝国为何分崩离析，并告诉你虽然西半部崩溃了，但东半部又延续了几个世纪？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Greek and Roman Architecture
topics.description: Identify Greek column styles — Doric (plain and sturdy), Ionic (scroll-shaped capitals), and Corinthian (ornate leafy capitals) — and Roman architectural innovations — the arch, the dome, and concrete — and spot their influence in modern public buildings such as courthouses, museums, government buildings, and monuments
evidence: Identify the three Greek column orders (Doric, Ionic, Corinthian) from pictures
Name Roman architectural innovations: the arch, the dome, and concrete
Point out Greek or Roman architectural features in a modern public building
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you walked past a courthouse or museum with big columns, could {{name}} tell you whether they're Doric, Ionic, or Corinthian and explain that the design comes from ancient Greece or Rome?
topics.descriptionZh: 认识希腊的三种柱式——多立克柱式（Doric，朴素且粗壮）、爱奥尼柱式（Ionic，柱头有像卷轴一样的装饰）和科林斯柱式（Corinthian，柱头有华丽的树叶装饰）；了解罗马建筑的伟大创新——拱门（arch）、穹顶（dome）和混凝土（concrete）；并学会在现代公共建筑（如法院、博物馆、政府大楼和纪念碑）中寻找这些古典建筑的影子。
evidenceZh: 能够从图片中识别出三种希腊柱式（多立克柱式、爱奥尼柱式、科林斯柱式）
能说出罗马建筑的三大创新：拱门（arch）、穹顶（dome）和混凝土（concrete）
能在现代公共建筑中指出希腊或罗马的建筑特征
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当你路过一座带有大柱子的法院或博物馆时，{{name}} 能分辨出这些柱子是多立克柱式、爱奥尼柱式还是科林斯柱式，并告诉你这种设计是源自古希腊还是古罗马吗？

topics.subject: History
topics.name: Greek and Roman Legacy Today
