topics.descriptionZh: 从二维图形中识别三维立体图形（3-D shapes），包括正方体（cubes）和其他长方体（cuboids）
evidenceZh: 根据展开图（net）识别长方体（cuboid）
说出等轴测图（isometric drawing）中所展示的三维立体图形（3-D shape）的名称
将二维图形（2-D representations）与正确的三维立体图形（3-D shape）相匹配
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果您给{{name}}看一张盒子或金字塔的平面建筑草图，他们能说出该草图所代表的三维立体图形（3-D shape）的名称吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Angle Sum Rules
topics.description: Know that angles at a point sum to 360° (one whole turn), angles on a straight line sum to 180°, and vertically opposite angles are equal; use these facts to find missing angles
evidence: State that two angles on a straight line add to 180°
Explain that four right angles at a point make 360°
Identify 270° as three right angles
topics.assessmentPrompt: If three angles meet at a point and two of them are 120° and 95°, can {{name}} work out the third angle — knowing all the angles at a point add up to 360°?
topics.nameZh: 角的求和法则 (Angle Sum Rules)
topics.descriptionZh: 知道同一点处的角之和为360°（周角 / one whole turn），直线上的角之和为180°（平角 / straight angle），且对顶角（vertically opposite angles）相等；利用这些事实求出未知角的度数。
evidenceZh: 说明直线上的两个角相加等于180°
解释同一点周围的四个直角之和为360°
识别出270°等于三个直角
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果三个角相交于同一点，其中两个角分别是120°和95°，已知同一点处的所有角之和为360°，{{name}}能算出第三个角的度数吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Classifying shapes by line properties
topics.description: Classify two-dimensional figures based on the presence or absence of parallel or perpendicular lines, or angles of a specified size; recognise right triangles as a category
evidence: Sort a set of quadrilaterals into those with parallel sides and those without
Identify which triangles in a set are right triangles
Classify shapes that have both perpendicular and parallel sides
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you show {{name}} a mixed set of triangles and quadrilaterals, can they sort them into groups — like "shapes with at least one right angle" or "shapes with parallel sides" — and explain their reasoning?
topics.nameZh: 根据线的属性对图形进行分类
topics.descriptionZh: 根据是否存在平行线或垂直线，或特定大小的角对二维图形进行分类；将直角三角形识别为一个独立的类别
evidenceZh: 将一组四边形分为具有平行边和不具有平行边的两类
识别一组三角形中的直角三角形
对同时具有垂直边和平行边的图形进行分类
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你给{{name}}看一组混合的三角形和四边形，他们能将其分成不同的组——例如“至少有一个直角的图形”或“有平行边的图形”——并解释他们的分类理由吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Degrees and turns
topics.description: Know that angles are measured in degrees, where one degree is 1/360 of a full turn; understand that an angle turning through n one-degree angles has a measure of n degrees
evidence: Explain that a full turn is 360° and a right angle is 90°
Describe what 'one degree' means in terms of a fraction of a circle
State that an angle of 45° has turned through 45 one-degree angles
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} knows a full circle is 360 degrees, can they tell you how many degrees a quarter turn is — and explain roughly what one single degree looks like?
topics.descriptionZh: 知道角度是用度（degrees）来测量的，其中1度是完整旋转一圈的1/360；理解如果一个角旋转经过了n个1度的角，那么这个角的测量值就是n度。
evidenceZh: 解释完整旋转一圈是360°，直角（right angle）是90°
用圆的分数（fraction）形式来描述“1度”的含义
说明45°的角是旋转经过了45个1度的角
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果{{name}}知道一整圈是360度，他们能告诉你四分之一圈（quarter turn）是多少度吗——并能大致描述一下单独的1度看起来是什么样子的吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Estimating Angles
topics.description: Estimate and compare acute, obtuse, and reflex angles in degrees; classify angles by type and order them by size
evidence: Estimate an angle as approximately 130° and classify it as obtuse
Identify a reflex angle in a diagram and estimate it as about 270°
Order four angles from smallest to largest by estimation before measuring
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you show {{name}} three different angles drawn on paper, can they estimate which is biggest, label each as acute, obtuse, or reflex — and then check with a protractor?
topics.descriptionZh: 以度为单位估测和比较锐角（acute angle）、钝角（obtuse angle）和优角（reflex angle）；按类型对角进行分类并按大小排序
evidenceZh: 将一个角估测为约130°，并将其归类为钝角（obtuse angle）
在图形中识别出优角（reflex angle），并将其估测为约270°
在实际测量前，通过估测将四个角按从小到大的顺序排列
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果您给 {{name}} 看纸上画出的三个不同的角，他们能否估测出哪个角最大，将每个角标注为锐角、钝角或优角（reflex angle），然后再用量角器（protractor）进行验证？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Lines, Rays & Angles
topics.description: Draw and identify points, lines, line segments, rays, angles (right, acute, obtuse), and perpendicular and parallel lines; identify these in two-dimensional figures
evidence: Draw a pair of perpendicular lines and a pair of parallel lines
Identify all pairs of parallel sides in a trapezoid
Mark a right angle, an acute angle, and an obtuse angle in a given figure
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is given a piece of paper and a ruler, can they draw a line segment, mark a point, and then draw another line through that point that runs perfectly parallel to the first?
topics.descriptionZh: 绘制并识别点、直线、线段、射线、角（直角、锐角、钝角）以及垂线和平行线；在二维图形中识别这些几何元素
evidenceZh: 绘制一对垂线和一对平行线
识别梯形中所有互相平行的边对
在给定的图形中标记出直角、锐角和钝角
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果给{{name}}一张纸和一把直尺，他们能否画出一条线段，标记一个点，然后穿过该点画出另一条与第一条完全平行的线？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Measuring angles
topics.description: Measure angles in whole-number degrees using a protractor; draw given angles and sketch angles of specified measure
evidence: Measure an angle with a protractor and read 47°
Draw an angle of 135° using a protractor
Identify which scale on the protractor to use for an obtuse angle
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is given a protractor and an angle drawn on paper, can they measure it accurately and then draw a new angle of a size you specify?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用量角器(protractor)测量整数度数的角；画出给定的角并绘制指定度数的角
evidenceZh: 使用量角器测量一个角并读出47°
使用量角器画一个135°的角
识别在测量钝角(obtuse angle)时应使用量角器上的哪个刻度
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果给 {{name}} 一个量角器和一个画在纸上的角，他们能准确测量该角，然后画出一个您指定大小的新角吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Measuring angles (age 9+)
topics.description: Recognise angle measure as additive; find unknown angles by adding or subtracting on a diagram using equations with a symbol for the unknown
evidence: Two angles on a straight line are 65° and x°; find x = 115°
An angle is decomposed into 35° and 40°; state the whole angle is 75°
Solve: angles at a point are 120°, 90°, and x°; find x = 150°
topics.assessmentPrompt: If two angles sit next to each other on a straight line and one is 65°, can {{name}} work out the other angle — knowing that angles on a straight line always add up to 180°?
topics.descriptionZh: 认识角度的可加性 (additive)；在图形中通过加减运算求未知角，并使用包含未知数符号的方程 (equations) 进行求解。
evidenceZh: 一条直线上的两个角分别是65°和x°；求x = 115°
一个角被分解为35°和40°；说明整个角是75°
求解：一个点周围的角分别是120°、90°和x°；求x = 150°
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果两个角在一条直线上相邻，其中一个是65°，{{name}}能算出另一个角吗——已知同一直线上的角加起来总是180°？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Regular and irregular polygons
topics.description: Distinguish between regular and irregular polygons based on reasoning about equal sides and equal angles
evidence: Classify a set of polygons as regular or irregular
Explain that a regular pentagon has 5 equal sides and 5 equal angles
Identify that a rectangle is irregular (equal angles but not all equal sides) unless it is a square
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you show {{name}} a stop sign (regular octagon) and a wonky eight-sided shape, can they explain which is regular and which is irregular — and why?
topics.nameZh: 正多边形与不规则多边形
topics.descriptionZh: 通过推理边和角是否相等，来区分正多边形（regular polygons）和不规则多边形（irregular polygons）。
evidenceZh: 将一组多边形分类为正多边形或不规则多边形
解释正五边形（regular pentagon）具有5条相等的边和5个相等的角
识别出长方形（rectangle）是不规则多边形（除非它是正方形），因为它的角虽然相等但边不全相等
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你给 {{name}} 看一个停车标志（正八边形，regular octagon）和一个歪歪扭扭的八边形，他们能解释哪个是正多边形，哪个是不规则多边形——以及为什么吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Transformations on a Grid
topics.description: Identify, describe, and represent the position of a shape following a reflection or translation using appropriate language; know that the shape has not changed
evidence: Reflect a triangle in a vertical mirror line on a coordinate grid and state the new coordinates
Translate a shape 3 units right and 2 units up and describe the movement
Explain that a reflected/translated shape is congruent to the original
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} slides or flips a shape on squared paper, can they describe exactly where it ends up and confirm the shape itself hasn't changed size or angles?
topics.nameZh: 网格上的图形变换 (Transformations on a Grid)
topics.descriptionZh: 使用恰当的语言识别、描述和表示图形在反射 (Reflection) 或平移 (Translation) 后的位置；知道图形本身的大小和形状没有发生改变。
evidenceZh: 在坐标网格 (Coordinate grid) 上，沿垂直对称轴 (Mirror line) 反射一个三角形，并写出新的坐标 (Coordinates)
将图形向右平移 (Translate) 3个单位、向上平移2个单位，并描述其移动过程
解释经过反射或平移后的图形与原图形是全等的 (Congruent)
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 在方格纸上滑动（平移）或翻转（反射）一个图形，他们能否准确描述图形最终的位置，并确认图形本身的大小和角度没有发生改变？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Understanding angles (age 9+)
topics.description: Use the properties of rectangles to deduce related facts and find missing lengths and angles
evidence: Given one side of a rectangle is 8 cm and the perimeter is 28 cm, find the other side
Explain that all angles in a rectangle are 90°
Find a missing side of a rectangle given its area and one side length
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} knows one side of a rectangular garden is 7 m, can they tell you the length of the opposite side and all four corner angles — without measuring?
topics.descriptionZh: 运用矩形（rectangle）的性质推导相关结论，并求出未知的长度和角度
evidenceZh: 已知矩形的一条边长为8厘米，周长（perimeter）为28厘米，求另一条边长
解释矩形中所有的角都是90°（直角）
已知矩形的面积（area）和一条边长，求另一条未知边长
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 知道一个矩形花园的一条边长是7米，他们能在不进行测量的情况下，告诉你对边的长度以及所有四个角的角度吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: What Is an Angle?
topics.description: Understand that an angle is a geometric shape formed by two rays sharing a common endpoint (vertex); recognise angles in real-life contexts and 2-D shapes
evidence: Identify the vertex and arms of an angle in a diagram
Find examples of angles in the classroom (e.g. open door, clock hands)
Explain why two rays meeting at a point form an angle
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you draw two lines starting from the same point on paper, can {{name}} tell you that the space between them is an angle — and point to the vertex where they meet?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解角是由两条具有公共端点（顶点）的射线组成的几何图形；能够在现实生活场景和二维图形中识别角。
evidenceZh: 在图中识别角的顶点和边
在教室中寻找角的实例（例如：打开的门、时钟的指针）
解释为什么两条相交于一点的射线会形成一个角
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你在纸上从同一点画出两条线，{{name}}能告诉你这两条线之间的部分是一个角，并指出它们相交的顶点吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 2-D shapes (age 10+)
topics.description: Draw 2-D shapes using given dimensions and angles, using a ruler and protractor accurately
evidence: Draw a triangle with sides 5 cm, 7 cm and an included angle of 60°
Construct a rectangle with given length and width using a ruler and set square
Draw a regular pentagon given the side length and interior angle
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} to draw a triangle with sides of 5 cm and 7 cm with a 40° angle between them, can they use a ruler and protractor to draw it accurately?
topics.nameZh: 二维图形(2-D shapes)（10岁及以上）
topics.descriptionZh: 使用给定的尺寸和角度，借助直尺(ruler)和量角器(protractor)准确地绘制二维图形
evidenceZh: 绘制一个边长为5厘米和7厘米、夹角为60°的三角形
使用直尺(ruler)和三角板(set square)绘制给定长和宽的矩形
根据给定的边长和内角(interior angle)绘制正五边形(regular pentagon)
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你让{{name}}画一个两边长分别为5厘米和7厘米、夹角为40°的三角形，他们能使用直尺(ruler)和量角器(protractor)准确地画出来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 3-D shapes (age 10+)
topics.description: Recognise, describe, and build simple 3-D shapes, including making nets
evidence: Identify which net will fold into a given 3-D shape
Construct the net of a triangular prism and fold it to verify
Describe a 3-D shape by naming its faces, edges, and vertices
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is given a flat cross-shaped piece of card (a net), can they predict what 3-D shape it will make when folded up — and then fold it to check?
topics.nameZh: 立体图形（3-D shapes）（10岁及以上）
topics.descriptionZh: 识别、描述和构建简单的立体图形（3-D shapes），包括制作展开图（nets）。
evidenceZh: 识别哪个展开图（net）可以折叠成指定的立体图形（3-D shape）
构建三棱柱（triangular prism）的展开图（net）并进行折叠验证
通过指出立体图形（3-D shape）的面（faces）、棱（edges）和顶点（vertices）来描述该图形
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果给 {{name}} 一张平面的十字形卡纸（即展开图/net），他们能预测折叠后会形成什么立体图形（3-D shape）吗——然后实际折叠进行验证？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Angles in triangles (age 10+)
topics.description: Find unknown angles in triangles, quadrilaterals, and regular polygons using angle sum properties
evidence: Find a missing angle in a triangle given two angles (using angle sum = 180°)
Calculate a missing angle in a quadrilateral (angle sum = 360°)
Calculate the interior angle of a regular hexagon from the angle sum formula
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} knows that angles in a triangle always add up to 180°, and two angles in a triangle are 55° and 70°, can they work out the third angle without measuring it?
topics.nameZh: 三角形中的角（10岁及以上）
topics.descriptionZh: 利用内角和性质求三角形、四边形和正多边形的未知角
evidenceZh: 已知三角形的两个角，求第三个角（利用内角和=180°）
计算四边形中的未知角（内角和=360°）
利用内角和公式计算正六边形的内角
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 知道三角形的内角和总是180°，并且一个三角形的两个角分别是55°和70°，他们能在不测量的情况下算出第三个角吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Classifying shapes by properties
topics.description: Compare and classify geometric shapes based on their properties and sizes; understand that attributes belonging to a category also belong to all subcategories; classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties
evidence: Explain why all squares are rectangles but not all rectangles are squares
Place quadrilaterals in a hierarchy diagram showing subset relationships
Identify properties shared by all parallelograms and explain why rhombuses and rectangles are special cases
topics.assessmentPrompt: If someone asks {{name}} "is a square also a rectangle?", can they explain why the answer is yes — because a square has all the properties of a rectangle plus equal sides?
topics.nameZh: 根据属性对图形进行分类
topics.descriptionZh: 根据几何图形（geometric shapes）的属性和大小进行比较与分类；理解属于某一类别的属性也属于其所有的子类别；根据属性将二维图形（two-dimensional figures）按层级（hierarchy）进行分类
evidenceZh: 解释为什么所有的正方形（squares）都是矩形（rectangles），但并非所有的矩形都是正方形
将四边形（quadrilaterals）放入展示子集关系（subset relationships）的层级图（hierarchy diagram）中
找出所有平行四边形（parallelograms）共有的属性，并解释为什么菱形（rhombuses）和矩形（rectangles）是特殊情况（special cases）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果有人问{{name}}“正方形也是矩形吗？”，他们能解释为什么答案是肯定的吗——因为正方形具有矩形的所有属性，并且四条边都相等？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Coordinates (age 10+)
topics.description: Describe positions on the full coordinate grid (all four quadrants); use coordinates with negative values
evidence: Plot points with negative coordinates such as (−3, 4) and (2, −5) on a four-quadrant grid
Identify the quadrant in which a given point lies
Describe the position of a shape using coordinates in all four quadrants
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is playing a game where ships can be at negative coordinates too, can they correctly plot and read positions like (−3, 2) or (1, −4) on a grid?
topics.descriptionZh: 描述完整坐标网格（全部四个象限）上的位置；使用包含负值的坐标。
evidenceZh: 在四象限网格上标出带有负坐标的点，例如（-3, 4）和（2, -5）
识别给定点所在的象限
使用全部四个象限的坐标来描述图形的位置
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 正在玩一个允许船只位于负坐标的游戏，他们能否在网格上正确标出并读取诸如（-3, 2）或（1, -4）这样的位置？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Numbers on a number line
topics.description: Understand a coordinate system defined by two perpendicular number lines (axes) with an origin at (0,0); know that an ordered pair (x, y) specifies a unique point where the first number gives horizontal distance and the second gives vertical distance from the origin
evidence: Identify the x-axis, y-axis, and origin on a coordinate grid
Explain that (3, 5) means go 3 along the x-axis and 5 up the y-axis
Distinguish (2, 4) from (4, 2) by explaining each coordinate's meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} looks at a map with a grid and you describe a location as "3 across and 5 up from the origin", can they find the exact point — and explain what each of the two numbers tells you?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解由两条互相垂直的数轴（axes）组成的坐标系（coordinate system），其原点位于 (0,0)；知道有序数对（ordered pair）(x, y) 可以确定一个唯一的点，其中第一个数字表示从原点出发的水平距离，第二个数字表示垂直距离。
evidenceZh: 在坐标网格（coordinate grid）中识别 x 轴（x-axis）、y 轴（y-axis）和原点（origin）
解释 (3, 5) 意味着沿 x 轴移动 3 个单位，再沿 y 轴向上移动 5 个单位
通过解释每个坐标的含义来区分 (2, 4) 和 (4, 2)
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看着一张带有网格的地图，而你描述某个位置为“从原点向右 3 个单位，向上 5 个单位”，他们能找到准确的点吗——并且能解释这两个数字分别代表什么含义吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Parts of a circle
topics.description: Illustrate and name parts of circles, including radius, diameter, and circumference; know that the diameter is twice the radius
evidence: Label the radius, diameter, and circumference on a circle diagram
Calculate the diameter given a radius of 4.5 cm (diameter = 9 cm)
Explain the relationship between radius and diameter in their own words
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you give {{name}} a round plate and a ruler, can they measure the diameter — and explain how the radius compares to the diameter?
topics.nameZh: 圆的组成部分 (Parts of a circle)
topics.descriptionZh: 画出并说出圆各部分的名称，包括半径 (radius)、直径 (diameter) 和周长 (circumference)；知道直径的长度是半径的两倍。
evidenceZh: 在圆形的示意图上标出半径 (radius)、直径 (diameter) 和周长 (circumference)
已知半径为4.5厘米，计算出直径（直径 = 9厘米）
用自己的话解释半径 (radius) 和直径 (diameter) 之间的关系
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你给 {{name}} 一个圆盘和一把尺子，他们能测量出直径 (diameter) 吗？并且能解释半径 (radius) 和直径之间的长度关系吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Plotting points in the first quadrant
topics.description: Plot and read ordered pairs in the first quadrant of the coordinate plane; represent real-world and mathematical problems by graphing points and interpreting coordinate values in context
evidence: Plot the point (4, 7) accurately on a first-quadrant grid
Graph a set of data pairs (e.g. time vs distance) as points on the coordinate plane
Read coordinates of a plotted point and explain what they represent in a given scenario
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you tell {{name}} a car journey passes through grid points (2, 3), (5, 7), and (8, 4) on a map, can they plot those points and describe what the journey looks like?
topics.descriptionZh: 在坐标平面的第一象限内描出并读取有序数对（ordered pairs）；通过描点并结合实际情境解释坐标值，来表示现实世界和数学问题
evidenceZh: 在第一象限网格上准确描出点 (4, 7)
在坐标平面上将一组数据对（如时间与距离）描成点
读取已描点的坐标，并解释其在给定情境中所代表的意义
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你告诉{{name}}一辆汽车的行程在地图上经过了网格点 (2, 3)、(5, 7) 和 (8, 4)，他们能描出这些点并描述这趟行程的轨迹吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Translating and reflecting shapes
topics.description: Draw and translate simple shapes on the coordinate plane; reflect shapes in the axes
evidence: Translate a triangle 3 units right and 2 units down on a coordinate grid and state the new coordinates
Reflect a shape in the x-axis and list the coordinates of the reflected vertices
Explain how translation changes coordinates (add/subtract) while reflection changes the sign of one coordinate
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} draws a triangle at coordinates (1, 2), (3, 2), and (2, 4) on a grid, can they then reflect it across the x-axis and tell you the new coordinates of each corner?
topics.descriptionZh: 在坐标系 (coordinate plane) 中绘制并平移简单图形；沿坐标轴反射图形
evidenceZh: 在坐标网格 (coordinate grid) 上将一个三角形向右平移3个单位，向下平移2个单位，并写出新的坐标
将图形沿x轴反射，并列出反射后各顶点的坐标
解释平移如何改变坐标（加/减），而反射如何改变其中一个坐标的符号
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 在网格上画出一个顶点坐标为 (1, 2)、(3, 2) 和 (2, 4) 的三角形，他们能将其沿x轴反射，并告诉你每个角的新坐标吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Understanding angles (age 10+)
topics.description: Recognise angles where they meet at a point, are on a straight line, or are vertically opposite; find missing angles using these properties
evidence: Find a missing angle at a point given the other angles (total 360°)
Use the straight-line property (angles sum to 180°) to find an unknown angle
Identify vertically opposite angles and use the property that they are equal to find unknowns
topics.assessmentPrompt: If two straight lines cross each other, can {{name}} tell you which pairs of angles are equal (vertically opposite) — and find a missing angle if you give them one of the others?
topics.descriptionZh: 识别相交于一点、位于一条直线上或互为对顶的角；利用这些性质求解缺失的角度。
evidenceZh: 在已知其他角的情况下，求一点处缺失的角（总和为360°）
利用平角性质（角度之和为180°）求未知角
识别对顶角（vertically opposite angles），并利用其相等的性质求未知角
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果两条直线相交，{{name}} 能否指出哪对角是相等的（对顶角）——并在已知其中一个角的情况下，求出一个缺失的角？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 3-D shapes (age 11+)
topics.description: Use the properties of faces, surfaces, edges, and vertices of 3-D shapes (cubes, cuboids, prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones, and spheres) to solve problems, including visualising cross-sections
evidence: Count and describe the faces, edges, and vertices of a triangular prism and a square-based pyramid
Describe the 2-D cross-section produced by slicing a cylinder horizontally or a cone vertically
Use properties of 3-D shapes to determine whether a given net will fold into a specified solid
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} slices a cylinder straight across the middle like cutting a tin of beans in half, can they describe the shape of the cut surface? What about slicing at an angle?
topics.nameZh: 三维图形（11岁及以上）(3-D shapes)
topics.descriptionZh: 运用三维图形（立方体(cubes)、长方体(cuboids)、棱柱(prisms)、圆柱(cylinders)、棱锥(pyramids)、圆锥(cones)和球体(spheres)）的面(faces)、表面(surfaces)、棱(edges)和顶点(vertices)的性质解决问题，包括想象截面(cross-sections)。
evidenceZh: 计算并描述三棱柱(triangular prism)和四棱锥(square-based pyramid)的面(faces)、棱(edges)和顶点(vertices)数量及其特征
描述将圆柱(cylinder)水平横切或圆锥(cone)垂直纵切所产生的二维截面(2-D cross-section)
运用三维图形(3-D shapes)的性质，判断给定的展开图(net)是否能折叠成指定的立体图形(solid)
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 像切半罐豆子一样将圆柱体(cylinder)从中间笔直地横切开来，他们能描述切面(cut surface)的形状吗？如果斜着切呢？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Angles in triangles (age 11+)
topics.description: Derive and apply formulae for the area of triangles, parallelograms, and trapezia, and for the volume of cuboids and other prisms (including cylinders), connecting each formula to its geometric reasoning
evidence: Calculate the area of a trapezium using A = ½(a + b) × h and explain why the formula works
Find the volume of a triangular prism by calculating cross-sectional area × length
Derive the formula for the volume of a cylinder as π × r² × h by reasoning from the prism formula
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} needs to tile a triangular section of a patio with a base of 4 m and height of 3 m, can they work out the area to know how many tiles to buy?
topics.descriptionZh: 推导并应用三角形（triangle）、平行四边形（parallelogram）和梯形（trapezium）的面积公式，以及长方体（cuboid）和其他柱体（prism，包括圆柱体（cylinder））的体积公式，将每个公式与其几何推理联系起来
evidenceZh: 使用 A = ½(a + b) × h 计算梯形（trapezium）的面积，并解释该公式为何成立
通过计算截面积（cross-sectional area）× 长度，求三棱柱（triangular prism）的体积
通过从柱体（prism）公式进行推理，推导出圆柱体（cylinder）的体积公式 π × r² × h
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 需要为露台的一个三角形（triangle）区域铺设地砖，该区域底边长4米、高3米，他们能算出面积以知道需要买多少块地砖吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Angle sums in triangles and polygons
topics.description: Derive and use the angle sum in a triangle (180°), use it to deduce the angle sum in any polygon ((n−2) × 180°), and calculate interior and exterior angles of regular polygons
evidence: Calculate a missing angle in a triangle by subtracting the known angles from 180°
Find the sum of interior angles in a hexagon by dividing it into triangles
Calculate each interior and exterior angle of a regular polygon given the number of sides
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} knows two angles of a triangle are 50° and 70°, can they work out the third? And can they figure out the angles inside a regular pentagon?
topics.nameZh: 三角形与多边形的内角和
topics.descriptionZh: 推导并运用三角形的内角和（180°），利用其推导任意多边形的内角和（(n−2) × 180°），并计算正多边形（regular polygons）的内角与外角
evidenceZh: 通过用180°减去已知角度，计算三角形中的未知角
通过将六边形分割成三角形，求出六边形的内角和
已知边数，计算正多边形的每个内角和外角
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 知道一个三角形的两个角分别是50°和70°，他们能算出第三个角吗？他们还能算出正五边形的内角吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Coordinate Transformations
topics.description: Identify properties of translations, rotations, and reflections; describe and perform these transformations on given figures, and understand that the image is congruent to the original
evidence: Reflect a shape in a given mirror line (including diagonal lines) and state the coordinates of the image
Rotate a shape about a given centre by 90° or 180° and describe the result
Translate a shape by a given vector and verify that lengths and angles are preserved
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is asked to rotate a triangle 90° clockwise around a fixed point, can they work out where each corner ends up — and confirm the triangle is still the same size and shape?
topics.descriptionZh: 识别平移 (translations)、旋转 (rotations) 和反射 (reflections) 的性质；在给定图形上描述并执行这些变换，并理解变换后的图形与原图形全等 (congruent)。
evidenceZh: 在指定的镜像线（包括对角线）上反射图形，并指出像的坐标
绕指定中心将图形旋转90°或180°，并描述结果
按给定向量平移图形，并验证长度和角度保持不变
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果让 {{name}} 把一个三角形绕固定点顺时针旋转90°，他们能算出每个顶点最终的位置，并确认三角形的大小和形状不变吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Measuring angles (age 11+)
topics.description: Draw and measure line segments and angles accurately using ruler and protractor, and interpret scale drawings to extract real measurements
evidence: Draw a triangle accurately given two sides and the included angle (SAS)
Measure angles in a geometric figure to the nearest degree using a protractor
Read a scale drawing to determine actual lengths, explaining the scale used
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is given an architect's floor plan where 1 cm represents 2 m, can they measure a room on the plan and work out its real-world dimensions?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用直尺和量角器准确地绘制和测量线段与角度，并能够解读比例图以提取实际测量数据。
evidenceZh: 已知两边及其夹角（SAS），准确绘制三角形
使用量角器测量几何图形中的角度，精确到度
识读比例图以确定实际长度，并解释所使用的比例尺
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果给{{name}}一份建筑师的平面图（比例尺为1厘米代表2米），他们能否测量图上一个房间的尺寸，并计算出其实际大小？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Properties of triangles and quadrilaterals
topics.description: Derive and illustrate properties of triangles, quadrilaterals, and circles using appropriate language, including interior angles, diagonals, symmetry, and relationships between side lengths
evidence: List and verify properties of a parallelogram (opposite sides parallel/equal, opposite angles equal, diagonals bisect each other)
Explain why a square is a special case of both a rectangle and a rhombus
Derive the relationship between the radius, diameter, and circumference of a circle
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} why the diagonals of a rectangle are always equal in length, can they explain it using the properties of the shape — rather than just measuring to check?
topics.nameZh: 三角形与四边形的性质
topics.descriptionZh: 运用恰当的语言推导并说明三角形、四边形和圆的性质，包括内角（interior angles）、对角线（diagonals）、对称性（symmetry）以及边长之间的关系。
evidenceZh: 列出并验证平行四边形的性质（对边平行且相等、对角相等、对角线互相平分）
解释为什么正方形是矩形（rectangle）和菱形（rhombus）的特例
推导圆的半径（radius）、直径（diameter）和周长（circumference）之间的关系
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你问 {{name}} 为什么矩形的对角线总是等长的，他们能否利用该图形的性质来解释，而不仅仅是通过测量来验证？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Types of angles (age 11+)
topics.description: Use conventional geometric terms and notation to describe, sketch, and draw points, lines, parallel and perpendicular lines, right angles, regular polygons, and reflectively/rotationally symmetric polygons
evidence: Use correct notation for line segments (AB), angles (∠ABC), and parallel lines (AB ∥ CD)
Sketch a regular hexagon and describe its rotational and reflective symmetry
Identify and label perpendicular and parallel lines in a given figure using standard symbols
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} to describe a triangle using proper geometry notation — naming its angles and sides with letters — can they do it clearly enough for someone else to draw it?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用规范的几何术语和记号来描述、草绘和绘制点、线、平行线与垂线、直角（right angles）、正多边形（regular polygons），以及具有轴对称（reflective symmetry）和旋转对称（rotational symmetry）的多边形。
evidenceZh: 正确使用线段（line segments，如AB）、角（angles，如∠ABC）和平行线（parallel lines，如AB ∥ CD）的符号表示
草绘正六边形（regular hexagon），并描述其旋转对称（rotational symmetry）和轴对称（reflective symmetry）特性
使用标准符号在给定的图形中识别并标记垂直线（perpendicular lines）和平行线（parallel lines）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你要求 {{name}} 使用规范的几何符号（geometry notation）来描述一个三角形——用字母命名它的角（angles）和边（sides）——他们能描述得足够清晰，让别人也能据此画出来吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Understanding angles (age 11+)
topics.description: Apply the properties of angles at a point (360°), on a straight line (180°), and vertically opposite angles to find unknown angles in multi-step problems
evidence: Find a missing angle using the fact that angles on a straight line sum to 180°
Use vertically opposite angles are equal to set up and solve an equation for an unknown
Combine multiple angle facts in a single diagram to find several missing angles step by step
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is given a diagram with several angles marked at crossing lines and some unknown, can they use the rules about straight lines and crossing lines to find all the missing angles step by step?
topics.descriptionZh: 运用一点周围的角（360°）、平角（180°）和对顶角的性质，在多步问题中求解未知角。
evidenceZh: 利用直线上角的和为180°的性质求解缺失的角
利用对顶角相等的性质，建立并求解未知角的方程
结合单个图形中的多个角的性质，逐步求解多个缺失的角
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果给 {{name}} 提供一个在相交线处标记了几个角且部分角未知的图形，他们能否运用关于直线和相交线的规则，逐步求出所有缺失的角？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Angles in triangles (age 12+)
topics.description: Know and use the criteria for triangle congruence (SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS), use standard labelling conventions for sides and angles of triangle ABC, and determine whether two triangles are congruent
evidence: State which congruence criterion (SSS, SAS, ASA, or RHS) applies to a given pair of triangles
Use the notation △ABC ≅ △DEF and match corresponding sides and angles
Determine whether given measurements produce a unique triangle, more than one, or none
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is shown two triangles where all three sides of one match all three sides of the other, can they explain why those triangles must be identical in shape and size?
topics.descriptionZh: 了解并运用三角形全等的判定条件（SSS、SAS、ASA、RHS），掌握三角形ABC边和角的标准标注规范，并判断两个三角形是否全等
evidenceZh: 指出给定的一对三角形适用哪种全等判定条件（SSS、SAS、ASA或RHS）
使用符号△ABC ≅ △DEF，并匹配对应的边和角
判断给定的测量数据能构成唯一三角形、多个三角形还是无法构成三角形
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果向{{name}}展示两个三角形，且其中一个三角形的三条边与另一个三角形的三条边分别对应相等，{{name}}能否解释为什么这两个三角形的形状和大小必定完全相同？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Angles with parallel lines
topics.description: Understand and use the relationship between parallel lines cut by a transversal: corresponding angles, alternate interior angles, and co-interior (same-side interior) angles; use these to find unknown angles
evidence: Identify alternate, corresponding, and co-interior angle pairs in a diagram with parallel lines
Explain why alternate angles are equal using the concept of translation along the transversal
Find missing angles in a parallel-line diagram using a combination of angle relationships
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a Z-shape or F-shape formed by two parallel lines and a crossing line in a diagram, can they identify the equal angles and explain why they’re equal?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解并运用平行线被截线所截时的角度关系：同位角 (corresponding angles)、内错角 (alternate interior angles) 和同旁内角 (co-interior angles)；并利用这些关系求解未知角的度数。
evidenceZh: 在平行线图形中识别内错角 (alternate angles)、同位角 (corresponding angles) 和同旁内角 (co-interior angles) 对。
运用沿截线平移 (translation) 的概念解释为什么内错角相等。
综合运用各种角的关系，在平行线图形中求出缺失角的度数。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 在图形中看到由两条平行线和一条相交线组成的 Z 字形或 F 字形，他们能否识别出相等的角并解释它们相等的原因？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Circles: Circumference & Area
topics.description: Calculate the circumference and area of circles using the formulae C = πd (or 2πr) and A = πr², and solve problems involving perimeters and areas of composite shapes that include circular parts
evidence: Calculate the circumference and area of a circle given its radius or diameter
Find the perimeter or area of a composite shape made from rectangles and semicircles
Explain the relationship between π, diameter, and circumference informally
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} wants to know how far a bicycle wheel travels in one full rotation, can they use the diameter of the wheel and π (pi) to work out the circumference?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用公式 C = πd（或 2πr）和 A = πr² 计算圆的周长与面积，并解决包含圆形部分的组合图形（Composite shapes）的周长与面积问题。
evidenceZh: 已知半径（Radius）或直径（Diameter），计算圆的周长与面积
计算由矩形和半圆组成的组合图形的周长或面积
通俗地解释圆周率（π）、直径与周长之间的关系
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 想知道自行车车轮转动一整圈能前进多远，他们能用车轮的直径和圆周率（π）来计算出周长吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Coordinates (age 12+)
topics.description: Understand similarity as a relationship where one shape is an enlargement of another; construct similar shapes by enlargement with a given scale factor and centre, with and without coordinate grids
evidence: Enlarge a shape by a given scale factor from a specified centre of enlargement
Determine the scale factor between two similar shapes by comparing corresponding sides
Explain why corresponding angles in similar shapes are equal while sides are in proportion
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} wants to enlarge a photo so it's three times bigger, can they work out the new dimensions — and explain that the shape stays the same but all lengths increase by the same factor?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解相似（similarity）作为一种关系，即一个图形是另一个图形的放大（enlargement）；在给定比例因子（scale factor）和中心（centre）的情况下，无论有无坐标网格（coordinate grids），通过放大来构造相似图形。
evidenceZh: 从指定的放大中心（centre of enlargement）按给定的比例因子（scale factor）放大图形
通过比较对应边（corresponding sides）来确定两个相似图形之间的比例因子（scale factor）
解释为什么相似图形中的对应角（corresponding angles）相等，而对应边成比例
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 想把一张照片放大到原来的三倍，他们能计算出新的尺寸吗——并能解释形状保持不变，但所有长度都按相同的比例因子增加吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Understanding angles (age 12+)
topics.description: Use ruler and compasses to perform standard constructions: perpendicular bisector of a line segment, perpendicular to a line from or at a given point, and bisecting an angle
evidence: Construct the perpendicular bisector of a line segment using compasses and a straight edge
Construct an angle bisector and verify by measuring both halves
Construct a perpendicular from a point to a line using compasses only
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} has only a ruler and a pair of compasses, can they construct a line that cuts another line segment exactly in half at a right angle — without using a protractor?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用直尺和圆规进行标准几何作图：线段的垂直平分线（perpendicular bisector）、过给定点或在线上作直线的垂线（perpendicular），以及平分角（bisecting an angle）。
evidenceZh: 使用圆规和直边（straight edge）作线段的垂直平分线（perpendicular bisector）
作角平分线（angle bisector）并通过测量两部分进行验证
仅使用圆规过一点作直线的垂线（perpendicular）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 只有一把直尺和一副圆规，他们能否在不使用量角器（protractor）的情况下，作出一条直线，使其以直角（right angle）精确地将另一条线段平分？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Trigonometry basics
topics.description: Use the trigonometric ratios sin, cos, and tan in right-angled triangles to find unknown sides and angles, including setting up the correct ratio for a given problem
evidence: Identify which trigonometric ratio to use (SOH CAH TOA) based on the known and unknown sides
Calculate an unknown side using sin, cos, or tan and a known angle
Find an unknown angle using the inverse trigonometric function (e.g. tan⁻¹)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} knows a ladder is 5 metres long and leans against a wall at 70° to the ground, can they use trigonometry to work out how high up the wall it reaches?
topics.descriptionZh: 在直角三角形中使用正弦（sin）、余弦（cos）和正切（tan）等三角比来求解未知的边和角，包括为给定问题建立正确的比例关系。
evidenceZh: 根据已知边和未知边，确定使用哪种三角比（SOH CAH TOA）
使用正弦（sin）、余弦（cos）或正切（tan）以及已知角度计算未知边长
使用反三角函数（如 tan⁻¹）求解未知角度
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 知道一架 5 米长的梯子斜靠在墙上，且与地面成 70° 角，他们能利用三角学计算出梯子在墙上达到的高度吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Types of angles (age 13+)
topics.description: Apply Pythagoras’ Theorem (a² + b² = c²) to calculate unknown side lengths in right-angled triangles, including in real-world and coordinate-geometry contexts
evidence: Calculate the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle given the two shorter sides
Find a shorter side given the hypotenuse and the other short side
Use Pythagoras’ Theorem to find the distance between two points on a coordinate grid
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} wants to check whether a shelf bracket makes a perfect right angle and the sides measure 30 cm, 40 cm, and 50 cm, can they use Pythagoras to verify?
topics.descriptionZh: 应用勾股定理（a² + b² = c²）计算直角三角形（right-angled triangles）中的未知边长，包括在现实世界和坐标几何（coordinate geometry）情境中的应用
evidenceZh: 已知直角三角形的两条较短边，计算其斜边（hypotenuse）
已知斜边和另一条较短边，求其中一条较短边
使用勾股定理求坐标网格（coordinate grid）上两点之间的距离
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 想检查一个支架（shelf bracket）是否构成完美的直角（right angle），且其三边长度分别为 30 厘米、40 厘米和 50 厘米，他们能使用勾股定理（Pythagoras' Theorem）来验证吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Early Maths Vocabulary
topics.description: Use mathematical words carefully when counting, comparing, and describing shapes and positions
evidence: Use 'more than', 'fewer than', and 'the same as' correctly when comparing groups
Name shapes correctly and describe their features using words like 'sides' and 'corners'
Use positional words (above, below, next to) precisely to describe where objects are
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} talks about maths — like comparing numbers or describing shapes — do they use the right words, like "larger than", "fewer", "beside", or "corner"?
topics.descriptionZh: 在数数、比较以及描述形状和位置时，能够准确使用数学词汇。
evidenceZh: 在比较物品组时，能正确使用“多于”(more than)、“少于”(fewer than)和“一样多”(the same as)。
能正确说出形状的名称，并使用“边”(sides)和“角”(corners)等词汇描述其特征。
能准确使用方位词（如“上面”(above)、“下面”(below)、“旁边”(next to)）来描述物体的位置。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}谈论数学——比如比较数字或描述形状时——他们能使用恰当的词汇吗，比如“大于”(larger than)、“更少”(fewer)、“在旁边”(beside)或“角”(corner)？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Finding efficient methods
topics.description: Notice when a calculation or pattern repeats and use this to count more efficiently or predict results
evidence: Notice that skip counting by 2s follows a repeating odd/even pattern
Recognise that adding 1 to any number always gives the next counting number
Use a repeated pattern (e.g. +10 on a hundred chart always moves down one row) to predict answers
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is counting or doing repeated additions, have they started to notice the pattern — like "5, 10, 15, 20…" — and used it to predict the next number without counting one by one?
topics.descriptionZh: 注意计算或规律何时重复，并利用该规律更高效地计数或预测结果
evidenceZh: 注意到两个两个地数遵循奇偶交替的重复规律
认识到任何数加1总是得到下一个计数数
利用重复的规律（例如在百数表上加10总是向下移动一行）来预测答案
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 在计数或进行重复加法时，他们是否开始注意到其中的规律——比如“5、10、15、20……”——并利用它来预测下一个数，而不是逐一去数？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Hands-On Problem Solving
topics.description: Select and use familiar tools (concrete objects, fingers, ten frames) to help solve a mathematical problem
evidence: Choose cubes, counters, or fingers to help solve an addition or subtraction problem
Use a ten frame to organise objects for counting or comparing
Explain why a particular tool (e.g. cubes rather than fingers) was chosen for a given problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is working out a maths problem, do they reach for helpful tools — like using their fingers, counters, or a number line — to support their thinking?
topics.descriptionZh: 选择并使用熟悉的工具（实物、手指、十格框(ten frames)）来帮助解决数学问题
evidenceZh: 选择小方块(cubes)、计数筹码(counters)或手指来帮助解决加法或减法问题
使用十格框(ten frames)来排列物体，以便于计数或比较
解释为什么针对特定问题选择了某种工具（例如，选择小方块而不是手指）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 在解答数学问题时，他们是否会主动使用有用的工具——比如借助手指、计数筹码(counters)或数轴(number line)——来辅助思考？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Making Sense of Problems
topics.description: Make sense of a problem by identifying what is being asked, choosing concrete objects or pictures to represent the situation, and explaining a pathway to the solution
evidence: When given a word problem within 10, explain what the problem is asking before attempting to solve
Choose objects, fingers, or drawings to represent a problem situation
After finding an answer, check it makes sense (e.g. re-count objects to verify a total)
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} gets a maths problem they don't immediately know how to solve, do they stop and think about what the question is asking — maybe drawing a picture — before diving in?
topics.descriptionZh: 通过明确问题所求，选择具体实物或图片来表征情境，并解释解题思路来理解问题。
evidenceZh: 在解答10以内的应用题时，在尝试解题前先说明题目所求
选择实物、手指或画图来表征问题情境
得出答案后，检查结果是否合理（例如：重新点数物品以验证总数）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 遇到一道不知道如何立刻解答的数学题时，他们会在动手解题前停下来思考题目的要求——比如画一幅图——吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Real-World to Maths Connections
topics.description: Move between a real-world situation and a mathematical representation using concrete objects, drawings, diagrams, tables, number sentences, or bar models
evidence: Given a story about combining groups, represent it with counters or cubes and find the total
Given a set of objects, tell a simple addition or subtraction story to match
Connect a physical action (putting together, taking away) to the matching operation
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is working out a real-life maths problem — like sharing 8 sweets between 2 people — can they use objects or draw a picture to show what's happening before writing any numbers?
topics.nameZh: 现实世界与数学的联系
topics.descriptionZh: 借助实物、绘画、图表、表格、数字算式（number sentences）或条形模型（bar models），在现实生活情境与数学表征（mathematical representation）之间进行转换。
evidenceZh: 给定一个关于合并组的故事，用计数筹码（counters）或方块（cubes）进行表征并求出总数
给定一组物品，讲述一个与之匹配的简单加法或减法故事
将具体的动作（如合并、拿走）与相应的数学运算联系起来
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 正在解决一个生活中的数学问题——比如把8颗糖果分给2个人——他们能在写出数字之前，先使用实物或画图来展示发生了什么吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Showing Your Working
topics.description: Show and tell how a mathematical answer was found using objects, drawings, and spoken words
evidence: Use objects or drawings to demonstrate how an addition or subtraction was solved
Respond to 'how do you know?' by pointing to objects or a drawing and describing what was done
Listen to a peer's explanation and say whether they agree or disagree
topics.assessmentPrompt: After {{name}} solves a maths problem, can they explain how they got their answer — using counters, a drawing, or words — rather than just writing down the final number?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用实物、图画和口头语言来展示并讲述数学答案是如何得出的。
evidenceZh: 使用实物或图画来演示加法（addition）或减法（subtraction）的求解过程。
在回应‘你怎么知道的？’时，通过指着实物或图画并描述自己的操作过程来回答。
倾听同伴的解释，并表达自己是同意还是不同意。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在 {{name}} 解决一个数学问题后，他们能否解释自己是如何得出答案的——使用计数器（counters）、图画或语言——而不仅仅是写下最终的数字？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Spotting mathematical patterns
topics.description: Notice simple patterns and structures: spot that changing order doesn't change the total, and recognise how numbers relate to each other
evidence: Notice that 3 + 2 gives the same answer as 2 + 3 (early commutativity)
Recognise that teen numbers are 'ten and some more' (e.g. 14 is 10 and 4)
Spot a pattern in a sequence of objects or numbers and predict what comes next
topics.assessmentPrompt: Has {{name}} noticed that adding numbers in a different order gives the same answer — like 3 + 5 and 5 + 3 both equal 8 — and can they explain why that makes sense?
topics.descriptionZh: 发现简单的数学规律与结构：观察到改变相加顺序不会改变总和，并理解数字之间的相互关系
evidenceZh: 观察到 3 + 2 和 2 + 3 的结果相同（初步的加法交换律概念）
理解十几的数字是由“10和几”组成的（例如，14是10和4）
发现物体或数字序列中的规律，并能预测接下来是什么
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 是否注意到以不同顺序相加数字会得到相同的答案——例如 3 + 5 和 5 + 3 都等于 8——并且能解释为什么这是合理的吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Using objects to model real problems
topics.description: Use objects, drawings, or simple number sentences to represent a real-world situation (early mathematical modelling)
evidence: Draw a picture or use objects to represent a simple real-world situation involving counting or comparing
Write or dictate a number sentence to describe a real-world situation (e.g. 'I had 5 apples and ate 2')
Use the model to answer a question about the situation
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you describe a simple real-life situation to {{name}} — like "there are 3 birds on a fence and 2 more land" — can they write a number sentence like 3 + 2 = 5 to represent it?
topics.nameZh: 使用实物对实际问题建模
topics.descriptionZh: 使用实物、图画或简单的算式（数字等式）来表示现实世界的情境（早期数学建模）
evidenceZh: 画图或使用实物来表示涉及计数或比较的简单现实情境
写出或口述算式（数字等式）来描述现实情境（例如：“我有5个苹果，吃了2个”）
使用模型来回答关于该情境的问题
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你向 {{name}} 描述一个简单的现实生活情境——比如“栅栏上有3只鸟，又飞来了2只”——他们能写出像 3 + 2 = 5 这样的算式（数字等式）来表示它吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Connecting maths to real life
topics.description: Represent real-world problems with number sentences, bar models, or diagrams, and interpret the mathematical result back in context
evidence: Choose and write an appropriate number sentence for a measurement or money word problem
Draw a bar model or diagram to represent a two-step or comparison problem
Interpret the numerical answer in context (e.g. '15 cm means the ribbon is 15 centimetres long')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} solves a word problem by drawing a bar model or writing an equation, can they also explain what their answer means in the real-world context — like "that means each child gets 4 sweets"?
topics.nameZh: 将数学与现实生活联系起来
topics.descriptionZh: 用算式 (number sentences)、条形模型 (bar models) 或图表来表示现实世界的问题，并将数学结果解释回实际语境中
evidenceZh: 为测量或金钱应用题选择并写出合适的算式 (number sentence)
绘制条形模型 (bar model) 或图表来表示两步计算或比较问题
在具体语境中解释数值答案（例如，'15厘米意味着这条丝带长15厘米'）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}通过绘制条形模型 (bar model) 或列出算式来解决应用题时，他们是否也能解释其答案在现实语境中的含义——比如'这意味着每个孩子分到4颗糖果'？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Connecting Representations
topics.description: Move between real-world situations, drawings, and number sentences, explaining how each representation connects to the others (quantitative reasoning)
evidence: Write a number sentence (e.g. 14 + 5 = 19) to match a word problem and explain the connection
Draw a bar model or part-whole diagram to represent a problem, then solve using the diagram
Translate between a concrete model and a symbolic equation, describing what each number represents
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} solves a word problem, can they draw a diagram or write a number sentence to show their thinking — and then explain how the picture and the numbers match the real situation?
topics.descriptionZh: 在现实情境、图画和数学算式（number sentences）之间进行转换，并解释每种表征（representations）是如何相互联系的（定量推理 quantitative reasoning）
evidenceZh: 写出匹配文字应用题（word problem）的数学算式（例如 14 + 5 = 19），并解释其中的联系
画出条形模型（bar model）或整体-部分图（part-whole diagram）来表示问题，然后利用该图形进行解答
在实物模型（concrete model）和符号算式（symbolic equation）之间进行转换，并描述每个数字所代表的含义
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 解答文字应用题时，他们能否画出图形或写出算式来展示思考过程，并解释图形和数字是如何与实际情境相匹配的？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Explaining Mathematical Reasoning
topics.description: With teacher prompting, explain and justify mathematical reasoning using drawings, number sentences, or words
evidence: Explain a solution strategy using a drawing or number sentence (e.g. 'I made ten first, then added the rest')
Justify why an answer is correct by showing an alternative method that gives the same result
Identify and explain an error in a worked example or a peer's solution
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} "how did you work that out?", can they show you with a drawing or explain their steps in simple words?
topics.descriptionZh: 在教师的引导下，通过画图、数字算式 (number sentences) 或文字来解释和论证数学推理过程。
evidenceZh: 使用画图或数字算式 (number sentence) 解释解题策略（例如：‘我先凑成十，然后再加剩下的数’）
通过展示能得出相同结果的其他方法来论证答案的正确性
识别并解释完整解答示例 (worked example) 或同学解题过程中的错误
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你问 {{name}}‘你是怎么算出来的？’，他们能用画图展示或用简单的语言解释他们的步骤吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Generalising Patterns
topics.description: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: spot calculation patterns, describe rules for sequences, and predict results using known mathematical facts
evidence: Use a known doubles fact to derive a near-doubles answer (e.g. 6 + 7 = 6 + 6 + 1 = 13)
Notice that subtracting 10 from any two-digit number always reduces the tens digit by 1
Describe a rule for a pattern and use it to extend or predict (e.g. 'each time we add 5, the ones digit alternates between 0 and 5')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is practising times tables or number patterns, do they spot a shortcut — like "if 6 × 7 = 42, then 6 × 8 must be 48" — and use known facts to work out ones they haven't memorised yet?
topics.descriptionZh: 识别并运用重复推理进行归纳：发现计算规律，描述数列规则，并利用已知的数学事实预测结果
evidenceZh: 利用已知的加倍（doubles）事实推导近加倍（near-doubles）答案（例如，6 + 7 = 6 + 6 + 1 = 13）
注意到从任意两位数中减去10，其十位数字总是减1
描述规律中的规则并利用其进行延伸或预测（例如，‘每次加5，个位数字在0和5之间交替’）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 练习乘法表（times tables）或数字规律时，他们能否发现捷径——比如‘如果 6 × 7 = 42，那么 6 × 8 必定是 48’——并利用已知事实推导出尚未记住的结果？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Guided Multi-Step Problem Solving
topics.description: With teacher guidance, make sense of multi-step and more complex problems by planning a pathway to the solution, identifying relevant information, and choosing appropriate operations
evidence: When given a word problem within 20 or 100, identify the known information and what needs to be found
Try a strategy (drawing, number line, known fact) and switch approach if the first attempt stalls
Check the reasonableness of an answer using estimation or a different method
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} works out that 3 children each get 12 sweets and ends up with 5, does {{name}} pause and say "that doesn't seem right" rather than just writing it down?
topics.nameZh: 教师指导下的多步问题解决
topics.descriptionZh: 在教师的指导下，通过规划解题路径、识别相关信息和选择合适的运算方法，理解多步（multi-step）及更复杂的问题。
evidenceZh: 在解答20或100以内的应用题（word problem）时，识别已知信息和需要求解的内容
尝试一种策略（如绘图、数轴（number line）、已知事实），如果第一次尝试受阻则转换方法
使用估算（estimation）或不同方法检查答案的合理性
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果{{name}}计算出3个孩子每人分到12颗糖果，最后算出的结果是5，{{name}}是会停下来思考并说“这好像不对”，而不是直接写下答案吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Numbers on a number line
topics.description: Select and use appropriate tools and representations (number lines, hundred squares, rulers, part-whole models) to support problem-solving
evidence: Choose a number line or hundred square to support adding or subtracting two-digit numbers
Select a ruler when a problem requires measuring length
Explain why one representation (e.g. a number line vs cubes) is more helpful for a particular problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is tackling a maths problem, do they choose a useful tool — like a number line for addition or a hundred square to count on — rather than always working in their head?
topics.descriptionZh: 选择并使用合适的工具与表征方式（如数轴 (number lines)、百数表 (hundred squares)、直尺 (rulers)、整体-部分模型 (part-whole models)）来辅助解决问题。
evidenceZh: 选择数轴或百数表来辅助进行两位数的加减法运算
当问题需要测量长度时，选择使用直尺
解释为什么某一种表征方式（例如数轴与立方体 (cubes) 相比）对解决特定问题更有帮助
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 在解决数学问题时，他们是否会选择合适的工具——例如用数轴进行加法运算，或用百数表进行接着数 (count on)——而不是完全依靠心算？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Precise Maths Communication
topics.description: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct vocabulary, specify units, and use symbols accurately
evidence: Use the = sign correctly to mean 'is the same as' rather than 'the answer is'
Include units when giving a measurement answer (e.g. '12 cm' not just '12')
Use precise terms such as 'edge', 'vertex', 'face' when describing 3-D shapes, and 'greater than', 'less than' when comparing numbers
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes or talks about a maths answer, do they include the units — like "5 centimetres" rather than just "5" — and use the right symbols like = or <?
topics.descriptionZh: 进行精确的数学表达：使用正确的专业词汇，明确标注单位，并准确使用数学符号。
evidenceZh: 正确使用等号（=）表示“等同于”（is the same as），而不是仅仅表示“答案是”（the answer is）
在给出测量结果时包含单位（例如写“12 cm”而不是只写“12”）
在描述三维图形（3-D shapes）时使用精确的术语，如“棱”（edge）、“顶点”（vertex）、“面”（face）；在比较数字时使用“大于”（greater than）和“小于”（less than）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 写出或口头表达数学答案时，他们是否包含了单位（比如写“5厘米”而不是只写“5”），并且正确使用了等号（=）或小于号（<）等符号？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Shape patterns
topics.description: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply properties of operations, place-value patterns, and relationships between shapes to solve problems efficiently
evidence: Use the commutative property deliberately (e.g. reorder 3 + 9 as 9 + 3 to count on from the larger number)
Use place-value structure to add or subtract tens (e.g. 47 + 10 = 57 because only the tens digit changes)
Recognise structural similarities between shapes (e.g. rectangles and squares both have 4 sides and 4 right angles)
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} notices a pattern in their maths work — like how multiplying by 10 always adds a zero — do they use that pattern to solve similar problems more quickly?
topics.descriptionZh: 寻找并利用数学结构（mathematical structure）：运用运算性质（properties of operations）、数位规律（place-value patterns）以及图形之间的关系来高效解决问题。
evidenceZh: 有意识地运用加法交换律（commutative property）（例如：将 3 + 9 重新排列为 9 + 3，以便从较大的数开始接着数）
运用数位结构（place-value structure）进行整十数的加减（例如：47 + 10 = 57，因为只有十位数字发生了变化）
识别图形之间的结构相似性（例如：矩形和正方形都有4条边和4个直角）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 在数学学习中注意到某种规律时——比如乘以10总是会在末尾添一个0——他们会利用这个规律来更快地解决类似问题吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Choosing the right strategy
topics.description: Select and use appropriate tools and representations strategically, including choosing between mental methods, jottings, formal algorithms, and calculators for arithmetic with multi-digit numbers, decimals, and fractions
evidence: Choose a mental method for 345 + 200 but a written method for 345 + 278
Select a ruler vs a metre stick based on the object being measured
Decide when a number line is more useful than base-ten blocks for a given problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} faces a maths problem, do they think about which method suits it best — like doing easy ones in their head, using a written method for bigger calculations, or sketching a diagram for geometry?
topics.descriptionZh: 策略性地选择和使用合适的工具与表征方式，包括在进行多位数、小数和分数的算术运算时，在心算（mental methods）、草稿记录（jottings）、正式算法（formal algorithms）和计算器之间做出选择。
evidenceZh: 对于345 + 200选择心算，而对于345 + 278选择笔算（written method）
根据被测物体的大小选择使用直尺（ruler）还是米尺（metre stick）
决定在特定问题中，数轴（number line）何时比十进制积木（base-ten blocks）更有用
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 面对数学问题时，他们会思考哪种方法最合适吗——比如心算解决简单问题，对较大的计算使用笔算，或者为几何问题绘制草图？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Extending Table Patterns
topics.description: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend multiplication table patterns, derive unknown facts from known ones, and describe rules for sequences
evidence: Notice that all multiples of 4 are even and use this to check answers
Derive 8 × 7 from 8 × 5 + 8 × 2 by spotting the pattern
Describe a rule for a growing pattern (e.g. 'add 50 each time') and use it to predict the next terms
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is learning their times tables, do they use known facts to figure out ones they're not sure of — for example, using 5 × 6 = 30 to work out that 6 × 6 = 36?
topics.descriptionZh: 识别并运用重复推理进行归纳：扩展乘法表规律，从已知事实推导未知事实，并描述数列的规律
evidenceZh: 注意到4的所有倍数都是偶数，并利用这一点来检查答案
通过发现规律，由 8 × 5 + 8 × 2 推导得出 8 × 7
描述递增模式的规律（例如'每次加50'），并利用它来预测后续项
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 学习乘法表时，他们是否会利用已知事实来推算不确定的结果——例如，利用 5 × 6 = 30 推算出 6 × 6 = 36？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Justifying mathematical reasoning
topics.description: Construct and follow multi-step mathematical arguments; identify errors in reasoning and explain why a method works or does not work
evidence: Explain step by step why a columnar addition method gives the correct answer
Find and explain an error in a worked example (e.g. incorrect regrouping)
Construct a simple argument for why a general statement is true (e.g. 'adding two even numbers always gives an even number')
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} hears another child's explanation for how they solved a maths problem, can {{name}} say whether the reasoning makes sense — and if not, point out exactly where the logic goes wrong?
topics.descriptionZh: 构建并理解多步数学论证；识别推理中的错误，并解释某种方法有效或无效的原因。
evidenceZh: 逐步解释为什么竖式加法（columnar addition）能得出正确答案
找出并解释解题示例中的错误（例如，错误的进位或退位（regrouping））
构建一个简单的论证来解释为什么一般性陈述是正确的（例如，'两个偶数相加总是得到偶数'）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 听到另一个孩子解释他们是如何解决数学问题的，{{name}} 能否判断其推理是否合理——如果不合理，能否准确指出逻辑出错的地方？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Multi-Step Problem Solving
topics.description: With teacher support, make sense of multi-step problems involving larger numbers or mixed operations by breaking them into parts, choosing strategies, and checking answers for reasonableness — children at this stage are developing the habit with guidance; independent strategy evaluation comes later
evidence: Break a two-step word problem within 1000 into sub-problems and solve each part
Estimate an answer before calculating to set a reasonableness benchmark
Check an answer using a different method or inverse operation and revise if needed
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} gets an answer that seems way too big or too small for a maths problem, do they notice and go back to check, even without you pointing it out?
topics.nameZh: 多步问题解决 (Multi-Step Problem Solving)
topics.descriptionZh: 在教师的支持下，通过将涉及较大数字或混合运算的多步问题拆解为若干部分、选择解题策略以及检验答案的合理性，来理解并解决这些问题——处于该阶段的儿童正在引导下逐步养成这一习惯，而独立评估策略的能力将在后期形成。
evidenceZh: 将1000以内的两步应用题拆解为子问题并逐一解答
在计算前估算答案，以设定合理性基准 (reasonableness benchmark)
使用不同的方法或逆运算 (inverse operation) 检验答案，必要时进行修正
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 算出的数学题答案看起来过大或过小，他们能否自己察觉并回头检查，即使没有您的提醒？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Shape patterns (age 7+)
topics.description: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply place-value patterns to three-digit operations, use multiplication/division relationships, and exploit shape properties to classify
evidence: Use the structure of place value to explain why adding hundreds only changes the hundreds digit
Use commutativity and the relationship between multiplication and division to derive unknown facts
Classify shapes by their structural properties (number of sides, right angles, parallel lines)
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is multiplying or working with larger numbers, do they use what they know about place value or number relationships to simplify the calculation — like breaking 24 × 3 into 20 × 3 + 4 × 3?
topics.descriptionZh: 寻找并利用数学结构（Mathematical structure）：将数位值（Place-value）规律应用于三位数运算，运用乘除法关系，并利用图形属性（Shape properties）进行分类
evidenceZh: 利用数位值（Place value）结构解释为什么加几百只会改变百位数字
运用交换律（Commutativity）以及乘除法之间的关系推导未知的运算事实
根据图形的结构属性（边数、直角、平行线）对图形进行分类
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}进行乘法运算或处理较大数字时，他们是否会利用已掌握的数位值（Place value）或数字关系来简化计算——例如将 24 × 3 拆分为 20 × 3 + 4 × 3？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Understanding fractions
topics.description: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, and symbolic equations involving three-digit numbers and fractions, explaining what each part represents
evidence: Write an equation with three-digit numbers to match a measurement or money word problem
Draw a bar model to represent a fraction problem and use it to solve
Explain how a number line diagram relates to the quantities in a word problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} works through a maths problem involving fractions or three-digit numbers, can they switch between drawing a diagram, using a number line, and writing an equation — and explain what each one shows?
topics.descriptionZh: 能够在涉及三位数 (three-digit numbers) 和分数 (fractions) 的现实情境、图表 (diagrams) 以及符号方程 (symbolic equations) 之间流畅转换，并解释各个部分所代表的含义。
evidenceZh: 列出包含三位数的方程式，以匹配测量或货币类应用题 (word problem)
绘制条形模型 (bar model) 来表示分数问题，并利用其进行求解
解释数线图 (number line) 如何与应用题中的数量相关联
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 解决涉及分数或三位数的数学问题时，他们能否在绘制图表、使用数线和列方程之间灵活切换，并解释每种方式分别展示了什么？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Understanding fractions (age 7+)
topics.description: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct place-value and fraction vocabulary, specify units in measurement answers, and use notation accurately
evidence: Consistently specify units in measurement answers (e.g. '35 cm' not '35')
Use fraction vocabulary precisely (numerator, denominator, equivalent)
Write equations with correct notation including £/p, >, <, = and fraction symbols
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} gives a maths answer involving measurements or fractions, do they include the correct units — like "3½ metres" or "2.5 kg" — and use the right symbols throughout?
topics.descriptionZh: 以数学的精确性进行交流：使用正确的数位（place-value）和分数词汇，在测量答案中明确标明单位，并准确使用数学符号。
evidenceZh: 在测量答案中始终标明单位（例如，写“35 cm”而不是“35”）
精确使用分数词汇（分子（numerator）、分母（denominator）、等值（equivalent））
使用正确的符号书写算式，包括英镑/便士（£/p）、大于（>）、小于（<）、等于（=）以及分数符号
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}给出涉及测量或分数的数学答案时，他们是否包含了正确的单位（如“3½米”或“2.5 kg”），并且全程使用了正确的符号？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Working with money
topics.description: Model real-world problems involving measurement, money, and time by choosing appropriate representations and interpreting results in context
evidence: Choose whether to use a bar model, number line, or equation for a measurement problem
Model a multi-step money problem with equations and interpret the final answer as change or total cost
Create a line plot from measurement data and use it to answer questions about the real-world situation
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} solves a real-life maths problem — like calculating how much fabric is needed for a project — can they choose the right representation (a diagram, a table, an equation) and explain what the answer means in the real situation?
topics.descriptionZh: 通过选择合适的表征方式（representations）并结合具体情境解释结果，对涉及测量（measurement）、金钱（money）和时间（time）的实际问题进行建模。
evidenceZh: 针对测量（measurement）问题，选择使用条形模型（bar model）、数轴（number line）还是方程式（equation）
使用方程式（equations）对多步骤（multi-step）的金钱（money）问题进行建模，并将最终答案解释为找零（change）或总成本（total cost）
根据测量（measurement）数据创建点线图（line plot），并利用它回答有关实际情况的问题
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 解决现实生活中的数学（maths）问题时——例如计算一个项目需要多少布料——他们能否选择合适的表征方式（如示意图、表格、方程式）并解释该答案在实际情境中的意义？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Choosing mathematical tools
topics.description: Select and use appropriate tools and representations strategically: choose between mental, written, and diagrammatic methods; use calculators for checking; select fraction models suited to the task
evidence: Decide to use mental multiplication for 25×4 but a written method for 167×3
Choose fraction strips rather than a number line to compare 3/8 and 1/4
Use a ruler and squared paper to verify area by counting squares after calculating l×w
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is working on maths, do they choose the right method — doing simple calculations in their head, using written working for complex ones, and sketching a diagram when a problem involves shapes or fractions?
topics.descriptionZh: 策略性地选择并使用合适的工具与表征方法：在心算、笔算和图示法之间做出选择；使用计算器进行验算；选择适合当前任务的分数模型（fraction models）。
evidenceZh: 决定对25×4使用心算，而对167×3使用笔算方法
选择使用分数条（fraction strips）而不是数轴（number line）来比较3/8和1/4
使用直尺和方格纸，在计算长×宽（l×w）后通过数方格来验证面积
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 做数学题时，他们是否能选择正确的方法——将简单的计算放在心算，复杂的计算使用笔算，并在问题涉及图形或分数时绘制示意图？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Fractions on a number line
topics.description: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, and symbolic equations involving multiplication, fractions, and decimals, explaining what each representation shows
evidence: Represent a sharing problem as both a fraction diagram and a division equation
Explain how a bar model for 4 × 23 connects to the area model and the written method
Translate a decimal on a number line into a fraction and explain the equivalence
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} works on a maths problem involving decimals or fractions, can they move between a fraction strip, a number line, and a written equation — explaining what each one is showing?
topics.descriptionZh: 能够在涉及乘法、分数（fractions）和小数（decimals）的真实情境、图表、数轴（number lines）和符号方程之间流畅转换，并解释每种表示方法所表达的含义。
evidenceZh: 将分配问题（sharing problem）表示为分数图（fraction diagram）和除法算式（division equation）
解释 4 × 23 的条形模型（bar model）如何与面积模型（area model）和竖式计算（written method）相联系
将数轴上的小数转换为分数，并解释其等价性（equivalence）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 解决涉及小数或分数的数学问题时，他们能否在分数条（fraction strip）、数轴和书面算式之间进行转换，并解释每一种形式所表示的含义？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Justifying mathematical reasoning (age 8+)
topics.description: Construct and present multi-step mathematical arguments; critique the reasoning of others and explain clearly why a method works or fails
evidence: Explain why 1/3 > 1/5 using the idea that more parts means smaller pieces
Find and explain an error in a peer's column subtraction with exchanges
Present a chain of reasoning: since 6×8=48 and 6×2=12, then 6×10=60 so 6×8=60−12=48
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a classmate claims "you can't multiply a fraction and get a bigger answer", can {{name}} think through whether that's always true — and give an example to support or challenge the claim?
topics.nameZh: 论证数学推理（8岁及以上）
topics.descriptionZh: 构建并展示多步数学论证；批判他人的推理过程，并清楚地解释某种方法为何有效或失效。
evidenceZh: 利用“份数越多，每份越小”的概念解释为什么 1/3 > 1/5
找出并解释同伴在列竖式退位减法（column subtraction with exchanges）中的错误
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果一位同学声称“进行分数乘法（fraction multiplication）不可能得到更大的结果”，{{name}} 能否深入思考这是否总是成立，并举例支持或反驳该说法？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Mathematical Precision
topics.description: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct fraction/decimal vocabulary, name angle types accurately, specify units in measurement and money, and use notation (=, <, >, ÷, ×) correctly
evidence: Distinguish between 'three fourths' and 'three quarters' and use both correctly
State an answer in the correct unit: '63 square centimetres' not just '63'
Write 15:45 in 24-hour notation and explain the distinction from 3:45 pm
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes up a maths answer involving angles, fractions, or money, do they use precise vocabulary and correct notation — like writing "acute angle", "3/4", or "£2.50" rather than vague descriptions?
topics.descriptionZh: 运用数学精确性进行交流：使用正确的分数 (fraction) 和小数 (decimal) 词汇，准确命名角的类型 (angle types)，在测量和货币中明确指定单位，并正确使用数学符号 (=, <, >, ÷, ×)。
evidenceZh: 区分“three fourths”和“three quarters”（四分之三的不同英文表达）并正确使用
用正确的单位陈述答案：写“63平方厘米 (square centimetres)”而不是只写“63”
用24小时制 (24-hour notation) 写出15:45，并解释它与下午3:45 (3:45 pm) 的区别
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}写下涉及角 (angles)、分数 (fractions) 或货币 (money) 的数学答案时，他们是否使用了精确的词汇和正确的符号——例如写“锐角 (acute angle)”、“3/4”或“£2.50”，而不是含糊的描述？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Modelling with multiplication and fractions
topics.description: Model real-world problems involving multiplication, area, fractions, and unit conversion by choosing appropriate representations and interpreting mathematical results in context
evidence: Model a tiling/area problem with an array and write the corresponding multiplication
Represent a recipe-scaling problem as a fraction calculation and interpret the answer in grams
Use a bar model to set up a unit conversion problem (metres to centimetres)
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is solving a real-life problem — like working out the area of a room in square metres — do they choose the right maths tool for the job and interpret the final number in terms of the real situation?
topics.descriptionZh: 通过选择合适的表征方式，并在具体情境中解释数学结果，对涉及乘法（multiplication）、面积（area）、分数（fractions）和单位换算（unit conversion）的实际问题进行建模。
evidenceZh: 使用阵列（array）对铺砖/面积问题进行建模，并写出相应的乘法算式
将食谱按比例缩放问题表示为分数计算，并将结果以克（grams）为单位进行解释
使用条形模型（bar model）建立单位换算问题（米换算为厘米）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 解决现实生活中的问题——例如计算房间的面积（单位为平方米）时，他们是否能选择合适的数学工具，并结合实际情况解释最终的数值结果？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Multi-Step Problem Solving
topics.description: Make sense of multi-step problems involving four operations, fractions, and area/volume by identifying sub-steps, choosing a strategy, and monitoring progress
evidence: Break a two-step word problem into parts and explain a plan before calculating
Choose between drawing a diagram or writing equations for a perimeter problem
Check a fraction-of-quantity answer by estimating: 3/5 of 20 must be more than half of 20
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} tackles a complex maths problem involving area, fractions, and multiple steps, do they plan their approach — estimating roughly what the answer should be before calculating, and then checking it makes sense at the end?
topics.nameZh: 多步问题解决 (Multi-Step Problem Solving)
topics.descriptionZh: 通过识别子步骤、选择策略和监控进度，理解涉及四则运算 (four operations)、分数 (fractions) 以及面积/体积 (area/volume) 的多步问题。
evidenceZh: 将两步文字题 (word problem) 拆解为几个部分，并在计算前解释解题计划
在解决周长 (perimeter) 问题时，选择画示意图或列方程
通过估算来检验“求一个量的几分之几”的答案：20的3/5必须大于20的一半
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 解决涉及面积、分数和多步计算的复杂数学问题时，他们是否会规划解题思路——在计算前先大致估算答案，并在最后检查答案是否合理？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Times tables (age 8+)
topics.description: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend patterns in times tables and equivalent fractions, derive unknown facts from known facts efficiently, describe general rules
evidence: Notice that all fractions equivalent to 1/2 have a numerator that is half the denominator
Use the pattern 3×4=12, 3×40=120, 3×400=1200 and explain the generalisation
Derive 8×7 from 8×5=40 plus 8×2=16 and describe the strategy as a general approach
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} notices a pattern — like that multiplying by 4 is the same as doubling twice — do they use that generalisation to solve similar problems more efficiently?
topics.descriptionZh: 认识并运用重复推理进行归纳概括：扩展乘法表与等值分数（equivalent fractions）的规律，高效地从已知事实推导未知事实，并描述通用规则。
evidenceZh: 注意到所有与1/2等值的分数（equivalent fractions），其分子都是分母的一半
通过 8×5=40 加上 8×2=16 推导出 8×7，并将此策略描述为一种通用方法
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 注意到一个规律——比如乘以4等于连续两次翻倍——时，他们是否会利用这种归纳规律来更高效地解决类似问题？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Using Mathematical Structure
topics.description: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit place-value patterns for ×10/×100, use the distributive property to break apart multiplications, apply fraction equivalence to compare and compute, use shape properties to classify quadrilaterals
evidence: Decompose 7×13 into 7×10 + 7×3 using the distributive property
Explain why multiplying by 10 shifts digits one place left using place-value structure
Use the fact that a square is a special rectangle to reason about quadrilateral properties
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is comparing fractions or working out a percentage, do they look for underlying patterns — like spotting that 50% is always half, or that equivalent fractions all sit at the same point on a number line?
topics.descriptionZh: 寻找并利用数学结构：利用位值（place-value）规律进行乘10/乘100运算，运用分配律（distributive property）拆分乘法，应用分数等值（fraction equivalence）进行比较和计算，利用图形性质对四边形（quadrilaterals）进行分类。
evidenceZh: 运用分配律（distributive property）将7×13拆分为7×10 + 7×3
利用位值结构（place-value structure）解释为什么乘以10会使数字向左移动一位
利用正方形是特殊长方形这一事实，推理四边形（quadrilaterals）的性质
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}在比较分数或计算百分比时，他们是否会寻找潜在的规律——比如发现50%总是等于一半，或者所有等值分数（equivalent fractions）在数轴（number line）上都位于同一点？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Choosing representations strategically
topics.description: Select and use tools and representations strategically: choose between mental methods, formal written methods, protractors, fraction strips, and diagrams based on the demands of the problem
evidence: Choose mental multiplication for 25 × 40 but long multiplication for 347 × 26
Select a protractor to verify an estimated angle rather than relying on visual inspection alone
Choose a common-denominator approach vs. benchmark comparison for ordering fractions, and explain why
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} faces a geometry or proportion problem, do they choose the right tool — like a protractor for angles or a fraction strip for comparing fractions — rather than always defaulting to one method?
topics.nameZh: 策略性地选择表征方式
topics.descriptionZh: 策略性地选择和使用工具与表征方式：根据问题的需求，在心算方法 (mental methods)、正式笔算方法 (formal written methods)、量角器 (protractors)、分数条 (fraction strips) 和图表 (diagrams) 之间进行选择
evidenceZh: 计算 25 × 40 时选择心算乘法 (mental multiplication)，计算 347 × 26 时选择竖式乘法 (long multiplication)
选择用量角器 (protractor) 来验证估算的角度，而不是仅仅依赖目测
在对分数进行排序时，选择通分法 (common-denominator approach) 或基准比较法 (benchmark comparison)，并解释原因
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 遇到几何或比例问题时，他们是否能选择合适的工具——例如用量角器 (protractor) 测量角度，或用分数条 (fraction strip) 比较分数——而不是始终默认使用单一方法？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Complex Multi-Step Problems
topics.description: Make sense of complex multi-step problems involving large numbers, fractions, decimals, and percentages by analysing what is known and unknown, planning multi-step strategies, and evaluating reasonableness through estimation and inverse operations
evidence: Break a three-step problem involving unit conversion and multiplication into sub-problems and solve systematically
Estimate 4,832 × 7 as roughly 5,000 × 7 = 35,000 to check a calculated answer of 33,824
Identify that a percentage answer over 100% doesn't make sense in context
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} faces a complex multi-step maths problem involving percentages, large numbers, or fractions, do they pause to identify what's known, estimate an answer, and then check their final result makes sense?
topics.descriptionZh: 通过分析已知和未知条件、规划多步策略，并利用估算和逆运算来评估结果的合理性，从而理解涉及大数、分数、小数和百分比的复杂多步问题。
evidenceZh: 将涉及单位换算和乘法的三步问题分解为子问题，并系统地求解
将 4,832 × 7 估算为大约 5,000 × 7 = 35,000，以此来检验 33,824 这一计算结果是否正确
能够识别出在特定情境下，得出超过 100% 的百分比答案是不合理的
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 面临涉及百分比、大数或分数的复杂多步数学问题时，他们是否会先停下来确认已知条件，估算答案，然后检查最终结果是否合理？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Fractions, Decimals & Percentages
topics.description: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit the relationship between fractions, decimals, and percentages; use factor pairs to simplify multiplication; apply angle facts to find unknowns; use properties of regular polygons systematically
evidence: Use the structure 25 × 16 = 25 × 4 × 4 = 100 × 4 = 400 by exploiting factor pairs
Recognise that 0.75 = 3/4 = 75% and use whichever form is most efficient for the problem
Use the fact that angles on a straight line sum to 180° as a structural tool to find missing angles
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} notices that fractions, decimals, and percentages are just different ways of writing the same thing, do they use that understanding to switch between them fluidly when it makes a calculation easier?
topics.nameZh: 分数、小数与百分比 (Fractions, Decimals & Percentages)
topics.descriptionZh: 寻找并利用数学结构：利用分数 (fractions)、小数 (decimals) 和百分比 (percentages) 之间的关系；利用因数对 (factor pairs) 简化乘法；应用角度事实 (angle facts) 求解未知角；系统地运用正多边形 (regular polygons) 的性质。
evidenceZh: 利用因数对 (factor pairs) 的结构进行计算：25 × 16 = 25 × 4 × 4 = 100 × 4 = 400
认识到 0.75 = 3/4 = 75%，并根据问题需要选择最高效的表达形式
将直线上角度之和为180°这一事实作为结构工具来求解未知角
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 注意到分数、小数和百分比只是同一事物的不同表达方式时，他们是否会利用这种理解，在能使计算更简便时流畅地在它们之间进行转换？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Fractions on a number line (age 9+)
topics.description: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, bar models, and symbolic equations involving multi-digit multiplication, fractions, decimals, and percentages, explaining connections between representations
evidence: Represent a scaling problem as both a bar model and a multiplication equation
Show how 0.35, 35/100, and 35% all represent the same quantity on a hundredths grid
Translate a line-graph reading into a subtraction equation to find the difference
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} solves a problem involving percentages or multi-digit multiplication, can they show the same situation using a bar model, a number line, and an equation — and explain what each one represents?
topics.nameZh: 数轴上的分数（9岁及以上）
topics.descriptionZh: 能够在涉及多位数乘法（multi-digit multiplication）、分数（fractions）、小数（decimals）和百分比（percentages）的实际情境、图表、数轴（number lines）、条形模型（bar models）和符号方程（symbolic equations）之间熟练转换，并解释不同表示方法之间的联系。
evidenceZh: 将缩放问题（scaling problem）同时表示为条形模型（bar model）和乘法方程（multiplication equation）
展示0.35、35/100和35%在百分位网格（hundredths grid）上如何表示相同的数量
将折线图（line-graph）的读数转化为减法方程（subtraction equation）以求出差值
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}解决涉及百分比（percentages）或多位数乘法（multi-digit multiplication）的问题时，他们能否使用条形模型（bar model）、数轴（number line）和方程（equation）来展示同一种情境，并解释每一种表示方法分别代表什么？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Precise Maths Vocabulary
topics.description: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct vocabulary for primes, factors, multiples, angle types, and polygon regularity; specify units including cm², m³, °; use notation for squares/cubes and percentages accurately
evidence: Distinguish 'factor' from 'multiple' in a written explanation
Write an area answer as 48 cm² (not just 48) and a volume estimate as approximately 60 cm³
Use 5² notation correctly and read it as 'five squared'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} talks or writes about maths involving primes, percentages, or polygons, do they use the precise technical words — like "prime factor", "obtuse angle", or "regular hexagon" — correctly and confidently?
topics.descriptionZh: 以数学的精确性进行沟通：正确使用质数（primes）、因数（factors）、倍数（multiples）、角的类型（angle types）和多边形规则性（polygon regularity）的相关词汇；明确指定单位，包括平方厘米（cm²）、立方米（m³）、度（°）；准确使用平方/立方的符号以及百分比（percentages）的表示法
evidenceZh: 在书面解释中区分“因数”（factor）和“倍数”（multiple）
将面积答案写为48平方厘米（48 cm²）（而不仅仅是48），并将体积估算写为大约60立方厘米（60 cm³）
正确使用5²的符号，并将其读作“5的平方”（five squared）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当{{name}}谈论或书写涉及质数（primes）、百分比（percentages）或多边形（polygons）的数学内容时，他们是否能正确且自信地使用精确的专业术语——例如“质因数”（prime factor）、“钝角”（obtuse angle）或“正六边形”（regular hexagon）？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Real-World Maths Modelling
topics.description: Model real-world problems involving scaling, unit conversion, area/perimeter, and percentage by selecting appropriate mathematical representations and interpreting results in context
evidence: Model a recipe-scaling problem with multiplication and fractions, then interpret the answer in grams
Represent a room-carpet problem by drawing a scale diagram and applying the area formula
Use a percentage bar model to find a sale price and explain the answer in £
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is solving a real-world maths problem — like scaling a recipe or converting units — do they choose a sensible representation, carry out the maths, and then explain what the result means in the real situation?
topics.descriptionZh: 通过选择合适的数学表示方法（mathematical representations）并结合实际情境解释结果，对涉及比例缩放（scaling）、单位换算（unit conversion）、面积与周长（area/perimeter）以及百分比（percentage）的现实世界问题进行建模。
evidenceZh: 使用乘法和分数（fractions）对食谱按比例缩放（recipe-scaling）问题进行建模，然后以克（grams）为单位解释答案
通过绘制比例图（scale diagram）并应用面积公式（area formula）来表示房间铺地毯问题
使用百分比条形模型（percentage bar model）计算打折售价，并以英镑（£）为单位解释答案
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 解决现实世界中的数学问题——例如按比例缩放食谱或进行单位换算——时，他们是否会选择合适的表示方法，完成数学计算，然后解释该结果在实际情境中的意义？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Reasoning with Equivalences
topics.description: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend patterns in equivalent fractions and percentage conversions, derive unknown facts from known facts, describe general rules for sequences and predict terms
evidence: Notice that multiplying any number by 25 can be done by multiplying by 100 then dividing by 4, and explain why
Describe the general rule for a sequence and predict the 20th term
Generalise: to find 10% divide by 10, to find 5% halve 10%, and use this to find 35% of any number
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} sees a sequence of equivalent fractions — like 1/2, 2/4, 3/6… — can they describe the rule and use it to find the next few terms, or to quickly convert between fractions and percentages?
topics.descriptionZh: 识别并运用重复推理进行归纳概括：拓展等值分数（equivalent fractions）与百分比转换的规律，由已知推导未知，描述数列（sequences）的通用规则并预测后续项。
evidenceZh: 注意到任何数乘以25可以通过先乘以100再除以4来实现，并解释原因
描述数列的通用规则并预测第20项
归纳概括：求10%就除以10，求5%就将10%减半，并利用此规律求任意数的35%
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 当 {{name}} 看到一组等值分数（equivalent fractions）——例如 1/2, 2/4, 3/6…——时，他们能否描述出其中的规律，并利用该规律找出接下来的几项，或者在分数和百分比之间进行快速转换？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Understanding fractions (age 9+)
topics.description: Construct and present logical mathematical arguments involving multiple steps; critique others' reasoning about fractions, angles, or calculations and clearly explain errors or alternative methods
