evidence: Calculate 23 × 4 using partitioning (20 × 4 + 3 × 4)
Calculate 96 ÷ 8 using known table facts
Begin to use a formal written layout for short multiplication
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} work out sums like '23 × 4' or '68 ÷ 4' — either in their head using times table knowledge, or by writing it out step by step?
topics.nameZh: 笔算乘法与除法 (Written Multiplication & Division)
topics.descriptionZh: 运用已知的乘法口诀表（times tables）写出并计算乘除法算式，包括两位数乘一位数，从心算（mental math）逐步过渡到规范的笔算方法（formal written methods）。
evidenceZh: 使用拆分法（partitioning）计算 23 × 4（即 20 × 4 + 3 × 4）
运用已知的乘法口诀表计算 96 ÷ 8
开始使用规范的短乘法（short multiplication）笔算格式
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否计算出“23 × 4”或“68 ÷ 4”这类算式——无论是利用乘法口诀表知识进行心算，还是通过逐步写出笔算步骤来计算？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: All times tables to 12×12
topics.description: Recall multiplication and division facts for multiplication tables up to 12 × 12
evidence: Recall any fact from the 1–12 times tables rapidly
Recall the corresponding division fact for any multiplication fact
Use known facts to check or derive answers in calculations
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} recall any multiplication or division fact from all the times tables up to 12 — like '9 × 8 = 72' or '132 ÷ 12 = 11' — quickly and accurately?
topics.descriptionZh: 熟练记忆12×12以内乘法表 (Multiplication tables) 的乘法和除法事实 (Facts)。
evidenceZh: 能快速回忆 (Recall) 1至12乘法表 (Times tables) 中的任意事实 (Fact)
能回忆 (Recall) 任意乘法事实 (Multiplication fact) 对应的除法事实 (Division fact)
利用已知事实 (Known facts) 来检查或推导 (Derive) 计算中的答案
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否快速且准确地回忆 (Recall) 12以内所有乘法表 (Times tables) 中的任意乘法或除法事实 (Fact) ——例如‘9 × 8 = 72’或‘132 ÷ 12 = 11’？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Division as Unknown Factor
topics.description: Understand division as an unknown-factor problem (e.g. find 32 ÷ 8 by finding the number that makes 32 when multiplied by 8)
evidence: Explain that 32 ÷ 8 = ? is the same as 8 × ? = 32
Use a known multiplication fact to find a division answer
Describe the relationship between multiplication and division as inverse operations
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} work out '32 ÷ 8' by asking 'what do I multiply 8 by to get 32?' — using times table knowledge rather than a separate division method?
topics.nameZh: 除法作为求未知因数问题
topics.descriptionZh: 理解除法是一个求未知因数的问题（例如，通过找到与8相乘能得到32的数来求解32 ÷ 8）。
evidenceZh: 利用已知的乘法事实（乘法口诀）来求得除法的答案
描述乘法与除法作为互逆运算（inverse operations）之间的关系
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否通过思考“8乘以多少等于32？”来计算“32 ÷ 8”——即利用乘法口诀知识，而不是使用单独的除法方法？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Factor Pairs & Commutativity
topics.description: Recognise and use factor pairs and commutativity in mental calculations
evidence: List all factor pairs of a given number (e.g. 24: 1×24, 2×12, 3×8, 4×6)
Use commutativity to reorder a multiplication for easier mental calculation
Explain what a factor pair is and how commutativity helps
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} needs to multiply '4 × 15', can they spot that splitting it into '4 × 5 × 3 = 20 × 3 = 60' is a clever shortcut — using factor pairs to make it easier?
topics.nameZh: 因数对与交换律 (Factor Pairs & Commutativity)
topics.descriptionZh: 识别并在心算中运用因数对 (factor pairs) 与交换律 (commutativity)
evidenceZh: 运用交换律重新排列乘法算式，使心算更简便
解释什么是因数对，以及交换律如何提供帮助
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 需要计算 '4 × 15'，他们能否发现将其拆分为 '4 × 5 × 3 = 20 × 3 = 60' 是一个巧妙的捷径——利用因数对 (factor pairs) 使计算变得更简单？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Fluent multiplication and division facts
topics.description: Fluently multiply and divide within 100 using strategies such as the relationship between multiplication and division
evidence: Answer any single-digit multiplication fact within 3 seconds
Answer any related division fact within 3 seconds
Use known facts to derive unknown facts (e.g. 9 × 7 from 10 × 7 − 7)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} answer any times table fact up to 10 × 10 quickly — and also give the related division facts, like '63 ÷ 9 = 7' from knowing '9 × 7 = 63'?
topics.descriptionZh: 利用乘除法之间的关系等策略，在100以内熟练地进行乘法和除法运算。
evidenceZh: 在3秒内回答出任何一位数乘法事实（single-digit multiplication fact）
在3秒内回答出任何相关的除法事实（related division fact）
利用已知事实推导未知事实（例如，通过 10 × 7 - 7 推导 9 × 7）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否快速回答出 10 × 10 以内的任何乘法口诀事实（times table fact）——并且还能给出相关的除法事实，例如从已知 '9 × 7 = 63' 得出 '63 ÷ 9 = 7'？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Mental multiplication and division
topics.description: Use place value, known and derived facts to multiply and divide mentally, including multiplying by 0 and 1, dividing by 1, and multiplying together three numbers
evidence: Calculate 40 × 6 = 240 mentally using place value
Explain why any number × 0 = 0 and any number × 1 = the number itself
Multiply three numbers mentally by choosing a useful pair first (e.g. 2 × 7 × 5 = 2 × 5 × 7 = 70)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} work out things like '6 × 0', '1 × 35', or '100 ÷ 100' instantly in their head — using what they know rather than working everything out from scratch?
topics.descriptionZh: 利用数位（place value）、已知和推导出的数学事实进行乘除法心算，包括乘以0和1、除以1，以及三个数连乘

解释为什么任何数乘以0都等于0，且任何数乘以1都等于其本身
通过优先选择便于计算的一对数来心算三个数的连乘（例如：2 × 7 × 5 = 2 × 5 × 7 = 70）

解决测量除法问题（例如：'从28厘米长的丝带中能剪出多少段4厘米长的丝带？'）
使用乘法解决阵列/面积应用题

解决缩放问题（例如：‘一座塔的高度是一栋15米建筑的3倍’）
解决对应问题（例如：‘3种面包，4种馅料——可以组合成多少种不同的三明治？’）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 需要计算‘5 × 23’，他们能否将其拆分为‘5 × 20 + 5 × 3 = 100 + 15 = 115’，而不是直接进行笔算？

topics.subject: Mathematics

Use this skill to estimate products of larger numbers

topics.descriptionZh: 运用基于位值（place value）和运算性质（properties of operations）的策略，将一位数与10到90范围内的整十数相乘。

运用此技能估算更大数字的乘积
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否先计算一位数乘法，然后在末尾添零，从而快速算出 '7 × 40' 或 '6 × 80'——分别得到 280 和 480？

topics.subject: Mathematics

Observe that the sum of two even numbers is always even
Identify a pattern in the multiplication table and explain it using commutativity or the distributive property

topics.descriptionZh: 识别算术规律（包括加法表或乘法表中的规律），并运用运算性质（properties of operations）来解释它们

观察到两个偶数（even numbers）的和总是偶数
识别乘法表中的规律，并运用交换律（commutativity）或分配律（distributive property）进行解释
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否发现乘法表中的规律——例如5的所有倍数都以0或5结尾——并解释为什么会产生这种规律？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Properties of Operations

Use the distributive property: 8 × 7 = 8 × 5 + 8 × 2 = 40 + 16 = 56
Use associativity to multiply three numbers: 2 × 3 × 5 = 6 × 5 = 30
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} use tricks like breaking up a number — working out '6 × 14' as '6 × 10 + 6 × 4 = 60 + 24 = 84' — to make multiplication easier?
topics.descriptionZh: 运用运算性质（交换律 (commutative)、结合律 (associative)、分配律 (distributive)）作为乘除法的计算策略。

运用分配律 (distributive property)：8 × 7 = 8 × 5 + 8 × 2 = 40 + 16 = 56
运用结合律 (associativity) 计算三个数相乘：2 × 3 × 5 = 6 × 5 = 30
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否运用拆分数字等小技巧——比如把“6 × 14”拆成“6 × 10 + 6 × 4 = 60 + 24 = 84”来计算——让乘法变得更简单？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Unknown in Multiplication & Division
topics.description: Determine the unknown whole number in a multiplication or division equation relating three whole numbers (e.g. 8 × ? = 48, ? × 6 = 42)
evidence: Find the missing factor in 7 × ? = 63
Find the missing dividend in ? ÷ 5 = 9
Explain the strategy used (e.g. using the related multiplication fact)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees '8 × ? = 48' or '? ÷ 6 = 7' written on paper, can they figure out what number goes in the blank?
topics.descriptionZh: 确定涉及三个整数的乘法或除法算式中的未知整数（例如：8 × ? = 48，? × 6 = 42）
evidenceZh: 找出 7 × ? = 63 中缺失的因数 (factor)
找出 ? ÷ 5 = 9 中缺失的被除数 (dividend)
解释所使用的策略（例如：使用相关的乘法事实 (multiplication fact)）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 在纸上看到“8 × ? = 48”或“? ÷ 6 = 7”，他们能算出空白处应该填什么数字吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: What Division Means

Draw a picture to represent a division expression
Match a division expression to a word problem involving equal sharing or grouping

topics.descriptionZh: 解释整数除法的商（例如，将 56 ÷ 8 解释为每份的物体数量或等分的组数）
evidenceZh: 解释 56 ÷ 8 可以表示将 56 平均分成 8 份，或者每份包含 8 个
画图表示除法算式
将除法算式与涉及平均分配或分组的文字应用题相匹配
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否解释 '56 ÷ 8' 可以表示 '如果把 56 个物品平均分给 8 个人，每个人能分到几个？'，而不仅仅是直接背出答案 '7'？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: What Multiplication Means

Draw a picture or array to represent a multiplication expression
Match a multiplication expression to a word problem involving equal groups

topics.descriptionZh: 解释整数的乘积（例如，将 5 × 7 理解为 5 组，每组 7 个物体的总数）
evidenceZh: 解释 4 × 6 表示 4 组，每组 6 个物体
画图或使用阵列（array）来表示乘法算式
将乘法算式与涉及等量分组（equal groups）的应用题相匹配
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到写下的“5 × 7”，他们能解释这表示 5 组，每组 7 个吗——而不仅仅是背诵出答案“35”？

topics.subject: Mathematics

topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否通过规范的竖式格式计算‘347 × 6’——逐位相乘并在需要时正确进位？

topics.subject: Mathematics

计算 125 ÷ 8 并解释结果：商15余5表示装满15袋，还剩下5个 (remainder)
利用乘除法关系 (multiplication-division relationship) 来检验除法答案

Represent a two-step problem with an equation using n for the unknown

topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果{{name}}阅读题目‘一所学校购买了7盒24支装的钢笔，并平均分给8个班级’，他们能否完成所有计算步骤并合理地决定如何处理余数（remainder）？

Derive 7 × 15 by calculating 7 × 10 + 7 × 5

通过计算 7 × 10 + 7 × 5 推导出 7 × 15 的结果

36是一个数的4倍——这个数是多少？

topics.subject: Mathematics

topics.subject: Mathematics

topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否快速计算出 '4.7 × 100' 或 '3,600 ÷ 1,000' —— 知道在数位顺序表（place-value chart）中，根据是乘法还是除法，数字会向左或向右移动？

topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能告诉你是什么让一个数成为“质数”——即它只能被1和它本身整除——并给出像7、11和13这样的一些例子吗？

topics.descriptionZh: 根据给定的规则生成数字或图形规律（pattern）；识别规律中未直接体现在规则中的明显特征，并通俗地解释它们出现的原因。
evidenceZh: 给定“从1开始，每次加3”的规则，生成各项（terms）并注意到它们奇偶（odd/even）交替。
给定一个图形规律，预测接下来的三个项（terms）并描述其规则（rule）。
解释为什么从2开始，每次加4，得到的总是偶数（even numbers）。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果告诉 {{name}} “从3开始，每次乘以2”，他们能否写出这个数列（pattern）——3, 6, 12, 24, 48——并发现其增长过程中的任何有趣特征？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Square and cube numbers
topics.description: Recognise and use square numbers and cube numbers, and the notation for squared (²) and cubed (³)
evidence: Identify 49 as 7² and explain that 7 × 7 = 49
Calculate 4³ = 64 and explain it means 4 × 4 × 4
List the first ten square numbers
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} know that '5²' means 5 × 5 = 25 and '3³' means 3 × 3 × 3 = 27 — and can they work out other squared and cubed numbers?
topics.descriptionZh: 认识并使用平方数（square numbers）和立方数（cube numbers），以及平方（²）和立方（³）的符号表示。
evidenceZh: 识别49为7²，并解释7 × 7 = 49
计算4³ = 64，并解释其含义为4 × 4 × 4
列出前十个平方数
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}是否知道“5²”表示5 × 5 = 25，“3³”表示3 × 3 × 3 = 27——并且能计算出其他的平方数和立方数吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Understanding fractions
topics.description: Solve problems involving scaling by simple fractions and problems involving simple rates
evidence: A recipe for 4 people needs 200 g of flour — how much for 6 people?
If 3 kg costs £12, how much does 5 kg cost?
Scale a shape by a factor of 1/2 and find the new dimensions
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a recipe serves 4 and {{name}} wants to make it for 6, can they scale up each ingredient — for example, changing '2 cups of flour' to '3 cups'?
topics.descriptionZh: 解决涉及简单分数按比例缩放（scaling）以及简单比率（rates）的问题。
evidenceZh: 4人份的食谱需要200克面粉——6人份需要多少？
如果3千克花费12英镑，5千克花费多少？
将图形按1/2的比例因子（scale factor）进行缩放，并计算新的尺寸
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果一份食谱可供4人食用，而{{name}}想为6人制作，他们能否按比例放大每种食材的用量——例如，将‘2杯面粉’改为‘3杯’？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Brackets in Expressions
topics.description: Use parentheses, brackets, or braces in numerical expressions and evaluate expressions containing these grouping symbols
evidence: Evaluate 3 × (4 + 5) by computing inside the parentheses first
Evaluate {2 × [3 + (7 − 1)]} with nested grouping symbols
Insert parentheses into an expression to make it equal a target value
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} look at '3 × (4 + 5)' and work out the brackets first — getting '3 × 9 = 27' — rather than just multiplying left to right?
topics.descriptionZh: 在数值表达式中使用小括号、中括号或大括号，并计算包含这些分组符号的表达式
evidenceZh: 先计算小括号内的数，求解 3 × (4 + 5)
计算包含嵌套分组符号的 {2 × [3 + (7 − 1)]}
在表达式中插入括号，使其计算结果等于目标值
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否在观察 '3 × (4 + 5)' 时，优先计算括号内的部分——得出 '3 × 9 = 27'——而不是简单地从左到右进行乘法计算？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Decimal place value
topics.description: Multiply one-digit numbers with up to two decimal places by whole numbers (e.g. 3.47 × 6)
evidence: Correctly compute 4.56 × 7 using a written method
Use place-value reasoning to explain why 3.2 × 5 = 16.0
Model a decimal multiplication using an area diagram or expanded form
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} work out '3.47 × 6' — keeping the decimal point in the right place and carrying correctly through each column?
topics.descriptionZh: 将整数部分为一位且最多包含两位小数的数与整数相乘（例如 3.47 × 6）
evidenceZh: 使用笔算方法正确计算 4.56 × 7
运用数位值（place-value）推理来解释为什么 3.2 × 5 = 16.0
使用面积图或展开式（expanded form）对小数乘法进行建模
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否计算出 '3.47 × 6' —— 保持小数点位置正确，并在每一列中正确进位？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Dividing by two-digit numbers
topics.description: Divide numbers up to 4 digits by a two-digit number using formal written short division where appropriate, interpreting remainders according to context
evidence: Use short division to compute 3,648 ÷ 16 efficiently
Explain when short division is more appropriate than long division
Interpret a remainder as a decimal or fraction in a measurement context
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} use short division to work out something like '2,184 ÷ 12' — keeping track of each digit and carrying any remainders into the next column?
topics.descriptionZh: 在适当的情况下，使用规范的书面短除法（short division）将最多4位的数字除以两位数，并根据具体情境解释余数（remainder）。
evidenceZh: 使用短除法（short division）高效计算 3,648 ÷ 16
解释何时短除法比长除法（long division）更适用
在测量情境中将余数（remainder）解释为小数或分数
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否使用短除法（short division）计算类似 '2,184 ÷ 12' 的题目——跟踪每一位数字并将任何余数（remainders）带入下一列？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Division with Decimals
topics.description: Use written division methods in cases where the answer has up to two decimal places; divide decimals to hundredths by whole numbers
evidence: Compute 14.76 ÷ 4 using a written method to get 3.69
Explain how to continue long division past the decimal point to obtain a decimal quotient
Solve a context problem that requires dividing a decimal amount equally (e.g. sharing £18.60 among 5 people)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} use a written method to calculate something like '17 ÷ 4 = 4.25' — carrying the division past the decimal point to get a decimal answer rather than a remainder?
topics.descriptionZh: 在答案最多包含两位小数的情况下使用竖式除法（written division）；将精确到百分位的小数除以整数。
evidenceZh: 使用竖式（written method）计算 14.76 ÷ 4，得出结果 3.69
解释如何将长除法（long division）延续到小数点之后，从而得出小数商（decimal quotient）
解决需要将小数金额平均分配的实际应用题（例如：将 18.60 英镑平分给 5 个人）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否使用竖式（written method）计算类似 '17 ÷ 4 = 4.25' 的题目——将除法运算延续到小数点后以得出小数结果，而不是保留余数？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Division with remainders (age 10+)
topics.description: Divide numbers up to 4 digits by a two-digit divisor using formal written long division, interpreting remainders as whole numbers, fractions, or by rounding as appropriate
evidence: Compute 4,752 ÷ 13 using long division and express the remainder as a fraction
Decide whether to round up or down a division remainder in a real-life context (e.g. buses needed)
Explain each step of the long division algorithm for a 4-digit ÷ 2-digit calculation
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} use long division to work out something like '1,848 ÷ 24' — going through the steps of divide, multiply, subtract, and bring down until they reach the answer?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用正式的竖式长除法 (long division) 计算最多四位数除以两位数的除法，并根据实际情况将余数解释为整数、分数或进行四舍五入。
evidenceZh: 使用长除法计算 4,752 ÷ 13，并将余数表示为分数
在现实生活情境中（例如需要的公交车数量），决定除法余数是向上取整 (round up) 还是向下取整 (round down)
解释四位数除以两位数长除法算法 (algorithm) 的每一个步骤
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否使用长除法 (long division) 计算诸如“1,848 ÷ 24”的题目——依次经历除 (divide)、乘 (multiply)、减 (subtract) 和落下 (bring down) 的步骤，直到得出最终答案？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Estimation to check answers to calculations
topics.description: Use estimation to check answers to calculations and determine, in the context of a problem, an appropriate degree of accuracy
evidence: Estimate 487 × 23 by rounding to 500 × 20 and use this to check a calculated answer
Determine whether an exact answer or an estimate is more appropriate in a given context
Spot an unreasonable answer by comparing with a quick mental estimate
topics.assessmentPrompt: Before {{name}} works out a large multiplication or division, can they estimate what the answer should be roughly — and then check whether their final answer is in the right ballpark?
topics.nameZh: 利用估算检验计算结果
topics.descriptionZh: 利用估算检验计算结果，并根据具体问题的背景确定适当的精确度
evidenceZh: 通过将487 × 23四舍五入为500 × 20来进行估算，并用其检验计算出的答案
在给定情境中判断精确答案或估算答案哪个更合适
通过与快速心算的估算值进行比较来发现不合理的计算结果
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在 {{name}} 计算大数乘除法之前，他们能否大致估算出答案——然后检查最终答案是否在合理范围内？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Long multiplication (age 10+)
topics.description: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers (up to 4 digits by 2 digits) using the formal written method of long multiplication
evidence: Correctly compute 2,463 × 37 using long multiplication
Explain each partial product in a long multiplication and why they are added
Multiply a four-digit number by a two-digit number without procedural errors
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} use long multiplication to work out something like '2,347 × 24' — setting it out in two rows, one for the units and one for the tens, then adding the results?
topics.descriptionZh: 熟练使用长乘法（竖式计算）的正式书面方法，进行多位数整数乘法（最多四位数乘以两位数）。
evidenceZh: 使用长乘法正确计算 2,463 × 37
解释长乘法中的每个部分积（partial product）以及为什么要将它们相加
准确无误地将一个四位数乘以一个两位数，不出现步骤错误
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否使用长乘法计算类似 '2,347 × 24' 的题目——将其分成两行排列，一行计算个位（units）的乘积，一行计算十位（tens）的乘积，然后将结果相加？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Multiplying and dividing (age 10+)
topics.description: Multiply and divide numbers by 10, 100, and 1000 giving answers up to three decimal places, understanding that digits shift position in the place-value chart
evidence: Compute 3.456 × 100 = 345.6 correctly
Compute 45.2 ÷ 1000 = 0.0452 correctly
Explain why multiplying by 10 shifts each digit one place to the left
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} work out '4.6 ÷ 1,000 = 0.0046' — knowing that each division by 10 shifts digits one place to the right, even past the decimal point?
topics.descriptionZh: 将数字乘以或除以10、100和1000，得出最多保留三位小数的结果，并理解数字在数位顺序表（place-value chart）中位置的移动规律。
evidenceZh: 解释为什么乘以10会使每个数字向左移动一个数位
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否算出 '4.6 ÷ 1,000 = 0.0046' —— 并理解每次除以10都会使数字向右移动一个数位，即使越过小数点（decimal point）也是如此？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Multi-step problems: choosing operations
topics.description: Solve problems involving addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, deciding which operations and methods to use and why; solve multi-step problems in contexts
evidence: Solve a three-step word problem involving a mix of all four operations
Explain why particular operations were chosen for each step of a multi-step problem
Identify and correct an error in a multi-step solution that used the wrong operation
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is given a multi-step problem mixing different operations — like working out the total cost of several items at different prices — can they plan and carry out each step correctly?
topics.descriptionZh: 解决涉及加法（Addition）、减法（Subtraction）、乘法（Multiplication）和除法（Division）的问题，决定使用何种运算和解题方法及其原因；在具体情境中解决多步问题。
evidenceZh: 解决一道涉及四则混合运算的三步应用题（Word problem）
解释在多步问题的每一步中选择特定运算的原因
识别并纠正多步解题过程中因使用了错误运算而产生的错误
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果给 {{name}} 出一道混合多种运算的多步问题——例如计算几件不同单价商品的总花费——他们能否正确规划并逐步完成计算？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Order of operations
topics.description: Understand and apply the conventional order of operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS) to carry out calculations involving the four operations
evidence: Explain why 8 + 2 × 5 = 18 (not 50) by referencing multiplication before addition
Evaluate a multi-step expression like 12 ÷ 3 + 4 × 2 correctly as 12
State the correct order: brackets, then orders/exponents, then multiplication/division (L→R), then addition/subtraction (L→R)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees '8 + 4 × 3', do they get 20 — not 36 — because they know to do the multiplication before the addition?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解并应用常规的运算顺序（PEMDAS/BODMAS）来进行涉及四则运算的计算。
evidenceZh: 通过引用“先乘后加”的规则，解释为什么 8 + 2 × 5 = 18（而不是 50）。
正确计算多步表达式，例如将 12 ÷ 3 + 4 × 2 正确计算为 12。
陈述正确的运算顺序：先括号，再指数/幂，然后乘除（从左至右），最后加减（从左至右）。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到“8 + 4 × 3”，他们是否会得出 20（而不是 36），因为他们知道要先算乘法再算加法？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Ratio (age 10+)
topics.description: Perform mental calculations including with mixed operations and large numbers, using strategies such as partitioning, compensation, and derived facts
evidence: Mentally compute 45 × 8 by partitioning into 40 × 8 + 5 × 8
Use known facts to derive 6.5 × 4 mentally
Solve a multi-operation mental calculation such as 250 × 3 + 500 and explain the strategy used
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} work out a mixed calculation like '(200 × 6) + 350 − 75' entirely in their head — keeping track of each step without writing anything down?
topics.descriptionZh: 进行心算，包括包含混合运算和大数的计算，使用拆分（partitioning）、补偿（compensation）和推导事实（derived facts）等策略。
evidenceZh: 通过拆分（partitioning）将45拆分为40和5，心算45 × 8，即计算40 × 8 + 5 × 8
利用已知事实（derived facts）在脑海中推导并心算6.5 × 4
解决诸如250 × 3 + 500的多重混合心算（multi-operation mental calculation），并解释所使用的策略
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否完全依靠心算完成诸如 '(200 × 6) + 350 − 75' 的混合运算，在不落笔的情况下在脑海中理清并跟踪每一个计算步骤？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Rounding Answers
topics.description: Solve problems which require answers to be rounded to specified degrees of accuracy
evidence: Compute a division and round the result to one decimal place as specified
Determine the appropriate degree of accuracy for a measurement context (e.g. round to nearest penny)
Solve a problem where an unrounded decimal answer must be interpreted in context (e.g. whole containers needed)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} calculates an answer of 8.63 but the question asks for it to the nearest whole number, can they round it correctly to 9 — and explain why that level of precision matters in context?
topics.descriptionZh: 解决需要将答案四舍五入（Rounding）到指定精确度（Degree of accuracy）的问题。
evidenceZh: 计算除法并按要求将结果四舍五入保留一位小数（One decimal place）
确定测量情境下合适的精确度（例如：四舍五入到最接近的分（penny））
解决需要结合实际情境解释未舍入小数答案的问题（例如：需要多少个完整的容器）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 计算出的答案是 8.63，但题目要求四舍五入到最接近的整数（Whole number），他们能否正确地将其四舍五入为 9——并解释为什么在实际情境中这种精确度（Precision）很重要？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Writing Number Sentences
topics.description: Write simple numerical expressions that record calculations with numbers, and interpret numerical expressions without evaluating them (e.g. recognise that 3 × (18932 + 921) is three times as large as 18932 + 921)
evidence: Write an expression for 'add 8 and 7, then multiply by 2' using parentheses
Explain what 4 × (365 − 12) represents without computing it
Compare two expressions and determine which is larger without evaluating
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} look at '4 × (5 + 3)' and say 'that's 4 times the result of adding 5 and 3' — reading the expression as a description of a calculation, without having to work it out first?
topics.descriptionZh: 编写简单的数值表达式（numerical expressions）来记录数字计算，并在不求值的情况下解读数值表达式（例如，认识到 3 × (18932 + 921) 是 18932 + 921 的三倍）
evidenceZh: 使用括号写出‘8和7相加，然后乘以2’的表达式
在不计算的情况下，解释 4 × (365 - 12) 表示什么
在不求值的情况下，比较两个表达式并确定哪个更大
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否看着‘4 × (5 + 3)’并说出‘这是5和3相加结果的4倍’——将表达式读作对计算的描述，而不需要先计算出结果？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Factors, multiples, and primes (age 11+)
topics.description: Use the concepts and vocabulary of prime numbers, factors, multiples, common factors, common multiples, highest common factor (HCF), lowest common multiple (LCM), and prime factorisation including product notation and the unique factorisation property
evidence: Express any integer as a product of its prime factors using index notation
Find the HCF and LCM of two numbers using prime factorisation
Apply the unique factorisation theorem to explain why every number has exactly one set of prime factors
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} find the highest common factor of two numbers like 24 and 36 — working out the biggest number that divides exactly into both — and explain how they found it?
topics.nameZh: 因数、倍数与质数（11岁以上）
topics.descriptionZh: 运用质数（prime numbers）、因数（factors）、倍数（multiples）、公因数（common factors）、公倍数（common multiples）、最大公因数（highest common factor, HCF）、最小公倍数（lowest common multiple, LCM）以及质因数分解（prime factorisation）的概念和词汇，包括乘积表示法（product notation）和唯一分解性质（unique factorisation property）。
evidenceZh: 使用指数记数法（index notation）将任意整数表示为其质因数的乘积
使用质因数分解法求两个数的最大公因数（HCF）和最小公倍数（LCM）
应用唯一分解定理（unique factorisation theorem）解释为什么每个数都恰好只有一组质因数
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否求出像 24 和 36 这样两个数的最大公因数（highest common factor）——即找出能同时整除这两个数的最大数——并解释他们是如何求出来的？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Ratio (age 11+)
topics.description: Use conventional notation for the priority of operations including brackets, powers, roots, and reciprocals; apply BIDMAS/BODMAS consistently to evaluate complex numerical expressions
evidence: Evaluate expressions involving brackets, indices, and all four operations in the correct order
Explain why the order of operations is necessary to avoid ambiguity
Use the reciprocal of a number and understand that a number multiplied by its reciprocal gives 1
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} evaluate a complex expression like '5 + 2³ ÷ 4' correctly — applying the right order of operations, handling the power before the division and division before the addition?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用包括括号、幂、根和倒数在内的运算优先级的常规符号；一致地应用BIDMAS/BODMAS（运算顺序法则）来计算复杂的数值表达式
evidenceZh: 按照正确的顺序计算包含括号、指数以及四则运算的表达式
解释为什么必须遵循运算顺序以避免产生歧义
使用一个数的倒数，并理解一个数与其倒数相乘的结果为1
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否正确计算像 '5 + 2³ ÷ 4' 这样的复杂表达式——应用正确的运算顺序，在除法之前处理幂运算，在加法之前处理除法？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Sign Rules for Multiplication
topics.description: Multiply and divide with positive and negative integers and rational numbers, understanding the rules for the sign of the product or quotient
evidence: Apply the sign rules when multiplying two integers (positive × negative, negative × negative)
Apply the sign rules when dividing two integers
Solve multi-step real-world problems involving all four operations with positive and negative rational numbers
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} knows that a negative times a negative makes a positive, can they use that rule to work out calculations like '−3 × −4 = 12' — and explain why it makes sense?
topics.nameZh: 乘法符号法则 (Sign Rules for Multiplication)
topics.descriptionZh: 对正负整数和正负有理数 (rational numbers) 进行乘除运算，理解积或商的符号法则 (rules for the sign of the product or quotient)。
evidenceZh: 在两个整数相乘时应用符号法则（正数×负数、负数×负数）
在两个整数相除时应用符号法则
解决涉及正负有理数四则运算的多步实际问题
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 知道“负负得正”（负数乘以负数得正数），他们能否运用这一法则计算出类似“−3 × −4 = 12”的算式，并解释其合理性？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Using inverse operations
topics.description: Recognise and use relationships between operations including inverse operations; use these relationships to check answers and simplify calculations
evidence: Use addition and subtraction as inverse operations to check and solve problems
Use multiplication and division as inverse operations to check and solve problems
Recognise that squaring and square-rooting are inverse operations
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} works out '252 ÷ 7 = 36', can they immediately use the inverse to check — '36 × 7 = 252' — without having to redo the division?
topics.descriptionZh: 认识并运用运算之间的关系，包括逆运算；利用这些关系来检验答案和简化计算。
evidenceZh: 运用加法和减法作为逆运算来检验和解决问题
运用乘法和除法作为逆运算来检验和解决问题
认识到平方 (squaring) 和开平方 (square-rooting) 是逆运算
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 计算出 '252 ÷ 7 = 36'，他们能否立即使用逆运算来检验——即 '36 × 7 = 252'——而不需要重新计算除法？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Number Words to Twenty
topics.description: Read and write number words from one to twenty
evidence: Read the word 'twelve' and identify it as 12
Write the word form of a given number 1–20
Match numeral cards to number word cards
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write number words like 'fourteen' or 'twenty' — and read them on a birthday card or in a story book without needing help?
topics.descriptionZh: 认读和拼写1至20的数词
evidenceZh: 认读单词“twelve”并识别为数字12
拼写1至20内给定数字的英文单词
将数字卡片与数词卡片进行匹配
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否写出像“fourteen”或“twenty”这样的数词，并在生日贺卡或故事书中无需帮助即可独立认读？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Reading and writing numbers to 100
topics.description: Read and write numerals from 0 to 100
evidence: Read two-digit numerals up to 100 correctly
Write any number 0–100 as a numeral from dictation
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read and write any number up to 100 — both as a numeral and by saying what it means?
topics.descriptionZh: 读出并写出0到100的数字
evidenceZh: 正确读出100以内的两位数
根据听写写出0到100的任意数字
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否读写100以内的任意数字——既能写出数字，又能说出其含义？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Reading and writing numbers to 20
topics.description: Read and write numerals from 0 to 20
evidence: Read any numeral 0–20 when shown it
Write numerals 0–20 legibly from dictation
Represent a number of objects with the correct written numeral
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read a number like '17' written on paper and write it themselves — and do they know what each digit means?
topics.descriptionZh: 认读和书写0到20的阿拉伯数字
evidenceZh: 看到0到20之间的任意数字时能正确认读
能听写并清晰、工整地书写0到20的数字
能用正确的数字表示物体的数量
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否读懂纸上写的像 '17' 这样的数字并自己写出来——并且他们知道每个数字（digit）代表的意义吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: The teen numbers
topics.description: Understand that the teen numbers (11–19) are composed of ten ones and some further ones (early place value)
evidence: Compose 14 as a group of ten and four ones using objects
Decompose 17 into 10 + 7 and record as an equation
Explain that 13 is 'one ten and three ones'
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} has 14 building blocks, can they see it as one full tower of 10 and 4 left over — understanding 'teen' numbers as ten-and-some-more?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解十几的数（11-19）是由1个十和几个一组成的（早期位值概念 early place value）
evidenceZh: 使用实物将14组合成1个十和4个一
将17分解为10 + 7并记录为等式
解释13是“1个十和3个一”
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果{{name}}有14块积木，他们能将其看作1座完整的10块积木塔和剩余的4块积木吗——从而理解“十几”的数就是“十和几”？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 10 More or 10 Less
topics.description: Mentally find 10 more or 10 less than a given two-digit number without counting
evidence: Given 56, quickly say 66 is 10 more and 46 is 10 less
Explain that adding 10 increases the tens digit by 1
Answer '10 more than 73' without using fingers or counting on
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} quickly tell you what is 10 more than 43 or 10 less than 71 — without counting up or down one at a time?
topics.descriptionZh: 不通过逐个计数，心算出给定两位数多10或少10的结果
evidenceZh: 给出56，能快速说出66是多10，46是少10
解释加10会使十位数字（tens digit）增加1
不使用手指或逐个往后数，直接回答‘比73多10’
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否不逐个往上或往下数，快速告诉你比43多10是多少，或者比71少10是多少？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: A Ten Is Ten Ones
topics.description: Understand that 10 can be thought of as a bundle of ten ones — called a 'ten'
evidence: Group 10 single cubes into one rod of 10 and explains why
Explain that 10 ones is the same as 1 ten
Exchange 10 ones for a single tens block
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain that ten single objects bundled together make 'one ten' — and that this is why we write 10 with a 1 in the tens place and a 0 in the ones place?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解10可以看作是一捆十个一（a bundle of ten ones）——称为一个“十”（a 'ten'）
evidenceZh: 将10个单个的小方块（single cubes）组合成一根包含10个小方块的长条（rod of 10），并解释原因
解释10个“一”（10 ones）与1个“十”（1 ten）是相同的
用10个“一”（10 ones）兑换一个“十位积木”（tens block）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否解释将十个单独的物品捆在一起（bundled together）构成了“一个十”（one ten）——并且说明这就是为什么我们在十位（tens place）写1，在个位（ones place）写0来表示数字10？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Comparing and ordering numbers
topics.description: Compare and order two-digit numbers using the symbols >, =, and <, based on place value understanding
evidence: Correctly place > or < between 34 and 43
Order a set of two-digit numbers from smallest to largest
Explain a comparison by referring to the tens digit first, then ones
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you show {{name}} the numbers 34, 67, and 21, can they put them in order from smallest to largest — and use the symbols > or < correctly?
topics.descriptionZh: 基于对数位（place value）的理解，使用符号 >、= 和 < 来比较和排序两位数
evidenceZh: 在34和43之间正确放置 > 或 < 符号
将一组两位数按从小到大的顺序排列
通过先比较十位数字（tens digit），再比较个位数字（ones digit）来解释比较过程
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果你向 {{name}} 展示数字 34、67 和 21，他们能把这些数字按从小到大的顺序排列，并正确使用 > 或 < 符号吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Number Words to 100
topics.description: Read and write numbers to at least 100 in words
evidence: Read 'fifty-seven' and write the numeral 57
Write 'eighty-three' when shown the numeral 83
Read and write all decade words (twenty, thirty … ninety) correctly
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write 'seventy-four' or 'one hundred and three' as number words — and read them correctly when they appear in a book or on a sign?
topics.descriptionZh: 能够用英文单词读出和写出至少到100的数字
evidenceZh: 读出单词“fifty-seven”并写出对应的数字57
看到数字83时，能写出对应的单词“eighty-three”
能正确读出和写出所有的整十数英文单词（twenty, thirty … ninety）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否将“seventy-four”或“one hundred and three”写成英文单词，并在书本或告示牌上看到这些单词时正确读出？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Place value understanding and number facts
topics.description: Use place value understanding and number facts to solve problems
evidence: Use knowledge that 34 = 30 + 4 to help add 34 + 20 = 54
Solve 'I think of a number, add 10, and get 45. What was my number?'
Apply partitioning to solve a problem in an unfamiliar context
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is asked 'which number is closest to 50 — 47 or 54?', can they use their number knowledge to answer quickly and explain why?
topics.nameZh: 数位理解与基本数事实
topics.descriptionZh: 运用数位理解和基本数事实来解决数学问题
evidenceZh: 运用34 = 30 + 4的知识来帮助计算34 + 20 = 54
解决‘我想了一个数，加上10后得到45。我原来想的数是多少？’的问题
运用拆分法（partitioning）解决陌生情境中的问题
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果问{{name}}‘哪个数字最接近50——47还是54？’，他们能否运用数位知识快速回答并解释原因？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Reading and writing numbers to 120
topics.description: Count to 120 starting at any number less than 120; read and write numerals to 120
evidence: Count from 47 to 120 without errors
Read the numeral 108 correctly
Write the numeral for one hundred and fifteen
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} start counting from any number up to 120 — for example, starting at 87 and counting up to 120 without losing track?
topics.descriptionZh: 从120以内的任意数字开始数到120；读写120以内的数字
evidenceZh: 从47数到120且不出错
正确读出数字108
写出“一百一十五”对应的数字
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否从120以内的任意数字开始数数——例如，从87开始一直数到120而不数错或漏数？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Representing Numbers
topics.description: Identify, represent, and estimate numbers using different representations including the number line
evidence: Place a two-digit number on a 0–100 number line in approximately the right position
Estimate 'about how many' objects are in a set of 30–50 without counting
Represent the same number using base-ten blocks, a number line, and a drawing
Represent a three-digit number using base-ten blocks, a number line, or a place-value chart
Estimate where a number falls on a 0–1000 number line
Match a base-ten representation to the correct numeral
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} show a number like 346 in different ways — as base-ten blocks, on a number line, or as a drawing — and explain what each representation shows?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用不同的表示方法（包括数轴）来识别、表示和估算数字。
evidenceZh: 在0-100的数轴上大约正确的位置标出一个两位数
在不数数的情况下，估算30到50个物体的集合中“大约有多少”个物体
使用十进制积木、数轴和图画来表示同一个数字
使用十进制积木、数轴或数位顺序表来表示一个三位数
估算一个数字在0-1000数轴上的大致位置
将十进制表示法与正确的数字进行匹配
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否用不同的方式（如十进制积木、数轴或图画）展示像 346 这样的数字，并解释每种表示方法所代表的含义？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: The multiples of 10
topics.description: Understand that the multiples of 10 (10, 20, 30 … 90) represent one to nine tens and 0 ones
evidence: Explain that 30 means 3 tens and 0 ones
Represent 50 using 5 tens rods and no unit cubes
Match decade numbers to their tens representation
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain that 60 means 6 tens and no ones — and that this is why the ones column has a zero as a placeholder?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解10的倍数（10、20、30……90）代表1到9个十（tens）和0个一（ones）
evidenceZh: 解释30代表3个十（tens）和0个一（ones）
使用5个十位计数棒（tens rods）且不使用任何单位方块（unit cubes）来表示50
将整十数（decade numbers）与其对应的十的表示形式相匹配
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否解释60代表6个十（tens）和0个一（ones）——并说明这就是为什么个位（ones column）需要用零作为占位符（placeholder）？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: The two digits of a two-digit number
topics.description: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones
evidence: Explain that in 47, the 4 represents 4 tens (40) and the 7 represents 7 ones
Use base-ten blocks to show a two-digit number as tens and ones
Identify the tens digit and ones digit in any two-digit number
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees the number 47, can they tell you there are 4 tens (forty) and 7 ones — rather than just reading the digits as 'four seven'?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解两位数的两个数字分别代表几个十和几个一
evidenceZh: 解释在数字47中，4代表4个十（40），7代表7个一
使用十进制积木（base-ten blocks）将两位数表示为几个十和几个一
识别任意两位数中的十位数字和个位数字
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到数字 47，他们能告诉你这代表 4 个十（四十）和 7 个一，而不是仅仅把数字读作‘四七’吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 10 or 100 More or Less
topics.description: Find 10 or 100 more or less than a given number up to 1000
evidence: Given a three-digit number, state what is 10 more and 10 less
Given a three-digit number, state what is 100 more and 100 less
Explain the strategy using place-value understanding (e.g. only the tens/hundreds digit changes)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} quickly work out '10 more than 342' or '100 less than 875' in their head — knowing which digit changes and which stays the same?
topics.descriptionZh: 计算1000以内的给定数多10/100或少10/100的结果
evidenceZh: 给定一个三位数，说出比它多10和少10的数
给定一个三位数，说出比它多100和少100的数
运用位值（place value）理解来解释策略（例如：只有十位或百位上的数字发生变化）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否在脑海中快速算出‘比342多10’或‘比875少100’的结果——清楚知道哪个数位（digit）上的数字变了，哪个没变？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: A Hundred Is Ten Tens
topics.description: Understand that 100 can be thought of as a bundle of ten tens — called a 'hundred'
evidence: Explain that 10 groups of 10 ones make 100
Bundle ten tens sticks into one hundred and describe what happened
Represent 100 using base-ten blocks showing 10 tens
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain that ten full tens stacked together make one hundred — and that this is why 100 has a 1 in the hundreds place and zeros in the rest?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解100可以被看作是一捆十个十——被称为‘一百’
evidenceZh: 解释10组10个一组成100
将十个十（ten tens）捆成一捆变成一百，并描述发生了什么
使用十进制积木（base-ten blocks）表示100，展示10个十
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否解释十个十组合在一起构成一百——以及这就是为什么100在百位（hundreds place）上是1，而其余数位上是0？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Odd or Even
topics.description: Determine whether a group of objects (up to 20) has an odd or even number of members
evidence: Pair objects and determine whether there is one left over (odd) or not (even)
Count a group by 2s to determine if the total is even
Write an equation to express an even number as a sum of two equal addends (e.g. 8 = 4 + 4)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} has a group of 14 objects, can they tell you whether that number is odd or even — for example by pairing them up to see if any are left over?
topics.descriptionZh: 判断一组物体（最多20个）的数量是奇数还是偶数
evidenceZh: 将物体两两配对，判断是否有一个剩余（奇数）或没有剩余（偶数）
两个两个地数一组物体，以确定总数是否为偶数
写出等式将一个偶数表示为两个相同加数的和（例如：8 = 4 + 4）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 有一组14个物体，他们能告诉你这个数量是奇数还是偶数吗——例如，通过将它们两两配对来查看是否有剩余？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Ordering Numbers to 1000
topics.description: Compare and order numbers up to 1000 using >, =, and < symbols, based on place-value understanding
evidence: Compare two three-digit numbers by examining hundreds first, then tens, then ones
Use >, =, and < correctly to record comparisons of three-digit numbers
Order a set of numbers up to 1000 from smallest to largest
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you give {{name}} a set of three-digit numbers like 456, 231, and 789, can they put them in order and use > and < correctly?
topics.descriptionZh: 基于对数位（place value）的理解，使用>、=和<符号比较和排序1000以内的数
evidenceZh: 先比较百位，再比较十位，最后比较个位，从而比较两个三位数
正确使用>、=和<符号记录三位数的比较结果
将一组1000以内的数从小到大排序
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果给{{name}}一组三位数，比如456、231和789，他们能把它们按顺序排好，并正确使用>和<符号吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Place Value to 1000
topics.description: Solve number problems and practical problems involving place value of numbers up to 1000
evidence: Solve a problem that requires identifying how many hundreds, tens, or ones are in a number
Apply place-value knowledge to a practical context (e.g. counting money in pounds)
Explain the strategy used to solve a place-value problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is told 'I have 4 hundreds, 3 tens, and 7 ones — what number is that?', can they put it together and tell you 437?
topics.descriptionZh: 解决涉及1000以内数字数位 (Place Value) 的数学问题及实际问题
evidenceZh: 解决需要识别一个数中包含多少个百、十或一的问题
将数位 (Place Value) 知识应用于实际情境（例如，计算英镑金额）
解释解决数位问题所使用的策略
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果有人告诉{{name}}：‘我有4个百、3个十和7个一——这是什么数？’，他们能将其组合并说出437吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Reading and writing numbers to 1000
topics.description: Read and write numbers to 1000 in numerals, number names, and expanded form
evidence: Read a three-digit numeral aloud correctly
Write a three-digit number in words (e.g. 'three hundred and forty-two')
Write a number in expanded form (e.g. 600 + 30 + 7)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read and write numbers up to 1,000 — both as numerals and in words — like reading '642' as 'six hundred and forty-two'?
topics.descriptionZh: 以数字、中文读数（number names）和展开式（expanded form）读写1000以内的数
evidenceZh: 正确朗读三位数
用汉字写出三位数（例如“三百四十二”）
用展开式（expanded form）写出数字（例如 600 + 30 + 7）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否读写1000以内的数——包括数字和中文读数——例如将“642”读作“六百四十二”？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: The multiples of 100
topics.description: Understand that the multiples of 100 (100–900) each represent a number of hundreds with 0 tens and 0 ones
evidence: Identify that 300 means 3 hundreds, 0 tens, 0 ones
Place multiples of 100 on a number line to 1000
Read and write multiples of 100 and explain their place-value structure
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain that 700 means 7 hundreds with no tens and no ones — and show what that looks like using base-ten blocks or a drawing?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解100的倍数（100–900）各自代表一定数量的百（hundreds），而十（tens）位和个（ones）位上均为0
evidenceZh: 识别出300表示3个百（hundreds）、0个十（tens）、0个一（ones）
在数轴（number line）上标出1000以内的100的倍数
读写100的倍数，并解释其位值（place-value）结构
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否解释700表示7个百，没有十和个——并使用十进制积木（base-ten blocks）或画图来展示其具体含义？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: The three digits of a three-digit number
topics.description: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones
evidence: State the value of each digit in a three-digit number (e.g. in 362, the 3 represents 3 hundreds)
Partition a three-digit number into hundreds, tens, and ones (e.g. 485 = 400 + 80 + 5)
Explain why 706 has 7 hundreds, 0 tens, and 6 ones
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees the number 348, can they tell you there are 3 hundreds, 4 tens, and 8 ones — rather than just reading the digits as 'three four eight'?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解三位数的三个数位分别代表几个百（hundreds）、几个十（tens）和几个一（ones）。
evidenceZh: 说出三位数中每个数位的值（例如，在362中，3代表3个百）
将三位数拆分为几个百、几个十和几个一（例如，485 = 400 + 80 + 5）
解释为什么706包含7个百、0个十和6个一
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到数字348，他们能告诉你这代表3个百、4个十和8个一，而不是仅仅把数字读作“三、四、八”吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 1000 More or Less
topics.description: Find 1000 more or less than a given number
evidence: Given 4,562, state that 1000 more is 5,562 and 1000 less is 3,562
Explain using place value that only the thousands digit changes
Apply this skill to numbers beyond 10,000
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} quickly work out '1,000 more than 3,456' or '1,000 less than 7,200' in their head — knowing only the thousands digit changes?
topics.descriptionZh: 计算一个给定数字加1000或减1000的结果
evidenceZh: 利用数位（place value）解释只有千位（thousands digit）上的数字会发生变化
将此技能应用到大于10,000的数字上
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否在脑海中快速算出“比3,456多1,000”或“比7,200少1,000”的结果——并且知道只有千位上的数字会发生变化？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Comparing Large Numbers
topics.description: Order and compare numbers beyond 1000
evidence: Compare two four-digit numbers using >, <, and = by examining digits from the highest place value
Order a set of numbers up to 10,000 from smallest to largest
Justify the ordering using place-value reasoning
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} put a set of four-digit numbers like 4,321, 1,876, and 9,045 in order from smallest to largest — comparing them digit by digit?
topics.descriptionZh: 对1000以上的数字进行排序与比较
evidenceZh: 通过从最高数位（place value）开始逐位检查，使用 >、< 和 = 符号来比较两个四位数
将一组10,000以内的数字按从小到大的顺序排列
运用数位值推理（place-value reasoning）来解释排序的合理性
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否将一组四位数（例如 4,321、1,876 和 9,045）按从小到大的顺序排列——逐位进行比较？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Negative Numbers
topics.description: Count backwards through zero to include negative numbers
evidence: Count backwards from 5 through zero: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0, −1, −2 …
Place negative numbers on a number line
Understand that negative numbers are less than zero and use them in context (e.g. temperature)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} count backwards past zero into negative numbers — like 3, 2, 1, 0, −1, −2, −3 — without hesitating at zero?
topics.descriptionZh: 倒数经过零，将负数纳入计数范围
evidenceZh: 在数轴 (number line) 上标出负数
理解负数小于零，并在实际情境（如温度）中应用负数
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否倒数穿过零进入负数区域——例如 3, 2, 1, 0, −1, −2, −3——并且在经过零时毫不迟疑？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Numbers to 10,000
topics.description: Identify, represent, and estimate numbers up to 10,000 using different representations
evidence: Represent a four-digit number on a place-value chart or with base-ten materials
Estimate where a number falls on a 0–10,000 number line
Match different representations of the same number (e.g. expanded form, place-value counters, numeral)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} mark a number like 6,400 roughly in the right place on a number line that goes from 0 to 10,000 — and explain how they decided where to put it?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用不同的表示方法识别、表示和估算10000以内的数
evidenceZh: 在数位顺序表（place-value chart）上或使用十进制教具（base-ten materials）表示一个四位数
估算一个数在0到10000的数轴（number line）上的位置
匹配同一数字的不同表示形式（例如：展开式（expanded form）、数位计数器（place-value counters）、数字（numeral））
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否在从0到10000的数轴上大致准确地标出像6400这样的数——并解释他们是如何决定将其放在那个位置的？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Place value of each digit
topics.description: Recognise the place value of each digit in a four-digit number (thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones)
evidence: State the value of each digit in a four-digit number (e.g. in 7,345 the 7 represents 7 thousands)
Partition a four-digit number into thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones
Compose a four-digit number from given place-value parts (e.g. 3000 + 400 + 50 + 2 = 3,452)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees the number 5,347, can they tell you the value of each digit — that the 5 means 5,000, the 3 means 300, the 4 means 40, and the 7 means 7?
topics.descriptionZh: 识别四位数中每个数字的位值（千位、百位、十位和个位）
evidenceZh: 说出四位数中每个数字的值（例如，在7,345中，7代表7个千）
将四位数拆分为千位、百位、十位和个位部分
根据给定的位值部分组合成四位数（例如，3000 + 400 + 50 + 2 = 3,452）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果 {{name}} 看到数字 5,347，他们能告诉你每个数字的值吗——即 5 代表 5,000，3 代表 300，4 代表 40，7 代表 7？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Place Value Problem-Solving
topics.description: Solve number and practical problems involving place value with increasingly large positive numbers
evidence: Solve a problem requiring rounding, comparing, or ordering numbers beyond 1000
Apply place-value knowledge in a practical context (e.g. population figures, distances)
Explain the strategy used, referencing place-value understanding
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is asked 'what is the largest 4-digit even number you can make from the digits 3, 7, 1, and 8?', can they work through it systematically and give you an answer?
topics.nameZh: 位值 (Place Value) 问题解决
topics.descriptionZh: 解决涉及不断增大的正数的位值 (Place Value) 计算和实际应用问题。
evidenceZh: 解决需要四舍五入 (rounding)、比较或排序 (ordering) 1000以上数字的问题
在实际情境（如人口数据、距离）中应用位值 (Place Value) 知识
解释所采用的策略，并结合对位值 (Place Value) 的理解进行说明
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果问 {{name}} ‘用数字 3、7、1 和 8 能组成的最大的4位偶数是什么？’，他们能否有条理地推导并给出答案？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Roman numerals to 100
topics.description: Read Roman numerals to 100 (I to C) and understand that the numeral system changed over time to include zero and place value
evidence: Read and write Roman numerals I, V, X, L, C and combinations up to 100
Convert between Roman numerals and Hindu-Arabic numerals (e.g. XLIV = 44)
Explain that Roman numerals have no zero and no place-value system
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read Roman numerals like XIV (14) or XLII (42) — and do they know why we stopped using Roman numerals for most things once zero and place value were invented?
topics.descriptionZh: 认读100以内（I到C）的罗马数字，并理解数字系统随时间演变，引入了零（zero）和位值（place value）的概念。
evidenceZh: 认读和书写罗马数字I、V、X、L、C以及100以内的组合
在罗马数字和印度-阿拉伯数字（Hindu-Arabic numerals）之间进行转换（例如：XLIV = 44）
解释罗马数字中没有零（zero），也没有位值制（place-value system）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能认读像 XIV（14）或 XLII（42）这样的罗马数字吗？他们是否知道为什么在发明了零（zero）和位值制（place value）之后，我们在大多数情况下就不再使用罗马数字了？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Rounding to 10, 100, 1000
topics.description: Round any number to the nearest 10, 100, or 1000
evidence: Explain the rounding rule using a number line (which multiple is closer)
Apply rounding to estimate calculations
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} round a number like 4,738 to the nearest 10 (4,740), 100 (4,700), or 1,000 (5,000) — and explain which digit they look at to decide?
topics.nameZh: 四舍五入到十位、百位、千位 (Rounding to 10, 100, 1000)
topics.descriptionZh: 将任何数字四舍五入 (rounding) 到最接近的10、100或1000。
evidenceZh: 利用数轴 (number line) 解释四舍五入规则（哪个倍数更接近）
应用四舍五入来估算计算结果
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否将诸如 4,738 的数字四舍五入到最接近的十位（4,740）、百位（4,700）或千位（5,000），并解释他们观察哪个数位（digit）来做决定？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Counting forwards and backwards (age 9+)
topics.description: Count forwards and backwards in steps of powers of 10 (10, 100, 1000, 10,000, 100,000) for any given number up to 1,000,000
evidence: Count on in 10,000s from 462,000
Count back in 100,000s from 800,000
Identify the next three terms: 375,000; 475,000; 575,000; ...
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} count forwards and backwards in steps of 1,000 or 10,000 from any starting number — like 34,500, 44,500, 54,500 — without losing track?
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否从任意起始数字（如34,500、44,500、54,500）开始，以1,000或10,000为步长进行顺数和倒数而不数错？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Negative numbers in context
topics.description: Interpret negative numbers in context (temperature, sea level, bank balance); count forwards and backwards with positive and negative whole numbers, including through zero
evidence: Place –3, –1, 0, 2, 5 on a number line
The temperature is –4°C and rises by 7 degrees — what is the new temperature?
Count backwards from 3 in ones: 3, 2, 1, 0, –1, –2
topics.assessmentPrompt: If the temperature drops to −5°C overnight and rises to 3°C by day, can {{name}} place both on a number line and say how many degrees warmer the daytime temperature is?
topics.descriptionZh: 在实际情境（如温度、海平面、银行余额）中理解负数；对正负整数进行顺数和倒数，包括跨越零
evidenceZh: 温度是 –4°C，上升了 7 度——新的温度是多少？
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果夜间温度降至 −5°C，白天升至 3°C，{{name}} 能否将这两个温度标在数轴上，并说出白天比夜间高多少度？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Place Value × 10 Pattern
topics.description: Recognise that in a multi-digit whole number, a digit in one place represents ten times what it represents in the place to its right (e.g. 700 ÷ 70 = 10)
evidence: Explain that the 3 in 3,000 is ten times the 3 in 300
Complete: 700 ÷ 70 = __ and explain using place-value reasoning
State how many times greater the value of the 5 in 50,000 is than the 5 in 5,000
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain that in 700, the 7 is worth 10 times more than in 70 — because moving one place to the left multiplies the value by 10?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解在多位整数中，任何一个数位上的数字所表示的值（place value），都是其右边相邻数位上数字所表示值的10倍（例如：700 ÷ 70 = 10）。
evidenceZh: 解释3,000里的3是300里的3的10倍
完成填空：700 ÷ 70 = __，并用数位值（place value）原理进行解释
说出50,000里的5所代表的值是5,000里的5所代表的值的多少倍
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否解释：在700中，7所代表的值是70中7的10倍——因为向左移动一个数位，数值就会乘以10？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Reading and writing numbers (age 9+)
topics.description: Read, write, order, and compare whole numbers up to at least 1,000,000 using base-ten numerals, number names, expanded form, and place-value understanding
evidence: Write 403,072 in words and in expanded form
Compare 548,301 and 543,801 using < and explain the reasoning
Order four six-digit numbers from smallest to largest
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read and write numbers into the millions — like 1,340,000 — and put a set of large numbers in order correctly?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用十进制数字（base-ten numerals）、数字名称（number names）、展开式（expanded form）和数位值（place-value）概念，读写、排序和比较至少达到1,000,000的整数。
evidenceZh: 用数字名称（number names）和展开式（expanded form）写出403,072
使用小于号（<）比较548,301和543,801，并解释推理过程
将四个六位数从小到大排序
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否读写百万级以上的数字（例如 1,340,000），并将一组大数正确排序？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Roman numerals to 1000
topics.description: Read Roman numerals to 1000 (M) and recognise years written in Roman numerals
evidence: Read MCMXCIX as 1999
Write 2024 in Roman numerals (MMXXIV)
Explain the subtractive principle: IV = 4 not IIII
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read Roman numerals like MMXIX (2019) or CDXLIV (444) — and recognise the year a film or building was made when it's shown in Roman numerals?
topics.descriptionZh: 阅读1000（M）以内的罗马数字，并识别用罗马数字表示的年份
evidenceZh: 将MCMXCIX读作1999
用罗马数字写出2024（MMXXIV）
解释减法原则（subtraction principle）：IV = 4 而不是 IIII
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能读懂像MMXIX（2019）或CDXLIV（444）这样的罗马数字吗？——并且当电影或建筑的制作年份以罗马数字显示时，能识别出是哪一年吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Rounding Large Numbers
topics.description: Round any whole number up to 1,000,000 to the nearest 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000, or 100,000 using place-value understanding
evidence: Round 456,782 to the nearest 10,000 (460,000)
Round 950,500 to the nearest 100,000 and explain the boundary case
Use rounding to estimate the sum of 387,412 + 214,560
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} round a large number like 346,712 to the nearest 1,000 (347,000) or 10,000 (350,000) — identifying which digit to look at for each rounding?
topics.nameZh: 大数的四舍五入 (Rounding Large Numbers)
topics.descriptionZh: 利用对数位（place value）的理解，将一百万以内的任何整数四舍五入（rounding）到最接近的十、百、千、万或十万。
evidenceZh: 将456,782四舍五入到最接近的万位（460,000）
将950,500四舍五入到最接近的十万位，并解释边界情况（boundary case）
利用四舍五入估算 387,412 + 214,560 的和
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否将像 346,712 这样的大数四舍五入到最接近的千位（347,000）或万位（350,000）——并准确指出在四舍五入时需要观察哪一位数字？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Working with Large Numbers
topics.description: Solve number and practical problems involving reading, writing, ordering, comparing, and rounding whole numbers up to 1,000,000
evidence: What is the largest six-digit number with digits summing to 15?
A stadium holds 67,450 people. Round to the nearest thousand for a news report
Order the populations of five cities and find the difference between the largest and smallest
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is told the population of a city is 2,347,819, can they read that number aloud correctly and say roughly how many millions it is?
topics.descriptionZh: 解决涉及读取、书写、排序、比较和舍入（四舍五入）高达1,000,000（一百万）的整数的数值与实际应用问题。
evidenceZh: 各位数字之和为15的最大六位数是多少？
一个体育场可容纳67,450人。为新闻报道将其人数四舍五入到千位（精确到千位）。
对五个城市的人口数量进行排序，并计算人口最多与最少的城市之间的差值。
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果告诉 {{name}} 某城市的人口为2,347,819，他们能否正确地读出这个数字，并说出它大约是几百万？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Decimal place value
topics.description: Round decimals to any place using place-value understanding; round any whole number to a required degree of accuracy
evidence: Round 3.4567 to 2 decimal places (3.46)
Use rounding to estimate 4.83 × 2.17 ≈ 5 × 2 = 10
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} round a decimal like 3.748 to one decimal place (3.7) or two decimal places (3.75) — and explain which digit they look at to decide?
topics.descriptionZh: 运用位值 (place value) 概念将小数四舍五入到任意数位；将任意整数四舍五入到所需的精确度 (degree of accuracy)
evidenceZh: 将 3.4567 四舍五入到两位小数 (decimal places)（3.46）
使用四舍五入 (rounding) 进行估算：4.83 × 2.17 ≈ 5 × 2 = 10
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否将像 3.748 这样的小数四舍五入到一位小数 (one decimal place)（3.7）或两位小数 (two decimal places)（3.75）——并解释他们观察哪一位数字来做出决定？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Measuring temperature
topics.description: Use negative numbers in context (temperature, finance, sea level); calculate intervals across zero
evidence: The temperature falls from 3°C to −5°C — what is the drop? (8 degrees)
Calculate the difference between a bank balance of −£120 and £350
Order −7, −3, 0, 2, 5 on a number line and find the interval from −7 to 5
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a bank account goes from −£45 to +£120, can {{name}} work out the total change — counting through zero to get £165?
topics.descriptionZh: 在实际情境中使用负数（温度、财务、海平面）；计算跨越零点的区间（interval across zero）
evidenceZh: 温度从3°C下降到−5°C——下降了多少度？（8度）
计算银行账户余额−120英镑和350英镑之间的差额
在数轴（number line）上对−7、−3、0、2、5进行排序，并找出从−7到5的区间
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果一个银行账户从−45英镑变为+120英镑，{{name}}能计算出总变化吗——跨越零点计算得出165英镑？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Numbers to Ten Million
topics.description: Solve number and practical problems involving reading, writing, ordering, comparing, rounding, and negative numbers up to 10,000,000
evidence: A country's population is 8,274,500 — round to the nearest million for a headline
Order the depths of three ocean trenches given in metres including negative values
Estimate the total attendance at three events by rounding each to the nearest 100,000
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} reads that the distance to the Moon is about 384,400 km, can they round it to the nearest 10,000 km and say whether it's closer to 380,000 or 390,000?
topics.descriptionZh: 解决涉及读写、排序、比较、四舍五入以及高达10,000,000（一千万）的负数的数字和实际问题。
evidenceZh: 某国人口为8,274,500——为新闻标题四舍五入到最接近的百万位
对三个海沟的深度（以米为单位，包括负值）进行排序
通过将每个活动的参与人数四舍五入到最接近的十万位，估算三次活动的总参与人数
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果{{name}}读到地月距离约为384,400公里，他们能将其四舍五入到最接近的10,000公里，并说明它更接近380,000还是390,000吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Patterns with Powers of Ten
topics.description: Explain patterns in zeros when multiplying by powers of 10 and in decimal-point placement when multiplying/dividing by a power of 10; use whole-number exponents to denote powers of 10 (e.g. 10³ = 1000)
evidence: Write 10⁴ = 10,000 and explain the exponent means four factors of 10
Explain why 3.4 × 10² = 340 by describing the decimal shift
Predict 2.56 × 10³ without calculating and explain the pattern
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain why 10² = 100 and 10³ = 1,000, and why multiplying by 10 just adds a zero — connecting the pattern of zeros to place value?
topics.descriptionZh: 解释乘以10的乘方时末尾零的个数规律，以及乘除10的乘方时小数点移动的规律；使用整数指数（exponents）来表示10的乘方（例如：10³ = 1000）。
evidenceZh: 写出 10⁴ = 10,000，并解释指数（exponent）代表四个10相乘
通过描述小数点移位（decimal shift）来解释为什么 3.4 × 10² = 340
无需计算即可预测 2.56 × 10³ 的结果，并解释其中的规律
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否解释为什么 10² = 100 且 10³ = 1,000，以及为什么乘以10只需在末尾加一个零——并将零的个数规律与数位（place value）的概念联系起来？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Place Value × 10 and ÷ 10
topics.description: Recognise that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left
evidence: Explain that the 4 in 0.04 is 1/10 of the 4 in 0.4
State that a digit moving one place left is ×10 and one place right is ÷10
Compare the value of the 6 in 6,000 and in 0.006
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain that in 4.56, the digit 5 is worth 5 tenths — ten times less than the 5 in 54, and ten times more than the 5 in 0.056?
topics.descriptionZh: 认识到在多位数中，某一位上的数字所代表的值是其右侧相邻数位上数字所代表值的10倍，是其左侧相邻数位上数字所代表值的1/10。
evidenceZh: 说明数字向左移动一位代表乘10（×10），向右移动一位代表除10（÷10）
比较6,000中的6与0.006中的6所代表的数值
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否解释在4.56中，数字5代表5个十分之一——它是54中数字5的十分之一，并且是0.056中数字5的十倍？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Reading and writing numbers (age 10+)
topics.description: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form; compare using >, =, < based on place-value meaning
evidence: Compare 0.372 and 0.38 using place-value reasoning
Write 'five and sixty-two thousandths' as 5.062
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read and write decimals like 3.047 or 0.625, say what each digit means (3 ones, 0 tenths, 4 hundredths, 7 thousandths), and put a set of decimals in order?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用十进制数字（base-ten numerals）、数字读法（number names）和展开式（expanded form）读写并比较精确到千分位的小数；根据数位（place-value）的意义使用 >、=、< 进行比较。
evidenceZh: 使用数位（place-value）推理比较 0.372 和 0.38
将“五又千分之六十二”（five and sixty-two thousandths）写为 5.062
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否读写像 3.047 或 0.625 这样的小数，说出每个数位的含义（3个一，0个十分之一，4个百分之一，7个千分之一），并将一组小数按顺序排列？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Reading and writing numbers to 10,000,000
topics.description: Read, write, order, and compare numbers up to 10,000,000 and determine the value of each digit
evidence: Write 4,302,561 in words
Order four seven-digit numbers from smallest to largest
State the value of the 7 in 7,045,200 as seven million
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read and write numbers up to 10 million — like 4,302,617 — and say the value of any digit in the number?
topics.descriptionZh: 读、写、排序并比较10,000,000以内的数，并确定每个数位的值
evidenceZh: 将四个七位数从小到大排序
指出7,045,200中数字7的值为七百万
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否读写10,000,000以内的数（如4,302,617），并说出该数中任意数位的值？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Reading Decimal Places
topics.description: Identify the value of each digit in numbers given to three decimal places (e.g. in 4.378, the 7 represents 7 hundredths)
evidence: State the value of each digit in 2.635 (2 ones, 6 tenths, 3 hundredths, 5 thousandths)
Explain the relationship between adjacent decimal places (each place is ten times smaller)
Write a number given digit values (e.g. 4 ones, 0 tenths, 7 hundredths, 3 thousandths = 4.073)
topics.assessmentPrompt: In the number 4.378, can {{name}} tell you that the 7 represents 7 hundredths — not 7 tenths or 7 thousandths?
topics.nameZh: 认识小数数位 (Reading Decimal Places)
topics.descriptionZh: 识别给定三位小数中每个数字的值（例如，在4.378中，7代表7个百分之一）
evidenceZh: 说出2.635中每个数字的值（2个一，6个十分之一，3个百分之一，5个千分之一）
解释相邻小数数位（decimal places）之间的关系（每个数位比前一个数位小十倍）
根据给定的数位值写出数字（例如，4个一，0个十分之一，7个百分之一，3个千分之一 = 4.073）
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 在数字4.378中，{{name}}能告诉你7代表7个百分之一（hundredths）——而不是7个十分之一（tenths）或7个千分之一（thousandths）吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Decimal place value (age 11+)
topics.description: Round numbers and measures to an appropriate degree of accuracy including to a specified number of decimal places or significant figures
evidence: Round numbers to a given number of decimal places
Round numbers to a given number of significant figures
Choose an appropriate degree of accuracy for a given context
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} round a measurement like 12.3746 km to 2 decimal places (12.37 km) or 3 significant figures (12.4 km) — and explain when each level of precision is appropriate?
topics.descriptionZh: 将数字和测量值四舍五入至适当的精确度，包括保留指定的小数位数 (decimal places) 或有效数字 (significant figures)
evidenceZh: 将数字四舍五入至指定的小数位数 (decimal places)
将数字四舍五入至指定的有效数字位数 (significant figures)
根据具体情境选择合适的精确度 (degree of accuracy)
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否将诸如12.3746公里之类的测量值四舍五入到2位小数（12.37公里）或3位有效数字（12.4公里）——并解释每种精度 (precision) 在何种情况下适用？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Fractions on a number line
topics.description: Understand and use place value for decimals, measures, and integers of any size; extend the number system to include all positive and negative integers, decimals, and fractions on a single number line
evidence: Identify the value of any digit in numbers of any size including decimals
Place positive and negative integers, decimals, and fractions on a number line
Use place value to compare and order numbers across the full number system
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} place a mix of numbers — like 3, −2, 0.5, −1.75, and ¼ — all on the same number line, in the right order?
topics.nameZh: 数轴上的分数 (Fractions on a number line)
topics.descriptionZh: 理解并使用任意大小的小数、度量和整数的数位（place value）；扩展数系，将所有正负整数、小数和分数包含在同一条数轴（number line）上。
evidenceZh: 识别任意大小数字（包括小数）中任何数位的值（value of any digit）
在数轴（number line）上标出正负整数、小数和分数
利用数位（place value）在整个数系中比较和排列数字
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否将一组混合数字——例如 3、−2、0.5、−1.75 和 ¼——按正确的顺序全部标注在同一条数轴（number line）上？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Fractions on a number line (age 11+)
topics.description: Order positive and negative integers, decimals, and fractions on a number line; use the symbols =, ≠, <, >, ≤, ≥ to compare values including negative numbers and mixed representations
evidence: Order a mixed set of positive and negative integers, decimals, and fractions
Use the symbols =, ≠, <, >, ≤, ≥ correctly in mathematical statements
Compare numbers presented in different forms such as 0.75 and 3/4
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is given a mixed list like 2.5, −3, ¾, 0, and −0.5, can they put them in order from least to greatest using a number line if needed?
topics.nameZh: 数轴上的分数（11岁及以上）
topics.descriptionZh: 在数轴上对正负整数、小数和分数进行排序；使用符号 =、≠、<、>、≤、≥ 来比较包括负数和混合表示形式在内的数值。
evidenceZh: 对正负整数、小数和分数的混合集合进行排序
在数学表达式中正确使用符号 =、≠、<、>、≤、≥
比较不同形式表示的数，例如 0.75 和 3/4
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果给 {{name}} 一个包含 2.5、−3、¾、0 和 −0.5 等数字的混合列表，他们能否在需要时借助数轴将它们从小到大进行排序？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Numbers on a number line
topics.description: Understand the absolute value of a rational number as its distance from zero on the number line; interpret absolute value as magnitude in real-world contexts; distinguish absolute value comparisons from ordering statements
evidence: Define absolute value as distance from zero on a number line
Calculate the absolute value of positive and negative rational numbers
Distinguish between comparing absolute values and comparing signed numbers in real-world contexts
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} tell you that the absolute value of −7 is 7 — because it's 7 steps from zero on a number line regardless of direction — and use this idea to compare distances?
topics.nameZh: 数轴上的数 (Numbers on a number line)
topics.descriptionZh: 理解有理数 (rational number) 的绝对值 (absolute value) 是其到数轴 (number line) 上零点的距离；在现实情境中将绝对值解释为数量大小 (magnitude)；区分绝对值比较与数值排序 (ordering statements)
evidenceZh: 将绝对值定义为数轴上到零点的距离
计算正负有理数的绝对值
在现实情境中区分比较绝对值与比较带符号数 (signed numbers)
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否告诉你 −7 的绝对值是 7——因为它在数轴上距离零点有 7 个步长，与方向无关——并运用这一概念来比较距离？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Square and cube numbers
topics.description: Use integer powers and associated real roots (square, cube, and higher); recognise powers of 2, 3, 4, and 5; distinguish between exact representations of roots and their decimal approximations
evidence: Calculate squares, cubes, and higher integer powers of whole numbers
Find square roots and cube roots of perfect squares and perfect cubes
Recognise key powers (powers of 2 up to 2¹⁰, powers of 3 up to 3⁵, etc.) and distinguish exact roots from approximations
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} work out that √25 = 5 and ∛27 = 3 — knowing these are the inverse of squaring and cubing — and say whether √50 is closer to 7 or 8?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用整数次幂及其相关的实数根（平方根、立方根及更高次方根）；识别2、3、4和5的次幂；区分根式的精确表示与其十进制近似值
evidenceZh: 计算整数的平方、立方及更高次整数幂
求完全平方数和完全立方数的平方根与立方根
识别关键次幂（如2的次幂直到2¹⁰，3的次幂直到3⁵等），并区分精确根与近似根
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}}能否算出√25 = 5且∛27 = 3——知道这是平方和立方的逆运算——并判断√50是更接近7还是8？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Estimating by rounding
topics.description: Use approximation through rounding to estimate answers and calculate possible resulting errors expressed using inequality notation a < x ≤ b; understand upper and lower bounds of rounded values
evidence: Estimate the answer to a calculation by rounding all values appropriately
Calculate upper and lower bounds of a rounded measurement
Express error intervals using inequality notation
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a length is measured as 7 cm to the nearest cm, can {{name}} say the actual length could be anywhere from 6.5 cm to 7.5 cm — understanding that rounding creates a range of possible values?
topics.nameZh: 通过四舍五入进行估算 (Estimating by rounding)
topics.descriptionZh: 使用四舍五入法进行近似计算以估算答案，并使用不等式符号 (inequality notation) a < x ≤ b 计算和表示可能产生的误差；理解四舍五入后数值的上限 (upper bound) 和下限 (lower bound)。
evidenceZh: 通过适当地四舍五入所有数值来估算计算结果
计算四舍五入后测量值的上限 (upper bound) 和下限 (lower bound)
使用不等式符号 (inequality notation) 表示误差区间
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果一个长度测量为 7 厘米（精确到 1 厘米），{{name}} 能否说明实际长度可能在 6.5 厘米到 7.5 厘米之间——从而理解四舍五入会产生一个可能值的范围？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Powers of Ten Notation
topics.description: Interpret and compare numbers in standard form A × 10ⁿ where 1 ≤ A < 10 and n is an integer; convert between ordinary numbers and standard form
evidence: Convert large and small numbers into standard form A × 10ⁿ
Convert numbers from standard form back to ordinary notation
Compare and order numbers given in standard form
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write 3,400,000 as 3.4 × 10⁶ and convert back — understanding that standard form is a shorthand for very large or very small numbers?
topics.descriptionZh: 解释和比较标准形式（科学记数法）A × 10ⁿ（其中 1 ≤ A < 10 且 n 为整数）表示的数；在普通数字与标准形式之间进行转换
evidenceZh: 将大数和小数转换为标准形式 A × 10ⁿ
将标准形式的数字转换回普通记数法
比较和排列以标准形式给出的数字
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否将 3,400,000 写成 3.4 × 10⁶ 并进行反向转换——理解标准形式是极大或极小数字的简写方式？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Number Sets & Infinity
topics.description: Appreciate the infinite nature of the sets of integers, real numbers, and rational numbers; position integers on a number line and distinguish between rational and irrational numbers
evidence: Explain that rational numbers can be written as a fraction of two integers and have terminating or repeating decimals
Give examples of irrational numbers and explain why their decimal expansions neither terminate nor repeat
Appreciate that between any two numbers there are infinitely many other numbers
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain that numbers like √2 and π can't be written as exact fractions — and that their decimal expansions go on forever without repeating?
topics.descriptionZh: 体会整数集、实数集 (real numbers) 和有理数集 (rational numbers) 的无限性；在数轴 (number line) 上标出整数的位置，并区分有理数和无理数 (irrational numbers)
evidenceZh: 解释有理数可以写成两个整数的分数形式，并且具有有限小数或循环小数
举出无理数的例子，并解释为什么它们的小数展开既不终止也不循环
体会任意两个数之间都存在着无穷多个其他数
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否解释像 √2 和 π 这样的数不能写成精确的分数——并且它们的小数部分是无限不循环的？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Equally Likely Outcomes
topics.description: Understand that 'equally likely' means every outcome has exactly the same chance of occurring; identify whether a given situation has equally likely outcomes (a fair coin, a fair die, a spinner with equal sections) or unequally likely outcomes (a bag with more of one colour, a spinner with unequal sections)
evidence: Explain that a fair coin has equally likely outcomes because heads and tails each have the same chance
Identify whether a spinner with unequal sections has equally likely outcomes or not, and explain why
Give an example of a situation with equally likely outcomes and one without, explaining the difference
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} tell the difference between a fair situation — like rolling a normal die where every number has the same chance — and an unfair one, like a bag with many more of one colour than another?
topics.descriptionZh: 理解“等可能 (equally likely)”意味着每种结果发生的机会完全相同；识别给定情境是具有等可能结果（如公平的硬币 (fair coin)、公平的骰子 (fair die)、各区域面积相等的转盘 (spinner)）还是非等可能结果（如某种颜色球更多的袋子、各区域面积不等的转盘）
evidenceZh: 解释公平的硬币具有等可能结果，因为正面和反面出现的机会相同
判断分区不等的转盘是否具有等可能结果，并解释原因
举出一个具有等可能结果的情境例子和一个不具有的情况，并解释两者的区别
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 能否区分公平情境（例如掷普通的骰子 (normal die)，每个数字出现的机会相同）和不公平情境（例如一个袋子里某种颜色的球比另一种颜色的多得多）？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Likelihood Language
topics.description: Use probability language to describe and compare the likelihood of everyday events using words such as certain, likely, even chance, unlikely, impossible
evidence: Place five everyday events (e.g. 'the sun will rise tomorrow', 'it will snow in July', 'I'll flip heads') on a scale from impossible to certain
Use 'likely', 'unlikely', 'certain', 'impossible', and 'even chance' correctly to describe different events
Explain why pulling a red ball from a bag of mostly red balls is 'likely' but not 'certain'
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} use words like "certain," "likely," "unlikely," and "impossible" correctly — for example, knowing that rolling a 7 on a normal die is impossible but rolling an even number is likely?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用概率语言来描述和比较日常事件发生的可能性，使用诸如“确定 (certain)”、“很可能 (likely)”、“机会均等 (even chance)”、“不太可能 (unlikely)”和“不可能 (impossible)”等词语。
evidenceZh: 将五个日常事件（例如“明天太阳会升起”、“七月会下雪”、“我会掷出正面”）放置在从“不可能”到“确定”的量表上
正确使用“很可能 (likely)”、“不太可能 (unlikely)”、“确定 (certain)”、“不可能 (impossible)”和“机会均等 (even chance)”来描述不同的事件
解释为什么从大部分是红球的袋子里抽出一个红球是“很可能 (likely)”但不是“确定 (certain)”的
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 是否能正确使用“确定”、“很可能”、“不太可能”和“不可能”等词语——例如，知道在普通骰子上掷出7是“不可能”的，而掷出偶数是“很可能”的？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Ordering Likelihoods
topics.description: Compare the likelihood of different events and order them from least to most likely — including situations with unequal outcomes such as a bag with more of one colour than another, or a spinner with sections of different sizes — and explain reasoning using informal language
evidence: Order four or more events from least likely to most likely and justify each placement
Compare likelihoods when outcomes are not equally likely — e.g. 'Drawing red from a bag with 7 red and 3 blue is more likely than drawing blue'
Explain why some events are closer to 'even chance' and others are closer to 'certain' or 'impossible'
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a bag has 8 red counters and 2 blue ones, does {{name}} understand that picking red is much more likely than picking blue — and can they put different events in order from least to most likely?
topics.descriptionZh: 比较不同事件发生的可能性，并按从最不可能到最可能的顺序进行排列——包括结果不均等的情况，例如一个袋子中某种颜色的球比另一种多，或一个转盘的不同区域大小不一——并使用日常语言解释推理过程
evidenceZh: 将四个或更多事件按从最不可能到最可能的顺序排列，并说明每次排列的理由
当结果发生的可能性不均等时比较可能性——例如，‘从装有7个红球和3个蓝球的袋子中摸出红球的可能性大于摸出蓝球’
解释为什么有些事件更接近‘机会均等（even chance）’，而另一些更接近‘必然（certain）’或‘不可能（impossible）’
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果一个袋子里有8个红色筹码和2个蓝色筹码，{{name}}是否理解摸出红色的可能性远大于摸出蓝色的可能性——并且他们能否将不同事件按从最不可能到最可能的顺序排列？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Probability as a Fraction
topics.description: Describe the probability of simple equally-likely outcomes using unit fractions: the probability of rolling a 6 on a fair die is 1/6, flipping heads is 1/2, picking one specific colour from three equally represented colours is 1/3; place these fractional probabilities on a 0-to-1 probability scale
evidence: State that the probability of rolling a 6 on a fair die is 1/6 and explain why
Express the probability of picking a red card from a standard deck as 26/52 or 1/2
Write the probability of a simple event as a fraction: favourable outcomes over total outcomes
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} flips a fair coin, do they know the probability of getting heads is 1/2 — and can they express similar simple probabilities as fractions and place them on a 0-to-1 scale?
topics.nameZh: 用分数表示概率 (Probability as a Fraction)
topics.descriptionZh: 使用单位分数 (unit fractions) 描述简单等可能事件的概率：掷公平骰子得到6的概率是1/6，抛硬币得到正面的概率是1/2，从三种等量颜色中挑选一种特定颜色的概率是1/3；并将这些分数形式的概率标注在0到1的概率尺度 (probability scale) 上。
evidenceZh: 说明掷公平骰子得到6的概率是1/6，并解释原因
将一副标准扑克牌中抽到红牌的概率表示为26/52或1/2
用分数写出简单事件的概率：有利结果数除以总结果数 (favourable outcomes over total outcomes)
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果{{name}}抛掷一枚公平硬币，他们是否知道得到正面的概率是1/2——并且能否将类似的简单概率用分数表示，并标注在0到1的概率尺度上？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Simple Chance Experiments
topics.description: Conduct simple probability experiments — flipping a coin, rolling a die, pulling coloured counters from a bag — record results, and compare experimental outcomes with expected theoretical outcomes
evidence: Flip a coin 20 times, record heads and tails in a tally chart, and describe what they notice about the results
Roll a die 30 times and compare how often each number came up with what they expected
Pull counters from a bag, record results, and explain whether the outcomes matched their prediction
topics.assessmentPrompt: Has {{name}} ever done an experiment like flipping a coin or rolling a die lots of times, recorded the results in a tally chart, and noticed any patterns in what came up?
topics.nameZh: 简单概率实验 (Simple Chance Experiments)
topics.descriptionZh: 进行简单的概率实验 (probability experiments) —— 如抛硬币 (flipping a coin)、掷骰子 (rolling a die)、从袋中抽取彩色筹码 (pulling coloured counters from a bag) —— 记录结果，并将实验结果与预期的理论结果 (theoretical outcomes) 进行比较。
evidenceZh: 抛硬币20次，在划记表 (tally chart) 中记录正面和反面，并描述他们对结果的观察
掷骰子30次，并将每个数字出现的次数与他们的预期进行比较
从袋中抽取彩色筹码 (coloured counters)，记录结果，并解释实际结果是否与他们的预测相符
topics.assessmentPromptZh: {{name}} 是否曾经做过像多次抛硬币或掷骰子这样的实验，在划记表 (tally chart) 中记录结果，并注意到出现的结果中有什么规律？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Calculating Simple Probability
topics.description: Calculate the probability of a simple event with equally likely outcomes using the formula: probability = number of favourable outcomes ÷ total number of possible outcomes; express the result as a fraction in its simplest form; apply to rolling dice, drawing from bags, and other simple chance situations
evidence: Calculate the probability of drawing a blue marble from a bag of 3 blue and 7 red as 3/10
Use the formula P(event) = favourable outcomes ÷ total outcomes to solve at least three different problems
Explain why increasing the number of favourable outcomes increases the probability
topics.assessmentPrompt: If there are 3 red and 7 blue balls in a bag, can {{name}} work out the probability of picking a red one and express it as a fraction in its simplest form?
topics.descriptionZh: 使用公式计算等可能结果的简单事件的概率（Probability）：概率 = 有利结果数 ÷ 可能结果总数；将结果表示为最简分数；并应用于掷骰子、从袋子中摸球及其他简单的随机情境中。
evidenceZh: 计算从装有3个蓝色和7个红色弹珠的袋子中摸出蓝色弹珠的概率为3/10
使用公式P(事件) = 有利结果数 ÷ 结果总数，解答至少三个不同的问题
解释为什么增加有利结果的数量会使概率变大
topics.assessmentPromptZh: 如果袋子里有3个红球和7个蓝球，{{name}}能计算出摸到红球的概率，并将其表示为最简分数吗？

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Experimental vs Theoretical
topics.description: Run repeated probability experiments and compare experimental (relative frequency) results with theoretical predictions; understand and demonstrate that as the number of trials increases, the experimental probability tends towards the theoretical probability — and that short runs can give very different results
evidence: Roll a die 60 times and compare experimental frequencies with the expected 10 per number
Explain why experimental results don't exactly match theoretical predictions but get closer with more trials
Predict what would happen if the experiment were repeated 600 times instead of 60
